jobs.title: Solutions and Lakehouse Architect
jobs.description: **About Peregrine** Peregrine Advisors is a rapidly growing AI and data innovation hub helping government solve hard problems and deliver better outcomes. We work across the full lifecycle—from strategy and governance through architecture, engineering, analytics, AI, visualization, and training—for clients including the SEC, PCAOB, DDOT, and DCAA. Our clients describe our support as “absolutely excellent” and our people as “instrumental to organization’s success.” Winner of the United Nations COP27 Datathon, our work has earned all Exceptional CPARS ratings, SEC Chair’s Awards, the SEC Vision Award, and recognition from FDA leadership. We are also built differently. Peregrine is the first and only social enterprise organized as a Benefit Corporation and SBA 8(a) company focused on AI and data for government. We believe business success should create client value, social value, and opportunity for our people. As we enter our next stage of growth, we need dependable, motivated, and skilled people who have a combination of intellectual curiosity and intellectual courage. With new clients, larger programs, and expanding responsibilities, the people joining Peregrine now will have the opportunity to help shape the company we become. **People first. Ownership always.** We solve problems through people, process, and technology, in that order. Technology matters, but people make transformation happen. That principle defines our culture. Trust and motivation are the foundational pillars of delivery on which our skills stand. We hire people we can trust, who care deeply about what they do, take ownership, learn quickly, help one another, and refuse to walk past a problem because it belongs to someone else. At Peregrine, you are not joining simply to fill a position. You are joining a team, taking ownership of a mission, and helping build a company. If that excites you, we should talk. At Peregrine Advisors, you will help design and build the lakehouse that a federal agency's data products, reporting, and machine learning run on. But we hire people, not seats. As the work evolves, you will learn new systems and tools, take on greater responsibility, and help develop the firm's capabilities, tools, and lines of business. We move our best to where the hardest problems are. This is a full\-time W\-2 position with a salary of $120,000 to $140,000 per year. It is a remote position. The initial engagement requires United States citizenship; dual citizenship and green card holders are prohibited by the contract terms. It also requires the ability to satisfy the required suitability, security, and access requirements. **Your first project** A lakehouse keeps data in open, low\-cost storage, as a data lake does, and adds the transactions, schemas, and governance of a data warehouse. Your first project will likely have you owning defined parts of the target lakehouse architecture on Azure Databricks and guiding their implementation within the program's established architecture. Depending on the assignment, you may: * Design components of the lakehouse on Azure Databricks, including the medallion layers that carry data from raw ingestion to curated, business\-ready tables, and the Delta Lake storage beneath them. * Implement and extend the agency's Unity Catalog governance model, including catalogs, schemas, access controls, lineage, and the data classifications the agency's policies require. * Build the data models the business reads from, using dimensional models for reporting and Data Vault where history and auditability matter. * Connect the lakehouse to the sources it does not hold through Lakehouse Federation, and to the analysts who use it through Databricks Structured Query Language (SQL) and Power BI. * Document design decisions and reference patterns for the components you own, and review implementation against them. You deliver components the agency can explain, govern, and extend. You make the tradeoffs explicit, write them down, and leave the team patterns it can apply without you in the room. This is where you start, not the shape of your career here. **Requirements** * 4\+ years of data architecture, data engineering, or analytics engineering experience, including design work on a production data platform * Bachelor's degree * Hands\-on Azure Databricks work, including Delta Lake and the medallion architecture * Data governance in Unity Catalog, including access control, lineage, and data classification * Data modeling for analytics, including dimensional modeling; Data Vault is a plus * Advanced SQL and working Python, including PySpark * Serving data to analysts and reporting tools, for example through Databricks SQL and Power BI * Writing the decision records, standards, and diagrams that engineers and reviewers follow * Delivery experience in a federal government environment, working to its security, access, and review processes * Proficiency in writing, PowerPoint, and Excel * United States citizenship; dual citizenship and green card holders are prohibited by the contract terms * The ability to satisfy the required suitability, security, and access requirements **Preferred** * Experience on a federal system accredited at Impact Level 5 (IL\-5\) or higher * Data architecture work in Microsoft Azure and at least one additional cloud platform, such as Amazon Web Services (AWS) or Google Cloud * Lakehouse Federation, Databricks SQL warehouses, or Azure Data Factory * Databricks certification, or a Microsoft Azure architecture or data certification * Federal data governance experience, including records, privacy, and security controls * Familiarity with artificial intelligence (AI)\-assisted developer tooling **Who you are** You think in systems and in the people who will use them. You can explain why a table belongs in one layer and not another, and you would rather settle a design question once in a written decision than reopen it in every review. You work within an established architecture and improve it from the inside. You experiment, fail, learn, and repeat quickly. You would rather own an outcome than be handed a task. **What you bring** * Hands\-on design work on Azure Databricks, including Delta Lake, the medallion architecture, and Unity Catalog. * Data modeling judgment across dimensional and Data Vault approaches, and a sense of which one a problem needs. * The writing discipline that turns an architecture into standards a team can follow. You adapt your development workflow as AI tools evolve, using them to help implement, test, and improve the components you own. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, US
jobs.description: Develop Health is on a mission to use AI to radically accelerate access to life\-saving medications. By automating complex, manual healthcare processes—like benefit verification and prior authorization— **we've been growing rapidly and over the past couple of years have helped over 3\.6 million patients!** We’re partnering with some of the largest pharmacy benefit managers and payers in the nation, revolutionizing how healthcare interactions occur by eliminating human delays and inefficiencies. Our small, elite team of founders and engineers have previously launched and exited successful healthcare startups including Rupa Health and Canvas Medical. We are now scaling rapidly following a major funding round. **About The Role** ------------------ We're looking for a **Staff Software Engineer** who wants to set the direction for AI products that do real work in healthcare, and still write a lot of the code. You'll lead projects that span systems, from the experience prescribers see to the services and AI behind it, get people aligned on the approach, and see it through to adoption. Success here looks like the whole team shipping faster and more reliably, not just you. Some of what you'd lead, from setting the direction to seeing it adopted: * **One routing model for every insurer.** Today, where a request goes depends on rules scattered across the system. You’ll design a single model that works across every channel and move every flow onto it, so prescribers can hit send and trust it lands in the right place. * **AI that does the work inside the prescriber’s tools.** You’ll set the technical direction for the AI that reads clinical notes and works through insurance rules, and shape how prescribers experience it, so requests move forward without pulling them away from patients. * **The workflow engine behind every request.** Requests move between our AI, our operations team, prescribers, and insurers over days or weeks. You’ll decide whether to evolve or replace the engine that coordinates it, so nothing stalls and everyone can see where a request stands. * **Coverage answers at the moment of prescription.** You’ll set the direction for the models and data that predict cost and requirements, and bring those answers into the prescriber’s workflow before they hit send. * **How we build with AI.** We move fast with coding agents. You'll raise the bar, set standard and drive adoption of cutting edge agentic coding across the engineering team. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * At least 8 years building and shipping production software, including setting the technical direction for a system multiple teams depend on and seeing it through to adoption. * You decide which problems are worth solving. You work with users and stakeholders to frame broad goals, negotiate scope, and push back when a requirement works against the outcome. * You design for where the product is going, not just the next feature. You weigh alternatives and failure modes across systems, know when an existing design needs to be replaced, and still reach for the simplest path there. * You raise the bar for the whole team. You spot the failures that keep coming back, fix the patterns behind them, and mentor engineers into owning bigger work. * You push coding agents to their limits, hold their code to the same bar as your own, and turn what you learn into practices the whole team uses. **You Don't Need** ------------------ Healthcare experience. We'll teach you the domain. You also don't need a PM background, experience building for planet\-scale traffic, or management experience. **How We Work** --------------- We start simple and add complexity when we have a reason to. We care a lot about getting things right, because a dropped request here means a patient waits longer for their medication, and we handle protected health information every day. Engineers own their work from the first customer conversation through launch and after. The people who do well here push hard, take feedback well, and ask a lot of questions. **What We Offer** ----------------- * 250K–300K base plus meaningful early\-stage equity * Medical, dental, and vision. We pay 100% of your premiums and 50% for dependents * 401(k) with a 4% match * Up to 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave, starting from your first day * Flexible PTO and all major holidays * A high\-end workstation and budget for the AI tools you want to use * A $5K relocation bonus Visa sponsorship will be considered on a case\-by\-case basis. As an early\-stage company, our ability to provide immigration support depends on the role, applicable immigration requirements, anticipated costs, and timing. Support is subject to review by immigration counsel and company approval. At this time we do not support new H1\-B visas for candidates outside the United States. **Interviewing With Us** ------------------------ There are three steps: a recruiter call, an engineering skills screen built around a realistic problem instead of trivia, and an onsite at one of our Bay Area offices. The whole process usually takes about two weeks, and we'll get back to you within a day after each step. Develop Health is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants of every background. Compensation Range: $250K \- $300K

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Authentication Platform
jobs.description: Are you ready to shape the future of authentication? Join 1Kosmos and help lead the next wave in identity assurance and passwordless innovation. 1Kosmos is driving the future of identity security, empowering organizations to eliminate passwords and establish trust at every step of the identity lifecycle. As a vibrant team of innovators, we develop advanced authentication solutions trusted by some of the world’s leading brands. Join us as we create a passwordless world and set new standards for digital identity assurance. **Your Title:** Engineering Manager, Authentication Platform **Your Location:** Hybrid – Edison, NJ HQ **You** **Report to:** SVP of Engineering and Chief Architect **Compensation:** $180,000 or more depending upon experience At 1Kosmos, we are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead technical execution across our Authentication (Auth) Platform, the passwordless, phishing\-resistant authentication, SSO, and access services that sit in the login path for millions of users. This is for someone who stays close to the code, brings sound technical judgment, and turns product requirements into secure, highly available, and shippable solutions. You will guide a distributed team of 4\-6 engineers based in India while working closely with Product and the Head of Engineering from our Edison office. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role: you will set architectural direction, make design decisions, remove delivery blockers, uphold release quality, and step into the codebase when the team or situation calls for it. You bring an “always sleeveless” mindset: no issue is too small to investigate, no production incident is beneath you, and no architectural decision should be made without understanding the system that exists today. **What you will do:** * **Steer architecture and design:** Understand the existing Auth Platform deeply — authentication flows, identity federation, session and token services, and integrations and guide the team toward technically sound designs that align with current capabilities and the longer\-term architectural direction. * **Turn product needs into executable engineering work:** Partner with Product early to shape requirements, clarify trade\-off s, sequence work, and translate feature requests into practical, well\-defined engineering plans. * **Own Auth Platform delivery:** Keep incoming work organized, priorities clear, dependencies visible, and commitments on track across passwordless login, MFA, SSO, and customer integrations. * **Lead through technical credibility:** Participate actively in design discussions, code reviews, debugging, and technical problem\-solving. Step into the codebase and contribute directly when needed to validate an approach, unblock a critical effort, or resolve a production issue. * **Set the release\-quality bar:** Establish and uphold standards for design review, code quality, test readiness, performance, security, standards compliance, and release decisions. * **Own production outcomes:** Authentication is in the critical path of every user session. Participate directly in incident response, troubleshooting, root\-cause analysis, and corrective actions for Auth services, with a focus on availability and login latency. * **Build secure, reliable systems:** Drive sound engineering decisions across Node.js microservices, identity protocols, cloud\-based SaaS deployments, Kubernetes, AWS, observability, performance, and platform resilience. * **Guide and unblock the team:** Provide daily technical direction, remove obstacles, facilitate effective delivery discussions, and help engineers make good decisions without becoming a status only manager. * **Bring a point of view:** Make timely, well\-reasoned technical decisions amid ambiguity, clearly communicate trade\-offs, and constructively challenge approaches when needed. * **Foster collaborative execution:** Work closely with Product, QA, Security, and engineering peers to create a low\-ego environment where ownership, rigor, and delivery matter. **What you bring:** * **10\+ years of software engineering experience**, including recent experience guiding technical delivery and engineering teams in a hands\-on capacity. * **Identity and access management depth:** Experience building or operating authentication, SSO, or IAM platforms in production. * **Proven hands\-on technical leadership:** Able to lead by example through architecture, code reviews, debugging, technical decision\-making, and direct contribution when a critical need arises. * **Sound technical judgment:** You form an informed point of view, explain trade\-offs clearly, and make decisions when the answer is not obvious. * **Demonstrated delivery leadership:** Experience organizing engineering work, identifying dependencies and risks, unblocking teams, and delivering quality capabilities predictably. * **Strong quality and operational rigor:** Experience with design and code reviews, automated testing, observability, incident response, root\-cause analysis, and release readiness for high availability services. * **Security\-first mindset:** Practical understanding of secure software development, threat modeling, data boundaries, platform security, and performance considerations in enterprise SaaS. * **Collaborative technical leadership:** Ability to influence through technical depth, clarity, and follow through while working effectively across US and India\-based teams. * Willingness to work from Edison, NJ three days per week and maintain meaningful working overlap with the India\-based Auth engineering team. **Technical Skills:** * **Programming Stack:** Node.js / JavaScript / TypeScript \- Deep, practical experience building, debugging, reviewing, and supporting production Node.js services. Node.js is the primary language across our microservices environment. * **Java and Go:** Working knowledge of Java and Go is secondary but not mandatory. * **Identity protocols and standards:** Strong working knowledge of OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect, and SAML 2\.0; FIDO2 / WebAuthn and passkeys; JWT and token lifecycle management (issuance, refresh, revocation); and NIST 800\-63B authenticator assurance levels. * **Authentication and access:** Experience with passwordless and multi\-factor authentication, session management, adaptive / risk\-based authentication, and authorization models (RBAC/ABAC). * **Enterprise identity integrations:** Familiarity with directory services (LDAP, Active Directory, Entra ID), SCIM provisioning, and integrating with IdPs and service providers such as Okta, Ping, and Microsoft. * **Applied cryptography:** Practical understanding of PKI, certificates, key management, signing and encryption, and secure secrets handling. * **Microservices and distributed systems:** Strong experience with service\-oriented architecture, API design, inter\-service communication, resiliency patterns, scalability, and performance. * **Cloud\-based SaaS platforms:** Demonstrated experience building and operating secure, scalable, multi\-tenant SaaS platforms. * **Cloud Stack:** AWS, GCP, Azure \- Strong working knowledge of AWS services, cloud deployment patterns, security, monitoring, reliability, and cost\-aware operational practices. Hands\-on experience with containerized workloads, Docker, Kubernetes, deployment practices, and operational troubleshooting. * **CI/CD and release engineering:** Experience with automated build, test, deployment, and rollback practices that support predictable and reliable releases. * **Performance engineering:** Experience diagnosing and improving latency, throughput, scalability, and reliability in high\-volume, latency\-sensitive distributed systems. **Who thrives here:** * Builders who stay close to real technical problems and lead by example. * Engineers who form a clear point of view, make informed decisions, and take responsibility for outcomes. * Problem solvers who can move between architecture, delivery details, debugging, and production incidents. * Pragmatic collaborators who understand existing systems before proposing change. * People energized by security, performance, reliability, and protecting users from identity fraud. * Leaders who earn trust through technical credibility, clarity, and follow\-through. **What we offer:** * Opportunity to build and lead a critical function at a high\-growth Series B startup * Competitive salary and equity package * Health, dental, and vision insurance * Unlimited PTO Policy * Collaborative, fast\-paced culture where your impact is immediate and visible

jobs.title: Director, AI Security Enablement
jobs.description: ABM (NYSE: ABM) is a leading provider of facility solutions with revenues of approximately $8\.7 billion and over 130,000 employees in 300\+ offices deployed throughout the United States and various international locations. ABM’s comprehensive capabilities include electrical \& lighting, energy solutions, facilities engineering, HVAC \& mechanical, janitorial, landscape \& turf, mission critical solutions and parking, provided through stand\-alone or integrated solutions. Reporting directly to the SVP \& CISO, the Director, AI Security Enablement will build and lead ABM's enterprise AI security strategy to include imbedding security into artificial intelligence, machine learning, and agentic AI across the business, spanning ABM’s AI security tooling, internal AI/ML development, and third\-party AI products and vendors. This leader designs and champions the guardrails, governance, and technical controls that allow ABM to adopt AI and agentic AI capabilities quickly and confidently, while protecting the business, its customers, and its employees from the emerging risks these technologies introduce. The role carries direct people\-leadership responsibility, building and developing a team of approximately three AI/ML security specialists, and also requires strong matrix\-management skills to coordinate and drive security outcomes through engineers, developers, data scientists, and vendor teams who do not report directly to this role. Highly organized program and stakeholder management is essential: this leader will run multiple concurrent security\-enablement initiatives across internal development teams and third\-party AI vendors, track them to completion, and communicate progress clearly to technical teams, business stakeholders and executive leadership. The Director, AI Security Enablement must have hands\-on depth in both traditional cybersecurity and modern AI security — including large language models (LLMs), generative AI, and agentic AI architectures where autonomous or semi\-autonomous agents take actions, call tools, and access systems and data on behalf of users or other systems. This role will establish cross\-functional partnerships across Security, Engineering, Data Science \& AI/ML teams, Legal, Risk, Privacy, and Operations to enable innovation while protecting the organization from emerging AI risks. **Benefits**: ABM offers a comprehensive benefits package. For information about ABM’s benefits, visit ABM Employee Benefits \| Staff \& Management **Pay:** $176,505 \- $260,000 The pay listed is the salary range for this position. Any specific offer will vary based on the successful applicant’s education, experience, skills, abilities, geographic location, and alignment with market data. You will also be eligible to participate in a company incentive or bonus program. ***Hybrid Model****: This leadership position is hybrid Monday\-Thursday. The role may require occasional travel based on business needs.* **Key Responsibilities** * Define and execute the enterprise AI security strategy, roadmap, and governance framework. * Establish policies, standards, and risk management practices for AI technologies. * Embed security\-by\-design principles across the AI lifecycle. * Lead AI threat modeling, security assessments, red teaming, and risk evaluations. * Build and develop a high\-performing AI Security team. * Provide executive\-level reporting on AI security posture, risks, and program maturity. * Partner with business and technology leaders to accelerate secure AI adoption. * Oversee AI\-related incident response, investigations, and remediation efforts. * Drive continuous improvement through metrics, industry benchmarking, and emerging threat monitoring. **What You'll Bring** **AI Security Expertise** * Deep understanding of AI and generative AI security concepts, including large language models (LLMs), agentic AI, autonomous agents, multi\-agent systems, and tool/function\-calling architectures. * Hands\-on experience evaluating and securing AI systems, including prompt injection defenses, jailbreak testing, data leakage prevention, and secure Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) implementations. * Knowledge of AI/ML security controls, governance practices, and security tooling used to monitor, assess, and protect AI environments. **Cloud \& Technology Platforms** * Experience securing AI solutions deployed on major cloud platforms, including AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud. * Familiarity with cloud\-native AI services such as Bedrock, SageMaker, Azure OpenAI Service, and Vertex AI, including associated security controls. **Executive Communication \& Influence** * Ability to translate complex AI security risks into practical business recommendations for technical teams, business leaders, and executive stakeholders. * Exceptional communication, stakeholder management, and cross\-functional leadership skills. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Information Technology, or a related field. * 12\+ years of progressive cybersecurity experience. * 5\+ years of experience leading and developing technical security teams. * 3\+ years leading AI security, AI governance, generative AI, or related cybersecurity programs. * **Governance, Risk \& Compliance** + Working knowledge of leading AI security and governance frameworks, such as NIST AI RMF, OWASP LLM Security Guidance, MITRE ATLAS, ISO 42001, or similar standards. + Understanding of AI\-related regulatory, privacy, and compliance requirements, including GDPR, CCPA, EU AI Act, HIPAA, or comparable frameworks. **Preferred Qualifications** * Master's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, or related field. * CISSP, CISM, CCSP, CDPSE, AI Governance Professional (AIGP), or equivalent AI Security/Governance certifications. **ABM is Equal Opportunity Employer.** ABM is committed to diversity and inclusion and encourages individuals from all backgrounds to apply. Every day, our over 100,000 team members deliver essential services that make spaces cleaner, safer, and efficient, enhancing the overall occupant experience. With over $8 billion in annual revenue and a blue\-chip client base, ABM delivers innovative technologies and sustainable solutions that enhance facilities and empower clients to achieve their goals. jobs.title: Senior Developer, Full-Stack .NET
jobs.description: **Job Summary:** The Senior Full\-Stack .NET Developer balances deep, hands\-on .NET software coding with technical oversight and vendor direction. This position acts as the vital bridge between architectural vision and team execution collaborating closely with our Technical Application Architect through design review and adherence to enterprise coding standards, while independently owning implementation approach and execution across our Azure Cloud infrastructure. A key component of this role involves writing clean, production\-grade .NET code, directing tasks for managed services vendors, verifying the quality of their deliverables, and partnering closely with Software Quality Assurance (SQA) to guarantee robust, thoroughly tested applications. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities:** * Drive hands\-on software development by writing clean, maintainable, and secure code across the entire application stack. * Incorporate design guidance and standards review from the Technical Application Architect while independently determining implementation approach for secure, robust, and scalable cloud applications, as well as desktop and mobile solutions. * Define clear technical requirements, assign development tasks to external managed services partners, and rigorously review their code to ensure alignment with ACCO’s standards. * Collaborate actively with the Software Quality Assurance team to design test plans, facilitate automated and manual testing, and ensure overall application stability prior to deployment. * Build and maintain a diverse application portfolio, focusing heavily on .NET cloud architectures while supporting desktop and mobile initiatives within the Microsoft ecosystem. * Establish, document, and enforce code quality, security protocols, and CI/CD pipelines across internal and external teams to ensure absolute adherence to architectural standards. * Conduct pairing sessions, code reviews, and workshops to help junior and mid\-level developers level up their development, architectures, and overall engineering skills. * Ensure all internal developers and external partners understand and follow our core design patterns, minimizing technical debt. * Build and maintain responsive, component\-driven front\-end interfaces, integrating them cleanly with back\-end services to deliver a high\-quality user experience. **Position Requirements (Work Experience, Skills, Licenses, etc.):** * 6\+ years of professional full\-stack software development experience with a strong focus on hands\-on coding. * Advanced, expert\-level proficiency writing clean code in C\# and the .NET framework (.NET Core / .NET 6 / .NET 8\+), alongside modern front\-end web technologies, including hands\-on experience building single\-page applications with Vue.js. * Hands\-on experience developing, deploying, and managing cloud\-native .NET applications within the Azure Cloud ecosystem. * Strong SQL skills and hands\-on experience working with relational and analytical data platforms, specifically Microsoft SQL Server and Databricks, including writing performant queries and integrating data access into .NET applications. * Proven experience assigning work to third\-party vendors or managed services teams and conducting strict quality control/code reviews on their deliverables. * Strong familiarity with software testing methodologies, collaborating with QA teams, and implementing .NET unit/integration tests (e.g., xUnit, NUnit). * Solid grasp of dependency injection and inversion of control, with hands\-on experience using the built\-in .NET dependency injection container to build loosely coupled, testable, and maintainable applications. **Education and Experience**: ***Required:*** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent practical/industry experience. ***Desired****:* * Experience developing console applications or background services or building cross\-platform mobile applications as single\-page apps using Vue.js with the Quasar framework. * Proven track record of leading, mentoring, or acting as a technical lead for a team of developers. * Certifications such as Azure Developer Associate or Azure Solutions Architect. **ACCO Competencies:** * **Proactivity/Initiative**: Recognizes what needs to be done and accomplishes it in a manner appropriate for one’s level/position and with minimal supervision. * **Perseverance**: Shows wherewithal to fight for difficult goals despite challenges and to bounce back from adversity. * **Motivation/Dedication**: Commits to excellence in pursuing unselfish goals. Initiates action with collective goals, takes responsibility, and shows personal humility. * **Technical Curiosity/Willingness to Learn**: Interest in seeking out new experiences, knowledge, and candid feedback; demonstrating an openness to learning and change. * **Insight**: The ability to gather and make sense of information that suggests new possibilities. * **Engagement**: Shows a knac business strategy. On a personal level has independently developed a vision for short\- and long\-term career success. * **Problem\-Solver**: Ability to identify, analyze, and solve problems in support of personnel, group, department, or organizational objectives. * **Execution**: Effectively takes a vision and translates into action by including the right people. Identify and remove barriers, when possible, to achieve results. Demonstrates appropriate compromise, effective time management, prioritization practices and holds team members (including themselves) accountable for their performance/conduct. * **Professionalism**: Respectfully observes and challenges the status quo with intent for improvement. Can take direction, accept feedback, and take full responsibility for their actions. Lead by example through positive influence and ethical leadership with consideration of the entire organization. **Job Responsibility Level:** No direct reports **Travel Requirements:** Travel required 0\-5% of the time to other office locations. **Hours:** This is an exempt position. Workdays are scheduled from Monday through Friday. Typically, work hours begin and end between 7:00 am and 5:00 pm as scheduled with the position's supervisor. Work outside of regular hours may occasionally be necessary to meet business needs. **Physical Demands:** (The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.) * Must frequently lift and/or move up to **10** pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to **20** pounds. * Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and ability to adjust focus. * Prolonged sitting. * Frequently required to reach with hands and arms. * Occasionally required to stand; walk and stoop, kneel, crouch. Why join ACCO? ACCO Engineered Systems is one of the largest mechanical contractors in the country. Since 1934, owners and builders have selected ACCO to design, install, and maintain more than 250,000 mechanical projects. ACCO is dedicated to the design, fabrication, installation, maintenance and service of commercial and industrial HVAC, refrigeration, plumbing, process piping, and building automation systems. Whether your project is a low or high\-rise office building, a shopping mall, hospital, semi\-conductor fabrication facility or pharmaceutical manufacturing plant…ACCO can design, build, install, and maintain a mechanical system to meet your needs. Here at ACCO, we are a part of something bigger. Just ask our customers: California Academy of Sciences, L.A. Live, and San Francisco 49ers Stadium. While we have been around for 80\+ years, we continue to grow at a dynamic pace. And we are looking for talented individuals to join our team. What's great about working at ACCO is that we’re a big enough company to be the leader in HVAC mechanical contracting in California and the Southwest U.S., but as a 100% employee\-owned ESOP, we’re a private company with a family\-oriented feel. Several of our employees have worked at ACCO for twenty\-five, thirty, and even over forty years! Together, the employees of ACCO are comprised of intelligent, dedicated, and entrepreneurial team members who put customers first and enjoy what they do. **ACCO IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER AA M/F/V/D.** We proudly hire U.S. Military Veterans, and those qualified are encouraged to apply. Equal Employment Opportunity is The Law.\|Pay Transparency Nondiscrimination Provision *ACCO will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment.* **Notice to Outside Recruiters:** Hiring managers are not authorized to review or accept recruiting agreements from any outside recruiting agencies. Outside recruiting agencies should not submit unsolicited resumes without signing the company's recruiting agreement.

jobs.title: Substation Design Engineer
jobs.description: Are you ready to be part of a company that's not just talking about the future, but actively shaping it? Join The AES Corporation, the largest US\-based global power company with a team of 8,300 employees across 12 countries. AES has been **ranked \#1 by BloombergNEF** in renewable energy sales to corporations in the US and Americas for five consecutive years, providing electricity for **millions of people worldwide.** We are proud to foster a strong workplace culture, earning prominent positions in Great Place to Work™ rankings across the markets where we operate. AES was also named one of the World’s Most Ethical Companies for the 13th consecutive year in 2026, highlighting our dedication to integrity, transparency, and responsible business practices. Our spirit of innovation continues to earn industry recognition. AES is the only seven\-time winner of the Edison Electric Institute’s Edison Awards in the twenty\-first century, a distinction honoring global leadership in advancing the electric power industry. If you're ready to be part of a company that's not just adapting to change, but driving it, AES is the place for you. We're not just building a more sustainable future, we're powering it. Apply now and energize your career with a true leader in global energy. At AES Ohio, we're powering the future by delivering safe, reliable, and sustainable energy solutions to the communities we serve. We're looking for a **Substation Design Engineer** who is eager to make a meaningful impact, collaborate with experienced professionals, and grow their engineering career while helping shape the electric grid of tomorrow. Whether you're building on early\-career experience or bringing established expertise, you'll have the opportunity to work on critical infrastructure projects, develop specialized technical skills, and contribute to the reliability of the energy system that supports thousands of customers every day. **Why Join AES Ohio?** * Work on impactful projects that strengthen and modernize the electric grid. * Collaborate with experienced engineers, construction teams, and industry experts. * Gain exposure to high\-voltage substation design and project lifecycle management. * Access professional development opportunities, mentorship, and career growth pathways. * Be part of a company that prioritizes safety, innovation, sustainability, and inclusion. * Contribute to a purpose\-driven organization committed to powering communities and advancing the energy transition. **What You'll Do** As a Substation Design Engineer, you will support the planning, design, and delivery of electrical substation projects ranging from **12kV to 345kV**. You will work closely with multidisciplinary teams to develop engineering solutions that are safe, reliable, and aligned with industry standards. **Key Responsibilities** * Develop detailed designs for all or portions of electrical substations, including: Physical layouts One\-line diagrams Protection and control schematics Wiring diagrams * Create comprehensive engineering design packages in accordance with AES Ohio standards and applicable industry requirements, including IEEE and NERC standards. * Prepare technical specifications for materials and services and support evaluation of vendor proposals and procurement activities. * Partner with field operations and construction teams to provide technical guidance during construction, maintenance, and commissioning activities. * Support the planning, design, and execution of substation capital projects. * Contribute to the continuous improvement of engineering standards, processes, and design databases. * Participate in storm restoration and emergency response efforts when needed, helping restore service to customers safely and efficiently. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering from an ABET\-accredited program. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with Bentley MicroStation or comparable CAD/design software. * Successful completion of the Fundamentals of Engineering (FE) Exam. * Knowledge of electrical substation equipment, including transformers, circuit breakers, relays, instrument transformers, disconnect switches, and related systems. * Understanding of engineering design principles, power systems, and utility infrastructure. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook and Excel. * Commitment to safety and the ability to incorporate safe design practices into all phases of engineering work. **Success in This Role** This role may be a great fit if you: * Enjoy solving complex technical challenges. * Thrive in collaborative, team\-oriented environments. * Communicate effectively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Are organized, detail\-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities. * Have a strong desire to learn, grow, and contribute to the future of energy infrastructure. AES is an Equal Opportunity Employer who is committed to building strength and delivering long\-term sustainability through diversity and inclusion. Respecting all backgrounds, differences and perspectives enables us to improve the lives of our people, customers, suppliers, contractors, and the communities in which we live and work. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity and/or expression, race, national origin, ethnicity, age, religion, marital status, physical or mental disability, pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical condition, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law. E\-Verify Notice: AES will provide the Social Security Administration (SSA) and if necessary, the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) with information from each new employee's I\-9 to confirm work authorization.

jobs.title: Software Engineer II - SDK
jobs.description: Description: The SDK team within AGS is responsible for designing, developing, and implementing both front and back\-end features for use by our internal game studios, as well as leading and supporting company\-wide initiatives to introduce the most modern technologies and frameworks into both internal and customer\-facing products. Developers within SDK work both inside and outside of our game system’s primary codebase to create comprehensive solutions to new requirements and challenges faced by our engineering teams in bringing games to market. Our team places a high value on distribution of knowledge and skills throughout all members, as well as the flexibility to work alone, in groups, or with engineers outside our own team in order to identify and implement creative solutions in gameplay, engine, and platform systems. **Responsibilities:** * Software Engineer IIs on the SDK team are responsible for development of both Platform and Game Presentation features. * You will be an active contributor in all aspects and stages of development, from participating in prototyping, requirements gathering and design, to implementation, documentation, deployment and maintenance. * You will regularly act as a liaison between SDK team and Game Studios to communicate what the game platform can do, assist in solving technical challenges, and identify solutions to allow game requirements to work within the platform. * Your knowledge and skills will be called upon to diagnose and implement optimizations or author coding or memory management strategies to improve game performance. * You may be recruited to research or prototype new features or experimental changes to help improve the platform as a whole. * This position requires a strong work ethic, a desire for continued self\-improvement, and the willingness to engage with new or unfamiliar technologies or frameworks in search of the best solutions. * It requires a commitment to being a positive contributor in both a group dynamic as well as independently, and to efficiently regulate workload within the team’s set objectives. Requirements: * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering or equivalent. * 5\+ years professional software development experience. * 3\+ years of Unity3D or equivalent game development experience. * Contributor to one or more shipped or live products having participated in both design and development activities. * Excellent knowledge of C\# including language fundamentals, OOP design practices and common patterns. * Knowledge of effective testing solutions and tools, as well as strategies for memory and time optimization and verification. * Demonstrate the capability to communicate efficiently and effectively in both written and oral forms. * Demonstrate the capacity for organized, clear problem\-solving skills even when faced with new or unfamiliar information. * Strong internal motivation to be a team player within a fast\-paced, customer\-oriented development environment. **Preferred Skills:** * Shipped project(s) using the Unity3D engine. * Professional experience within the casino gaming or slot gaming sectors. * Skills or knowledge of networking systems TCP/UDP communication or multiplayer systems at a professional level. * Skills or knowledge of graphics pipelines, OpenGL, rendering processes or image processing at a professional level. * Professional experience relating to testing frameworks or test automation. * Experience developing and deploying within a cloud architecture or containerized system architecture. **Note: All offers are contingent upon successful completion of a background check** ***\*Posted positions are not open to third party recruiters and unsolicited resume submissions will be considered free referrals.*** ***AGS is an equal opportunity employer.***

jobs.title: Data Engineer Lead
jobs.description: **Data Engineer Lead** *AIG \| Data Office · Data Engineering* **About The Role** The Data Engineer Lead is a hands\-on engineering role within AIG's Data Engineering organization. You will design, build, and operate production\-grade data pipelines and platforms — and bring sound engineering judgment to every solution you deliver. We actively leverage GenAI tooling — including Claude Code and Snowflake Cortex — as a genuine productivity multiplier across the development lifecycle. We want someone who is motivated to learn, keeps up with a fast\-moving space, and continuously finds new ways to put these tools to work. You will collaborate closely with the product owner, business stakeholders, and fellow engineers. Strong communication and analytical skills matter here as much as technical depth — the ability to ask the right questions, think through trade\-offs clearly, and explain your reasoning is part of the job. **Responsibilities** * Design, build, and operate production\-grade PySpark and Python pipelines on AWS EMR, Glue, and S3 with integrated data quality checks and observability. * Own end\-to\-end delivery of data products from requirements through production, working within an Agile/Scrum framework — including sprint planning, CI/CD, release management, and production readiness * Translate business and product requirements into concrete technical designs, defining pipeline structure, data models, and SLAs. * Demonstrate a sound understanding of architecture and design patterns, evaluate trade\-offs of design decisions, and articulate clear rationale to peers and stakeholders. * Set and enforce engineering standards — coding conventions, data quality frameworks, reusable pipeline patterns, and observability hooks — across the team. * Conduct thorough code reviews and pair with engineers on hard problems, raising the technical quality of the whole team. * Leverage GenAI tooling — such as Claude Code CLI, Snowflake Cortex — throughout the development lifecycle to write better code faster and improve solution quality. * Collaborate with product owners to refine requirements, surface trade\-offs, and push back constructively when scope is technically unworkable. * Communicate design decisions and delivery updates clearly to both engineering peers and non\-technical stakeholders. * Mentor junior engineers through review, pairing, and knowledge sharing, building team capability alongside product delivery. * Produce clear technical documentation — Architecture Decision Record (ADR), runbooks, data dictionaries, and pipeline lineage notes — as a standard part of delivery, not an afterthought. * Evaluate and drive adoption of productivity tooling and best practices, setting team norms for safe and effective use. **Experience/Skills** *Required* * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field. * 7\+ years of hands\-on data engineering experience with a consistent track record delivering production data pipelines end\-to\-end. * Strong command of PySpark, Python, and SQL — including Spark optimization, partition management, and query performance tuning in Snowflake. * Hands\-on experience with AWS data services: S3, Glue, EMR, Aurora, Lambda, IAM, and CloudWatch. * Working knowledge of architecture and design principles — Lakehouse patterns, data modeling, fault\-tolerant ingestion — with demonstrated ability to apply them in practice. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving jobs.title: Full-Stack Engineer
jobs.description: **Role summary** ---------------- Full\-stack engineer building enterprise applications on Azure. You'll maintain our established .NET back end (shared C\# libraries, coding standards, architecture patterns) while building modern, consistent user interfaces in React/TypeScript on our shared design system. You'll use AI\-assisted tools (Claude Code, Claude Design) to deliver production\-grade code against our standards, and you'll own the review that keeps it secure and maintainable. **Why your work matters** ------------------------- Our technology powers solutions that help people harmed by unsafe products and medications. The applications and websites you build help people at some of the hardest moments of their lives: you’ll make the process simpler, faster and more human. **What you'll bring** --------------------- * **Full\-stack experience:** 5\+ years building enterprise applications, with C\#/.NET Core on the back end and React/TypeScript on the front end. * **Azure:** hands\-on with App Services, Functions, Azure SQL, Data Factory, API Management and DevOps. * **APIs and data:** RESTful API design and T\-SQL/Azure SQL database work. * **Engineering discipline:** layered architecture built on shared libraries, documented coding standards and established patterns. * **AI\-assisted development:** you use agentic coding tools (Claude Code preferred) to speed up delivery from structured specifications. You also write and maintain the standards and specs those tools work from. * **Rigorous code review:** you check AI\-generated code against our security, standards and architecture requirements, and fix gaps quickly. * **Delivery:** you build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, automated testing and release management. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Experience building or maintaining a design system or shared component library (design tokens, Tailwind) * Turning Claude Design or Figma designs into production code * Next.js, or WordPress / headless content management * RAG, vector databases or Azure OpenAI * Modernizing legacy apps (Blazor, ASP.NET MVC, jQuery) into microservices * SSRS reporting * Application Insights monitoring *If you don't check every box, please apply anyway. We hire for strong fundamentals and the ability to learn.* **Your first 90 days** ---------------------- * **First 30 days:** Get to know our .NET and Azure platform alongside our lead engineer, and ship your first updates through our deployment pipeline. * **By 60 days:** Take ownership of an existing application and help build our shared design system for a consistent look across our apps and websites. * **By 90 days:** Serve as a trusted backup on our core systems and deliver your first modern application using AI\-assisted development tools.

jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer
jobs.description: #### **Aeroflow Health – Senior Systems Engineer** Aeroflow Health is a national leader in home medical equipment and clinical services. We combine technology, operational excellence, and compassionate expertise to deliver essential products and care directly to patients' homes. At Aeroflow Health, we make healthcare accessible by taking a holistic approach to how we care for our patients. We are equally passionate about taking care of our employees. Recognized as one of the fastest\-growing healthcare companies in the U.S., an Inc. 5000 honoree, and a certified Great Place to Work®, Aeroflow continues to seek ways to be one of the nation's top employers. As we continue to grow, we remain committed to building an exceptional workplace where talented professionals are empowered, supported, and inspired to make a meaningful impact every day. ##### **The Opportunity** Aeroflow Health's IT Operations team plays a critical role in supporting the technology infrastructure that keeps our business running and enables us to serve patients nationwide. Our team manages a diverse technology environment spanning on\-premises infrastructure, virtualized systems, cloud platforms, and enterprise applications. We partner across the organization to ensure our systems are secure, reliable, scalable, and positioned to support the company's evolving needs. As a **Senior Systems Engineer**, you'll have an opportunity to make a meaningful impact on the stability, performance, and future direction of our infrastructure. We're looking for an experienced engineer who brings deep technical expertise, enjoys solving complex infrastructure challenges, and can look beyond immediate issues to anticipate what the business will need next. This is an opportunity for someone who wants to do more than maintain existing systems. You'll help evaluate our current environment, identify opportunities for improvement, strengthen infrastructure performance, and contribute to long\-term capacity planning and technology decisions. You'll work alongside experienced IT professionals in a collaborative environment where your technical knowledge, recommendations, and problem\-solving abilities can make a tangible difference. ##### **Your Primary Responsibilities** As a Senior Systems Engineer, you'll help manage, optimize, and strengthen Aeroflow's enterprise systems and infrastructure while contributing to the team's long\-term technology strategy. Key responsibilities include: * **Infrastructure Administration:** Configure, maintain, troubleshoot, and optimize enterprise systems, including Windows Server environments, virtualization platforms, and associated infrastructure technologies. * **Virtualization \& Storage:** Support and enhance virtualized environments, with particular emphasis on Microsoft Hyper\-V, System Center Virtual Machine Manager (SCVMM), and enterprise storage solutions. * **Infrastructure Optimization:** Evaluate existing infrastructure configurations, identify performance or capacity concerns, and recommend improvements that enhance reliability, efficiency, and scalability. * **Capacity Planning \& Future Readiness:** Monitor infrastructure utilization, anticipate future resource needs, and contribute to hardware planning, budgeting, and long\-term infrastructure decisions. * **Systems Administration:** Manage and support Windows Domain Services, including Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and related technologies. * **Automation \& Efficiency:** Leverage PowerShell scripting and other automation tools to streamline administration, improve consistency, and reduce manual processes. * **Endpoint Management:** Support enterprise endpoint management, software deployments, patching, upgrades, and lifecycle strategies using tools such as SCCM. * **Technical Troubleshooting:** Serve as an escalation resource for complex systems issues, partnering with the Service Desk and other IT teams to identify root causes and implement sustainable solutions. * **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with systems, network, and application teams, along with external vendors, to support infrastructure improvements, system integrations, and technology initiatives. * **Documentation \& Standards:** Develop and maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, and system standards to promote consistency, reliability, and knowledge sharing. * **Security \& Compliance:** Support system security, infrastructure standards, and applicable regulatory requirements, including HIPAA and patient confidentiality. * **Continuous Improvement:** Identify opportunities to strengthen systems, improve operational processes, and contribute to infrastructure architecture and technology planning. Additional expectations: * Maintain knowledge of and comply with applicable laws, regulations, and company policies. * Recognize compliance as a condition of employment and an element of job performance. * Maintain HIPAA compliance and patient confidentiality. * nterprise identity and productivity platforms. * Experience with systems integrations, infrastructure automation, or enterprise architecture initiatives. * Experience working in healthcare or another regulated environment. ##### **What We Look For** We're looking for someone who combines strong technical expertise with curiosity, initiative, and a genuine desire to improve the systems they support. The ideal candidate doesn't simply maintain an environment because that's how it's always been configured. They ask thoughtful questions, evaluate how things are working, and identify opportunities to make them better. You'll be successful here if you: * **Think beyond the immediate problem.** You consider how today's infrastructure decisions will affect performance, scalability, and reliability tomorrow. * **Bring solutions, not just observations.** You can identify an issue, explain why it matters, and recommend a practical path forward. * **Take ownership.** You're comfortable working independently, making recommendations, and following through on technical initiatives. * **Balance expertise with curiosity.** You bring meaningful depth in your areas of specialization while remaining eager to learn and collaborate across technologies. * **Communicate with confidence and humility.** You can explain complex technical issues clearly, welcome different perspectives, and contribute to a collaborative team environment. * **Care about the bigger picture.** You recognize that reliable infrastructure ultimately supports the employees, clinicians, and patients who depend on Aeroflow every day. At Aeroflow, you'll have the opportunity to apply your expertise to meaningful infrastructure challenges, collaborate with experienced professionals, and help shape an environment built for continued growth. ##### **What Aeroflow Offers** Competitive Pay, Health Plans with FSA or HSA options, Dental, and Vision Insurance, Optional Life Insurance, 401K with Company Match, 12 weeks of parental leave for birthing parent/ 4 weeks leave for non\-birthing parent(s), Additional Parental benefits to include fertility stipends, free diapers, breast pump, Paid Holidays, PTO Accrual from day one, Employee Assistance Programs and SO MUCH MORE!! Here at Aeroflow, we are proud of our commitment to all of our employees. Aeroflow Health has been recognized both locally and nationally for the following achievements: * **Family Forward Certified** * **Great Place to Work Certified** * **5000 Best Place to Work award winner** * **HME Excellence Award** * **Sky High Growth Award** If you've been looking for an opportunity that will allow you to make an impact, and an organization with unlimited growth potential, we want to hear from you! Aeroflow Health is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. *We value transparency and candidate safety throughout the hiring process. Aeroflow recruiters may reach out through platforms such as LinkedIn or Indeed; however, all interviews and/or offer coordination and sensitive information requests will occur only through our official communication channels. You will never be asked to provide personal data outside our secure application portal, and all interview or offer details will come from an @aeroflowinc.com email address. We do not conduct interviews via text message or instant\-messaging apps. If you have concerns, please contact our Talent Acquisition team for verification.* Equal Opportunity Employer This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.description: Atmos Energy's Safety and Enterprise Services Enterprise Integrity Management team is looking for a **Sr Data Integrity Analyst.** Alternatively, we will consider qualified profiles for an **Engineer I \- Sr Engineer.** Responsibilities for both positions are outlined below. **As a team member in the Safety and Enterprise Services Enterprise Integrity Management team, responsibilities for this role will include:** * Support data and risk analysis for Atmos Energy’s 75,000 miles of distribution mains and 6,700 miles of transmission pipelines. * Work with team of Engineers and Data Analysts to provide service/support and serve as a resource for Atmos Energy’s operating divisions. * Maintain, update, and administer company programs, plans, manuals, procedures, practices, and standards for integrity management, laboratory testing, and pipe replacement prioritization. * Support audits, inspections, investigations, and litigation. * Coordinate cross\-functional subject matter experts and stakeholder teams across Atmos' states and operating divisions." **Preferred skills include:** * Proficient in MS Excel. * Familiarity with Transmission Integrity, Distribution Integrity a plus. * Familiarity with databases, database applications (i.e. MS Access), data analysis a plus. * Familiarity with GIS, geospatial data a plus. * Familiarity with reporting and visualization tools a plus (i.e. Tableau, PowerBI, etc.). * Familiarity with modeling \& analysis, reliability engineering, asset management a plus. * Familiarity with corrosion management, NACE certifications a plus. THE JOB DESCRIPTIONS BELOW DO NOT ATTEMPT TO LIST ALL OF THE DUTIES THAT ARE OR MAY BE PERFORMED IN THIS POSITION **Primary Duties for Sr Data Integrity Analyst:** 1\. Creates and documents standards to assure the integrity of and consistency in enterprise\-wide system data by acting as a liaison between workgroups. Manages enterprise\-wide data cleansing and validation efforts. 2\. Conducts the root cause analysis of complex issues and exercises discretion to elevate the awareness of critical findings. Identifies, recommends, and implements initiatives to improve processes or increase efficiencies. Establishes quality control measures and reports on performance metrics. 3\. Tests processes and system configurations to identify areas of deficiency and determine appropriate changes to complex application configuration. Works with Business Process/Change Management department to translate business requirements into technical specifications. 4\. Develops, configures, and tests automated data collection systems. Understands and represents division end\-user requirements and perspectives when evaluating current and future system needs or implementing new procedures. 5\. Leads efforts to centralize and standardize data management tools and techniques. Performs periodic validation of data across multiple systems. Identifies, researches and resolves variances. 6\. Demonstrates strong functional knowledge of multiple system applications and databases. Provides training and support to enterprise\-wide resources. **Minimum Requirements for Sr Data Integrity Analyst:** * Bachelor's degree in Business Administration or a related field preferred and five years' experience in the utility industry with exposure to compliance and/or regulatory agencies; or equivalent. **Engineer I – Engineer III** * Bachelor's degree in Engineering from an ABET accredited program ( *Engineer I)* * Bachelor's degree in Engineering from an ABET accredited program **and** two ( *engineer II)* – four ( *engineer III)* years’ of experience **with** Engineer\-In\-Training registration with a state board **Sr Engineer** * Bachelor's degree in Engineering from an ABET accredited program * Six Years’ Experience * Professional Engineering Designation Problem Solving / Independent Judgment: Applies advanced skills to resolve complex problems independently. Requires occasionally performing activities including, but not limited to, bending, stooping, grasping, reaching, twisting, turning and/or lifting. jobs.title: Senior Staff TLM, Security Systems
jobs.description: **Who we are** Aurora’s mission is to deliver the benefits of self\-driving technology safely, quickly, and broadly. The Aurora Driver will create a new era in mobility and logistics, one that will bring a safer, more efficient, and more accessible future to everyone. At Aurora, you will tackle massively complex problems alongside other passionate, intelligent individuals, growing as an expert while expanding your knowledge. For the latest news from Aurora, visit aurora.tech or follow us on LinkedIn. **What we are looking for** The mission of Aurora’s Systems Engineering team is to architect, validate, and integrate complex hardware, software, and safety\-critical operations into a cohesive autonomous vehicle platform . As a **Senior Staff TLM (Technical Lead Manager), Security Systems** you will be the technical anchor bridging Systems Engineering, Product Security, and Autonomous Vehicle Hardware/Software teams. You will focus on the hands\-on engineering, requirement definition, threat modeling, and system integration required to build security directly into Aurora’s autonomous vehicle hardware architecture, safety compute stack, and cloud telemetry. You will translate high\-level security architecture and regulatory requirements into concrete system\-level design specs, trade studies, interface definitions, and verification plans. Your role is critical in ensuring that cybersecurity is engineered into our platform as a core engineering property alongside functional safety, system performance, and reliability. The job level is negotiable based on experience. Flexible work locations are available (**MTV preferred**, SFO, PIT, SEA, BJC. DET, BZN) for US\-based employees (Full remote is not available for this role). **In this role, you will** * **Define System Security Requirements \& Interfaces:** Translate architectural security goals into detailed, testable system and sub\-system security requirements across vehicle compute, sensor suites, internal networks (CAN, Automotive Ethernet), and cloud gateways. * **Conduct System\-Level Threat Modeling \& Risk Analysis:** Perform hands\-on systems threat modeling (e.g., TARA, STRIDE) and vulnerability impact analyses on safety\-critical ECUs, onboard compute platforms, and telemetry links to ensure robust defense\-in\-depth. * **Execute Trade Studies \& Technical Integration:** Partner with Hardware and Embedded Software teams to lead trade studies on hardware security anchors (HSM, TPM, TrustZone), secure boot chains, onboard key management, and cryptographic overhead on real\-time execution. * **Bridge Systems, Security, and Safety Engineering:** Work directly with Safety Engineers (ISO 26262\) and Security Architects (ISO/SAE 21434\) to align system fault mitigation with security threat response, ensuring security defenses never compromise vehicle functional safety. * **Lead System Security Verification \& Validation (V\&V):** Define security test plans, trace requirements through the V\-model, and collaborate with validation teams to execute hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL) and vehicle\-level security verification. * **Drive Supplier \& Tier\-1 Technical Specifications:** Author technical security requirements for component suppliers and Tier\-1 hardware partners, evaluating technical compliance during integration. **Required Qualifications** * **8\+ years of experience** in systems engineering, embedded systems engineering, or product security engineering within automotive, robotics, aerospace, or safety\-critical hardware/software systems. * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a related STEM field. * Demonstrated expertise in system\-level security controls, including hardware security modules (HSMs/TPMs), secure boot chains, applied cryptography, and secure communication protocols (e.g., SecOC, TLS, secure CAN/Ethernet). * Proven experience writing technical system requirements, defining ICDs (Interface Control Documents), and performing requirements traceability using systems engineering tools (e.g., JAMA, JIRA, DOORS). * Hands\-on experience performing threat modeling (TARA, STRIDE) and failure mode analysis on complex cyber\-physical or embedded systems. * Excellent cross\-functional technical leadership skills, with a track record of driving system\-level decisions across software, hardware, and safety teams. **Desirable Qualifications** * Experience with and knowledge of automotive and cloud security standards and regulations, such as **ISO/SAE 21434, ASPICE, ISO 27001** or **UNECE R155/R156**. * Practical experience engineering systems that interface safety\-critical autonomous compute stacks with off\-board telemetry or cloud control infrastructures. * Hands\-on experience with hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL) testing, penetration testing coordination, or vulnerability remediation on physical systems * Experience aligning functional safety (HARA) and cybersecurity (TARA) analyses to manage co\-dependent vehicle risks. * Strong foundation of experience to successfully engage, communicate and influence OEMs, Tier\-1s, Suppliers, or commercial partners in order to further Aurora’s security posture. * Experience building and scaling security architecture frameworks from the ground up in safety\-critical or heavily regulated industries. * Advanced security architecture or engineering certifications such as **CISSP\-ISSAP**, **CISM**, or equivalent. *For roles based in Mountain View, CA and Seattle, WA:* The salary range for this position is $212,000 \- $340,000 per year. *For roles based in Pittsburgh, PA:* The salary range for this position is $191,000 \- $306,000 per year. Aurora’s pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, the successful candidate’s starting base pay will be determined based on factors including job\-related skills, experience, qualifications, relevant education or training, and market conditions. These ranges may be modified in the future. The successful candidate will also be eligible for an annual bonus, equity compensation, and benefits. **Working at Aurora** At Aurora, we bring together extraordinarily talented and experienced people united by the strength of our values. We operate with integrity, set outrageous goals, and build a culture where we win together — all without any jerks. We believe in\-person work increases collaboration, empathy, and our ability to lead effectively. As a result, Aurorans are expected to work from the office at least 3 days per week, with some roles requiring more frequent in\-office presence, up to 5 days per week, based on operational needs. Our Careers page provides insight into what it is like to work at Aurora, and you can find all the latest updates in our Newsroom. **Our commitment to safety** At the core of everything we do is our commitment to safety. Building best\-in\-class self\-driving technology will take time, and we believe that each employee at Aurora has a role in contributing to safety, every step of the way. Aurora expects commitment to our safety policies from every employee, and seeks candidates who take an active responsibility, can contribute to building an atmosphere of trust, and invest in the organization’s long\-term success by prioritizing working safely, no matter what. **Our commitment to inclusion** Aurora considers candidates without regard to their race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy status, parent or caregiver status, ancestry, political affiliation, veteran and/or military status, physical or mental disability, or any other status protected by federal or state law. Aurora considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state, and local law. We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at careersiteaccommodations@aurora.tech. *For California applicants, information collected and processed as part of your application and any job applications you choose to submit is subject to Aurora’s California Employment Privacy Policy.*

in a Linux environment * Proven experience building middleware, runtime frameworks, or distributed systems, such as pub/sub messaging, IPC, schedulers, or executors * Deep understanding of
