jobs.title: Marketing AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About Avenue Z, Inc.** Avenue Z is a digital marketing and PR agency engineered to move fast. Brands partner with us to drive revenue and reputation through high\-impact public relations, performance media, AI search optimization (AEO), and our creator network. Trusted by leaders in emerging tech, finance and consumer brands, ***we drive influence*** across all channels \- from AI Search to The Wall Street Journal, Shopify to TikTok, Meta to Google. **The role** ------------ You are a growth marketer who builds. You have bought media on Meta, Google, or TikTok with your own hands, you know what a good ROAS looks like before the dashboard loads, and when something is manual, repetitive, or slow, your instinct is to open an editor and wire it to the platform API rather than schedule a working session. The Marketing AI Engineer builds and ships the AI agents, automations, and reporting systems that run paid media, creator and affiliate campaigns, CRO, and client reporting at Avenue Z. The work is concrete: agents that launch and QA ads across Meta, TikTok, and Snap; systems that reallocate budget toward top\-performing creators; reporting that ties creator content, ad spend, and attributed revenue into one picture; alerts that catch an expiring TikTok Shop affiliate code or a Meta partnership permission before spend stalls. You are also the technical lead for our AI builders. You set the standard for how agents are designed, reviewed, and shipped across service lines, you review their work, and you are the person leadership turns to when a build needs a decision. You will embed with the paid media, creator, and ecommerce teams to find where throughput or margin is lost, build the system that fixes it, drive adoption, and move to the next one. This is a builder and a leader role. You ship working systems yourself, and you raise the bar for everyone else who ships them. **What you'll do** ------------------ **Build against the marketing platforms our revenue runs on** * Integrate with the Meta Marketing API, TikTok Business and TikTok Shop APIs, Google Ads API, Snap, Shopify, and affiliate and creator platform APIs: OAuth and token refresh, rate limits, webhooks, and partnership\-access flows. * Build agents and automations for ad launching and QA, budget pacing and reallocation, creative tagging and performance intelligence, anomaly detection, and cross\-platform commission tracking. * Build the reporting layer that shows a brand what actually drove revenue, cross\-referenced against Shopify as the source of truth. **Embed with the teams and ship against real problems** * Sit with paid media, creator and affiliate, CRO, and ecommerce teams. Audit how they work today, map the workflow from input to output, and find the steps that should run automatically. * Turn a messy manual process into a working system inside weeks, not quarters. Define where a human approves and where the system acts on its own, especially where money or brand safety is on the line. * Drive adoption. A system that ships and sits unused does not count. Train the team, gather feedback, and iterate. **Build Innovative AI Driven Marketing SolutionsAI** * Provide technical leadership on product roadmap. Be an expert in building and shipping production ready solutions. * Set the standard for how Avenue Z designs, reviews, documents, and ships agents and automations across service lines, and enforce it through code review and design review. * Review and mentor the engineers and builders already working on AI automation across PR, SEO and AEO, organic social, and ecommerce. Unblock them, raise their quality bar, and own the outcome of their work. * Run the intake and prioritization of automation requests so the team builds what moves revenue, time saved, or client retention, in that order. * Report progress, blockers, and measured impact to the CTO and present to leadership. **Invent new capability** * Build things that create new advantages for the business, not just faster versions of old tasks: autonomous media buying, creative\-to\-landing\-page pipelines, creator performance ranking, and whatever you see next that we have not. **What you won't do** --------------------- * Be a passive project coordinator or a pure strategist with no build capability. * Spend months planning without shipping. * Wait for perfect requirements before building. * Build for novelty instead of business value. * Replace human judgment where brand, strategy, or client context still matters. * Treat marketing as someone else's domain. You have to understand the ad account as well as the people running it. **Who you are** --------------- **Required** * A background in growth marketing. You have personally run paid media on at least one of Instagram and Facebook, Google, or TikTok, and you understand campaign structure, pixels and events, attribution windows, creative testing, and what the numbers mean. * Hands\-on experience working with the Meta Marketing API and the TikTok Business or TikTok Shop APIs, plus other marketing platform APIs (Google Ads, Shopify, Klaviyo, affiliate and creator platforms). You have built something real against them, not read the docs. * Deep, current, hands\-on knowledge of the digital marketing industry: how agencies and brands actually operate, where the manual work sits, and what clients pay for. * Extensive hands\-on experience with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or similar) and a working command of good coding practice: version control, code review, environment and secrets management, testing, and documentation. A computer science degree is not required. Shipped work is. * Experience leading others who build. You have been a principal engineer, a founder, a lead engineer, a technical team lead, or a leader of product managers, and you have set and enforced a quality bar for a team's work. * Experience building AI agents and automations in production: prompts, tool use, approval gates, error handling, and monitoring, using whatever stack fits (Python or TypeScript, agent frameworks, workflow platforms such as n8n or Make where they are the right tool). * A portfolio of projects or code repositories you can walk us through (see below). * Based in, or relocating at your own expense to, Miami or Orlando. Onsite. **Preferred** * Experience in an ecommerce or performance marketing agency, or on a DTC brand's growth team. * TikTok Shop, creator and affiliate marketing, or influencer campaign experience. * Data work: SQL, BigQuery or a similar warehouse, Looker Studio or similar BI tools. * Shopify app or Shopify API experience. * You have built and sold, launched, or run something of your own. **Critical traits** * Moves fast and learns fast. * Thinks in systems and sees ambiguity as a build opportunity. * Commercially aware: knows the difference between an impressive demo and a system that makes or saves money. * High agency. Does not wait to be assigned the problem. * Good judgment on what should be automated and what should stay human. * Can switch between a conversation with a media buyer and a code review without changing register. **Benefits** ------------ * Salary: $100k\-$120k * Medical, vision, and dental plans * 401(k) plan with 4% employer match * Unlimited PTO * Professional development stipend

jobs.title: Enterprise Sales Director — Data & AI Services and SaaS
jobs.description: **Build the sales function — don’t inherit it.** Aviana is a profitable, 25\-year\-old data and AI consultancy with its own forecast software product. We have grown entirely through referrals and long\-term client relationships, which means we have excellent delivery, Fortune 1000 clients, and no new logo engine. You would be the first dedicated seller we have hired, reporting directly to the COO. If you want a territory with warm inbound and a recognized brand, this is not it. If you have built pipeline from nothing before and want to own a go\-to\-market function as it grows, keep reading. **What you will sell** * **Data Management** — platform modernization, governance, pipelines, data quality ($250K–$1M\+) * **Data Science** — forecasting, predictive models, analytics engineering ($200K–$800K) * **Forward Deployed Engineering** — engineers embedded with client teams building production systems ($400K–$1\.5M) * **Nemesis** — our forecasting and planning software for clinical laboratory and industrial supply chain ($75K–$300K ARR) Buyers are CIOs, Heads of Data \& Analytics, and VPs of Supply Chain and Operations. Cycles run for two to eight months. **What you will own** * Your own target account list and outbound motion — an SDR supports you, the strategy is yours * Deals qualified against a written standard, not optimism * A fixed\-scope entry engagement as the wedge: land, prove, expand * Google/ AWS/ Azure Cloud co\-sell relationships * An honest forecast and a clean CRM **What we are looking for** * 7\+ years selling technology services or enterprise software to Fortune 1000 and mid\-market buyers * 3\+ years carrying a new\-business quota as a hunter, not an account manager * Three new logos you sourced yourself, start to finish — be ready to walk through them * Comfort with complex 2–8\-month cycles: multiple stakeholders, procurement, security review * Enough technical fluency to talk with a Head of Data about forecast accuracy without retreating to the brochure * 25–40% travel **Strongly preferred:** a network in healthcare, clinical laboratory, banking, or industrial manufacturing; experience selling both services and software; having been an early sales hire somewhere; hyperscale co\-sell experience. **Compensation and benefits** * Base salary $130,000–$160,000, depending on experience * On\-target earnings $240,000–$400,000, uncapped, with accelerators above quota * Health coverage, 401(k), paid time off, travel expense This is a salaried position with commission. It is not commission\-only. Full details of the commission structure and ramp are shared with candidates who reach final interview. **To apply** Send your resume and a short note on one thing: a new logo you won that you probably should not have, and how. That tells us more than a cover letter. Aviana Global Technologies is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from every background and are happy to make accommodation in the interview process. Pay: $130,000\.00 \- $160,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Application Question(s): * How many years have you carried a new\-business (new logo) quota? * Have you sold deals with sales cycles of six months or longer? Work Location: Hybrid remote in Yorba Linda, CA 92887

jobs.title: Senior Engineer - AI Data Scientist
jobs.description: **Job Description** At BAE Systems Space and Mission Systems (SMS), we design and deliver advanced defense, intelligence, and security solutions that protect national interests and enable mission success. Our teams tackle complex, high‑impact challenges using cutting\-edge technology, rigorous engineering, and data\-driven insight. We are seeking an AI Data Scientist to help shape the next generation of intelligent systems across our Space and Mission Systems Division. The Operations Strategic Capabilities Unit plays a fundamental role in enabling efficient business and program execution – from strategic capital investments, industrial operations and an efficient supply chain, to state\-of\-the\-art manufacturing and test operations and top\-notch facilities management. **What You’ll Do:** * **Lifecycle Leadership:** Adhere to and actively promote the MPA project lifecycle and Data Integration, Reporting/Visualization processes and best practices. * **Project Ownership:** Independently lead high\-complexity, cross\-functional, or ambiguous analytical projects. Demonstrate solid problem decomposition skills to turn vague business needs into concrete technical roadmaps. * **Technical Mentorship:** Provide direct technical guidance and mentorship to less\-experienced analysts and data scientists. Promote best practices in experimentation, modeling, and code quality across the entire team. * **Operational Management:** Accurately estimate and budget hours and milestone dates for assigned projects: track and report on hours to ensure alignment with budget and schedule. * **Quality Assurance:** Maintain a high standard of delivery where technical errors are minimized and manageable, ensuring stability in tool deployments. * **AI Development:** Design, develop, and deploy robust machine\-learning algorithms, with a specific focus on Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic frameworks, and RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation) systems. * **Stakeholder Collaboration:** Work directly with a wide range of stakeholders to translate complex business requirements into actionable, user\-driven technical solutions. * Maintain a regular and predictable work schedule. * Establish and maintain effective working relationships within the department, the Strategic Business Units, Strategic Capabilities Units and the Company. Interact appropriately with others in order to maintain a positive and productive work environment. * Perform other duties as necessary. **On\-Site Work Environment:** This position requires regular in\-person engagement by working **on\-site three or more days** each normally scheduled week in the primary work location. Travel and local commute between company campuses and other possible non\-company locations may be required. **Working Conditions:** * Work is performed in an office, laboratory, production floor, or cleanroom, outdoors or remote research environment. * May occasionally work in production work centers where use of protective equipment and gear is required. * May access other facilities in various weather conditions. **Required Education, Experience, \& Skills** * BS degree or higher in Engineering or a related technical field is required plus 4 or more years related experience. * Each higher\-level degree, i.e., Master’s Degree or Ph.D., may substitute for two years of experience. Related technical experience may be considered in lieu of education. Degree must be from a university, college, or school which is accredited by an agency recognized by the US Secretary of Education, US Department of Education. * Proficiency in Python and SQL. * Solid Data Science background in Machine Learning (ML), statistical methods, and data modeling techniques. * Experience designing AI\-driven applications using API\-accessible LLMs (agent workflows, tool design, RAG). * Solid understanding of prompt/context engineering and system design for agent\-like architectures and evaluation techniques. * Extensive knowledge of modern LLM capabilities, limitations, and failure modes. * Experience with embeddings, vector databases, and retrieval systems. * Experience with AI workflow platforms (Dataiku, Stack AI, Open WebUI). \#LI\- JL2 **Pay Information** Full\-Time Salary Range: $97008 \- $164914 Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience. Employee Benefits: At BAE Systems, we support our employees in all aspects of their life, including their health and financial well\-being. Regular employees scheduled to work 20\+ hours per week are offered: health, dental, and vision insurance; health savings accounts; a 401(k) savings plan; disability coverage; and life and accident insurance. We also have an employee assistance program, a legal plan, and other perks including discounts on things like home, auto, and pet insurance. Our leave programs include paid time off, paid holidays, as well as other types of leave, including paid parental, military, bereavement, and any applicable federal and state sick leave. Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non\-monetary recognition awards. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics. **About BAE Systems, Inc.** BAE Systems, Inc. is the U.S. subsidiary of BAE Systems plc, an international defense, aerospace and security company which delivers a full range of products and services for air, land and naval forces, as well as advanced electronics, security, information technology solutions and customer support services. Improving the future and protecting lives is an ambitious mission, but it’s what we do at BAE Systems. Working here means using your passion and ingenuity where it counts – defending national security with breakthrough technology, superior products, and intelligence solutions. As you develop the latest technology and defend national security, you will continually hone your skills on a team—making a big impact on a global scale. At BAE Systems, you’ll find a rewarding career that truly makes a difference. Headquartered in Boulder, Colorado, Space \& Mission Systems is a leading provider of national defense and civil space applications, advanced remote sensing, scientific and tactical systems for government and commercial customers. We continually pioneer ways to innovate spacecraft, mission payloads, optical systems, and other defense and civil capabilities. Powered by endlessly curious people with an unwavering mission focus, we continually discover ways to enable our customers to perform beyond expectation and protect what matters most. This position will be posted for at least 5 calendar days. The posting will remain active until the position is filled, or a qualified pool of candidates is identified. Multiple positions may be available on this opening.

jobs.title: Associate Director AI Product Engineer - Financial Institution Operations & Technology
jobs.description: **We Do Consulting Differently** -------------------------------- Preferred locations: New York, Chicago, Washington, D.C., Dallas, and Boston. Other locations considered case by case. **About the Practice** Berkeley Research Group is building a Financial Services Operations \& Technology practice focused initially on Commercial and Consumer Banking. We combine banking expertise, technology, and AI to help clients improve operations. **The Role** ------------ We are hiring a hands\-on AI Product Engineer focused on evaluation: proving whether AI products are accurate, reliable, and safe for banking operations. You will build automated tests, investigate failures, and provide evidence for release decisions while contributing to product development. Working with banking experts and engineers, you will define correct results, measure performance, and turn findings into product improvements. Your core responsibility is evaluation from early development through live use. Client stakeholders retain release and risk\-acceptance authority. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ **Own the Evaluation Approach** ------------------------------- * Define what each product must get right, how errors could affect customers or operations, and what evidence is needed before use. * Build reusable software that runs tests, scores results, and compares versions. Make testing part of everyday development, not a final checkpoint. * Work with engineers to reproduce failures, identify causes, and verify fixes. Contribute product code where needed to improve accuracy and control. **Design Tests and Measure Results** ------------------------------------ * Set pass criteria and scoring rules with business and risk teams. Distinguish minor defects from errors that must block release. * Maintain representative test cases, including incomplete records and rare, high\-impact errors. Reserve unseen examples for final testing to avoid overstating performance. * Have banking experts establish expected answers and resolve scoring disagreements. Measure factual accuracy, missing information, incorrect additions, and support from cited sources. * Check automated scoring against expert review. Test whether reviewers agree and whether AI\-based scoring misses important errors. * Compare versions on the same tests. Report results by task and error severity, with sample sizes and uncertainty, not just averages. **Verify Accuracy and Explain Failures** ---------------------------------------- * Test whether the system finds the right information and whether its answer reflects that information. Separate source problems from answer errors. * Check extracted facts against original records. Independently verify amounts, dates, and totals, and test whether citations actually support each important claim. * Test when the product should answer, request clarification, or refer work to a person. Verify that reviewers can detect and correct material errors. **Manage Risk and Monitor Performance** --------------------------------------- * Test for invented facts, unsupported recommendations, unfair outcomes, disclosure of sensitive information, and attempts to make the system ignore its safeguards. * Protect client data, restrict access and permitted actions, and use only approved services. Verify that safeguards work in practice. * Document repeatable test results, unresolved failures, and limitations. Recommend release, restricted use, or further development; support independent review and required client approvals. * Sample live outputs and track error rates and user corrections. Add confirmed failures to repeatable tests; trigger investigation or suspension when quality falls below agreed standards. Explain findings clearly, coach colleagues, and develop reusable tests and controls. Support proposals, technical estimates, and recruiting. * **Qualifications** ------------------ **Required** ------------ * Minimum 5 years of working experience with a minimum of 1 year experience in AI evaluation. * Demonstrated ownership of AI evaluations that informed real release decisions, including test design, expert\-reviewed answers, scoring, and failure investigation. * Strong Python skills and experience building automated test software, connecting data sources, and recording repeatable results across product versions. * Ability to select representative samples, interpret error rates and uncertainty, and distinguish genuine improvement from weak tests or inconsistent scoring. * Experience building or improving AI products used in operations, with practical controls for sensitive data, output accuracy, and human review. * Experience in financial services or another regulated environment, with the ability to translate business requirements into practical tests and controls. Strong communication and teamwork skills, ability to mentor colleagues, and willingness to travel to client sites as needed. * **Preferred** ------------- * Banking experience in lending, payments, servicing, collections, or default operations. * Experience independently evaluating AI products, checking automated scoring against expert judgment, or testing security and fairness in financial institutions. * Experience evaluating document review, summaries, information search, or automated workflows, including comparisons across AI services and conventional software. Consulting or product delivery experience, including client discovery, implementation planning, and user adoption. * **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- Success means reliable evidence of what a product gets right, where it fails, and whether it is ready for use. Evaluations catch important errors before release, guide measurable improvements, and detect declining quality in live operations. Testing supports sound decisions, not simply a passing score. Associate Director Salary range: $180,000 \- $250,000 Job title and level will be determined based on qualifications and experience. Candidates must be able to verify their legal right to work in the United States without employer sponsorship now or in the future. **About BRG** BRG combines world\-leading academic credentials with world\-tested business expertise and purpose\-built emerging technologies. Our culture centers on agility and connectivity which sets us apart and gets you ahead. At BRG, our professionals include specialist consultants, industry experts, renowned academics, and leading\-edge data scientists. Together, they bring a diversity of real\-world experience, data, and human and artificial intelligence, to economics, disputes, and investigations; corporate finance; and performance improvement services that address the most complex challenges facing organizations across the globe. Our unique structure nurtures the interdisciplinary relationships that give us the edge, laying the groundwork for more informed insights and more original, incisive thinking. When paired with our global reach and resources, our diverse perspectives and technical capabilities make us uniquely capable to address our clients’ challenges. We get results because we know how to apply our thinking to your world. At BRG, we don’t just show you what’s possible. We’re built to help you make it happen. jobs.title: Senior Staff Data Engineer
jobs.description: Biohub is the first large\-scale initiative bringing frontier AI models, massive compute, and frontier experimental capabilities under one roof. We're building a general\-purpose system to accelerate scientific discovery, integrating frontier AI models, biological foundation models, and lab capabilities, with the ultimate goal of curing disease. Our technology powers scientists around the world, translating AI capabilities into tools that accelerate research everywhere. **The Team** ------------ Biohub is a 501(c)(3\) biomedical research organization building the first large\-scale scientific initiative combining frontier AI with frontier biology to solve disease. We build the technology to help scientists around the world use AI\-powered biology to study how cells operate, organize, and work as part of systems to understand why disease happens and how to correct it. With our compute capacity, AI research and engineering, and state\-of\-the\-art technology for measuring, imaging, and programming biology, we are enabling scientists worldwide to use AI\-powered biology to advance our understanding of human health. **The Opportunity** ------------------- The role is part of the Data Engineering team, which focuses on owning the strategy, sourcing and implementation for data supporting AI research and development. Our goal is to maximize the speed, agility, and capability of biological AI research by connecting public data resources and Biohub's experimental platforms to AI systems. The data that trains biological frontier models comes in dozens of modalities (sequences, images, spatial coordinates, time series, molecular structures, metadata, publication artifacts) each with its own noise characteristics, biases, and information content. The question of how to represent this data for learning is one of the most important open problems in biological AI. As a Senior Staff Data Engineer at Biohub, you'll be designing systems that ingest data from public repositories, transform heterogeneous biological formats into AI\-ready datasets, combine that with proprietary datasets, and deliver training datasets to researchers pushing the boundaries of what's possible in biological AI. The infrastructure you build will directly shape what our models can learn. We're a small team with significant resources and long time horizons. We use AI tools aggressively in our own work—Claude Code, agents for workflow automation, LLMs for metadata extraction. We care about code quality, operational reliability, and building systems that scale. And we care about the biology: we want engineers who can recognize when a pipeline output is technically correct but scientifically wrong. If you want to work at the intersection of large\-scale infrastructure and frontier science, with real autonomy and the chance to build something genuinely new, we'd like to talk. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Design and build data pipelines that process genomic and imaging data at petabyte scale * Solve performance and bandwidth challenges with creative engineering * Build agent\-based systems for automated dataset curation, quality control, and workflow generation * Create tooling for data cataloging and registration that makes datasets discoverable and accessible * Collaborate with AI Research teams to translate model requirements into data specifications, and with our scientists to integrate public and internal data into large\-scale ai\-ready datasets * Improve pipeline reliability and observability, working toward 99%\+ success rates without manual intervention **What You'll Bring** --------------------- * 12\+ years of experience building reliable, operable data systems at petabyte scale * Strong software engineering fundamentals * Experience deploying distributed computing frameworks like Databricks, Spark, or Ray for large\-scale data processing * Experience building and deploying large scale data platform solutions using infrastructure as code like Terraform or CDK * Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred) and on prem infrastructure * Comfort with ambiguity; ability to make progress when requirements are evolving * Interest in AI\-native development practices and tooling * Nice to have: Background in computational biology, bioinformatics, or life sciences and experience with genomics datasets and formats (FASTQ, BAM, VCF) or imaging formats (OME\-Zarr, HDF5\) **Compensation** ---------------- The anticipated base pay ranges for this role in Redwood City, CA and New York City, NY is $270,000–$300,000 annually for the Senior Staff level. New hires are typically hired into the lower portion of the range, enabling employee growth in the range over time. Actual placement in range is based on job\-related skills and experience, as evaluated throughout the interview process. This position may be eligible to participate in Biohub's discretionary annual performance bonus program. Bonus eligibility and targets are determined in accordance with Biohub's total rewards philosophy and may vary by role. **Better Together** ------------------- As we grow, we're excited to strengthen in\-person connections and cultivate a collaborative, team\-oriented environment. This role is a hybrid position requiring you to be onsite for at least 60% of the working month, approximately 3 days a week, with specific in\-office days determined by the team's manager. The exact schedule will be at the hiring manager's discretion and communicated during the interview process. **Benefits for the Whole You** ------------------------------ We're thankful to have an incredible team behind our work. To honor their commitment, we offer a wide range of benefits to support the people who make all we do possible. * Provides a generous employer match on employee 401(k) contributions to support planning for the future. * Paid time off to volunteer at an organization of your choice. * Funding for select family\-forming benefits. * Relocation support for employees who need assistance moving If you're interested in a role but your previous experience doesn't perfectly align with each qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply as you may be the perfect fit for this or another role. \#LI\-Hybrid \#LI\-Onsite

organizational capability at Blackrock Neurotech. #### **What You'll Do** * Own the architecture and technical direction for high\-performance BCI software spanning device, edge, and distributed a regulated device * Establish scalable software engineering practices, development infrastructure, testing approaches, and processes appropriate for a regulated medical device environment * Navigate complex dependencies across hardware, clinical, pre\-clinical, data science/AI, cybersecurity, infrastructure, and other technical teams to keep development moving forward * Develop resource, hiring, and budget plans aligned with the software roadmap and future organizational needs * Partner with Quality, Regulatory, and cross\-functional leaders to ensure software architecture, development practices, documentation, and validation support applicable medical device requirements * Communicate technical strategy, tradeoffs, risks, and progress clearly to audiences ranging from individual engineers to executive leadership #### **What You Bring** * 10\+ years of progressive software engineering experience, including 5\+ years in engineering leadership roles with responsibility for team development, technical direction, and delivery * Demonstrated experience building and leading a team from the ground up, including defining the organizational structure, hiring key talent, and establishing the processes and infrastructure needed to scale * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience * Demonstrated experience architecting high\-performance software systems across multiple technical boundaries, such as embedded systems, edge computing, distributed systems, or cloud\-connected environments * Experience architecting software systems built around AI/ML pipelines, such as real\-time inference, model deployment and monitoring, or latency\-sensitive high\-bandwidth signal processing * Experience leading software development within the medical device industry or a similarly complex, regulated product environment * Strong understanding of modern software engineering practices, including architecture, development workflows, testing, deployment, and lifecycle management * Experience creating software roadmaps, managing technical dependencies, and translating ambiguous or evolving requirements into executable plans * Demonstrated success building and developing engineering teams, including hiring, mentoring, setting expectations, and creating accountability for delivery * The technical depth to operate credibly with senior engineers and remain engaged in architecture, design, and critical technical problem solving * Proven ability to work across disciplines and influence both technical and executive stakeholders. * A calm, adaptable leadership style and the ability to bring clarity and structure to complex, fast\-moving environments * Experience developing software for Class III or other complex medical devices strongly preferred * Working knowledge of medical device software development and quality frameworks, including IEC 62304, ISO 14971, and QMSR/ISO 13485 preferred * Experience with Python and/or compiled languages used in high\-performance or embedded systems * Experience with embedded Linux, distributed systems, CI/CD, automated testing, or cloud\-connected device architectures * Experience supporting software used in clinical studies or clinical environments is preferred * Familiarity with cybersecurity considerations for connected medical devices and applicable security frameworks * Experience applying AI\-enabled development tools or building software architectures that incorporate AI/ML capabilities **Working Location:** This is an on\-site role based at Blackrock Neurotech's headquarters in Salt Lake City, Utah. Occasional travel may be required. #### **How We Work** We are a small, experienced team working on consequential problems. * We take ownership of outcomes and follow through with clarity and accountability * We prioritize sustained, high\-quality work over performative urgency * We value rigor, sound judgement and thoughtful decision\-making * We collaborate deliberately: low ego, high trust and high context *This is a high\-ownership role, but it is not an "always\-on" one. You will produce documentation, tutorials, white papers, sample applications, and video guides. You will partner with the Product, Engineering, Research, and GTM/Solutions Engineering teams and work across the open\-source agent ecosystem. You will spend most of your time building and then sharing what you build. **What You'll Be Working On:** * **Agentic Reference Systems:** Architect and ship end\-to\-end reference agents and starter kits on Crusoe that developers can use as a starting point for production, covering tool use, MCP, multi\-agent orchestration, RAG, structured outputs, memory, and evals. * **Examples \& Documentation:** Own the code examples, tutorials, and documentation that help developers go from first API call to working agent, and keep them tested and up to date as the ecosystem changes. * **Open Source \& GitHub:** Own Crusoe's developer\-facing GitHub presence, including examples, cookbooks, and integrations. Contribute upstream to agent frameworks, inference engines, and developer tooling (for example LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, Pydantic AI, the OpenAI Agents SDK, MCP, vLLM, and SGLang) so they work well with Crusoe. * **Technical Content \& Video:** Turn the systems you build into content developers rely on: deep\-dive blog posts, notebooks, YouTube videos, livestreams, and short technical clips. * **Building in Public:** Share your work on X, LinkedIn, YouTube, Discord, Reddit, Hacker News, etc. Answer technical questions, review community projects, and become a trusted technical voice in the agent and open\-source community. * **Use\-Case Blueprints:** Partner with GTM/Solutions Engineering to spot recurring customer patterns and turn them into open reference architectures for developer segments such as Physical AI, robotics, simulation, and other industry verticals. * **Product \& Research Partnership:** Join Product, Engineering, and Research workflows. Test features and models before launch, make sure samples and docs are ready on launch day, and bring developer friction back as concrete product input, following each issue until it is fixed or explicitly deprioritized. * **Talks \& Workshops:** Give technical talks, live demos, and hands\-on labs at conferences, meetups, hackathons, and workshops. **What You'll Bring to the Team:** * **Engineering Experience:** 5\+ years as a software engineer, ML engineer, applied AI engineer, forward\-deployed engineer, or in a similar hands\-on engineering role, with strong Python. A Developer Relations title is not required. * **Engineering Credibility:** Ability to earn credibility with both AI infrastructure engineers and ML/AI engineers. * **Agentic AI:** Hands\-on experience building LLM applications and agents with tool calling, MCP, retrieval, memory, and evaluation, using one or more frameworks such as LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, Pydantic AI, or the OpenAI Agents SDK. You have well\-formed opinions about what works and what breaks in production. * **Cloud Infrastructure:** Experience working with cloud computing platforms (such as AWS, GCP, or Azure) or managed AI solutions, with a foundational understanding of cloud infrastructure concepts. * **Inference \& Model Serving:** Working knowledge of how models are served, including OpenAI\-compatible APIs, open\-weight models, and serving engines such as vLLM or SGLang. You can explain cost and latency tradeoffs credibly. * **Public Track Record:** Evidence of sharing technical work in public through GitHub repos, open\-source contributions, blog posts, videos, talks, or an active technical presence on social platforms. Please include links when you apply. * **Technical Communication:** Strong communication skills across written and verbal formats, including technical documentation, white papers, video explainers, and presentation decks. * **Ownership \& Collaboration:** You work well across teams, set your own priorities, and ship in a fast\-moving environment. * **Travel Requirement:** Ability to travel up to 20%. * **Education:** Bachelor's/Master's/PhD degree in Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience. **Bonus Points** * Maintainer or significant contributor to an open\-source AI, agent, or inference project * Experience producing technical video content such as YouTube tutorials, livestreams, or screencasts * Experience fine\-tuning or post\-training open\-weight models (SFT/RL/LoRA) * An existing technical audience that trusts your views on models, agents, and tooling **Benefits:** * Competitive compensation and equity packages * Restricted Stock Units * Paid time off, paid holidays \& leave of absence programs * Comprehensive health, dental \& vision insurance * Employer contributions to HSA account * Paid parental leave * Paid life insurance, short\-term and long\-term disability * Professional development \& tuition reimbursement * Mental health \& wellness support * Commuter benefits (parking \& transit) * Cell phone stipend * 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary * Volunteer time off * Global travel insurance \& emergency assistance * Daily meals allowance * Additional perks \& programs specific to location **Compensation Range** Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $180,000\-$220,000 \+ Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Product Engineer
jobs.description: ### **The Role** CubX is looking for a **Senior Full Stack Product Engineer** who can take a business need from concept to production. This is a hands\-on role for someone who combines strong full\-stack engineering with product thinking and design judgment. You’ll work directly with business leaders and users to understand problems, design thoughtful solutions, and build polished internal applications that improve how our managed service business operates. **AI\-assisted development is a core part of this role.** We’re looking for someone who has successfully used AI coding tools to accelerate professional software development while maintaining ownership of architecture, quality, security, and the final product. ### **What You'll Do** * Lead discovery with stakeholders to understand business problems, requirements, workflows, and constraints. * Translate complex needs into clear user journeys, product designs, and technical solutions. * Create wireframes and prototypes and establish the visual direction for intuitive, polished interfaces. * Design application architecture, data models, APIs, integrations, permissions, and workflows. * Build and maintain full\-stack applications using **React, TypeScript, Node.js, and MongoDB**. * Partner with DevOps on **Docker, CI/CD, Azure deployments, and production reliability**. * Use AI tools throughout planning, development, testing, debugging, refactoring, and documentation. * Review and verify AI\-generated code rather than treating AI output as production\-ready by default. * Own solutions through release and continue improving them based on user feedback and production behavior. ### **What We’re Looking For** * Proven experience taking products or significant workflows from an ambiguous business need through **design, development, deployment, and ongoing improvement**. * Strong hands\-on experience with **TypeScript, React, Node.js, and MongoDB**. * Experience with **Azure, Docker, Git, CI/CD, REST APIs, authentication, authorization, and automated testing**. * Strong product judgment and the ability to simplify complex business workflows. * Experience creating and implementing user interfaces, not simply working from someone else’s designs. * Strong communication skills and comfort working directly with business and technical stakeholders. ### **Show Us What You’ve Built** During the interview process, we’ll ask you to walk us through **two examples of software you delivered using AI\-assisted development**. At least one should demonstrate your involvement from **stakeholder discovery and original product/design thinking through development and production release**. Be prepared to discuss: * The business problem and how you approached it. * Your design and architecture decisions. * How you used AI during development. * An AI\-generated mistake or issue you identified and how you caught it. * What ultimately shipped and how you improved it after release. Working demonstrations, anonymized case studies, and redacted materials are welcome. **Requirements** **Product and engineering requirements** * A track record of leading discovery and personally taking products or substantial workflows from an ambiguous need through visual design, architecture, implementation, production release, and continued improvement. * Deep hands\-on proficiency in TypeScript, React, and Node.js, with the ability to explain, debug, and maintain the full application and the code generated by AI. * Strong practical experience with MongoDB, Docker, Azure, Git, and CI/CD; REST APIs, service boundaries, authentication, authorization, and automated testing. * A portfolio or case studies showing visual direction you personally created and implemented; strong product judgment, stakeholder communication, and the ability to simplify complex workflows. **Required AI development experience** You use AI coding tools and agents as a repeatable part of professional software delivery. Be ready to demonstrate the following: * Substantial hands\-on experience with one or more tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, or GitHub Copilot, supported by production work you personally shipped. * Effective agentic coding: define the task, establish acceptance criteria, guide work across relevant files and services, inspect changes, and correct the approach when needed. * Practical context engineering: give agents the relevant requirements, repository context, architectural constraints, and examples. Maintain concise project instructions and reusable workflows where they improve results. * Independent verification of AI output through code review, type checks, appropriate automated tests, and direct inspection of the application. Identify invented APIs, missed requirements, security issues, and regressions. * Good judgment about when to delegate work to AI, when to investigate directly, and when to reject or rework a proposed solution. Balance tool capability, cost, speed, and reliability. * Careful handling of company and customer information, credentials, tool permissions, and production access when using AI tools. ### **Nice to Have** * Experience building **AI\-powered application features** using LLM APIs, structured outputs, tool calling, retrieval, or model evaluations. * Experience improving AI\-development workflows through reusable agent instructions, automated checks, or **Model Context Protocol (MCP)** integrations. * Experience with **MSP operations, enterprise administration, or internal business applications**. **Benefits** * Competitive salary range * Paid time off and company holidays * Health, dental, and vision insurance options * 401(k) retirement plan with company match * On\-site gym for employee wellness * Modern, collaborative office environment * Ongoing training and professional development * Opportunity to work with cutting\-edge technology * Team events and employee appreciation initiatives * Strong company culture focused on innovation and teamwork

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Overview:** ExploreK12 Literacy is looking for a Principal Software Engineer who combines deep technical expertise, strong engineering judgment, and hands\-on execution. This role is for an engineer who can get deeply into a complex, mature application, understand how it actually works, and help determine how it should evolve. You will work directly in the code while also helping teams navigate difficult technical decisions, modernization efforts, architectural constraints, and ambiguous engineering problems. You will be a senior technical leader within the Literacy product area, partnering closely with engineers, engineering leaders, and architects to help shape technical direction across multiple teams and products. You will help shape technical direction, surface risks and tradeoffs, and turn complex problems into practical paths forward. You will also work across product boundaries where shared capabilities or product convergence require coordination with other engineering teams. Modernization is an important part of this role, but it is not the goal by itself. The goal is to enable the future of the product while making the system easier to understand, change, test, deploy, and operate. Sometimes that means modernizing a system. Sometimes it means integrating with it, isolating it, incrementally replacing part of it, or deliberately leaving it alone. We are also looking for someone who is fluent in modern AI\-assisted software development and interested in applying AI thoughtfully where it can improve engineering effectiveness or create meaningful product value. You do not need to be an AI specialist. **Job Responsibilities:** **Solve Difficult Technical Problems** * Get deeply into our applications, codebases, data flows, integrations, dependencies, and operational behavior to understand how the system actually works. * Investigate complex technical problems through multiple layers of the system until the underlying causes and constraints are understood. * Turn ambiguous or complicated engineering problems into clear problem statements, options, tradeoffs, and recommended approaches. * Bring strong technical judgment to decisions involving complexity, risk, customer value, cost, maintainability, team capacity, and future product needs. * Surface significant technical risks early and take clear, well\-supported positions when you believe the organization is heading toward a poor technical outcome. **Remain a Hands\-On Engineer** * Contribute meaningful production code and take direct responsibility for technical work where your involvement can have high impact. * Depending on the needs of the product, own or contribute to projects, features, migrations, prototypes, architectural changes, and difficult engineering investigations. * Work at both the architecture and implementation levels, moving between system\-level reasoning and code\-level details as the problem requires. * Use hands\-on involvement to build firsthand understanding of the system rather than operating primarily through architecture documents and reviews. * Exercise judgment about when personally implementing a solution is the highest\-leverage contribution and when enabling another engineer or team will create greater value. **Help Evolve a Mature Product** * Partner with architects and product engineering leaders to understand the current application landscape and help craft practical approaches for its evolution. * Identify where architectural constraints and technical debt are materially affecting engineering effectiveness or limiting future product capabilities. * Recommend modernization investments based on evidence, expected value, risk, cost, reversibility, team capacity, and product direction. * Apply approaches such as incremental replacement, modularization, API enablement, migration, strangler patterns, or parallel adoption when they are appropriate to the problem. * Help teams decompose significant technical change into achievable increments that reduce risk and produce useful progress. * Recognize when existing technology is adequate and modernization would create more cost or risk than value. * Help reduce friction in how engineers understand, change, test, deploy, and operate important parts of the product. * Contribute to a credible longer\-term path for the product's technical evolution rather than treating modernization as a collection of isolated projects. **Provide Principal\-Level Technical Leadership** * Be a high\-leverage technical partner on important architectural decisions, novel problems, technically risky initiatives, and work with significant cross\-product implications. * Identify architectural constraints, technical risks, and systemic issues that span multiple teams, products, or strategic initiatives, and help drive resolution before they become significant delivery, operational, or customer\-impacting problems. * Work with Product and Design during solution discovery and implementation planning  * Over your first year, success should be visible in both the product and the engineering organization. Important parts of the system are becoming easier for engineers to understand, change, test, deploy, or operate. The organization has a clearer, credible path for evolving the product's architecture, and meaningful modernization work is underway where it creates real value. Some of that evolution may also unlock product capabilities that were previously difficult or impractical to deliver. Teams are making more consistent technical decisions across product boundaries because shared architectural assumptions, integration approaches, and long\-term technical tradeoffs are understood earlier. Cross\-team technical risks are surfaced sooner, and the organization has greater confidence in its technical direction beyond any individual application or team. Senior engineers and technical leads are taking on increasingly difficult technical problems with stronger judgment and greater independence. Your presence increases the organization's technical capability rather than creating dependency on you. AI is becoming a practical part of how engineering works, and useful opportunities for AI in the product are being identified and pursued based on customer and business value rather than novelty. **Why Work for Us** When you join ExploreK12™, you become part of a mission to help educators unlock brighter futures for every student. As a trusted leader in educational technology, we serve more than 17 million students and educators across 150\+ countries with innovative, research\-backed learning solutions that truly make a difference. Our flagship products—Gizmos™, Raz\-Plus®, and Reflex™—are beloved by educators and students alike for being as practical and effective as they are fun. To learn more about our organization and the exciting work we do, visit www.ExploreK12\.com. **Remote First Work Environment** Our Remote First approach gives employees the flexibility and trust they need to effectively balance work with life. It creates a culture in which all employees are valued and where success is measured in results. It allows us to work collaboratively, inclusively and for greater positive impact, regardless of our individual locations. If you will be working remotely, either occasionally or on a permanent basis, you must have a reliable internet connection through a cable or fiber\-optic broadband service with minimum speeds of 10 Mbps download and 5 Mbps upload. The successful candidate will be expected to actively participate in video\-based interviews during the recruiting process and ongoing virtual meetings with their camera on, as part of their role. To maintain confidentiality and ensure a fair evaluation process, the use of note\-taking tools, reference materials, or AI\-powered tools (including generative AI, language models, or similar technologies) during interviews or other selection activities is prohibited unless prior written approval has been obtained from the People Experience team. platform services carry baselines and you hold them The self\-service surfaces product engineers use: your components ship with documentation, sane defaults, and no ticket queue Co\-building with product teams: new shared services start embedded with a product line and graduate to platform services when proven **What you will need** ---------------------- Strong production engineering: Python plus one systems language (Go or Rust welcome), Kubernetes, infrastructure\-as\-code, and one major cloud Hands\-on experience with LLM infrastructure: a model gateway pattern (such as LiteLLM or in\-house), model serving (such as vLLM or managed endpoints), and vector or retrieval systems Agent\-systems experience: you have built with an agent orchestration framework (such as LangGraph or first\-party agent SDKs) and understand tool calling and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) Evaluation engineering: you have built or operated eval harnesses (golden datasets, regression gates in CI, LLM\-judge calibration) and can explain why they gate merges Post\-training fluency: you have fine\-tuned or post\-trained a model, built the data pipeline behind one, or reproduced techniques from recent papers in production systems Daily, hands\-on use of AI coding assistants as part of your own development workflow We care about depth in four or five of these areas more than surface familiarity with all of them. What sets you apart Guardrail\-engine or AI\-observability experience (NeMo Guardrails, OpenTelemetry GenAI conventions, LangSmith, Braintrust, or equivalent) Reinforcement learning infrastructure (reward modelling, RLHF or GRPO\-class pipelines) or SLM distillation experience Multi\-tenant SaaS infrastructure: tenancy isolation, metering, usage\-based billing Financial services engineering (banks, insurers, or payment providers) is the ideal background; other regulated\-industry or security engineering depth also counts Open\-source contributions or a portfolio of deployed agents and eval suites (we would rather see this than a CV) The reference stack The reference technology stack for this role is our supported paved road: self\-hosted LangSmith and LangGraph Platform as the agent runtime and evaluation plane, model providers behind a swappable gateway seam, PostgreSQL with pgvector plus ClickHouse and S3\-compatible object storage as the data platform, Neo4j Enterprise as the semantic knowledge graph, an agent memory plane serving episodic and precedent memory over MCP, MCP\-native connectors, OpenTelemetry and Grafana for observability, all on CNCF\-conformant Kubernetes with Helm and Argo CD, deployable to any hyperscaler or on\-prem. Review, not typing, is where engineering judgment goes. Three human gates govern everything we ship: spec approval, merge, and release. Regulated code paths (money movement, authentication, cryptography, secrets) are always human owned. Small and senior by design. No separate QA function, no scrum masters; quality . jobs.title: Software Engineer - Clinical Software
jobs.description: **At Caris, we understand that cancer is an ugly word—a word no one wants to hear, but one that connects us all. That’s why we’re not just transforming cancer care—we’re changing lives.** We introduced precision medicine to the world and built an industry around the idea that every patient deserves answers as unique as their DNA. Backed by cutting\-edge molecular science and AI, we ask ourselves every day: *“What would I do if this patient were my mom?”* That question drives everything we do. But our mission doesn’t stop with cancer. We're pushing the frontiers of medicine and leading a revolution in healthcare—driven by innovation, compassion, and purpose. **Join us in our mission to improve the human condition across multiple diseases. If you're passionate about meaningful work and want to be part of something bigger than yourself, Caris is where your impact begins.** **Position Summary** Caris Life Sciences serves hundreds of thousands of molecular cases a year and continues to grow at double\-digit rates. Its molecular, imaging, and clinical\-outcomes data support software that helps ensure a cancer patient's report is right, complete, and on time. The Software Engineer, Clinical Software Products contributes engineering work across Caris's clinical application portfolio: product delivery, reliability, and incremental modernization of the production systems that support regulated clinical workflows. This assignment supports the case\-management and order\-intake platform: the order front door and case\-lifecycle services every case runs through on its way to a report. Engineers deliver features and integrations across an actively modernizing platform, with emphasis on data integrity, controlled change, and order\-to\-report throughput. The engineering environment supports advanced AI coding assistants and agentic workflows across design, implementation, and test generation. Characterization tests and golden\-master replay validation provide executable evidence. Onboarding is harness\-first: the engineer builds or extends characterization tests to capture current behavior as repeatable validation evidence. Delivery runs on CI/CD, automated testing, application\-level observability, and risk\-based release governance aligned with current FDA Computer Software Assurance guidance. Representative technologies across the portfolio include Java, TypeScript, browser\-based application frameworks, server\-side JavaScript, and selected enterprise Java components. The interview process covers the specific assignment and technology stack. Reporting to an Engineering Manager or Senior Engineering Manager within Clinical Software Engineering, this individual contributor builds and maintains clinical software applications governed by SOX financial controls and FDA regulatory requirements. The role contributes to technical delivery on an assigned product team and upholds the engineering and compliance standards those systems require. Location: Irving, Texas (Dallas–Fort Worth), on\-site. **Job Responsibilities** * Design, implement, and maintain features and components across Caris's clinical software platforms: well\-structured, testable, documented code that holds up in a regulated production environment. * Contribute to design and architecture discussions, understanding the technical options and trade\-offs that inform the team's decisions. * Give and receive peer code review, upholding code\-quality standards and surfacing issues that could affect system correctness, performance, or compliance. * Work with product management to clarify requirements, understand technical constraints, and estimate backlog items. * Help maintain the technical record: design documents, architecture decision records, and operational runbooks that meet SOX and FDA change\-control obligations. * Instrument, monitor, and support production systems; participate in incident response and root\-cause analysis for production issues. * Build automated test coverage across unit, integration, and end\-to\-end levels as first\-class engineering work. * Automate the recurring engineering and operational work that delivery turns up: repeated manual steps become scripted, reviewed automation, not standing process. * Participate in pair programming and structured knowledge sharing with peers, escalating to senior engineers on complex architectural or compliance questions. * Identify technical\-debt and reliability concerns and propose and carry out remediation work that improves system maintainability or compliance posture. * Work AI\-first: use AI coding assistants and agentic workflows as daily practice across design, implementation, and test generation, with peer and engineering review as the quality gate. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 3\+ years of professional software engineering experience building and maintaining production software systems. * Hands\-on experience across the full SDLC in a team setting: requirements refinement, design, implementation, testing, and release. * A track record of writing and maintaining automated tests for production software, at the unit, integration, or end\-to\-end level. * Working proficiency in code review and in applying engineering standards to shared codebases. * Hands\-on experience with AI coding assistants and agentic development workflows in real engineering work. * Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, specifically Word, Excel, Outlook, and general working knowledge of Internet for business use. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience in healthcare, clinical laboratory, diagnostics, or life sciences software environments. * Familiarity with agile delivery frameworks and the tooling around them. * Exposure to cloud\-native application development and deployment patterns. * Interest in growing into technical design and architecture discussions, with the ability to explain ideas clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences. * Willingness to participate in pair programming, knowledge sharing, or structured peer learning. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills applied to complex, regulated production systems. * Experience in environments governed by FDA requirements, SOX controls, CLIA, or HIPAA. Regulated\-domain experience is preferred, not required. **Physical Demands** * Ability to sit, stand, and work at a computer for extended periods. **Training** * All job\-specific, safety, and compliance training is assigned based on the job functions associated with this employee. **Other** * This role may require periodic travel to other Caris sites or partner locations. * After\-hours response to emergency production issues and participation in periodic scheduled on\-call rotations may be required. **Conditions of Employment:** Individual must successfully complete pre\-employment process, which includes criminal background check, drug screening, credit check ( applicable for certain positions) and reference verification. This job description reflects management’s assignment of essential functions. Nothing in this job description restricts management’s right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. Caris Life Sciences is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: DATA QUALITY ENGINEER I/II/III
jobs.description: The Data Quality Engineer supports institutional data quality across Central Michigan University by profiling, validating, cleansing, converting, reconciling, and improving data used by enterprise systems, reporting, compliance, decision\-making, and ERP migration efforts. The position develops and applies data quality rules, validates source\-to\-target mappings, documents findings, tracks issues, troubleshoots data problems, and coordinates with functional and technical partners to improve the accuracy, completeness, consistency, reliability, security, and usability of institutional data. The position will support ERP migration, operational data quality, reporting, integration, and ongoing data governance activities across student, finance, human resources, payroll, procurement, research administration, and other administrative data domains. **Required Qualifications** Data Quality Engineer I: Foundational knowledge of data analysis, reporting, data quality, or enterprise data concepts. Familiarity with relational databases, SQL, spreadsheets, reporting tools, or data extraction methods. Ability to troubleshoot routine data issues, follow established procedures, and learn institutional systems and data processes. Strong attention to detail, communication, customer service, and collaboration skills. Data Quality Engineer II: All the qualifications of Data Quality Engineer I, plus: Four years of experience, or equivalent combination of education and experience, related to data analysis, data quality, reporting, data migration, data integration, or enterprise systems. Experience supporting data profiling, validation, cleansing, reconciliation, reporting, or data conversion activities. Experience with enterprise data support technologies such as SQL databases, reporting tools, ETL or data integration tools, data warehouses, dashboards, or enterprise application data services. Ability to recommend and implement improvements to data validation, data remediation, documentation, or operational practices. Working knowledge of data quality rules, source\-to\-target mapping, validation logic, and ongoing data management processes. Experience with data issue analysis, root\-cause investigation, troubleshooting, or performance support. Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and collaboration skills. Data Quality Engineer III: All the qualifications of Data Quality Engineer II, plus: Six years of experience, or equivalent combination of education and experience, related to data analysis, data quality, reporting, data migration, data integration, or enterprise systems. Experience contributing to data quality planning, validation strategies, remediation approaches, or operational improvement efforts for enterprise data and related systems. Strong working knowledge of relational data structures, SQL, reporting, ETL, integration, or data warehouse technologies used to support enterprise data quality work. Strong working knowledge of relational data structures, SQL, reporting, ETL, integration, or data warehouse technologies that support enterprise data quality work. Experience working with ERP, cloud\-hosted, vendor\-managed, or hybrid application data environments. Ability to mentor, support, or share knowledge with other staff. Experience supporting integrations or data exchange activities across multiple systems. Ability to contribute to the design, improvement, or long\-term support of enterprise data quality solutions. Excellent communication, collaboration, and problem\-solving skills. Senior Data Quality Engineer: All the qualifications of Data Quality Engineer III, plus: Eight years of experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience, related to data analysis, data quality, reporting, data migration, data integration, or enterprise systems. Experience leading data quality, data conversion, reconciliation, remediation, or enterprise data management work across multiple complex data domains or services. Strong understanding of data governance, data stewardship, security practices, risk mitigation, and operational reliability in enterprise data environments. Ability to lead or significantly contribute to the design, scalability, resiliency, and long\-term support of enterprise data quality solutions, validation processes, and reconciliation practices. Demonstrated ability to identify improvement opportunities and develop practical recommendations for implementation. Demonstrated professionalism and sound judgment in working with faculty, staff, students, vendors, implementation partners, and other stakeholders. Demonstrated leadership in communication, coordination, or stakeholder engagement for complex data quality work. Models collaborative, service\-oriented, and values\-based behavior in support of team and university goals. **Preferred Qualifications** Experience with enterprise platforms and technologies such as SAP, Oracle, Workday, SQL Server, data warehouses, business intelligence platforms, t approaches, software solutions, and works with business offices to address business needs or improve processes. **Supervision Exercised** None. **Message to Applicants** Central Michigan University is dedicated to fostering an environment that is reflective of the communities we serve. We are especially interested in highly qualified candidates who will advance and promote CMU’s mission, vision, and leadership standards. You must submit an on\-line application in order to be considered as an applicant for this position. Cover letters may be addressed to the Hiring Committee. This position will remain open until filled. The university reserves the right to close the recruitment process once a sufficient applicant pool has been identified. **For best consideration, please submit application materials on or before November 17th, 2026\.** **Employee Group** Professional \& Administrative \-Salary **Staff Pay Level** **Pay Range** $60,000 \- $85,000 **Division** President **Department** Application Support \& Dev \- OIT **Position Status** Provisional **Position End Date** 12/01/2031 **Employment Status** Full\-Time **FTE** 1\.0 **Position Type** 12 month **Weekly Work Schedule** M\-F, 8\-5 **Location** Mount Pleasant, MI **About the Department** **About CMU** Central Michigan University has a more than 125\-year legacy of preparing students to become leaders and changemakers in their communities and in their personal and professional lives. We serve nearly 15,500 students on our Mount Pleasant campus, in satellite locations around the state and throughout the country, and through flexible online programs. Many of our approximately 300 undergraduate, master’s, specialist and doctoral programs in the arts, media, business, education, human services, health professions, liberal arts, social sciences, medicine, science and engineering are nationally ranked for excellence. CMU leads the nation in leadership development programming through our Sarah R. Opperman Leadership Institute, and we are proud to be among only 5% of U.S. universities in the top two Carnegie research classifications. Our faculty work with graduate and undergraduate students in areas such as Great Lakes research, medical innovation, engineering technology and more. Central is home to 17 men’s and women’s Division 1 sports including football, basketball, gymnastics, baseball, wrestling and more. Our student\-athletes achieve great success in competition and in the classroom, capturing Mid\-American Conference championships and maintaining an average cumulative GPA of 3\.17\. CMU is located in Mount Pleasant, a community that blends the best of small\-town living with big\-city amenities. It’s part of the culturally varied and vibrant Great Lakes Bay Region that also includes Saginaw, Bay City, Midland and the state’s largest Native American community, centered on the Saginaw Chippewa Isabella Reservation in Mount Pleasant. Area residents enjoy the mix of outdoor activities, cultural events, shopping and dining options, and family attractions. Other major Michigan destinations and attractions — Lansing, Grand Rapids, Detroit, Traverse City, wineries, beaches, golf and ski resorts, and many more — are within easy reach of the city’s central location in Michigan’s Lower Peninsula. CMU employees enjoy access to a nationally recognized wellness program along with health care and benefits that exceed regional, state and national norms. **CMU Leadership Standards** Central Michigan University is a place where we value students and work for their success, where we act as family, and where employees are engaged, appreciated and have extraordinary opportunities to make a difference. We intentionally maintain and strengthen the hallmark CMU culture that sets us apart from our peers by expecting CMU leaders and employees to model the following Leadership Standards and develop them within their teams. Please review the **Leadership Standards** before applying for this position.

**Key Accountabilities:** * Design and deploy multi\-step AI automation flows that connect LLM inference, CRM triggers, webhook events, and data transforms across integrated systems * Build and prompt templates, few\-shot frameworks, and output validation logic to ensure AI responses meet business\-defined quality standards * Develop and run LLM evaluation pipelines using frameworks such as reporting workflows * Translate technical model outputs into interpretable business signals, supporting revenue operations and pipeline visibility **Desired Skills and Experience:** **Required:** * quality and business\-aligned evaluation frameworks. * **Knowledge\-based AI \& ontology design** Understands how to structure what a system needs to know — defining entity types, relationships, and From homes to industries that shape lives, we deliver solutions that keep people connected and energized—and it all starts with you. We’re doing things that matter. Our electrical engineering solutions impact millions worldwide through safe and dependable energy supply. We deliver electrical solutions from the ocean depths to outer space. As part of Marmon, you’re helping keep millions worldwide healthy, connected and safe. **Cerrowire**®, a **Marmon/Berkshire Hathaway** company, is a leading U.S. copper wire supplier for residential, commercial and industrial applications. In addition to rugged and dependable, guaranteed products, including MC cables and aluminum wires, the **Cerrowire** focus is on customer service and delivering on time and in full from our wire manufacturing plants in Alabama, Georgia, Indiana, and Utah. The successful candidate brings solid Fabric, SQL and Python skills, hands\-on generative AI experience, and the judgment to build AI that is secure, measurable and cost\-aware. **Why Join Us?** * Health Benefits effective day one (Life, Health, Dental, Vision) * Holiday pay effective day one * Vacation and Personal Time Off (prorated \& accrued) * Tuition Reimbursement * Employee Discount Program * Six Sigma \& Lean Training * Learning \& Development Training * 401k with company matching **Key Responsibilities:** Data \& Analytics * Build and maintain gold\-layer data products, semantic models and standardized business metrics in Microsoft Fabric, partnering with the Senior Data Engineer on upstream pipelines. * Develop Power BI reports and Copilot\-enabled experiences that let users securely interact with governed datasets. * Implement usage telemetry and adoption dashboards for BI, automation and AI tools, and recommend improvements based on usage patterns.
