jobs.title: Principal Solution Engineer
jobs.description: **Principal Solution Engineer, US** =================================== US – Remote **ABOUT CERTINIA** ------------------ Certinia (formerly FinancialForce) is the leading Services\-as\-a\-Business platform, connecting every stage of the services lifecycle — from opportunity and delivery through customer success and financial management — on a single, Salesforce\-native platform. Certinia's Professional Services Automation (PSA), Financial Management (FM), and Customer Success (CS) solutions, together with Veda, Certinia's AI layer, give services businesses the intelligence and agility to run with certainty and grow with confidence. Headquartered in Austin, Texas, with team members around the world, Certinia is backed by Haveli Investments, TA Associates, General Atlantic, and Salesforce Ventures. For more information, visit www.certinia.com (http://www.certinia.com). **THE ROLE** ------------ Solution Engineers are trusted advisors focused on customer outcomes. Through structured, value\-based discovery and demonstration, we help prospects see a clear, credible path to transformation on the Certinia platform — including how Certinia's agentic AI capabilities change the way services businesses run. We continually build our solution expertise, our command of the competitive landscape, and our ability to present value in business terms our customers care about. Beyond deal execution, we support pipeline\-generating activity, contribute to sales enablement, and feed market and competitive intelligence back into product and marketing. The Principal Solution Engineer is a senior individual contributor and the solution expert on Certinia's most complex opportunities, with a focus on the industry's leading solution for Professional Services Automation and the AI capabilities that now extend it. You will co\-own strategic opportunities with Account Executives from first discovery through value realization, lead executive\-level demonstrations and value narratives, and set the standard for how the Solution Engineering team sells. You will also help shape how AI is used inside the presales motion itself — building, piloting, and sharing the agents, assets, and practices that make the whole team faster and more effective. Ideal candidates bring deep services\-industry credibility, strong executive presence, and genuine curiosity about how AI is changing both what we sell and how we sell it. **WHAT YOU'LL DO** ------------------ ### **Win complex, multi\-stakeholder deals** * Fully understand customer and prospect requirements and priorities through structured, executive\-level discovery. * Partner with Account Executives to deliver engaging, value\-centric demonstrations and executive readouts that differentiate Certinia, using the Tell–Show–Tell methodology. * Co\-own strategic opportunities as the solution expert throughout both net new and ongoing customer cycles, including multi\-threaded engagements with finance, operations, delivery, and IT stakeholders. * Build quantified value narratives and business\-case models that connect platform capability to outcomes a CFO or COO will act on. * Lead or support responses to RFIs, RFPs, and security questionnaires on the most strategic pursuits. ### **Sell AI credibly to enterprise buyers** * Position Certinia's Veda AI capabilities and agentic workflows in customer evaluations — showing what is real and shippable today, where autonomy is safe, and where a human stays in the loop. * Help customers think through governance, data security, and risk when considering AI agents running parts of their business, and answer the hard questions from technical and executive buyers with confidence. * Demonstrate how Veda works across Certinia's PSA, FM, and CS solutions on a single, Salesforce\-native platform to deliver an AI\-enabled services business. * Stay current on how competitors package and claim agentic capability, and help the team respond with accuracy rather than hype. ### **Innovate how we work with AI** * Use AI tools jobs.title: Grants Engine: Engineering Manager
jobs.description: **Grants Engine: Engineering Manager** *Child Poverty Action Lab / Full\-time / Remote* **About the Role** The Grants Engine is an AI\-powered tool that helps public agencies and community organizations find, prioritize, and pursue federal and state funding. It combines a continuously updated grant clearinghouse built from automated scrapers, AI\-driven synthesis of long funding notices into the eligibility criteria that actually matter, recommendations based on organizational profiles and priorities, and grant pipeline and cohort management tools. Our goal is to put public funding within reach of organizations that do not have grant\-writing staff. We are live with beta users, onboarding our first statewide partner, and moving toward general access, with rapid state\-by\-state expansion of grant coverage. Today the product is built by two contracted development firms (application and data ingestion), an infrastructure engineer, and part\-time support from CPAL's centralized engineering team. Automated testing and regression testing, standardized deployment, logging, and monitoring are now in place across the application and scraper pipeline. What we do not have is a dedicated owner for this layer. With work split across vendors, no single person holds the architecture and technical quality of the whole system, and downstream impacts of one team's decisions surface later than they should. As our first engineering manager, you will bring technical ownership in\-house: assess what is actually in place, decide what to keep, what to deepen, and what to replace, and then own it from there. **Responsibilities** * Own technical implementation of the product roadmap end to end, from scoping through delivery. * Partner with the Product Lead to scope features, size effort, and plan resourcing. Surface downstream impacts and tradeoffs early, in terms non\-engineers can weigh. * Translate partner commitments (data integrations, custom configuration, API work) into realistic technical plans and timelines. * Own the architectural direction of both the application and the data ingestion pipeline, and make sure the two are designed as one coherent system rather than two products that happen to share a database. Set and enforce the standard for what "done" means (test coverage, observability, documentation) through design discussions and code review. * Extend our testing practice into the evaluation infrastructure our AI workflows require. A wrong summary can cost an organization weeks on an ineligible application. * Own our engineering practices (testing, deployment, logging, monitoring): deepen coverage, close the gaps, and make sure they are consistently followed rather than nominally in place. * Build operational discipline: a real cadence for reviewing logs and alerts, clear ownership when something breaks, and the habit of catching problems before users report them. * Serve as the single point of technical accountability across our contracted and internal engineers. Work with the Product Lead to set shared standards and communication cadence, and hold contracted partners to them. * Help define, recruit for, and hire the engineering roles we add as we scale, including deciding where contracted work should move in\-house. Onboard and mentor engineers, and raise the technical bar of everyone around you. **Engineering \<\> Product** The Engineering Lead (EL) reports to the Product Lead (PL). The PL owns roadmap strategy, prioritization, and phasing, and is accountable for what we build and why. The EL owns how we build it and is accountable for technical quality, architecture, and delivery. This is a reporting line, but the working relationship is a partnership. The EL is expected to push back on sequencing, scope, and timelines when the technical reality warrants it, bringing an alternative rather than only an objection, and to raise infrastructure and technical debt early enough to shape the roadmap. * Architecture, technical design, engineering standards, and technical hiring decisions are the EL's call. * Prioritization tradeoffs, partner commitments, and scope decisions are the PL's call, made with the EL's input. * Where the two conflict, the expectation is that it gets worked out between them with the tradeoffs made explicit, not escalated by default. A working sign of success in this partnership is that the PL is no longer coordinating between development teams, chasing deployments, or personally verifying that downstream technical impacts were considered. **What we are looking for** * Significant hands\-on software engineering experience on production systems, with a track record of leading engineers as a team lead, engineering manager, or technical lead. * Hands\-on: you will read code, review pull requests, debug production issues, and write code when it is the fastest path. * Pragmatic: you know which corners are safe to cut at this stage and which are not, and you can explain the difference to a non\-engineer. * Sound judgment about existing systems. You have taken a team from "we have this" to "this actually works and everyone follows it" (test coverage, CI/CD, observability, incident response, code review) without grinding delivery to a halt, strengthening what is worth keeping rather than rebuilding by default. * Strong systems and architecture judgment, and the ability to quickly understand a codebase you did not write, with enough range across frontend, backend, data pipelines, and AWS infrastructure to make sound decisions, evaluate others' work, and lead an infrastructure migration with specialists. * Clear communicator who builds trust across teams, including with contractors you do not directly employ. * Ownership\-driven and comfortable with ambiguity: you name problems and take them on rather than waiting for direction. **Helpful, not required** * Experience with web scraping, ETL, or data pipeline systems at scale, particularly where upstream sources change without warning. * Experience building evaluation and quality infrastructure for LLM or AI\-driven product features. * Experience managing or transitioning work from external development agencies to an internal team. * Experience in civic technology, government technology, or the nonprofit sector. **Logistics** * Location: Remote, with quarterly travel to offices in Dallas * Compensation: $200K \- $250K base

jobs.title: Senior FinOps Engineer, Global Data & Analytics
jobs.description: **ABOUT THE ROLE** AI is generating cost at a scale and complexity that traditional FinOps tooling was not built for — and this role exists to solve that problem. As FinOps Engineer, you will design and maintain the data pipelines that move metered AI usage from our internal AI Studio platform into clean, trusted, reporting\-ready datasets. You will build and automate the dashboards that surface weekly exceptions and drive monthly billing accuracy, ensuring that chargeback across business units, platforms, applications, models, and environments is always defensible and timely. This is a hands\-on engineering role with direct visibility into how the organization understands and governs its AI investment. **WHAT YOU'LL DO** **Pipeline Engineering \& Data Architecture** * Design, build, and maintain data pipelines that ingest metered usage data from AI Studio and API\-sourced datasets, transforming raw consumption signals into normalized, reporting\-ready structures * Ensure spend is accurately attributed at every relevant dimension — business unit, platform, application, model, and environment — with consistent lineage and auditable methodology * Integrate data from multiple sources (AI Studio, cloud billing APIs, Snowflake, Databricks) into a coherent, trusted cost dataset that Finance and Engineering teams can rely on for decisions * Implement data quality controls, reconciliation checks, and anomaly detection logic to catch attribution errors, missing data, and billing discrepancies before they reach downstream consumers * Maintain pipeline reliability and timeliness — cost data that arrives late or with gaps is not useful for governance; build with that constraint in mind * Evolve the data architecture as new AI platforms, models, and usage patterns come in scope, keeping the system extensible without accumulating technical debt **Reporting \& Dashboard Automation** * Build and automate Power BI dashboards that track weekly cost exceptions — surfacing anomalies, budget variances, and unallocated spend with enough context that owners can act without additional investigation * Develop monthly billing metrics dashboards that drive chargeback processing, giving Finance clear visibility into actuals by business unit and cost category * Automate recurring reporting workflows — month\-end close support, variance summaries, trend analysis — reducing manual effort and eliminating recurring rebuild cycles * Design reports that serve multiple audiences: technical detail for engineering owners, financial summaries for Finance partners, and executive\-ready rollups for leadership * Instrument unit economics views — cost per model, cost per application, cost per environment — that help teams understand the financial weight of their AI choices **Cost Attribution \& Chargeback** * Own the technical implementation of the chargeback model: ensuring spend is tagged, allocated, and attributed consistently across all dimensions required for accurate billing * Partner with the FinOps Team Lead and Finance to translate business rules for cost allocation into pipeline logic and reporting outputs * Identify and remediate attribution gaps — untagged resources, missing ownership metadata, inconsistent naming — through automation rather than manual correction * Build alerting and threshold logic that flags exceptions in near\-real\-time, enabling the operating team to investigate and resolve before monthly close * Track and report on chargeback accuracy over time, building confidence in the numbers with Finance stakeholders who rely on them for business unit P\&L **Practice Development** * Contribute to the evolution of the FinOps data model as AI consumption patterns grow in complexity — new models, new providers, new usage types require a pipeline that keeps pace * Evaluate and adopt relevant standards (e.g., FOCUS — FinOps Open Cost and Usage Specification) to ensure the organization's cost data aligns with emerging industry norms * Document pipeline design, data definitions, transformation logic, and dashboard specifications in a way that makes the system maintainable and understandable across the team * Identify opportunities to automate manual processes upstream and downstream of the pipeline — reducing toil and improving the timeliness and reliability of cost data * Solid data engineering background: experience building and maintaining production data pipelines that ingest, normalize, and transform data from multiple sources at scale * Proficiency in Python, including data manipulation libraries (pandas, and comparable tools for working with structured and semi\-structured datasets) * Strong SQL skills — able to write, optimize, and maintain queries against large datasets in modern data platforms * Experience with Snowflake and/or Databricks for data storage, transformation, and pipeline execution * Demonstrated ability to build dashboards and reports in Power BI that are trusted, used, and maintained — not just created and forgotten * Comfort working with API\-sourced datasets: designing ingestion patterns, handling schema changes, and ensuring data freshness and completeness * Understanding of cloud billing data structures — how usage is metered, rated, and reported — sufficient to work effectively with raw cost and usage data **Preferred** * Familiarity with Azure cost management data structures; experience with Azure Data Explorer (ADX) and Kusto Query Language (KQL) is a meaningful advantage in this environment * FinOps Certified Practitioner or FinOps Certified Engineer; working knowledge of the FinOps Foundation framework and cost management lifecycle * Experience with AI or LLM cost data — token consumption, model\-level attribution, inference vs. training cost structures, API\-based usage metering * Exposure to FinOps platforms (Apptio Cloudability , FinOut , or cloud\-native cost tools) and how their data can be integrated with internal pipelines * Experience implementing tagging standards, cost allocation automation, or data quality enforcement in a cloud billing context * Background working in a chargeback or showback environment where accuracy and auditability of cost data are non\-negotiable **KEY COMPETENCIES** * **Engineering discipline:** Builds pipelines that are reliable, documented, and maintainable — not just pipelines that work once. * **Data curiosity:** Asks why the numbers look the way they do; does not surface data without understanding it. * **Precision under ambiguity:** Produces accurate, auditable outputs even when upstream data is messy, incomplete, or inconsistently structured. * **Automation mindset:** Defaults to building systems that run without manual intervention; treats recurring manual effort as a problem to solve. * **Cross\-functional communication:** Translates technical data concepts into language that Finance and business stakeholders can act on. * **Ownership:** Treats the pipeline and dashboards as products — with reliability standards, change management, and accountability for quality. The pay range for the role is $134,200 to $195,800\. The specific offer will depend on an applicant’s skills and other factors. This role may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program. Chubb offers a comprehensive benefits package, more details on which can be found on our careers website. The disclosed pay range estimate may be adjusted for the applicable geographic differential for the location in which the position is filled. Chubb is a world leader in insurance. With operations in 54 countries, Chubb provides commercial and personal property and casualty insurance, personal accident and supplemental health insurance, reinsurance, and life insurance to a diverse group of clients. The company is distinguished by its extensive product and service offerings, broad distribution capabilities, exceptional financial strength, underwriting excellence, superior claims handling expertise and local operations globally. jobs.description: This is a hybrid position with the expectation of 3x/week in our SF office Software Engineer \- Platform Bringup Meet the Team Meraki Software Engineers breathe life into our cloud\-managed networking devices, which range from switches, routers, and wireless access points to desktop phones and security cameras. We leverage real\-time telemetry from thousands of deployed networks spanning the globe to continuously improve the performance and stability of our products. Platform Bring\-up Engineers play a key role in building new Meraki products by integrating everything from bootloaders to web servers on prototype hardware. Our device firmware is built on Linux and open\-source software. We work individually and in small teams to release several new products each year. The MV Cameras team is a small, fast\-moving group building security cameras with a unique edge\-storage architecture. The Meraki MV system is powerful, secure, and does not rely on any on\-premise servers, making it easy to deploy and scale from one to hundreds of cameras per site. Today, cameras are mainly used for security, but we are exploring how imagery can solve broader problems or offer unique insights. MV cameras blend the best of cloud and IoT technology, making it simple for customers to use the camera as a sensor. Your Impact **As a Software Engineer focused on platform bring\-up, you will:** * Execute on projects from prototype hardware bring\-up through to shipping product. * Partner with our Hardware Engineering team to validate component selection and support the architecture of new Meraki products. * Integrate vendor board support packages and software development kits with our firmware and build systems. * Develop, port, and debug Linux device drivers. * Contribute to the improvement of our firmware design, development, and deployment practices alongside the broader engineering team. Minimum Qualifications * Bachelors with 1\+ years of related experience or equivalent related work experience * Experience with embedded systems development, including cross\-platform development and build tools (GNU toolchain, OpenWRT, buildroot, or Yocto), bootloaders (U\-Boot, coreboot, or UEFI), kernel configuration, and device trees. * Experience with common bus protocols such as I2C, SPI, and MDIO. Preferred Qualifications * Experience writing device drivers. * Upstreaming Linux patches. * Experience reading and interpreting electrical schematics and technical data sheets. * Experience with multi\-threaded or parallel programming. * Experience with image sensors, GPUs, ISPs, DSPs, or H.264 video encoding technologies. Why Cisco? At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. We are Cisco, and our power starts with you. jobs.description: ### **Data Engineer** ### **In this role, you will:** * Experience with using AI\-assisted development tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Databricks Genie, OpenRouter, or similar) to accelerate coding, troubleshooting, and documentation, while reviewing and testing all AI\-generated output before it reaches production. * Develop new data pipelines in Azure Databricks, and contribute to the enterprise data lakehouse. * Enhance and extend existing SQL Server Agent jobs, stored procedures, views, functions and SSIS packages, including the surrounding schema changes each enhancement requires. * Develop, enhance and extend data integrations with external systems and APIs using Salesforce MuleSoft * Write and tune complex T\-SQL against large data volumes; analyze execution plans and apply indexing and statistics strategies to resolve performance problems. * Build and maintain data models and datasets that support Power BI reporting, including publishing, scheduled refresh and gateway configuration. * Perform data validation, reconciliation and data\-quality checks across source and target systems. * Provide production support for approximately 300 data integration jobs: monitor, triage, diagnose and resolve failures, and drive root\-cause analysis so the same failure does not recur. * Partner in person with team members, application developers, and business stakeholders across academic and administrative departments to gather requirements and deliver solutions. * Communicate status, root causes and business impact clearly to non\-technical stakeholders in written and verbal English. We are looking for team members who love our product and mission and see the remote first environment as a bonus. Beyond the job description, here are some traits members of our team share: We value **Curiosity** and learning in our employees. We promote open\-mindedness, embrace mistakes, and encourage challenging questions for personal growth. We create a culture of continuous learning to empower our team to tackle challenges and excel in their roles. **Efficiency in everything**. We operate lean, optimizing resources to improve our products and deliver a world\-class customer experience. We prioritize value over excess, embodying a scrappy and resourceful spirit to achieve our mission and values. We prioritize taking decisive action over deliberation, recognizing that building a world\-class product requires pushing personal limits and taking risks. We believe that a **Bias Toward Action** is essential for achieving our goals and delivering exceptional results to our customers. We strive for **Transparency** and prioritize open, Direct communication. This helps us resolve issues quickly and build strong relationships with our stakeholders. We take our work seriously and see it as a reflection of who we are. We're always looking for ways to improve and are open to feedback. We approach our work with a sense of ownership and a desire to deliver the best possible results. By embodying a **Founder Mindset**, we're able to achieve our goals and create exceptional products. We value a **Caring Mentality**. Our customers come first, and we collaborate to provide exceptional service. jobs.title: MEC Plant Engineer
jobs.description: Under the direction of the Plant Manager, the Plant Engineer provides technical leadership and engineering support to ensure the safe, reliable, environmentally compliant, and cost‑effective operation of the Middletown Energy Center. This role supports day‑to‑day plant operations, maintenance and outage planning, reliability and performance improvement initiatives, capital projects, and regulatory compliance efforts. Plant Engineer serves as a key technical resource for plant personnel and collaborates closely with operations, maintenance, contractors, vendors, and corporate support teams to optimize plant performance, equipment reliability, and overall availability. The Middletown Energy Center is 1x1 gas fired combined cycle facility utilizing Mitsubishi 501 GAC Gas Turbine and Toshiba Steam Turbine. The facility uses city water in a cooling tower for condenser cooling. The 475 MW facility is interconnected to the PJM market. ### **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** * Provide hands\-on engineering support for all combined cycle plant systems, equipment, and processes. * Troubleshoot equipment and system issues, supporting root cause analyses for forced outages, equipment failures, and performance deviations. * Monitor and analyze plant performance, heat rate, and reliability metrics to identify optimization and improvement opportunities. * Maintain accurate and current technical drawings, engineering files, system documentation, and reference materials. * Engineer, evaluate, justify, and implement plant modifications, upgrades, and reliability improvement initiatives. * Support planning and execution of scheduled and emergent outages, including scope development, contractor coordination, schedule support, quality oversight, and post‑outage reviews. * Develop scopes of work, technical specifications, bid packages, and engineering documentation for maintenance activities and outages. * Support reliability programs including Management of Change (MOC) and Root Cause Analysis (RCA), ensuring proper documentation and corrective action implementation. * Assist in development, optimization, and execution of preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance strategies within the CMMS. * Support capital project development, budgeting, execution, and cost tracking. * Coordinate and provide technical oversight of contractors, consultants, and vendors working on site. * Responsible for NERC compliance at plant level. * Support regulatory and corporate compliance requirements, including environmental, safety, and internal standards. * Assist with development and continuous improvement of plant procedures, operating practices, and maintenance programs. * Promote a strong safety culture and ensure compliance with all safety policies and regulatory requirements. * Provide technical guidance and mentorship to operations and maintenance personnel. * Support workforce development and qualification programs. * Participate in plant call‑out and emergency response activities as required. * Perform other duties as assigned. ### **Qualifications and Skills** **Required** * Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline (or equivalent combination of education, technical training, and industry experience). * 5–10 years of experience in power generation operations, maintenance, engineering, or related industrial environments. * Strong technical knowledge of combined cycle power plant systems, including gas turbines, steam turbines, HRSGs, generators, balance‑of‑plant systems, instrumentation, controls, and electrical systems. * Demonstrated troubleshooting, analytical, organizational, and communication skills. * Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast‑paced operational environment. **Preferred** * Experience supporting plant commissioning, outage execution, reliability engineering, and capital projects. * Familiarity with reliability‑centered maintenance (RCM) practices. * Experience with CMMS platforms such as Maximo or EAM. * Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel. * Ability to read and interpret P\&IDs, electrical schematics, and other engineering drawings. * Experience coordinating contractors and managing technical projects in an industrial or power generation setting. **Work Environment \& Physical Requirements** This position involves a combination of office and field work in an operating power plant environment. The Plant Engineer must be available for extended hours during outages and emergent conditions and participate in an on‑call rotation as required. Physical requirements include the ability to: * Climb ladders and stairs and work at heights * Enter confined spaces * Lift up to 50 pounds * Perform frequent walking, standing, bending, kneeling, reaching, and extended periods of physical activity Applicants must possess a **valid driver's license** and maintain a clean driving record, as this position requires occasional travel for company business. Candidates should be comfortable operating a vehicle as part of their job responsibilities and must meet any applicable company and insurance requirements. We offer a variety of excellent benefits. Full\-time employees are offered the following: medical, dental, vision, LTD, STD, and Life insurance plans. You can even select additional “al la carte” benefits to meet all your needs. You can also enroll in our 401k, flex spending accounts for medical and childcare needs, and participate in our employee referral and tuition reimbursement programs. Qualified Applicants must be legally authorized for employment in the United States. Qualified Applicants will not require employer sponsored work authorization now or in the future for employment in the United States. We believe in transparency and providing candidates with important information to make informed decisions. The salary range for this position is commensurate with experience, qualifications, and location. Actual compensation will be determined based on several factors, including but not limited to skills, experience, and relevant qualifications. This range represents the base salary and does not include other forms of compensation, such as bonuses, benefits, or equity, which may be offered in addition to the base pay. jobs.title: Senior Cloud Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description** 911 is the front door to American healthcare — and for millions of people, it's the wrong one. Americans place an estimated 240 million calls to 911 every year, and roughly 70–80% of EMS responses end in an ambulance ride to the emergency department — even when the patient doesn't need emergency\-level care. The system was built to transport, not to navigate. Crosswalk Health is building the navigation layer 911 was never designed to have. We partner with first responder agencies, community providers, and payors to route patients in crisis to the right care, in the right setting, at the right time. EMS is one of the most critical entry points in healthcare, and one of the most underutilized. We're changing that — aligning incentives across payors and providers to drive down costs at every level of the system, improve outcomes, and get high\-needs populations the care they actually need. **About the Role** Every day, people in crisis call 911\. Many of them don't need an emergency room. They need the right care, in the right setting, at the right time. Instead, they're transported to ERs, costs compound, and outcomes suffer. We're seeking a Senior Cloud Engineer to own our AWS environment and infrastructure as code. This is a true zero\-to\-one opportunity on a lean engineering team, where you'll build the system rather than inherit it. This is not a role for someone who wants a finished playbook to execute. You'll make real calls on how things get built, work alongside engineers at the top of their craft, and help shape how we use AI responsibly in a healthcare environment. If you want to build something that meaningfully changes how care gets delivered, and you want your AI\-native skills to get sharper rather than rustier, keep reading. **Reports to:** Director of Engineering **What You'll Do** * **Own Our AWS Environment:** Architect, administer, and evolve our cloud infrastructure on AWS, with reliability, security, and performance in mind. * **Build Infrastructure as Code:** Define and maintain our infrastructure through code so environments are repeatable, reviewable, and easy to reason about. * **Be AI\-Native, Without Cutting Corners:** Use AI tools to move faster while holding the line on the engineering fundamentals that keep software safe in production, don't break other systems, and stay understandable to humans. * **Help Define Responsible AI Autonomy:** Work with the team to figure out how to give AI more autonomy with the right guardrails and assurances in place. This is thought leadership you rarely get outside of your own side projects. * **Make Real Technical Calls:** Shape architecture and tooling decisions on a team small enough that your judgment matters. * **Partner Across the Department:** Work closely with our senior engineers and technical leaders on systems that handle sensitive healthcare data. **What We're Looking For** **Requirements:** * **Senior\-Level Cloud Experience:** 4\-8 years of experience in cloud or infrastructure engineering. * **AWS Depth:** Hands\-on experience administering AWS environments, not just using them. We're an AWS shop, so this is a must. * **Infrastructure as Code:** Strong experience defining and managing infrastructure through code. * **AI\-Native Mindset:** Comfortable using AI as a core part of how you work, and clear about where human judgment and engineering rigor still have to stay in the loop. * **Production Fundamentals:** A track record of shipping software and infrastructure that is safe to run in production. * **Ownership Mentality:** Comfortable in an early\-stage environment where you'll make decisions and build process as you go. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience in healthcare, health tech, or another environment with sensitive data and compliance requirements. **Life at Crosswalk** **Be the answer in someone’s most critical moment.** **Our mission:** Building healthier communities. **Our vision:** To be the answer to the needs of all patients in their most critical moments. **Why Crosswalk** * **Meaningful work, measurable impact.** Your work reaches real people on some of the hardest days of their lives, and you can see the results. * **Build from the ground up.** We’re seed\-stage, backed by Primary Ventures and LRV Health, and you’ll have real say in how this gets built. * **Learn from operators who’ve done it.** Our leadership team brings experience from Strive Health, Evolent Health, and Oak Street Health, alongside deep EMS leadership. * **Grow with a category\-defining company.** 911 care navigation is a new category, and we’re helping define it. **What drives us** **Integrity.** We uphold honesty and accountability in everything we do. **Compassion.** We bring empathy and understanding to our work and to each other. **Tenacity.** We persist through challenges with resilience and determination. **Camaraderie.** We build trusting relationships that create belonging and teamwork. **Disruption.** We challenge the status quo to drive transformative change. **Benefits that support you** * Medical coverage with Crosswalk paying 100% of the premium for every tier of our HDHP, so you and your dependents are covered at no cost to you * 401K with company match * Remote\-first team that makes time to be together: the whole company gathers twice a year, and you meet in person with your own team once a year. * 12 weeks of parental leave * Unlimited PTO \+ 10 company holidays **Help us give every 911 caller needs\-matched care. We’d love to meet you.**

Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission\-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you. **About the Role:** This is a backend engineering position on the Spotlight platform team. You will design, build, and operate the cloud\-native services and infrastructure that power CrowdStrike's endpoint vulnerability assessment capabilities at global scale. This role requires a strong focus on distributed systems, service reliability, scalability, and cloud architecture across AWS and GCP. This role also requires reasoning and judgment over large volumes of continuously changing data, at the scale CrowdStrike operates — work that conventional rule\-based systems have only partially addressed. We're treating agentic reasoning as a core architectural element rather than a feature layered onto an existing system, which means real decisions are still open: where reasoning belongs, where determinism is the better answer, and how to make either hold up in production. **The Product and Platform:** Falcon Vulnerability Assessment is the industry's first scan\-less endpoint vulnerability assessment solution, delivering real\-time, zero\-impact assessments of endpoint security posture. processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes. * Ability to communicate effectively at all levels of an organization * Strong collaboration skills and experience working in a global team * Commitment to software quality — unit tested, code reviewed, and continuously integrated **Bonus Points:** * Experience in cybersecurity — welcome, though not required * Experience with Kubernetes and event\-driven autoscaling (KEDA) * Experience with observability tooling (Splunk, Grafana, LogScale, or similar) * Familiarity with security vulnerability management or cybersecurity platforms * Good jobs.title: OT Security Engineer
jobs.description: **The Company** The energy industry is entering one of the most significant periods of growth and transformation in its history. Meeting the nation's growing demand for reliable electricity will require new ideas, new infrastructure, and talented people committed to building for the future. At Cypress Creek Energy, we're meeting that challenge by developing and operating the energy infrastructure needed to power communities, support economic opportunity, and strengthen resilience. We believe our responsibility extends beyond the grid and that how we build matters just as much as what we build. That same commitment extends to our employees. We invest in professional growth, encourage collaboration across teams, and provide opportunities to take ownership, expand your expertise, and advance your career. Our culture is grounded in safety, accountability, respect, and a shared commitment to deliver results. Join us and help meet one of the most important energy challenges of our time while building a rewarding career. **Overview** Cypress Creek Solutions operates and maintains a geographically distributed fleet of utility\-scale solar and energy storage assets. Our Operational Technology (OT) Security Program protects the control and monitoring systems that keep that fleet running safely and reliably. As we scale, we are building the internal team that will build and run it — a ground\-floor opportunity to shape OT security across a growing renewables fleet. As OT Security Engineer, you are the hands\-on technical owner of the Program's protective and recovery controls across our transmission and distribution generation facilities, battery storage, and SCADA environments. You will design and implement segmentation, hardening, access controls, and recovery capability, and stand up the OT\-appropriate security tooling the Program depends on. This is engineering work that lives close to live operations, so a safety\-first, availability\-first mindset is essential. Our 24/7 monitoring, detection, and first\-line response are delivered by a managed security service provider under contract. Your role is the technical build and engineering the provider cannot do for us: standing up controls and tooling, and leading the technical response when an incident is escalated to us. You will work closely with the provider on tooling integration and incident handoff. Reports to: Manager of OT Security **Responsibilities** * Design and maintain network segmentation across the OT fleet — security zones and conduits, the IT/OT boundary (firewalls and DMZ), and deny\-by\-default traffic flows; secure wireless, cellular, and field communications. * Build and maintain secure configuration baselines by device type; harden OT assets and manage baseline deviations, with availability and safety taking precedence. * Implement OT access controls: least\-privilege, role\-based access; multi\-factor authentication for remote and interactive access; brokered and monitored vendor and provider remote access; and enforced credential standards. * Assess the security impact of OT changes and define test and rollback plans within the change\-management process. * Apply cryptographic protections to OT data in transit and at rest where technically feasible and operationally appropriate. * Engineer and test backups and recovery for critical OT systems and configurations; support recovery objectives and documented recovery procedures. * Partition systems into zones and conduits and help determine target security levels to support OT risk assessments (aligned to IEC 62443\-3\-2\). * Select, stand up, and operate OT\-appropriate security tooling — passive or low\-impact where active scanning is unsafe — integrated with our managed security provider's services. * Lead technical containment, eradication, and recovery during OT security incidents. **Education \& Experience Required** * 5\+ years in OT/ICS security, industrial network engineering, or control\-system engineering — ideally in generation, energy storage, or utilities. * Hands\-on experience with network segmentation, industrial firewall and DMZ design, and secure remote access for control environments. * Working familiarity with ICS/OT architectures and protocols (e.g., SCADA, PLC/RTU, battery management and power\-conversion systems; Modbus, DNP3, IEC 61850\) and their operational constraints. * Working knowledge of IEC 62443 (particularly system requirements and zones and conduits) and NIST SP 800\-82\. * A demonstrated OT mindset: safety and availability take precedence over confidentiality, and controls are tested before deployment. * Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, cybersecurity, or a related field — or equivalent hands\-on experience in industrial control systems, OT/ICS networks, or control\-system engineering. * Embrace and live by the mission and values of Cypress Creek Energy Preferred Qualifications * GICSP, GRID, or equivalent OT/ICS security certification. * Experience deploying OT\-specific monitoring or asset\-visibility platforms (passive detection tooling). * Familiarity with NERC CIP low impact obligations as they touch electronic and physical access controls. * Direct experience with battery energy storage, utility\-scale solar, or renewables. **Location:** The preferred location for this role is one of our office locations: Durham, NC. Our team operates on a hybrid schedule, with in\-office schedule of three days per week. **Benefits:** * 15 days of Paid Time Off, accrual up to 20 days, 11 observed holidays. * 401(k) Match * Comprehensive package including medical, dental, vision and health insurance * Wellness stipend, family planning stipend, and generous parental leave * Tuition Reimbursement * Phone Bill Reimbursement * Company Swag **A note to Recruiting Agencies Cypress Creek Energy Human Resources team does not accept unsolicited resumes from third party recruiters, staffing firms, or related agencies. The Human Resources team coordinates all recruiting and hiring at our company. We do not accept resumes from third\-party recruiters unless authorized by the Human Resources team and if a signed agreement is in place. Any unsolicited resumes will be considered property of CCE and we are not responsible for any related fees. All communication related to recruiting partnerships should ONLY be directed to the Human Resources team.** **Cypress Creek Energy is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status. We are committed to providing a workplace that is inclusive and values diversity, and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.** *Please be aware of recruiting scams—official communications will only come from @ccrenew.com, we will never request personal or financial information, and any suspicious activity should be reported to* *HR@ccrenew.com**.*

jobs.title: Manufacturing Tooling Engineer
jobs.description: Description Deploy's client designs, manufactures, and constructs buildings and delivers them as products across the country. We fabricate the steel for uber modules, the structural frame the DMC system is built on, and we make the hardest parts of complex buildings on our own lines: headwalls, surgery ceilings, MEP racks, Central Energy Plants, exam rooms, bathrooms, and whole building modules. Twelve production lines, five programs, more than 800 teammates. We are the OEM and our own Tier 1 and Tier 2 supplier at once: the part, the subassembly, and the module that ships all come off our lines, and your tooling has to hold at every level. Everything we build on those lines runs on tooling. Jigs, fixtures, assembly tables, weld fixtures, and the gauges that prove the part is right. When the tooling is good, the line runs to takt and quality is built in rather than inspected in. When it is not, everything downstream pays for it. This is a new position because tooling needs an owner. The job starts with design and ends on the floor. You work out how a part should be held and located, with manufacturing process engineering and product design still at the table, and you model the fixture that does it. You run the stack\-up until the tolerances close, get it built in our own shop or at a vendor you manage, and stand at the line while the first parts come off it. When a fixture slows a line or a part comes out wrong, you are there that day. Some of that tooling serves lines already running; some is for lines that do not exist yet and must be proven before launch. You also inherit what is already on the floor: the drawings, the bills of material, the revision control, the asset records, and the calibration and repair schedules you keep with our Maintenance group. What we are looking for: * Five or more years designing and building jigs, fixtures, or production tooling in a manufacturing environment. * Fluent with tooling design software (SolidWorks, Inventor, or similar) and Revit for the building model. * Working knowledge of GD\&T and tolerance stack\-up, applied to real parts. * Hands\-on fabrication experience. Welding, metal fabrication, basic machining. * Comfort managing outside vendors on cost, lead time, and quality. * The judgment to explain why a fixture you built is designed the way it is, and what you rejected along the way. * A mechanical engineering degree helps and is not required. Our manufacturing has grown 2x in 24 months and looks to double again. The tooling backlog is real. If you want a queue someone else prioritizes for you, this is not the right seat. If you want to set the standard for how a company builds its tooling, it is. What you lead and what you do not. You get a dedicated fabricator to start, and each internal tooling project carries a budget you manage. The work arrives as a brief, owned by the General Manager or the Chief Launch Engineer, who triages competing priorities. You do not own the product design, the line's production schedule, or Maintenance. You influence all three. You sharpen the brief into a problem statement and a proposed answer, present to our internal review, iterate, and build. Our CEO is a designer and builder and works directly with the launch team. The seat: Manufacturing Tooling Engineer, reporting to Vesko Bozadzhiev, Manager of Manufacturing Engineering. Onsite in Birmingham, Alabama, with occasional travel to vendors and job sites. Relocation assistance available. **Do not send a resume. Send the problem statement for a fixture you designed, a simple sketch showing how you solved it, and a few sentences on what went wrong the first time and what you changed. Write it yourself. We check first that all three pieces are there and that you wrote them. What clears goes to Vesko Bozadzhiev, who judges the fixture and the thinking. What clears him goes to Chris Giattina, our CEO, who reads it himself and answers. We will ask for the resume when we talk. We are reading through November 16, 2026\.** Hiring Manager: Vesko Bozadzhiev at VBozadzhiev@bloxbuilt.com. Benefits BLOX offers comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance, flexible spending accounts, paid time off, short\- and long\-term disability, life insurance, and a 401(k) plan. It is the policy of Deploy's client to use ability and willingness to contribute to our team effort as the criteria for making employment related decisions, regardless of an individual's race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or other protected status. In addition, we strictly prohibit the harassment of any employee because of his/her race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation and gender identity), disability, or other protected status. jobs.title: Builder Product II
jobs.description: Our builder customers are small and mid\-size residential home builders. They manage estimating, purchasing, scheduling and job costing in one place. With little time and thin margins, they choose tools that are easy to adopt and save hours on every job. The biggest opportunity is the link between builder and dealer, where orders and schedules still move by phone and spreadsheet. The PM will need to be curious about the workflows end to end. **THE MISSION** Most ERP companies are trying to "add AI" as a sidecar. We are using AI to rewrite the rules of how enterprise software is built, tested, and operated from the ground up. As a Builder 2 focused on our Residential Home Construction Products, you are the translator between ambition and execution. You aren't here to write PRDs that sit in Confluence; you are here to define the missions that the squad runs. You are likely the person who has replaced static roadmaps with living, AI\-generated prioritization models and is now looking for a place where that isn't just "allowed," but is the core requirement. As you build new customer value driven enhancements/products you will work with the Industry PM and the Value Stream PM to guide you in overall strategy goals and key metrics for the applicable value stream are achieved. **CORE DNA — THE SHARED FOUNDATION** **AI\-native workflow** You have moved past writing requirements in Word docs. You use LLMs to synthesize user research, generate acceptance criteria, and stress\-test your own assumptions before a single line of code is written. **Agentic implementation** You can specify and pressure\-test the behavior of autonomous agents. You understand what LangGraph state machines do, and you can write the "Mission Brief" that constrains one correctly. **Legacy\-to\-modern bridge** You aren't afraid of 20\-year\-old ERP workflows. You see them as a map of latent user intent waiting to be extracted, re\-expressed, and automated. **Deterministic mindset** You understand that "the PM said it was fine" isn't a guardrail. You define measurable acceptance criteria, quantitative evals, and the ground\-truth definitions that let engineers prove correctness. **ELECTIVE SPECIALTY — THE MISSION ARCHITECT** While you share the Core DNA with the squad, your "Superpower" is translating complex ERP business logic into precise, executable agent missions: **Domain logic translation** You can take a 50\-page accounting regulation or a decade of tribal knowledge from a SME and with the help of the Value Stream PM, turn it into structured system prompts, agentic constraints, and eval rubrics the squad can build against. **Agentic UX definition** Work with UX Research to define what "good" looks like when the interface is an AI agent, not a button. You write the behavioral specs (tone, escalation logic, failure modes) for generative UI experiences talking to customers to validate what you have built. **Eval ownership** You don't just define features; you define how correctness is measured. You co\-own the eval framework with the QA Builder, writing the "ground truth" definitions that judge agent output. **Discovery** Use AI to run your own user research, synthesize support tickets, usage telemetry, and interview transcripts, along with UX research and information from Signal to help prioritize insight. **WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY DO** **Write the mission briefs** Replace traditional PRDs with structured "Mission Specifications", agent goals, tool constraints, success evals, and failure conditions that give Builders everything they need to ship without a kickoff meeting. **Encode the business logic** Interview subject matter experts and translate their knowledge into system prompts and agentic constraints that prevent hallucinations in workflows. **Define the "ground truth"** Co\-build the eval datasets and rubrics that the QA Builder uses to verify agent output against real ERP business logic; not vibes. **Rapid mission prototyping** Turn a "what if we automated X" into a working proof\-of\-concept prompt chain fast enough to validate before the squad commits to a build cycle. **Own the modernization backlog** Use AI\-assisted analysis of usage data, support volume, and codebase complexity to continuously prioritize which legacy modules the squad attacks next based on overall strategy objectives. **THE STACK** You don't need to build it, but you need to understand it well enough to spec it precisely. * Python (prompt scripting \& eval tooling) * SQL — ERP data fluency * LangChain / LangGraph — agent behavior specification * OpenAI / Anthropic APIs * DSPy — programmatic eval frameworks * GitHub — PR reviews \& spec versioning * Weights \& Biases — embedding and eval observability **WHO YOU ARE** * **The "Requirements Hater":** You have a physical reaction to 40\-page PRDs nobody reads. If a requirement can't be expressed as a testable agent instruction, you question whether it's real. * **Agent\-first thinker:** You don't think in "features"; you think in "capabilities." You have already used an LLM to spec, critique, or prioritize your own work. * **Domain obsessive:** You find ERP business logic genuinely interesting. You understand the basics of how customer workflows work and leverage the Value Stream PM or other experts to drive why it matters and what breaks when it doesn't. * **Rigor over hype:** You know the difference between a compelling AI demo and an agent that's safe to run on a workflow. You won't ship the former as the latter. **WHY JOIN US** **No roadmap theater** We don't do quarterly planning decks. We run missions. You own the definition of what gets built and what "done" means. **The "Final Boss" of product complexity** ERP workflows are the most logic\-dense, high\-stakes product surface on earth. If you can spec agents that run a supply chain for example, you have mastered the hardest problem in product. **Agentic autonomy** You won't be writing tickets for engineers. You'll be defining the missions, the evals, and the ground truth then getting out of the way. **The BUILDER Tribe** You won't be the "only AI person" in the room. You'll be 1 of 4 like\-minded practitioners who are all obsessed with moving 10x faster.

jobs.title: Senior Integration Engineer
jobs.description: ### **This is a Remote Position. US based role only. No HB\-1 Visa Support** **OUR VISION** Equs is a company building privacy\-first AI, identity, and trust infrastructure for the agentic era. The digital world was built around platforms, not people. AI is rewriting what software can do, and we have a narrow window to make sure that future puts the individual at the center rather than further behind. We start from one conviction: your digital identity should belong to you, travel with you, and give you real agency in how you show up online. You set the rules, you hold the keys, and you benefit from your own data. We are building toward that future across every layer it requires: the infrastructure that makes it possible, the standards that make it interoperable, and the experiences that bring it to life for the people who use it. We are early, and we are clear about what is built today and what is still ahead. The people who use what we build keep control of their own data, and we hold ourselves to that standard in everything we make.### **WHAT YOU WILL DO** We’re taking the EQUS Developer Toolkit to organizations of all kinds, from banks and other regulated institutions to employers, education providers, public bodies and digital platforms, and every one of them needs someone technical on our side to get them live. This is our first dedicated integration hire and a hands\-on, customer\-facing role. You’ll be the technical lead for each customer from the first architecture call to the first credential in production: designing the solution, connecting their identity and back\-end systems, and guiding them through security review. You’ll bring what you learn back into the product and the docs, and help shape how integration works as the team grows. You may be required to work on other EQUS products over time. Your day\-to\-day includes, but is not limited to:* Designing each customer’s solution, turning use cases such as KYC status, employee or student IDs, qualifications, age checks, membership and AI\-agent payment mandates into a Developer Toolkit design (issuance and presentation flows, wallet model and build method) that the customer’s architects can sign off * Running technical onboarding, provisioning sandbox and production tenants, issuing client credentials, setting up Issuers, Verifiers and credential schemas with the customer, and enabling and tracking on\-request features such as the Web Wallet, AP2 agent flows and quota increases * Connecting customer identity systems, guiding IAM teams through Bring Your Own IdP (OpenID Connect), Authorization Server registration and OAuth client\-credentials setup in both directions * Getting back\-end integrations live, specifying and reviewing each customer’s Attribute Provider endpoint and helping their engineers debug using request IDs, error codes and rate\-limit headers * Supporting front\-end teams as they embed our UI within strict security policies and allowed\-origin rules, apply their branding, and enable the browser Digital Credentials API where devices support it * Leading EU Digital Identity Wallet readiness, from moving Verifiers to X.509 and securing registration certificates from national Registrars to configuring trusted roots * Owning the technical side of security and procurement, answering due\-diligence questionnaires and joining security reviews using our data\-handling, encryption, DPA and TOMs documentation * Supporting business development in technical sales conversations, helping prospective customers understand what an integration involves and helping us close our first deals * Acting as the customer’s voice to product, logging and prioritizing the gaps that block deals and working with our engineering team and partners on fixes * Making every integration faster than the last, writing quickstarts, help\-center articles, sample code and a reusable customer integration pack with sector variants, including a flow decision tree, security answers and a go\-live checklist ### **WHAT YOU WILL NEED TO SUCCEED** You combine deep technical skill with real empathy for customers, and you’re as comfortable with a bank’s IAM team as with a startup’s two developers. You’re fluent in OAuth 2\.0 and OpenID Connect and can work out why a token is rejected, you can read an OpenAPI spec and write enough back\-end code to build sample integrations, and you understand PKI well enough to untangle a certificate chain. You write clearly, whether it’s an integration design, a security answer or public documentation. You are comfortable with ambiguity, because parts of our product are still being built and you’ll design around the roadmap. You are self\-directed in a remote setting, managing your own time and keeping several customer integrations moving at once.### **YOUR EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE** This role calls for 4 or more years in a customer\-facing technical role such as solutions engineer, integration engineer or technical consultant for an API or identity product. You’ve personally taken enterprise customers from pilot to production, ideally in regulated or security\-conscious sectors such as banking, insurance, government, healthcare or education, including security reviews and vendor due diligence. You bring hands\-on experience with REST APIs and at least one back\-end language (TypeScript/Node, Java/Kotlin or Python), and a working understanding of X.509 certificates, trust anchors and key management. Experience with verifiable credentials and digital identity standards (OID4VCI, OID4VP, SD\-JWT VC, ISO 18013\-5 mdoc), eIDAS 2\.0 and the EU Digital Identity Wallet ecosystem, enterprise identity providers such as Microsoft Entra, Okta or Ping, and payments, open banking or agentic\-payment protocols like AP2 are all a plus. Additional effort will be put forth in ensuring the paste products are capable of being used in a high\-volume semiconductor/electronic manufacturing environments with that achieve customer yield targets. The candidate will provide leadership in consistently achieving global alignment by helping the team define the technical path for the application development work stream, partner closely with R\&D Innovation at our San Jose CA site, partner on projects with our Printed Circuit Board \& IC Substrate experts at our Waterbury CT site, participate in select customer demos and applications, Application Qualification Team (Japan, China, Taiwan, S. Korea), and interact with Business Development teams across the ActiveCopper adoption curve. This leadership role will represent ActiveCopper applications directly with customers and internal stakeholders. You and your team will participate in regular global technical knowledge sharing forums. **What will you be doing?** --------------------------- * **Application Development Leadership:** Lead full development of the ActiveCopper paste deposition process optimized for quality and consistency, while advancing product maturity from Early \> Capable toward Capable \> Deployed. * **Team Leadership and Mentoring:** Provide leadership, supervision and mentoring to Applications Managers, Engineers and Applications Technicians within reporting structure; develop both leadership and managerial skills for your direct reports; own the overall development plan for team members into subject matter experts on Active Copper application processes. * **Process Integration:** Responsible for the full organization and staffing of the with the Application Qualification Team (AQT) and d helping customers qualify and scale ActiveCopper on their lines. * **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Continually foster organizational collaboration with R\&D Innovation, metrology, Business Development, and Product Management teams to resolve complex chemistry, process, and equipment challenges tied to Active Copper adoption. Own establishing a mechanism for collaboration to prosper. * **Metrology and Characterization:** Ensure the ADT and AQT groups have metrology equipment to be successful. This includes but not limited to cross\-section, SEM, AOI, and X\-ray techniques to characterize deposit quality, board reliability, and process performance. * **Technical Communication:** Lead and coach your organization in creating and delivering best in class technical presentations and reports to internal partners and external customers; author technical documentation and best\-practice guidelines for the application process. * **Strategic Input:** Provide input into the strategic direction of the Active Copper business unit based on application development results and industry best practices. **Who are You?** ---------------- * 10\-15 years of relevant experience, years of relevant technical experience in electronics manufacturing, materials science, or a related applications field. Likely education background: Mechanical, Chemical, or Industrial Engineering, or Materials Science. * Must have experience in leading a group (7\+) of engineers and/or scientists. Must have demonstrated experience mentoring and development. * Must have previous experience and demonstrated success in a global leadership role. * Must be willing to travel up to 50% * Strong ability lead and coach the team to problem solve through design and interpret experiments utilizing statistical analyses; proficiency in DOE, Six Sigma, or methodologies. * Direct hands\-on experience with the fabrication of semiconductor, microelectronics, medical devices, printed circuitry fabrication and materials is a plus * Ability to link business strategy, customer applications, and technical knowledge to advance the company's commercial position. * Strong verbal and written communication skills, with experience authoring technical reports and delivering presentations to technical and customer audiences. * Prioritizes safety of self and team and actively contributes to a culture of safety. **What competencies will you need?** ------------------------------------ **We are Offering...** ---------------------- Challenge Yourself and Impact the Future \- You will be part of a highly collaborative culture that promotes continuous improvement through cross\-functional partnerships to achieve our mission. We do this through a strong and unified culture and transparent management, which has empowered us to create high\-performing global teams that achieve superior solutions for our customers. As part of the MAES Team, you will have... Opportunities for career growth, competitive compensation (competitive base salary and performance\-related bonus plan), and benefits packages (health, dental, and vision insurance, Wellness Program, PTO/Holidays, as well as a 401(k)\-retirement plan with a company match). Innovative work environment where you will be a part of a dynamic and collaborative team. Perks and incentives include paid parental leave, tuition reimbursement, and opportunities for professional development. The typical base salary range for this position is between $174,732 and $262,098\. Base pay is determined based on a variety of factors such as experience, years of service, and skillset. Base pay is determined holistically. **Equal Opportunity Employer** All qualified applications will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, pregnancy, genetic information, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected category applicable under federal, state and local laws.

O.N.E Purpose: * **Customer Obsession:** Consistently provide exceptional experiences for our clients, patients, and colleagues by understanding their needs and exceeding their expectations. * **Embracing New Ideas:** Continuously innovate by embracing emerging technology and fostering a culture of creativity and experimentation. * **Striving for Excellence:** Execute at a high level by demonstrating our “Best in KLAS” Ensemble Difference Principles and consistently delivering outstanding results. **The Opportunity:** **JOB SUMMARY** By embodying our core purpose of customer obsession, new ideas, and driving innovation, you will help ensure that every touchpoint is meaningful and contributes to our mission of redefining the possible in healthcare. As a Senior Platform Engineer, you are a hands\-on technical engineer who sits at the intersection of data engineering, cloud platform, and networking — building the infrastructure and pipelines that make Ensemble's data platform reliable, secure, and scalable. You will design and implement Azure\-based platform solutions, author data pipelines, harden network architecture, and apply solid software engineering discipline across everything you ship. This is primarily a delivery role. You will spend the majority of your time writing code, configuring infrastructure, reviewing pull requests, and solving hard operational problems — not managing people or setting org\-wide strategy. You bring strong opinions about platform reliability, cloud cost, and network security, and you translate those opinions into running systems. We are open to strong cloud/platform engineers who want to go deep on data, and to strong data engineers who have grown into platform and networking responsibility. What matters is that you have done hard, hands\-on work at the intersection of these disciplines — you understand both why a pipeline fails and why a Private Endpoint DNS record is wrong, and you are comfortable owning both. **JOB COMPETENCIES** **Platform \& Cloud Engineering —** Designs, builds, and operates Azure\-based platform infrastructure — compute, storage, networking, identity, and security — with a bias toward infrastructure as code, repeatability, and operational simplicity; balances speed of delivery with platform reliability and cost efficiency. **Data Engineering Depth —** Delivers scalable, well\-tested data pipelines and transformations on Databricks and Azure Data Factory; applies sound data modeling, performance tuning, and data quality discipline as standard practice rather than afterthoughts. **Network \& Security Awareness —** Understands Azure networking constructs — VNets, subnets, NSGs, Private Endpoints, DNS, and ExpressRoute/VPN — and applies them correctly in platform design; proactively identifies and closes network attack surface without creating unnecessary friction for engineering teams. **Software Engineering Craft —** Writes clean, testable, maintainable code; participates actively in code and design reviews; treats CI/CD and automated testing as the default way of working; holds a high bar for version control hygiene and deployment safety. **Operational Ownership —** Takes end\-to\-end accountability for the platform components and pipelines in scope — from initial design through production monitoring, incident response, and continuous improvement; does not hand off and walk away. **Technical Communication —** Communicates clearly with both engineering peers and non\-technical stakeholders; can explain complex networking or data platform trade\-offs to a product manager or a VP without losing the audience or oversimplifying the substance. **Continuous Learning \& AI Fluency —** Stays current with the Azure, Databricks, and data engineering ecosystem; consistently applies generative AI tools to accelerate engineering work, improve code quality, and troubleshoot complex systems. **ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS** **Customer Obsession, New Ideas, Striving for Excellence** * Consistently deliver high\-quality platform and data solutions that improve the reliability, speed, and accuracy of data reaching internal and external stakeholders. * Apply generative AI tools in day\-to\-day engineering work to accelerate development, improve code quality, troubleshoot complex systems, and design scalable solutions. **Da . * Azure certifications relevant to the role (e.g., AZ\-305, DP\-203, AZ\-700\) are a plus, but not a substitute for demonstrated hands\-on experience. * Familiarity with
