jobs.title: Senior AI Product Builder
jobs.description: **Who We Are:** Exiger is the AI partner for supply chain and procurement automation. Its centralized 1EXIGER.AI platform allows organizations to manage their entire operating network, from parts to suppliers, regulators, and customers, through an autonomous agentic workforce that learns, adapts, and augments with every decision. The AI\-native platform, combined with the largest supply chain knowledge asset, empowers 550\+ global customers, including 150 Fortune 500 and 80\+ government and defense industrial organizations, to act first. Exiger is FedRAMP® authorized and a 2x Leader in Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Supplier Risk Management. **Senior AI Product Builder** ============================= **Location:** Richmond, VA or McLean, VA **Work Environment:** Hybrid **Who We Are** -------------- Exiger is the AI partner for supply chain and procurement automation. Its centralized 1EXIGER.AI platform allows organizations to manage their entire operating network, from parts to suppliers, regulators, and customers, through an autonomous agentic workforce that learns, adapts, and augments with every decision. The AI\-native platform, combined with the largest supply chain knowledge asset, empowers 550\+ global customers, including 150 Fortune 500 and 80\+ government and defense industrial organizations, to act first. Exiger is FedRAMP® authorized and a 2x Leader in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Supplier Risk Management. **Build the Next Generation of Super Intelligence Products** ------------------------------------------------------------ At Exiger, we're reimagining how AI\-powered products are conceived, built, and delivered. Our vision for Super Intelligence brings together advanced AI, intelligent agents, proprietary data, and human expertise to help organizations solve complex problems and make better decisions. We're looking for an experienced **Senior** **AI Product Builder** who thrives at the intersection of product, technology, and the customer. This is not a traditional Product Manager role focused solely on roadmaps and requirements, nor is it a purely engineering role focused only on implementation. We're looking for someone who can understand complex business challenges, work directly with customers and stakeholders, identify what should be built, and help turn those ideas into working AI\-powered products. You should be equally comfortable leading a conversation with business executives, collaborating with engineers on technical approaches, and rapidly prototyping solutions using AI tools, APIs, code, and automation platforms. The ideal candidate brings strong product instincts, hands\-on technical experience, and the ability to navigate ambiguity. You've worked directly with customers, understand how to uncover their underlying needs, and know how to translate those insights into products that deliver measurable value. You'll play an important role in shaping Exiger's next generation of Super Intelligence experiences while helping define a faster, more collaborative, AI\-enabled approach to product development. **What You'll Do** ------------------ ### **Customer Discovery \& Stakeholder Engagement** * Work directly with customers, business leaders, and internal stakeholders to understand their challenges, workflows, and opportunities for improvement. * Lead discovery conversations, workshops, product demonstrations, and feedback sessions with both technical and nontechnical audiences. * Translate ambiguous business problems and customer requests into clear product opportunities, requirements, and actionable solutions. * Build strong relationships with stakeholders, manage expectations, and establish trust through clear communication and consistent follow\-through. * Challenge assumptions, ask thoughtful questions, and help customers distinguish between what they initially request and what will actually solve their problem. * Communicate product recommendations, technical tradeoffs, progress, and outcomes effectively to senior business leaders and cross\-functional teams. ### **Product Ownership \& Execution** * Take ownership of product initiatives from initial discovery and problem definition through prototyping, development, launch, and iteration. * Partner with engineers, designers, data specialists, and other product builders to translate customer needs into useful AI\-powered experiences. * Define product requirements, user journeys, workflows, success metrics, and acceptance criteria. * Prioritize opportunities based on customer impact, business value, feasibility, and available resources. * Make thoughtful tradeoffs around scope, speed, usability, technical complexity, and long\-term value. * Rapidly test ideas with customers, incorporate feedback, and refine solutions before investing heavily in development. * Use product analytics, customer feedback, and measurable outcomes to determine what to build, improve, or stop. * Drive alignment across teams and keep initiatives moving for ence, or Productboard. * Experience in government, defense, supply chain, procurement, risk management, compliance, or other complex enterprise environments. * A bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, business, product management, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. **How We Work** --------------- Our product development lifecycle is AI\-enabled from beginning to end. We use AI to accelerate research, explore ideas, analyze information, generate and review code, create tests, document decisions, and improve the products we deliver. We believe the most effective AI products are built by people who understand both the technology and the customers using it. Our AI Product Builders are expected to work across disciplines, engage directly with stakeholders, test ideas early, and help teams move quickly from a customer problem to a useful working solution. AI accelerates the process, but human judgment, customer understanding, and accountability remain essential. We value curiosity, ownership, strong communication, thoughtful experimentation, and the ability to turn ambiguity into action. **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- During your first year, you will: * Develop a strong understanding of Exiger's customers, platform, proprietary data, and AI capabilities. * Build trusted relationships with customers, business stakeholders, and internal product and engineering teams. * Independently lead customer discovery conversations and translate complex business challenges into actionable product opportunities. * Successfully guide AI\-powered product initiatives from problem identification through launch and iteration. * Collaborate with engineering teams to design and deliver practical, reliable, and scalable AI\-enabled experiences. * Demonstrate strong judgment in prioritizing product opportunities, evaluating technical approaches, and making informed tradeoffs. * Present product concepts, demonstrations, recommendations, and outcomes confidently to technical and nontechnical stakeholders. * Help deliver AI\-powered capabilities that achieve measurable customer adoption, efficiency improvements, or business value. * Contribute to Exiger's evolving Super Intelligence product vision and help establish better ways of building products with AI. **Show Us What You've Built** ----------------------------- We welcome examples of products, applications, AI\-powered workflows, prototypes, or initiatives you've helped bring to life. We're particularly interested in understanding the problems you've solved, how you engaged with customers or stakeholders, the decisions you made, the solutions you helped build, and the impact they delivered. Your experience doesn't need to follow a traditional product management or engineering career path. What matters most is your ability to **connect customer needs, product judgment, and technical execution to create products that people actually use.** **\#LI\-Hybrid** Exiger is named a Leader in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Supplier Risk Management, twice selected as one of Fast Company's 'Brands That Matter,' and recipient of the Third Party Risk Association's Innovator Award, Exiger's technology has been recognized by leading analyst evaluations and 50\+ awards. Learn more at **Exiger.com** and follow Exiger on **LinkedIn**. At Exiger, our values define how we work and why we lead. We are mission\-inspired, imagination\-driven, trust\-anchored, and compassion\-focused—committed to building technology that makes the world safer, more transparent, and more resilient. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or protected veteran status, or any other legally protected basis, in accordance with applicable law. *Exiger's hybrid work policy is periodically reviewed and adjusted to align with evolving business needs.*

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: **About FacilityOS** ==================== FacilityOS is a fast\-growing company redefining how facilities operate—bringing safety, security, and daily operations into one unified platform used by organizations around the world. As we continue to scale globally, we’re building a team of driven, curious people who want to make an impact. You’ll be part of a dynamic, collaborative culture where individuals are trusted to take ownership, solve meaningful problems, and grow in their careers. Our team comes together in\-office twice a week to connect, collaborate, and build momentum. If you’re looking to do your best work alongside a great team in a high\-growth environment, FacilityOS is the place to build your career. **About the Role:** We are looking for a highly capable Sr. Full Stack Engineer who can ramp up quickly, collaborate effectively with the existing team, and begin contributing meaningful delivery outcomes within the first few weeks. This role is well suited for someone who is comfortable navigating legacy systems, applying strong architectural principles, and making thoughtful technical decisions that improve delivery throughput without compromising quality. The ideal candidate brings strong backend engineering experience, sound judgment, and the ability to work independently while staying closely aligned with team standards and architectural direction. This role is a hybrid position where you’ll be required to come into our office three (3\) times a week. **Duties and Responsibilities:** * Design, develop, review, and maintain backend web applications and services across the FacilityOS platform. * Quickly develop a working understanding of existing platform architecture, legacy components, integration points, and modernization opportunities. * Collaborate with the engineering team to make sound technical decisions that align with established architectural principles and delivery goals. * Contribute to legacy modernization efforts using incremental, low\-risk approaches such as the Strangler Fig pattern where appropriate. * Maintain high code\-quality standards through code reviews, unit testing, static code analysis, and the adoption or improvement of engineering tools and standards. * Participate actively in peer code reviews, providing constructive feedback and helping promote maintainable, testable, and scalable solutions. * Troubleshoot and resolve application issues across environments, including staging and production, with a focus on root\-cause analysis and sustainable fixes. * Work directly with engineering leads, product stakeholders, and project managers to support business operations and project delivery. * Research, evaluate, and recommend innovative application, automation, and architectural improvements that would benefit the FacilityOS platform. **Skills and Qualifications:** * Minimum of 6 years of proven experience in backend .NET Framework / .NET Core web application development using C\#. * Minimum 5 years of experience developing web applications using Angular and Typescript * Proven ability to quickly understand complex legacy systems, identify key integration points, and contribute effectively with limited ramp\-up time. * Strong experience using object\-oriented programming, design patterns, and clean architecture principles to build maintainable, testable software. * Proven experience writing unit tests and applying quality\-focused development practices. * Proven experience designing and building RESTful services. * Experience in designing and building cloud\-native SaaS and PaaS applications (Azure / AWS). Azure cloud experience will be preferred * Solid knowledge of Microsoft SQL Server and T\-SQL. * Ability to make sound technical decisions in collaboration with existing engineering teams. * Proactive, curious, and investigative mindset with strong attention to quality and detail. * Passion for technology, continuous improvement, and modern engineering practices. * Ability to self\-manage priorities and deliver outcomes with minimal supervision. * Strong team\-player attitude with the ability to collaborate across engineering, architecture, and product stakeholders. * Hands\-on experience with Event\-Driven architecture is a plus * Hands\-on experience with Microservices is a plus **Why work at FacilityOS?** We work hard and play hard and we do both with passion and respect for one another. Our company promotes a fast\-paced, fun, friendly, and highly collaborative work environment that provides: Comprehensive health coverage A Hybrid work environment Opportunity for advancement and growth Catered Events, Snacks, Drinks – You won’t go Hungry! Birthday and Life Celebrations Two annual parties in a year **FacilityOS Commitment** We believe that a diverse team is the key to innovation and growth. We are an equal opportunity employer that value diversity at our company and encourage all candidates to apply. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. FacilityOS will accommodate individuals with disabilities through each stage of the recruitment and selection process. Please advise us of any needs when your interview is booked, and we will do our best to meet your needs. Please note that all candidates must be legally eligible to work in the location in which you applied. **Background and Reference Checks** Any offer of employment may be conditional upon full background checks including a criminal record check, a credit check and employment and educational verifications. A reference check will also be conducted. *We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process such as reviewing applications. These tools assist the recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. All advancement and hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us or click* *here**.* **FacilityOS thanks all candidates for their interest, however only those selected to continue in the process will be contacted.**

jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting \& Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.**About the Team** ------------------ Launched in 2021, Fanatics Betting and Gaming is the online and retail sports betting subsidiary of Fanatics, a global digital sports platform. The Fanatics Sportsbook is available to 95% of the addressable online sports bettor market in the U.S. Fanatics Casino is currently available online in Michigan, New Jersey, Pennsylvania and West Virginia. Fanatics Betting and Gaming operates twenty\-two retail sports betting locations, including the only sportsbook inside an NFL stadium at Northwest Stadium. Fanatics Betting and Gaming is headquartered in New York with offices in Denver, Leeds and Dublin. The Accounts team sits within the Fanatics Betting and Gaming \- Shared Services domain and owns the customer account lifecycle, from registration, login, and identity verification to the geolocation, eligibility, and responsible gaming controls that decide whether a customer is allowed to play. Accuracy and customer trust are the team's core tenets, because customers trust us with their money, their identity, and their personal data. We are seeking a **Senior Software Engineer** to build and maintain the scalable, highly available, and compliant Java services behind the account lifecycle. This is a hands\-on engineering role for someone who enjoys owning features end to end, solving complex integration problems, and working closely with product, compliance, and operations partners. This is a US\-based remote position. ### **Responsibilities** * Design, build, and maintain Java backend services using Spring Boot or similar frameworks. * Deliver features across registration, KYC, login and MFA, device registration, account management, tax reporting, Fanatics ID integration, and watchlist monitoring. * Build and maintain services that enforce regulatory and responsible gaming requirements, including geolocation, state and self\-exclusion, prohibited persons, loss limits, and eligibility. * Build integrations with third\-party identity, verification, geolocation, and compliance providers, designing for failure, retries, and data integrity. * Write scalable, well\-tested services with strong unit and integration test coverage. * Contribute to architecture and design discussions for APIs, event\-driven systems, and data flows. * Troubleshoot complex production issues and take part in the weekly on\-call rotation, contributing to runbooks and post\-mortems. * Partner with Product, Technical Program Management, Compliance, Support, and client engineering to turn business and regulatory requirements into technical solutions, and take part in sprint planning and agile delivery. * Mentor junior to mid\-level engineering teammates through code reviews, design feedback, and pairing. * Follow engineering best practices (CI/CD, testing, observability, feature flagging, documentation) and improve reliability and maintainability by addressing technical debt. ### **Experience and Skills** * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience with Java. * Strong experience building and supporting production Java backend services with Spring Boot or similar frameworks. * Experience developing REST APIs and integrating distributed systems and data flows. * Experience with event\-driven architectures such as Kafka or similar messaging platforms. * Experience working in AWS or other cloud environments. * Experience with relational and NoSQL data stores such as Postgres and MongoDB. * Experience using AI tools or coding assistants to improve engineering productivity. * Experience with identity and account systems (registration, authentication, MFA, OAuth2/OIDC), KYC, fraud, or payments is preferred. * Experience with compliance\-driven systems such as geolocation, responsible gaming, or regulatory data handling is preferred. * Experience building highly available, regulated, or enterprise\-scale applications is preferred. * Experience with observability tooling (for example Datadog) and operating services on call is a plus. * Strong troubleshooting, ownership, and communication skills, with the ability to work independently and with cross\-functional partners. Depending on the role, your interview and onboarding experience may include in\-person components, such as onsite interviews or Launching into Better: LIVE—a multi\-day cultural immersion in New York City for full\-time, non\-seasonal hires. Ferguson, a Fortune 500 company, is proud to provide best\-in\-class products, service and capabilities across the following industries: Commercial/Mechanical, Facilities Supply, Fire and Fabrication, HVAC, Industrial, Residential Trade, Residential Building and Remodel, Waterworks and Residential Digital Commerce. Ferguson has approximately 36,000 associates across 1,700 locations. Ferguson is a community of proud associates who operate with the shared purpose of building something meaningful. This role serves as a critical liaison between business stakeholders, engineering teams, application owners, and data consumers by analyzing how data moves from databases through backend services, middleware components, APIs, and into consuming front\-end applications. This individual will work closely with development teams, stakeholders, technology leads, and agile teams to ensure successful delivery of program milestones and adherence of the deliverables to the product roadmaps. Your problem solving and technical skills along with ability to synthesize findings, developing practical and realistic recommendations, and communicate results will help you excel at this position. The ideal candidate possesses strong technical analysis skills, extensive SQL expertise, and the ability to quickly understand system architectures, data models, integrations, and dependencies. This individual will play a key role in documenting application ecosystems, supporting modernization initiatives, troubleshooting production issues, and providing insights into data lineage and system behavior. **Key Responsibilities:** **System and Data Flow Analysis:** * Analyze and document end\-to\-end data flows across databases, backend services, middleware platforms, APIs, and user\-facing applications. * Develop and maintain current\-state and future\-state system architecture diagrams, process flows, and data lineage documentation. * Identify system dependencies, integration points, data transformations, and downstream impacts of changes. * Partner with development teams to understand application architectures and integration designs. * Document business and technical requirements related to system interfaces and data exchanges. **Data Analysis and SQL Development:** * Write complex SQL queries to extract, validate, analyze, and troubleshoot data across multiple databases. * Perform data mining and root cause analysis to investigate production incidents, data discrepancies, and system issues. * Analyze data quality, completeness, and accuracy across integrated systems. * Validate data movement between source systems and consuming applications. * Support reconciliation efforts by comparing and tracing data across multiple platforms. **Application and Integration Support:** * Collaborate with software engineers, solution architects, product teams, and business stakeholders to understand system functionality and technical requirements. * Analyze REST APIs, service interactions, message flows, and integration patterns. * Assist in impact assessments for enhancements, upgrades, and application modernization initiatives. * Support testing efforts by defining test scenarios and validating expected data outcomes. * Participate in troubleshooting efforts related to application integrations and data issues. **Documentation and Process jobs.title: Principal Data Engineer
jobs.description: What if you could join a rapidly growing company and play a critical role in bringing new medicines to patients by helping scale the programmable infrastructure behind a new human cellular biology platform? ### **About Vesalius** Vesalius Therapeutics is pioneering a new platform to generate breakthrough treatments for common diseases. Our platform combines large\-scale human genetics, genomics, stem cell studies, high\-dimensional cellular phenotyping, and artificial intelligence to uncover causal biology and identify optimal intervention points for new therapies. Vesalius was founded in 2019 by Flagship Pioneering. ### **Role Overview** We are seeking a Principal Data Engineer to lead the architecture and evolution of the data platform underpinning our human genetics, multi\-omics, and high\-content imaging programs. This is a senior, hands\-on leadership role with broad technical authority. As the architectural lead for data engineering, you will set the direction for our AWS environment and the pipelines, catalog, and access layers built on it, defining the technical roadmap and the standards others build against. The scope spans core cloud data engineering (orchestration, warehousing, infrastructure as code, cost governance) and the distinctive challenges of scientific data: connecting each microscopy image to its cell line, donor, and study of origin, and enabling scientists to answer genotype questions directly, without specialist intervention. You will join a focused, high\-impact team supporting a research organization whose data generation and analytical ambitions are expanding rapidly. Our platform is established and productive, and is now entering a deliberate modernization phase. You will lead that transition, with significant influence over the platform's next\-generation architecture. At Flagship, we accept impossible missions to enable bigger leaps. Our core values guide us through uncertainty and toward lasting impact. ### **Role Responsabilities** * Serve as technical owner and architect of our AWS environment, including account structure, IAM, networking, compute, and storage. * Lead and extend cost governance, including budgets, alerting, tagging enforcement, rightsizing, and storage lifecycle and tiering. * Define and own developer operations for the data platform, including infrastructure as code, CI/CD, container builds, and secrets and environment management. * Upgrade our data lake, managed orchestration, metadata and data ingestion workflows to scale with future data production and enhance the infrastructure that transfers data from the lab to the cloud. * Partner with ML and computational biology leaders to define the interface between platform and modelling. ### **Required Qualifications** * 10\+ years building and operating production data infrastructure, with a track record of architecting and owning platforms end to end. * Deep AWS expertise: S3, IAM, EC2, Batch, Lambda, and Spark (EMR or equivalent). Experience as technical owner of production cloud environments, including multi\-account architecture and cross\-account access. * Strong Python and SQL, with a background in production\-grade pipeline development. * Production experience with workflow orchestration (Nextflow, Airflow, Temporal, Step Functions, Redun, or similar) and the judgement to evaluate and select among them. * Infrastructure as code (CloudFormation/CDK), CI/CD, containers, and observability. DevOps is a core competency for this role. * Data modelling and warehouse or lakehouse design, including metadata management, lineage, and data quality practice. * Cost governance at scale, including budgets, tagging, rightsizing, and storage lifecycle across hundreds of terabytes. * Fluency with scientific data semantics (studies, samples, donors, cell lines, assays) and the ability to partner directly with scientists to translate their questions into data models. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Familiarity with genetics and genomics data. * Microscopy or high\-content screening data, including large binary object stores, transfer optimization, and image streaming for model training. * Databricks, OpenMetadata, or a comparable catalog in production. * Snowflake, particularly governed access patterns over cloud object storage. * ML infrastructure: SageMaker or Databricks ML, MLflow or Weights \& Biases, feature stores. * Serving data to LLM or agent clients (MCP servers, tool APIs). * Experience leading data platform architecture as a senior or principal individual contributor, ideally in biotech, pharma R\&D, or a research institute. **We are an equal opportunity employer**. jobs.title: Associate in Research, 12 Month – Applied Research & Commercialization Hub (National High Magnetic Field Laboratory)
jobs.description: **Department** -------------- Applied Research \& Commercialization Hub (ARCH) \- National High Magnetic Field Laboratory The National High Magnetic Field Laboratory is building ARCH, the Applied Research and Commercialization Hub, and is hiring a physicist who will run its laboratory. ARCH exists to move magnet\-based measurement technology from something that works once, in the hands of the person who invented it, to something that runs to a date for someone who needs the answer. The laboratory sits alongside the world’s highest\-field DC magnets, a millikelvin suite reaching 20 mK, a maker's space with CNC, manual machining and 3D printing, and the machine shop. Its first book of work is commercial measurement: thermal expansion, low\-temperature thermal conductivity and magnetization on materials that go into quantum\-computing hardware, delivered to a specification and a deadline. Behind that sits a seed\-funded project portfolio and a pipeline of new capability. **Responsibilities** -------------------- The Associate in Research runs that laboratory under the Director’s technical direction and works the seam between the MagLab’s research programs and ARCH. Techniques are invented across this laboratory every year. A few of them are worth maturing into something repeatable, and the judgment about which few, and about what maturing them costs, is the core of this job. The successful candidate will spend part of their week designing and running measurements at the bench, part of it deciding what the laboratory takes on next, and part of it in front of engineers from companies who want to know whether the MagLab can answer their question. * **Run the ARCH laboratory.** Own the day\-to\-day operation: schedule, throughput, equipment readiness, consumables, records, safety. Set up the laboratory from the ground with the Director as it comes online. * **Design, run and interpret measurements.** Take a problem from specification to data to a defensible interpretation, at low temperature and high field, on samples the laboratory has not seen before. * **Mature techniques into capabilities.** Work with scientists and technical staff across the MagLab’s facilities to find measurement methods worth hardening, then take them from a working demonstration to a documented, repeatable procedure with known uncertainty. * **Scope what the laboratory can sell.** Assess a candidate job for feasibility, magnet time, staff effort, uncertainty and cost, and say plainly what ARCH can and cannot deliver. * **Carry the technical side of customer engagements.** Translate a company’s problem into a measurement plan, agree what a result will and will not settle, and report back in terms an engineer outside the field can use. * **Deliver seed\-funded projects.** Run assigned projects against milestones, report monthly on progress and risk, and prepare the evidence for the twelve\-month Go/No\-Go review. * **Put AI to work in the laboratory.** Automate measurement sequences, analysis and reporting. Apply machine learning and current AI tooling to shorten the path from raw data to an answer, and to open up experiments that were impractical when each run needed watching. * **Mentor, train and supervise.** Run the ARCH intern line, and train new staff and collaborators on the laboratory’s equipment and procedures. Co\-supervise graduate students hosted from other institutions, whose academic supervision stays with their home group, with scope to take on direct supervision as the laboratory’s grant\-funded student base develops. jobs.title: Build Your Robotics Career - Explore the Country as a Robotics Field Service Engineer or Technician
jobs.description: **Who we are:** Formic is on a mission to reshape American manufacturing by making automation accessible to every factory. As labor constraints rise, costs increase, and global competition intensifies, automation is no longer optional for manufacturers that want to stay competitive. We deliver automation through a Robotics\-as\-a\-Service model that combines industrial robotics, proprietary software, and full\-service support into a single, integrated solution. By removing the traditional barriers of cost, complexity, and risk, we enable manufacturers to deploy automation quickly and realize measurable gains in throughput, safety, and operational efficiency without large upfront capital investment. Backed by leading investors including Lux Capital, Initialized Capital, Blackhorn Ventures, and Mitsubishi HC Capital North America, Formic is scaling rapidly and building the foundation for a new era of high\-performance, Made in America production. **Ready for a new adventure? Build your career at the forefront of robotics and industrial automation while exploring the country! Bring your technical skills, curiosity, and sense of adventure. We'll bring the robots, the challenges, and the opportunity to explore somewhere new.** As Formic's customer base and robot fleet expand nationwide, we're looking for talented, adventurous Robotics Field Service Engineers (FSEs) and Field Service Technicians (FSTs) who are excited to go wherever opportunity takes them. We'll help you relocate to a market where your skills are needed, with the possibility of moving again as our fleet grows and new opportunities emerge. Whether you're an experienced technician ready for bigger challenges or an accomplished engineer looking for your next chapter, you'll work with cutting\-edge robotics, solve meaningful technical problems, and help transform manufacturing across America. Apply today to join our nationwide Field Service talent pipeline and be considered for opportunities as they open across the country. Your next adventure might be somewhere you've never been! **About the team:** The Fleet Operations Team drives uptime and operational performance across Formic's growing fleet of deployed robotic systems. Working inside live manufacturing environments, the team diagnoses issues, restores production, and continuously improves system reliability at scale. Fleet Operations operates at the intersection of robotics, controls, and real\-world factory execution, ensuring Formic's automation delivers consistent, measurable performance across diverse industrial applications. **About the role:** As a Robotics Field Service Technician, you are a hands\-on member of Formic's Fleet Operations Team. Working closely with Engineering and senior field staff, you will execute preventive maintenance, carry out directed corrective repairs, and represent Formic directly within customer facilities in your assigned region / territory. This is a hands\-on, safety\-focused role in uptime\-critical environments. Success requires disciplined execution of established procedures, calm work during production interruptions, and clear documentation. Your work directly supports fleet performance, customer satisfaction, and long\-term system reliability. **In this role, you will:** * Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on industrial robotic systems and automated manufacturing cells * Troubleshoot and resolve mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, PLC, and robotic control system issues, independently or with support depending on technical complexity and experience * Respond to customer service calls, diagnose production interruptions, and restore equipment to reliable operation * Work hands\-on with industrial robots, sensors, motors, drives, conveyors, and other automation equipment * Diagnose robotic faults, perform system recovery, and support programming, configuration, and controls troubleshooting as appropriate to your expertise * Monitor fleet performance, identify anomalies, and proactively address reliability concerns * Investigate recurring failures, participate in root cause analysis, and implement or recommend corrective actions * Collaborate with Engineering, senior field personnel, and other cross\-functional teams to resolve technical challenges and improve system performance * Document service activity, troubleshooting findings, repairs, and spare parts requirements using maintenance management systems * Provide technical guidance and hands\-on support to customer operators and maintenance personnel * Build strong, trusted relationships with plant managers, maintenance teams, and customer stakeholders * Follow rigorous industrial safety standards, including lockout/tagout (LOTO) procedures * Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that increase equipment uptime, reliability, and service efficiency * Continue developing your technical expertise across robotics, industrial controls, networking, and automation systems * Travel throughout sis for more advanced engineering\-level opportunities * Strong written and verbal communication skills, including clear technical documentation and customer interaction * Commitment to safety, disciplined execution, and working effectively in active manufacturing environments * Resourcefulness, adaptability, and the ability to work independently while knowing when to collaborate or escalate * Willingness to relocate anywhere within the United States * Comfort with regional travel up to 80% and overnight travel up to 50% * Genuine enthusiasm for learning, exploring new places, and building a long\-term career in robotics and automation **Bonus points if you have:** * Hands\-on experience with industrial robots from FANUC, KUKA, Yaskawa, ABB, or Universal Robots * PLC programming or advanced troubleshooting experience, particularly with Allen\-Bradley or Siemens * Experience with industrial networks, HMIs, VFDs, robotic safety systems, or industrial communication protocols * Familiarity with palletizing, case packing, pick\-and\-place, machine tending, or conveyor systems * Experience in food, beverage, packaging, CPG, or other high\-speed manufacturing environments * Experience using CMMS platforms to track maintenance activity, repairs, and equipment history * Prior customer\-facing field service experience * Spanish language proficiency * Openness to relocate to future relocations as Formic's fleet and customer base grow **What we look for:** We're building this company from the ground up, and every person we hire has an outsized impact on our culture, performance, and trajectory. While each team member brings unique strengths and perspectives, we look for people who align with our Operating Principles and embody them in action. If this sounds like you, Formic may be the right place for you! * **Fearless Optimism:** You make bold bets and default optimistic. You believe in the mission, aren't paralyzed by risk, and fear inaction more than failure. You see ambiguity as opportunity and bring energy to building what doesn't yet exist. * **Create the Magic:** You absorb complexity so customers don't have to. Whether your customer is external or internal, you focus on delivering experiences that are clear, fast, value\-added, and outcome\-driven. You don't say "not my job." You make things work. * **Today, Not Tomorrow:** You have a bias to action. You close the loop. You take extreme ownership. You understand that speed compounds, and you don't confuse activity with results. * **Seek Truth:** You think from first principles. You value data over ego and strong opinions loosely held. You're willing to challenge assumptions, including your own, in pursuit of the best answer. * **Made of Rubber:** You are resolute and adaptable. When things break or priorities shift, you rebound stronger. You treat setbacks as learning moments and move forward with grit. * **One Formic:** You operate without silos. You practice radical helpfulness, document clearly, and make clean handoffs. You assume positive intent and prioritize team success over individual credit. **Equal Opportunity Employment:** Formic is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion or religious creed, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, marital status, family or parental status, disability, military or veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. All employment decisions are based on a person's merit, business needs, and role requirements. If you require further accommodations or have questions regarding accessibility of our roles, please reach out to careers@formic.co. **AI Use:** At Formic, fairness and transparency are at the heart of our hiring process. As a Validation Engineer, you'll work at the intersection of robotics, embedded systems, and next\-generation automation. You'll help move innovative technologies from engineering development to production, solve complex technical challenges, and ensure our products perform where it matters most: in the field. This hands\-on role offers meaningful ownership, broad engineering exposure, and the chance to shape how we validate and bring emerging technologies to market. ***What You'll Do*** * *Own Product jobs.title: Body Structure Engineer - Wheelchair Accessible Vehicles
jobs.description: **About Freedom Motors USA** At Freedom Motors USA, we build wheelchair accessible vehicles that give people the independence to go where they want, when they want. Every lowered floor, ramp, and reinforced frame we engineer has a direct effect on someone’s daily life, so we hold our work to the highest standards of safety and quality. * ️ **Redefining Mobility Since 1987** —Innovating solutions that open doors to greater freedom and more independence. **Industry\-Leading Accessibility** — Building the widest range of wheelchair accessible vehicles and changing lives. **Family\-Owned, Nationwide Reach** — Proudly delivering to driveways across the country from our headquarters in Battle Creek, Michigan. We're hiring a Body Structure Engineer to design, modify, and validate the floor structures, frames and chassis components at the heart of our wheelchair\-accessible conversions. You'll take OEM SUVs and minivans and re\-engineer them to accommodate wheelchair users while preserving the crash performance, structural integrity and regulatory compliance of the original vehicle. This is a hands\-on role where your designs move quickly from CAD to prototype to the production floor. **RESPONSIBILITIES:** * **Design conversion structures.** Design and validate body and floor structure designs in CAD, starting with early concepts and physical mock\-ups and carrying them through to release. Specify structural adhesive and bonding applications alongside welded joints that hold up in production. * **Engineer mechanisms and components.** Select and design steel and aluminum parts that balance vehicle weight, load capacity and structural strength. Engineer complex moving parts such as closures, door operators, suspension modifications and ramp mechanisms that integrate cleanly with modified structures. * **Ensure compliance** Keep every modification compliant with Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standards (FMVSS), ADA requirements and mobility industry safety standards. * **Build and validate.** Lead prototype builds including design verification (DV) and process verification (PV) builds and coordinate crash testing. Plan design, purchasing, assembly, and testing needs that align with overall project timing and deliverables using Stage Gate/APQP processes. * **Bring designs to production.** Partner with our purchasing, parts and production teams to launch designs that meet cost, quality, and timing targets without compromising safety. * **Always improving.** Look to standardize parts and designs across vehicle platforms wherever it makes sense. Support root cause investigations, engineering changes and design improvements on vehicles already in production. **QUALIFICATIONS AND REQUIREMENTS**: * Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, or a related field. * 3–5\+ years of experience in automotive body\-in\-white (BIW), body structures, or vehicle structural engineering. Prior experience or familiarity with vehicle upfitting, specialty vehicles, or mobility conversions a plus. * Proficiency in CAD software such as CATIA, SolidWorks, or AutoCAD. * Working knowledge of sheet metal fabrication, welding processes, structural adhesives \& bonding methods and automotive materials. * Experience with engineering and quality tools such as FEA, DFA/DFM, DOE, DFMEA/PFMEA, DVP\&R, 8D or similar problem solving, GD\&T, and tolerance stack\-up. ANSYS, LS\-DYNA or HyperWorks a plus. * Understanding of crash dynamics and vehicle safety testing. Familiarity with industry relevant FMVSS standards, SAE J2249 securement requirements or the NMEDA Quality Assurance Program (QAP) a plus. * Sharp problem solving abilities and close attention to detail with clear written and verbal communication skills. * Demonstrated ability to work well in a fast\-paced environment and able to meet deadlines while under pressure. *This job description is meant to provide an overview of the duties and responsibilities of this position. It is not intended to be an all inclusive listing.*

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer - Automotive
jobs.description: **Who We Are:** Founded in 1987, Freedom Motors USA is a family\-owned manufacturer and retailer of wheelchair\-accessible vehicles, headquartered in Battle Creek, Michigan. We provide customized mobility solutions that promote independence and freedom. * ️ **Redefining Mobility Since 1987** —Innovating solutions that open doors to greater freedom and more independence. **Industry\-Leading Accessibility** — Building the widest range of wheelchair accessible vehicles and changing lives. **Family\-Owned, Nationwide Reach** — Proudly delivering to driveways across the country from our headquarters in Battle Creek, Michigan. We’re hiring an **Electrical Engineer** responsible for the electrical systems in our wheelchair accessible conversions, from concept through production. You’ll design and integrate the controls for our ramps, doors, and kneeling systems with each OEM vehicle’s power and network systems, and make sure they work every time, because our customers depend on them daily. You’ll partner with Engineering, Production, Quality, suppliers, and OEM partners, and see your designs go from the bench to customers’ driveways. **RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Design the electrical architecture, interfaces, and system behavior for our conversions across multiple OEM platforms, including safety interlocks like preventing ramp deployment unless the vehicle is in park. * Integrate our systems without disrupting OEM airbags, ADAS, body controls, or diagnostics. * Design and troubleshoot control modules, circuitry, power distribution, and harness and connector interfaces. * Develop and validate embedded software, including control logic, diagnostics, and CAN/LIN communication. * Plan and support testing from bench and prototype through DV, PV, EMC, durability, and production validation. * Lead root cause investigations and support field issues from dealers and customers. * Create technical documentation, assess OEM model\-year changes, and participate in DFMEAs and design reviews. **QUALIFICATIONS:** * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field. * 3\+ years in automotive, transportation, industrial controls, or a related industry. * Experience designing and troubleshooting electronic hardware and supporting embedded software. * Working knowledge of CAN, LIN, UART, SPI, and I2C. * Hands\-on skill with oscilloscopes, multimeters, logic analyzers, and CAN diagnostic tools at the subsystem and vehicle level. * Strong communication and teamwork skills. **EXTRAS:** * Upfit or OEM electrical integration experience, or a background in mobility or specialty vehicles. * EV/hybrid platforms, ISO 26262, ASPICE, or HIL testing. * PCB design, C/C\+\+ embedded development, or wiring harness design. *This job description is meant to provide an overview of the duties and responsibilities of this position. It is not intended to be an all inclusive listing.*

jobs.title: AI Design Engineer
jobs.description: **AI DESIGN ENGINEER** **Custom Millwork, Casework \& Fixtures** **Location: Tacoma, WA · Full\-Time · On\-Site** **Travel: Some travel to El Paso, TX and Phoenix, AZ** **Reports to: Director of AI \& Automation and Director of Operations** **Industry: Commercial Construction \& Manufacturing** **Compensation: $105,000 – $165,000 plus bonus** It's 11:40 on a Tuesday night, and you're doing it again. The house is quiet. You've got an AI model open on one monitor and a reception desk elevation on the other. You're trying to get the model to read an architect's PDF, find the casework, and give you a cabinet schedule your engineering software can actually use. It half\-works. You're grinning anyway. At 7:00 tomorrow morning you'll walk into a drafting room where that same architect's PDF gets redrawn by hand, line by line. The submittal goes out, comes back covered in redlines, goes out again, comes back again. Someone re\-keys dimensions that already exist in three other files. The most experienced engineer in the building carries the shop's construction standards in their head, and nobody has written them down because nobody has the time. You mentioned AI in a meeting once. Someone called it "your computer thing," and the room moved on. You're not crazy. You're early. We've been looking for you. **This Industry Still Draws Like It's 1998\.** Here it is plainly. Custom millwork, cabinetry, and commercial construction have worked the same way for a long time. Drafting is still manual. Design intent arrives as a PDF and a skilled person redraws it. A single wall\-paneling submittal has to show every joint condition, the panel core, veneer species and cut, leaf and panel matching, room\-match sequencing, grain direction, blocking heights, and the hardware schedule. Every line is drawn by a human, and when the architect changes one dimension, a human redraws all of it. Engineering is still translation. Product libraries help. But every custom reception desk, feature wall, art display, and curved transaction top still starts with a person converting someone else's drawing into parts, joinery, and machining. Manufacturing is still manual everywhere except the robots. The CNC router is the future. The tape measure, the paper traveler, and the re\-keyed cut list are not. That isn't where this industry is going. Frontier doesn't intend to wait for a software vendor to deliver the future in a version 14\.0 update. **We Don't Want Someone to Use Better Software. We Want Someone to Change the Industry.** This is not a CAD manager job. We're not looking for someone to maintain our libraries, run our upgrade cycle, or train people on new buttons. We want the person who is going to work out what engineering, drafting, and design look like when AI is part of the crew, prove it on real projects that get built on our floor and installed in real buildings, and then watch the rest of the industry try to catch up. That's the job: you, Frontier, and the tip of the spear. **Ownership Is Making a Bet. The Bet Is You.** Most manufacturers our size put their big money into equipment: a new CNC router, a panel saw, an edgebander line, a robot cell. We buy machines too. We're manufacturers, and we love machines. But Frontier's ownership believes the bigger opportunity is this one. Changing how we engineer, draft, and design is a bigger lever than the next large piece of capital equipment. That isn't a line in a slide deck. It's how ownership thinks about where money goes. Frontier is an aggressively AI\-forward company with AI\-forward ownership. Our leadership doesn't just "support" AI. They use it, they understand it, and they fund it the way manufacturers fund equipment. We've already hired a Director of AI \& Automation to drive AI across the business. This role takes that same commitment to the core of what we make: the drawings, the engineering, and the design behind every piece of millwork that leaves our shop. You will work for that Director, alongside the leadership of our cabinet engineering and drafting team. **Efficiency That Grows the Shop** The point of making drafting and engineering faster is not to shrink the team. It is to take the capacity we free up and put it into more work, more complex projects, and more people growing into this craft in a technological world. Every hour we pull out of redraw, re\-keying, and tribal\-knowledge bottlenecks is an hour we can put into taking on more volume, training the next generation of engineers and drafters, and opening roles that did not exist when every line had to be drawn by hand. Frontier intends to grow and expand the operation. AI is how we create the room to do that without burning out the people who already carry the standards in their heads. This role amplifies craftspeople. It does not replace them. The efficiency pickups fund growth, new opportunities, and a bigger shop that can compete on both craft and technology. **Signs This Is You** * You have a folder somewhere n the software vendors. Nobody has written it. That's the job. If you need clean, structured data and a defined process before you can do anything, this isn't the role. If you look at a stack of redlined PDFs and see the next ten years of your career, we should talk. What you will have is something almost nobody in this industry gets: ownership that understands what you're trying to do, funds it like equipment, and will clear obstacles out of your way. And a clear mandate: the wins you create are meant to help us grow, not just do the same work with fewer people. **About Frontier Door \& Cabinet** We are builders. True American manufacturers. Frontier Door \& Cabinet has been in business for nearly 30 years. We started as a garage operation and grew into one of the largest specialty contractors in the Pacific Northwest, focused on Division 08 (doors, frames, and hardware) and Division 12 (cabinets and countertops) for commercial construction, with operations in Tacoma, El Paso, and Phoenix. Our facilities run CNC routers, panel saws, and edgebanders, and our estimating team quotes nearly every available project in our markets. Cabinets get installed. Projects have deadlines, budgets, and general contractors who don't care about your technology roadmap. They care that the casework matched the submittal and showed up on time. That pressure is exactly why AI matters so much here. The gap between where this industry is and where it could be is enormous, and we intend to be the company that closes it first, and to use that advantage to expand what we can take on. **What We Offer** * Competitive salary ($105,000 – $165,000 depending on experience) plus bonus * Health, dental, and vision insurance * 401(k) * A real budget for AI tools, hardware, training, and industry events (IWF, AWFS, AWI), funded the way we fund production equipment * Direct access to ownership and the leadership team, without layers in between * The chance to build something the whole industry ends up copying, and to help grow a real manufacturing operation while you do it **How to Apply** Send your resume and answers to two questions. No cover letter. 1\. Show us the most interesting thing you've built with AI on your own time. A repo, a screen recording, a screenshot, or a photo of the whiteboard all work. We want proof that you build things. 2\. Name the first drafting or engineering task you'd eliminate, and tell us how you'd do it. If you've spent years thinking "this could all be so much better" while the rest of the shop kept doing it the old way, this is your chance to stop thinking it and start building it. **The Fine Print: The Software** Software isn't the point of this job. But you should know we speak the language, and that you'll be walking into a familiar world. The people we want have lived inside some combination of these: * Microvellum on AutoCAD / BricsCAD: parametric casework engineering, shop drawings, CNC output * Cabinet Vision: design\-to\-manufacture for cabinets and casework * AlphaCAM: CNC router and stone programming, nesting * SolidWorks (and SWOOD): complex fixtures and mixed wood, metal, and glass assemblies * AutoCAD, Revit, Rhino \+ Grasshopper, Inventor * Bluebeam Revu: submittals, redlines, and revision tracking **Also familiar:** TopSolid'Wood, imos iX, 2020 / Design Flex, Moraware CounterGo, SlabSmith, digital templating (Prodim, LPI) **On the AI side:** whatever is best this month. Python, LLM APIs, agents, AutoLISP, .NET, the SolidWorks API. You don't need all of them. You need to know why each one still takes so many clicks and have a theory about how few it should take. *Frontier Door \& Cabinet, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.*

The system will support a workforce development program serving job seekers from initial outreach and enrollment through training, case management, employment placement, and post\-employment follow\-up. maintaining a complete history of services and outcomes. **Primary Responsibilities** The developer will design and implement a Microsoft Power Platform solution that includes: * Build a centralized participant database using **Microsoft Dataverse** * Develop a user\-friendly **Power Apps** interface for staff * Design relational tables for participant information, assessments, eligibility, enrollment, training, case management, supportive services, job search activity, employer engagement, employment placements, credentials, and follow\-up * Develop an **Outreach and Referral Tracker** for recruitment activities, partner referrals, participant inquiries, and follow\-up actions * Create participant status workflows from **Recruitment → Assessment → Eligibility → Enrollment → Training → Job Search → Employment → Retention → Completion** * Create individualized participant records and case\-management histories * Allow instructors to record attendance, training participation, progress, and credential attainment * Allow case managers to document participant goals, barriers, supportive\-service needs, case notes, referrals, job\-search activity, interviews, and employment outcomes * Track employer introductions, job opportunities, interviews, placements, wages, job titles, employers, and employment dates * Track post\-employment retention and follow\-up activities * Configure **Power Automate** workflows for staff assignments, reminders, missing documentation, participant follow\-ups, interviews, employment retention, and other required activities * Build **Power BI dashboards** showing enrollment, participant demographics, training activity, credentials, employment placements, wages, retention, supportive services, staff activity, and program performance * Develop reporting that supports WIOA performance measures, including employment, earnings, credential attainment, measurable skill gains, and participant follow\-up * Create management dashboards identifying participants requiring follow\-up or missing required information * Establish role\-based access for Program Managers, Case Managers, Instructors, and Data/Operations staff * Configure employer referrals, interviews, job offers, placements, job titles, wages, and employment start dates. **Retention \& Follow\-Up** Automated post\-placement follow\-up schedules and tracking of employment retention and outcomes. **Reporting \& Analytics** Power BI dashboards for program management, staff performance, participant outcomes, recruitment, enrollment, training, job placement, experience with **Power Automate** * Strong **Power BI** dashboard and reporting experience * Experience designing relational databases and data models * Experience implementing role\-based security understanding of data quality, validation, auditing, and reporting * Ability to develop clear technical documentation and train nontechnical staff **Preferred Qualifications** Experience developing programs * Employment and job\-placement programs * Nonprofit or public\-sector organizations Familiarity with **CWDS, workforce\-development reporting, WIOA performance measures, or similar government workforce systems** is particularly valuable. **Project Deliverables** The selected developer will be expected to deliver a fully functioning production system, including: * Dataverse database architecture * Power Apps staff application * Power Automate workflows * Power BI management dashboards * User roles and security configuration * Automated reminders and follow\-up processes * Reporting/export functionality * Testing and quality assurance * Administrator and user documentation * Staff training * Production deployment and initial post\-launch support **Ideal Candidate** We are looking for someone who can do more than build dashboards. The ideal developer can understand Full Circle's complete workforce\-development process and translate it into a practical, secure, and easy\-to\-use system that staff will use every day to manage participants from initial recruitment through employment and retention. Pay: $40\.00 \- $100\.00 per hour Expected hours: 16\.0 – 40\.0 per week Work Location: Hybrid remote in Exton, PA 19341

jobs.description: **Job Description** **The Role** Join our GPSC Insights Engineering team, responsible for ideating, incubating, and delivering new data solutions for global purchasing supply chain (GPSC), Supplier Quality (SQ) and our partners. As the AI Data Engineering Manager, you will lead a multidisciplinary team responsible for building and operating industrialized data assets, AI data products, and data platforms that support Business Intelligence, Advanced Analytics, machine learning, and generative AI use cases. You will own a distinct AI data engineering area, translate functional strategy into a clear team direction and roadmap, and ensure delivery of trusted, scalable, secure, observable, and fit\-for\-purpose data products. In this role within the GPSC Insights Engineering organization under the Data organization, you will lead individual contributors and, as appropriate, other technical leaders across complex initiatives spanning multiple teams and departments. You will combine advanced technical judgment with people leadership, workforce planning, resource allocation, stakeholder influence, operational accountability, and change leadership to deliver measurable outcomes aligned with GM and GPSC priorities. **What You'll Do** * Lead and develop a diverse team of data engineers, AI/ML platform engineers, software engineers, and technical leads; jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer (Simulation)
jobs.description: **Job Description** General Motors is reimagining automation at economy scale to make manufacturing more competitive in the USA. You are a Staff Software Engineer who loves to drive physics\-grade simulation. Modeling and validating manipulation, perception, SLAM, and navigation requires physics, sensor models, and dynamics that process simulators do not provide. You will build the simulation infrastructure our robotics, physical AI, and test teams depend on, and own the roadmap toward virtual commissioning and digital twin capability. You have the taste to see important problems, the talent to build great solutions and the grit to get it done. This role sits between core robotics development and the test organization and drives the validation that happens before hardware gets involved. **The Opportunity** * Build and own our simulation environment for manipulation, perception and navigation validation. * Model robot platforms with physically accurate dynamics, kinematics, and actuation. * Implement sensor models for RGB\-D cameras, LiDAR and other supported sensors with realistic noise characteristics. * Build scene and facility authoring tooling, including import paths from CAD and existing plant models. * Integrate simulation into CI so scenario coverage runs on every release candidate. * Support the AI team with simulation for data generation and policy evaluation. * Drive the virtual commissioning and digital twin roadmap, including workcell import and collaborative authoring. Quantify and document where simulation diverges from hardware, so results are used with a known confidence. * **The Job Requirements** **Experience** * 6\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with 4\+ years building or operating robotics simulation. * Experience validating real robot behavior against simulation and closing the gap. Experience supporting other teams as an infrastructure owner. * **Education** * M.S. degree or higher in Robotics, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, or a closely related technical field. jobs.title: Director, North America AI Forward Deployed Engineering
jobs.description: **Be the one building AI\-powered experiences where they matter most.** At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI\-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships. Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real\-world enterprise environments every day. **About the Role** ================== Genesys is building a new Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) team to take the most valuable AI use cases from customer idea to production. build trusted relationships with customer CIO, CTO, digital and CX leaders. * Drive prototype\-to\-production conversion through clear KPIs, production\-readiness frameworks, evaluation pipelines, guardrails and operational handoff models. **Build for Reuse and Scale** ----------------------------- * Create repeatable delivery methodologies, playbooks and engagement models that multiply impact without multiplying headcount. * Package proven skills, agents, prompts, integrations, evaluations and deployment patterns into reusable assets and reference architectures that accelerate the next customer. * Champion AI\-native development: drive adoption of coding agents and AI\-assisted workflows (for example Cursor, Claude Code, and Kiro) to raise team velocity. * Contribute to lighthouse AI wins and referenceable customer stories that demonstrate Genesys differentiation. **Shape Product and Go\-to\-Market** ------------------------------------ * Turn field learnings into clear product requirements and work directly with Product and Engineering to remove production blockers and influence the roadmap. * Collaborate with AI Sales Specialist and Pre\-Sales leadership on engagement triggers, target accounts, scoping and positioning of FDE\-led offerings, and flag expansion opportunities early. * Work alongside peer leaders across FDE, Pre\-Sales, AI Architecture and Services to align strategy, avoid overlap and support shared revenue and adoption targets. **Operate with Rigor** ---------------------- * Establish metrics and executive reporting: time\-to\-value, production deployment milestones, adoption, customer satisfaction, AI\-influenced ACV, reuse of assets and team utilization. * Contribute to scoping, commercial and IP considerations for co\-developed solutions, balancing customer value with strategic investment. Stay hands\-on: review architectures and step into critical customer moments when needed. * **What We're Looking For** ========================== **Leadership and Organizational Experience** -------------------------------------------- * 5\+ years leading customer\-facing technical teams efits. **Working at Genesys** * **AI at enterprise scale** – Build, support and operate AI\-powered technology used by more than 8,000 organizations worldwide. 150\+ new AI features were released in the last fiscal year. * **A flexible\-first culture** – Join a global team of nearly 7,000 employees with flexible ways of working designed to help people do their best work. * **Growth in the AI era** – Build future\-ready skills through mentorship, learning programs, leadership development and education support. * **Time to recharge and give back** – Benefits include paid volunteer time, August Free Fridays, well\-being resources and regionally tailored programs for employees and their families. * **Recognized globally** – Genesys is Great Place to Work® certified in 17 countries and 94% of employees are proud to tell others they work at Genesys. Get notified about relevant opportunities . **Be the one building what's next \- where AI, experience and impact come together.** ===================================================================================== **Employee Referral** If a Genesys employee referred you, please apply using the link they shared so we can connect your application to their referral. **About Genesys:** Genesys® empowers more than 8,000 organizations worldwide to create the best customer and employee experiences. As a result, organizations can drive customer loyalty, growth and retention while increasing operational efficiency and teamwork across human and AI workforces. To learn more, visit www.genesys.ai. **Reasonable Accommodations:** If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are limited in your ability to access or use this online application and need an alternative method for applying, you or someone you know may contact us at reasonable.accommodations@genesys.com . jobs.title: AI Engineer II
jobs.description: United States \- Remote Product Strategy/Full time/Remote About the Product Concierge is Guidewire's omnichannel AI agent for P\&C carriers. It answers the phone when a policyholder has just had an accident, takes first notice of loss, asks the questions a good adjuster would ask, and writes a clean claim into ClaimCenter. It runs in production today with real carriers and real policyholders, not as a demo. Two things make this harder than a typical chatbot. First, it has synchronous voice: latency is a product requirement, not a metric on a dashboard. Second, FNOL is a regulated event where the quality of the intake determines the eventual cost of the claim. A missed question early is a bigger loss reserve later. The Role: You will build, evaluate, and harden the agent itself: the orchestration, the context it sees, the tools it can call, and the evals that tell us whether a change made it better or just different. Our rollout philosophy is a dimmer, not a light switch. We widen the agent's autonomy one notch at a time, and every notch has to be earned with evidence. Much of your work is producing that evidence, then acting on what it says. **Job Description** ### **What you'll do** * Own end\-to\-end slices of the agent: prompt and context architecture, retrieval over policy and coverage data, tool and API calls into core claims systems, and handoff to a human when the agent should stop. * Build and run the eval loop, golden sets, trajectory evaluation, LLM\-as\-judge, error analysis on real production call traces, and make it the thing that gates releases. * Drive containment and resolution rates up without trading away accuracy, and instrument the system well enough that we can tell which of the two moved. * Work directly on the voice path: turn\-taking, interruption, latency budgets, and the telephony layer underneath (LiveKit, SIP). * Sit in on carrier calls and listen to recordings. The best fixes usually come from hearing where the conversation went sideways, not from reading the logs. ### **What we're looking for** 1\. Building and deploying AI applications. You've shipped an LLM application that real users depend on, and you know that the hard part is that the output is not predictable. You're fluent in the building blocks LLMs, context engineering, RAG, agentic workflows, and you have real ML and deep learning depth underneath that fluency. Most importantly, you know how to make an unpredictable system behave predictably enough to trust: disciplined evals, error analysis, and statistical measurement rather than vibes and a handful of spot checks. 2\. Software engineering fundamentals. You can reason about cost, latency, reliability, and scalability as tradeoffs rather than goals, and you know which ones you're making. You've designed data stores and distributed systems, you write tests, and you take security and privacy seriously while advocating CI/CD process automation. We handle claims data, recorded calls, and PII under carrier and regulatory scrutiny. 3\. Using coding agents. You work with coding agents daily and you're good at it: managing their context, deciding when a spec is worth writing and when it isn't, giving them verifiers so they can close their own loops, and knowing when to intervene versus leave them alone. You also keep changing how you work as the tooling changes, rather than settling into a 2025 workflow. 4\. Shaping the build. You won't be handed a finished spec. You'll be in the room where we decide what the agent should do next, which means you need product sense and enough insurance context to argue about it. You'll know when to put an MVP in front of a carrier next week and when a claims workflow demands that we slow down and get it right the first time. Underneath all four: you keep learning. This field looks different every six months and we expect to keep changing our minds. ### **Nice to have** * Real\-time or streaming voice systems (ASR, TTS, telephony, SBC/SIPREC) * Insurance, claims, or another regulated domain where being wrong has a cost attached * Experience building internal eval or observability tooling other engineers actually adopted. * Experience in Machine learning principles, or have experience in model experimentations, training and deploying models in Productions. * Experience in P\&C Insurance or exposure to Guidewire products and services. * Prompt or pipeline optimization frameworks (DSPy, GEPA) applied to a production system ### **How to apply** Send a short note about something you shipped where the model's unpredictability was the central problem, and what you did about it. We care more about that than about a list of frameworks. ***Guidewire is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds.*** The US base salary range for this full\-time position is \- . Your base pay will depend on your experience, skills, education, training, and location among other factors. All full\-time positions or part\-time roles working 30 hours or more a week at Guidewire are eligible for benefits that support their health and well\-being including health, dental, and vision insurance, paid time off, and a company sponsored retirement plan. In addition, some roles may be eligible for the annual company bonus plan, commissions, and/or long term incentive awards which are contingent on a variety of factors including, but not limited to, company and employee performance. Interested in this position? **About Guidewire** Guidewire is the platform P\&C insurers trust to engage, innovate, and grow efficiently. We combine digital, core, analytics, and AI to deliver our platform as a cloud service. More than 540\+ insurers in 40 countries, from new ventures to the largest and most complex in the world, run on Guidewire. As a partner to our customers, we continually evolve to enable their success. We are proud of our unparalleled implementation track record with 1600\+ successful projects, supported by the largest R\&D team and partner ecosystem in the industry. Our Marketplace provides hundreds of applications that accelerate integration, localization, and innovation. For more information, please visit www.guidewire.com and follow us on Twitter: @Guidewire\_PandC. Guidewire Software, Inc. is proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We are committed to an inclusive workplace, and believe that a diversity of perspectives, abilities, and cultures is a key to our success. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, citizenship, marital status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability. All offers are contingent upon passing a criminal history and other background checks where it's applicable to the position. Guidewire is proud to be a disability inclusive employer. We are committed to providing individualized accommodations and support to candidates for any part of our hiring process. If you think you may need disability\-related accommodations, please email EmployAbility at accommodations\-gw@employ\-ability.org.uk, our disability partner, or schedule a call with an EmployAbility expert (calendar booking slot) for a confidential conversation.
