jobs.title: Data Analytics Lead
jobs.description: **About HappyRobot** -------------------- HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email \- they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23\) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $200M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide. Our platform is battle\-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto. **About the Role** ------------------ You’ll help make data a core part of how we build and improve HappyRobot’s products. You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, and Machine Learning teams to measure how changes to our models, agents, and product features affect real\-world performance. You’ll define meaningful metrics, design experiments, and conduct deeper analyses to understand how our agents create value for clients. Your work will range from evaluating A/B tests and model changes to analyzing millions of conversations and workflows. You’ll turn complex data into clear insights that influence our product and ML roadmaps. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * Define and track product, feature, and agent\-level metrics. * Design, run, and interpret A/B tests for model changes, prompts, agent behavior, workflows, and product features. * Measure how the performance of our agents affects client outcomes, such as task completion, operational efficiency, response quality, and automation rates. * Connect offline model evaluations with production performance and real\-world customer impact. * Conduct deep analyses across conversations, workflows, and product usage to identify opportunities and explain differences in performance. * Investigate anomalies and regressions, perform root\-cause analyses, and recommend improvements. * Build statistical models, simulations, and analytical frameworks to support product and ML decisions. * Partner with Engineering to improve instrumentation, data quality, experimentation systems, and analytical data models. * Build dashboards and self\-serve tools that help teams understand product and agent performance. * Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to technical and non\-technical stakeholders. **Must Have** ------------- * 4\+ years of experience in Data Science, Product Analytics, or another highly quantitative product role. * Strong experience with experimental design, A/B testing, statistics, causal inference, and hypothesis\-driven analysis. * Advanced proficiency in SQL and Python. * Experience defining and operationalizing product and feature metrics. * Ability to translate ambiguous product questions into rigorous analyses and actionable recommendations. * Strong product instincts and the ability to distinguish statistical significance from meaningful product or customer impact. * Experience partnering closely with Product, Engineering, or Machine Learning teams. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * High attention to detail and commitment to analytical accuracy. * Founder mindset: ownership, independence, curiosity, and willingness to go deep. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience working with large language models, AI agents, generative AI, or other probabilistic ML products. * Experience measuring the production impact of model, prompt, retrieval, or orchestration changes. * Familiarity with ML evaluation systems and the relationship between offline evaluations and online metrics. * Experience analyzing conversational, NLP, speech, or other unstructured data. * Experience with enterprise or B2B products. * Experience combining quantitative analysis with qualitative methods such as conversation reviews, customer feedback, surveys, or user research. * Familiarity with modern analytics infrastructure, data warehouses, experimentation platforms, and business intelligence tools. * Prior experience in a fast\-growing startup or other highly ambiguous environment. **Why join us?** ---------------- * Join a world\-class team of engineers and builders. * Backed by top investors including a16z, Y Combinator, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo. * Have ownership and autonomy of projects and are encouraged to ship. * Comprehensive Benefits including healthcare, dental, vision coverage. * Competitive salary \+ equity in a high\-growth startup. **Our Operating Principles** ***Extreme Ownership*** We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame\-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us. ***Craftsmanship*** Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw\-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching. ***We are “majos”*** Be friendly \& have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine \& honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego. ***Urgency with Focus*** Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We’re running a high\-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy. ***Talent Density and Meritocracy*** Hire only people who can raise the average; ‘exceptional performance is the passing grade.’ Ability trumps seniority. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. We give ownership to those who earn it, and we all hold each other to a high standard. A\-players want to work with other A\-players — that’s how we win. ***First\-Principles Thinking*** Strip a problem to physics\-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don’t copy\-paste solutions. We go back to basics, ask why things are the way they are, and rebuild from the ground up if needed. This mindset pushes us to innovate, challenge stale assumptions, and move faster than incumbents. It’s how we build what others think is impossible. *The personal data provided in your application and during the selection process will be processed by Happyrobot, Inc., acting as Data Controller.* *By sending us your CV, you consent to the processing of your personal data for the purpose of evaluating and selecting you as a candidate for the position. Your personal data will be treated confidentially and will only be used for the recruitment process of the selected job offer.* *In relation to the period of conservation of your personal data, these will be eliminated after three months of inactivity in compliance with the GDPR and legislation on the protection of personal data.* *If you wish to exercise your rights of access, rectification, deletion, portability or opposition in relation to your personal data, you can do so through security@happyrobot.ai subject to the GDPR.* *For more information, visit**https://www.happyrobot.ai/privacy\-policy* *By submitting your request, you confirm that you have read and understood this clause and that you agree to the processing of your personal data as described.*

jobs.title: AI Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: **About Hellyeah AI** Hellyeah is the agentic operating system for distribution. AI agents plan, execute and optimize growth work, and humans approve it. A small engineering team runs several live products, with coding agents as part of how we ship. **The role** You will own the platform our products and agents run on: the gateway every model call passes through, the runtime for our production agents, and the clusters, data stores, pipelines, secrets and release paths underneath. We're hiring two engineers, one in San Francisco and one in Shanghai. One will lean toward the AI platform and the other toward the core platform. You'll share ownership and on\-call, and work closely with our CTO. We run production AI across text, speech and video, mostly through third\-party model APIs, with some self\-hosted serving. The gateway supports internal teams, our products and customers. We do not train models. If you only want to work on model training, look elsewhere. If you want to make a multi\-provider AI stack reliable, secure and affordable, keep reading. Product teams own product features. IT support, marketing sites and SEO sit outside this role. **What you'll do** *The AI platform* * **Run the model gateway.** Own routing, fallbacks, provider failover, rate limits and rollouts for 90\+ model deployments across OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure, Google and AWS Bedrock. Benchmark new providers on latency, quality, cost and failure behavior before they take traffic, and escalate to vendors when they fall short. * **Make the gateway multi\-tenant.** Give each team and customer the right keys, routes, limits and usage metering, and reconcile usage against provider invoices. * **Run the AI developer platform.** Own shared coding\-agent access, including seats, quotas and per\-user limits, plus the remote workspaces our engineers use. One heavy user should never slow down everyone else. * **Run production agents safely.** Own sandboxing, credential scoping and pinned releases for long\-running agents on Kubernetes. * **Automate your own job.** Expect to build a lot of autonomous infra workflows and infra agents that take on routine requests and alerts, with a person approving risky actions. * **Own infrastructure and AI spend.** Reconcile provider bills against usage, tie spend to a team and product, and catch anomalies early. Right\-size clusters, spend vendor credits before they expire, and handle quota and billing escalations with cloud and model vendors. *The core platform* * **Keep clusters and cloud healthy.** Debug and upgrade EKS, AKS and bare\-metal k3s through Argo CD and Kustomize. Manage AWS, Azure and GCP through reviewed Terraform. * **Run the edge.** Own Cloudflare across a dozen domains: DNS, WAF, TLS, CDN and object storage, plus GeoDNS, load balancers, egress IPs and email authentication. * **Ship new services fast.** Point a coding agent at an open\-source repo and have it in production the same day: manifests or Helm, pinned images, Postgres and Redis, SSO, DNS, TLS, secrets and backups, all through GitOps. Make it highly available when it needs to be, and give each service a named owner. Build production infrastructure for new product launches the same way. * **Hack your way to a solution.** When something blocks you, read the source, patch it, work around it or build what's missing. You always have one more way to solve the problem. * **Lead migrations.** Move workloads between regions, clouds and platforms with a tested rollback, retire what's left behind, and bring stray services under GitOps. * **Operate the data layer.** Upgrade and migrate production PostgreSQL, MySQL, ClickHouse and Redis, run schema changes safely, and prove backups by restoring them. * **Keep data pipelines flowing.** Run Airbyte, Airflow, Dataform and CDC into BigQuery so product and finance data stay fresh, and catch a stalled sync before it fills a production disk. *Reliability and security* * **Own reliability.** Set SLOs and alerts people trust, lead incidents across infrastructure and product services, including realtime speech, write the reviews, and automate the triage you keep repeating. * **Own observability.** Keep metrics, logs and traces flowing and usable across every cluster and the gateway. Maintain Grafana, Prometheus, Loki and Datadog, build on OpenTelemetry, add telemetry to new services, and manage retention and cost, so engineers and agents can see what's happening without asking you. * **Own infrastructure security.** Rotate credentials, replace static keys with workload identity, find exposed secrets and vulnerable dependencies, respond to exposures, and control access to customer data. * **Make access self\-serve.** Replace manual grants with SSO, workload identity and scoped secrets, so engineers get what they need without asking you. Own the OAuth clients and API apps we run on ad and commerce platforms, including their reviews. *The team around you* * **Give product teams a paved road.** Build the release pipelines, canaries, preview environments and guardrails that let them ship and operate their own services. * **Review and teach.** Review infrastructure changes from engineers, founders and their agents, and share the runbooks and agent skills that keep everyone fast. **Your first 90 days** * Join on\-call and run an incident review. * Take a new model from benchmark to production traffic. * Reconcile one month of gateway usage against provider invoices. * Cut manual access requests in half. * Put one recurring request or alert under agent handling, with a person approving risky actions. * Make sure a second person can run each critical system. **What you'll bring** * 5\+ years running production infrastructure, with real on\-call experience * Deep Kubernetes debugging, including stateful workloads * Hands\-on experience running Kubernetes on bare metal, including storage, networking, upgrades and node failure * GitOps and Terraform in production, ideally across more than one cloud * Networking fundamentals: DNS, TLS, load balancing, WAF and routing * You've taken a third\-party service to production end to end, including SSO, backups and upgrades * You've led a region, cloud or database migration with a tested rollback * Hands\-on work with LLM APIs in production: routing, rate limits, streaming, failure modes and cost * You've cut a real cloud or AI bill and can show the numbers * Enough Go or Python to read an unfamiliar codebase and ship a fix * Hands\-on observability: you can maintain Grafana, Prometheus and OpenTelemetry collectors, write metric and log queries, and build a dashboard people use * Security judgment: least privilege, secret handling, credential rotation, safe rollouts * Daily use of coding agents, plus clear views on what they should not touch unreviewed * You've handed real operational work to agents or automation, with guardrails, approvals and recovery when a run dies * You follow the current agent landscape, including Hermes Agent, OpenClaw, open\-source Codex and Vercel's eve, and can explain agent harness best practices: durable runs, sandboxing, scoped credentials, human approval, memory, tracing and evals * The confidence to say no to a risky change and explain why, including to a founder * Written English for daily work with teammates in the US, China and India **Nice to have** * LiteLLM or a similar LLM gateway * LLM serving, jobs.title: AI Silicon Performance Modeling and Analysis Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Details:** ================ **Job Description:** -------------------- **About the Role and Team** The AI Silicon Architecture and Performance Engineering team is responsible for developing and maintaining performance models that enable architecture exploration, design evaluation, scalability analysis, and performance projection for next\-generation AI silicon products. These models are a critical component of the product development process, providing early visibility into architectural tradeoffs, bottlenecks, and optimization opportunities long before silicon availability. We are seeking a highly experienced and motivated engineer to drive AI silicon performance modeling, validation, architectural analysis, and stakeholder engagement activities. The candidate will work closely with architects, performance stimulus generation teams, silicon design teams, and product stakeholders to evaluate and optimize key AI silicon subsystems that determine overall platform scalability and performance. The role focuses on performance modeling and analysis of AI SoC communication fabrics, memory subsystems, scale\-up and scale\-out interconnects, host\-device memory paths, and end\-to\-end data movement infrastructure. The successful candidate will leverage SystemC/TLM\-based modeling methodologies to generate actionable insights that directly influence architecture and product decisions. This position requires a unique combination of software development expertise, architecture understanding, analytical problem solving, and cross\-functional technical leadership. The engineer will be expected to independently drive complex technical initiatives while serving as a trusted performance expert across multiple organizations. **Key Responsibilities:** **AI Silicon Performance Model Development** * Implement new architectural features and capabilities based on evolving product requirements. Improve model fidelity, scalability, maintainability, and simulation performance. * * Perform detailed debugging and root\-cause analysis of model issues and performance anomalies. * Contribute to the evolution of modeling infrastructure, methodologies, and best practices. Develop, maintain, and enhance SystemC/TLM\-based performance models representing critical AI silicon subsystems. * * + Drive modeling of key architectural components including: + SoC fabrics and on\-chip communication networks + Memory controllers and memory subsystem behavior + Scale\-up controllers and fabrics enabling accelerator\-to\-accelerator communication within a node, tray, or pod + Scale\-out controllers and fabrics enabling communication across nodes, racks, and larger AI clusters + Host CPU to accelerator memory paths + Local, host, and remote memory access paths End\-to\-end data movement architectures + **Functional Validation and Model Correlation:** * Define and execute comprehensive validation strategies to ensure correctness and architectural accuracy of performance models. * Develop validation plans, regression suites, coverage methodologies, and quality metrics. * Correlate modeled behavior against architectural expectations, reference simulations, performance projections, and available hardware measurements. * Investigate and resolve discrepancies between expected and observed behavior. * Establish robust validation frameworks that improve stakeholder confidence in model\-generated performance projections. Continuously improve validation methodologies and model quality. * **AI Silicon Performance Characterization and Architectural Analysis:** * Design and execute performance studies covering a wide range of workloads, traffic patterns, and system configurations. * Analyze performance of communication fabrics, memory systems, and data movement paths under representative AI workloads. * Evaluate bandwidth utilization, latency characteristics, congestion behavior, traffic distribution, buffering efficiency, and resource utilization. * Characterize interactions across local memory, host memory, and remote memory domains. * Assess scalability of scale\-up and scale\-out architectures across increasingly larger deployment footprints. * Identify performance bottlenecks and quantify their impact on overall system throughput and efficiency. * Conduct architectural tradeoff studies to evaluate alternative design approaches. jobs.title: Microsoft 365 Security Engineer (Remote)
jobs.description: **The Role** ============ The Inviso Microsoft 365 Security Engineer is a hands\-on technical consultant who designs, implements, and optimizes security, compliance, identity, and governance solutions across Microsoft 365\. This role focuses on helping clients secure Microsoft 365 environments using Microsoft Purview, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Defender, and emerging Microsoft agent security and governance capabilities, including Agent 365\. The Engineer translates security and compliance requirements into practical technical controls and works directly with client teams to implement, validate, and operationalize those solutions. As part of Inviso’s Microsoft Solutions Group (MSG), the Engineer works across client engagements, partnering with architects, consultants, security teams, and client stakeholders to deliver secure, governed Microsoft 365 environments. **This is a 100% remote role working in the US and requiring US time\-zone availability.** **Key Activities for this Role** ================================ * Design, configure, and implement Microsoft Purview security, compliance, data governance, and information protection capabilities. * Configure and optimize Purview Information Protection, sensitivity labels, Data Loss Prevention (DLP), retention, eDiscovery, and related compliance controls. * Implement security and governance capabilities for Microsoft 365 Copilot and AI agents using Agent 365 and related Microsoft security technologies. * Design and implement identity and access controls using Microsoft Entra ID, including Conditional Access, MFA, RBAC, identity governance, and privileged access. * Assess Microsoft 365 environments, identify security and compliance gaps, and develop actionable recommendations and remediation plans. * Configure and integrate Microsoft Defender, Microsoft 365 security, compliance, identity, and governance capabilities across customer environments. * Partner directly with client security, compliance, identity, and IT teams to translate business and regulatory requirements into technical solutions. * Develop technical documentation, configuration standards, governance frameworks, implementation plans, and operational procedures. * Support client workshops, technical discovery, solution design, implementation, testing, and knowledge transfer. * Maintain delivery activities, technical work items, documentation, and project status while meeting Inviso quality and utilization expectations. **Experience \& Skills Required** ================================= * 3\+ years of hands\-on experience implementing and supporting Microsoft 365 security, compliance, or identity solutions in enterprise environments. * Strong hands\-on experience with Microsoft Purview, including Information Protection, sensitivity labels, Data Loss Prevention, retention, eDiscovery, or related compliance capabilities. * Experience implementing Microsoft Entra ID security controls, including Conditional Access, MFA, RBAC, privileged access, and identity governance. * Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 Copilot, AI agents, Agent 365, or security and governance controls for enterprise AI workloads. * Experience with Microsoft Defender and Microsoft 365 security capabilities, including integration across identity, applications, endpoints, and cloud services. * Understanding of Zero Trust principles and their application across Microsoft 365 identity, data, applications, and collaboration services. * Experience assessing existing environments, identifying security or compliance gaps, and implementing remediation recommendations. * Proficiency with PowerShell and automation for Microsoft 365 administration, security, compliance, and configuration. * Strong consulting and customer\-facing skills with the ability to lead technical discussions and clearly communicate recommendations. * Strong written documentation skills and experience working within structured consulting or project delivery teams. **Desired Qualifications** ========================== * Microsoft security certifications such as SC\-100, SC\-300, SC\-400, or equivalent Microsoft 365 security and compliance certifications preferred. * Experience securing Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio agents, or other enterprise AI and agent\-based solutions. * Experience with Microsoft Sentinel, Defender for Cloud Apps, or broader Microsoft Security technologies. * Experience working in consulting, professional services, or complex enterprise Microsoft 365 environments. * Bachelor’s degree in a related technical field or equivalent professional experience preferred. **Compensation** ================ At Inviso, we believe great talent should be rewarded with competitive pay, meaningful benefits, and room to grow. Beyond base pay, we offer a strong benefits package that includes medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with company match, annual training reimbursement, paid time off, paid holidays, and additional perks designed to support your well\-being and long\-term success. **Why You’ll Love Working at Inviso:** ====================================== * **Do work that matters.** We are a global technology and business consulting firm that helps organizations implement AI, modern data platforms, and digital marketing strategies. * **Work somewhere people choose to stay.** Our low attrition, strong average tenure, and employees who have spent 10, 15, or even 20 years with Inviso speak volumes about our culture and how we care for our people. * **Bring your ideas and be heard.** You will join a collaborative, people\-first environment where ideas matter, contributions are recognized, and excellent work creates real opportunities for growth. * **Keep learning and growing.** Inviso invests in employees through continuous learning, mentorship, collaboration, and career development across a diverse global organization. * **Join a company with deep industry credibility.** Inviso has worked closely with Microsoft for more than 20 years and is proud to be a top\-rated supplier and Managed Partner with numerous credentials.

Data Center Mechanical Operation Engineer (Union), Local 30 Shift Schedule: 11 PM \-7 AM Sunday\-Tuesday / Wednesday\-Thursday\-off / 11 PM \- 7 AM Friday \& Saturday **JOB SUMMARY** A Data Center Mechanical Operating Engineer will be responsible to assist in the hands\-on maintenance of building systems for the safe, efficient, and proper operations of all assigned properties. Engineer will perform minor repairs and helps in the operation, monitoring, and performance of preventive maintenance on the building systems as necessary. The Operating Engineer must be a Member in Good Standing with the Local 30, or be willing to become a member of the Local 30 upon acceptance by the Union. **QUALIFICATIONS** **–** To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. **EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE** – A high school diploma or GED is required. A minimum four (4\) years of relevant experience in the building maintenance industry and accredited trade school degree in HVAC, electronic, or other industry related trade. Union training and certification is also acceptable. Must have Universal CFC certification (or obtain within 90 days of employment). Should be knowledgeable in the safe and proper use of the following tools: ladders, lifts, basic hand tools, voltmeter, manual drain auger, plumbers helper, safety goggles, ear protection, and fire extinguisher. **COMMUNICATION \& TECHNOLOGY SKILLS** \- Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals. Have the ability to write routine reports and correspondence as well as follow detailed procedures and associated forms and data logging. Ability to use common technology, such as desktop PC, cellular phone, tablet/iPad, copier/scanner, and other electronic tools or devices as needed. Ability to use common software and applications, such as Microsoft Office products (especially Word, Outlook, and Excel) and CMMS system(s). **MATHEMATICAL SKILLS** \- Ability to calculate figures and amounts such as load balancing, proportions, percentages, area, circumference, and volume. Have the ability to apply concepts of basic algebra and geometry. **REASONING ABILITY** \- Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists. Have the ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule format. **PHYSICAL DEMANDS** \- Physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. The employee frequently is required to stand; walk; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 10 pounds, frequently lift and/or move up to 25 pounds, and occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. **WORK ENVIRONMENT** \- The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. jobs.title: Technical Program Manager - Hardware
jobs.description: **ABOUT LVT** LVT is redefining how businesses operate in the physical world, moving beyond traditional security solutions to deliver AI\-driven, actionable intelligence that makes sites smarter, safer, and more secure. Since pioneering our first mobile, solar\-powered units, our commitment to scrappy, hands\-on innovation has made us an established leader and one of the fastest\-growing companies in intelligent site technology. We are building the next generation of solutions—from our physical units in the field to a powerful Agentic AI platform—that allows our customers to gain unprecedented visibility and control over safety, compliance, and operations. This is your chance to join a cutting\-edge team that isn't just watching the world change, but actively building the technology that is changing it. We’re a team that’s focused on growth and innovation, and we’re proud that our crew, products, and leadership are being recognized for it. * **A Top\-Tier Growth Company:** Named one of the *Financial Times’ Fastest Growing Companies 2025* and *\#10 on the Inc. 5000 Rocky Mountain Regional* list for 2025\. * **Innovative Leadership:** Our CEO, Ryan Porter, was named an *EY Entrepreneur of the Year 2025*, and our CTO, Steve Lindsey, was inducted into the *Silicon Slopes CTO Hall of Fame* in 2024\. * **Product \& Software Excellence:** We were named one of *The Software Report’s Top 100 Software Companies of 2023* and are a winner of the *Security Today Govies Award* for 2025\. **ABOUT THIS ROLE** As a Technical Program Manager, you will own the delivery of new features for LVT's deployed hardware models and for the next\-generation models still in development. You will run programs end to end, from scope and schedule through cross\-team dependencies, risk, and release, across firmware, hardware, backend software, and go\-to\-market. You will give stakeholders clear communication and real visibility into execution, and you will prioritize aggressively so effort is put toward features customers value. This role is built for a TPM ready to own programs and improve how the team operates. LVT is a flexible\-first company, and this role is in person at our office in American Fork, UT, where you will work alongside the hardware, firmware, and software teams you partner with. Because our work involves physical hardware, occasional travel (approximately 5–15%) may be needed to visit our facilities or partners. **ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES** * **Own Feature Programs End to End:** Drive scope, schedule, dependencies, and risk for new features on existing hardware models, from intake through release to the field. * **Deliver Features for Models in Development:** Align feature timelines with hardware milestones across prototyping, validation, and production so software and hardware land together. * **Resolve Cross\-Team Blockers:** Work directly with engineers across firmware, hardware, and backend software to clear blockers, and escalate only the risks that need a leadership decision. * **Prioritize Aggressively:** Protect the critical path by declining or deferring work that doesn't serve the plan, and make tradeoffs visible to the people who own them. * **Communicate Without Surprises:** Tailor updates to each audience so stakeholders always know status, risks, and the decisions needed from them. * **Build Visibility Into Execution:** Maintain accurate roadmaps, dashboards, and status reporting in Jira, Confluence, and Smartsheet that take minutes to read, not hours. * **Recover Slipping Programs:** Replan quickly when schedules slip, bringing options and a recommendation to escalation conversations rather than only the problem. * **Pressure\-Test Plans and Estimates:** Use working knowledge of LVT's hardware, firmware, and cloud architecture to spot unrealistic estimates and hold credible conversations with engineers. * **Improve How the Team Operates:** Refine templates, status reporting, and ceremonies for your programs, onboard new TPMs, and contribute to TPM candidate interviews. **OUR IDEAL CANDIDATE** * **Program Ownership:** You have run programs end to end with minimal supervision and can point to features or products you shipped on time and on scope. * **Technical Credibility:** You understand the systems your programs touch well enough to identify risk and challenge estimates. You don't need to be an engineer, but engineers can't fool you. * **Clear Communicator:** You write and speak concisely, adjust to your audience, and surface bad news early. * **Prioritization Discipline:** You say no to work that doesn't serve the plan, and you explain the tradeoff instead of absorbing the request. * **Cross\-Functional Influence:** You earn trust across Product, Software, Firmware, and Hardware and keep multiple teams working from the same plan, even as it shifts. * **Judgment on Escalation:** You know which risks to solve yourself and which to raise, and you raise them with a proposed path forward. * **Experience:** You likely have 3–6 years of experience in technical program management or a related role, with fluency in Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet, or similar tools. * **A Plus:** Experience with hardware\+edge\+cloud products including validation, manufacturing, or supply chain. **BENEFITS** We believe you do your best work when your whole life is supported. We invest in our crew’s health, families, and financial futures with a benefits package designed to support you inside and outside the office. Full\-time benefits include, but not limited to: Comprehensive health, dental and vision coverage, retirement benefits (401k match up to 4%), and flexible PTO. ***LVT IS PROUD TO BE AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER.*** *All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. All candidates must pass a drug screening and background check upon employment. Some roles may also require passing a federal background check and fingerprinting. Must be authorized to work in the U.S. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, and/or to perform essential job functions, please reach out to your recruiter.*

can point to concrete workflows where AI adds value; critically evaluates and validates AI\-generated output; and applies AI responsibly, protecting confidential and customer data. * Experience with institutional investment or asset management data, ideally in public markets (fixed income, and derivatives) and research (data driven insights from structured and unstructured company, sector, macro sources). * Expert SQL, with a strong command of data modeling, warehousing, and architecture, and sound judgment on design tradeoffs. * Expert\-level experience in designing and architecting scalable, high\-performance Snowflake and AWS data solutions, including complex data models, ETL/ELT pipelines, performance optimization, and establishing best practices for data engineering across multiple squads * Proficient in Python for transforming, integrating, and automating data workflows. * Hands\-on experience with AWS services used in data and application workloads, such as S3, Lambda, RDS (PostgreSQL), API Gateway, and IAM. * Hands\-on CI/CD experience, automating how data work is built, tested, and deployed with tools such as GitHub Actions or similar. * Experience building data quality and automated testing into pipelines, from tests that run with every change to regression checks that confirm data products stay correct after releases, using data testing and quality tools such as dbt, iceDQ, or similar. * Experience leading technical work, such as guiding design decisions, mentoring engineers, or setting a team’s technical direction. **About Us****Pay Philosophy:** The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. jobs.title: Azure DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: Libra Solutions helps simplify and ease the burden of legal processes for plaintiffs, heirs, and the attorneys and doctors who serve them. By combining financial strength with technology\-driven innovation, we simplify difficult legal processes, reduce delays, and help people access both money and the care they need, when they need it most. Our companies are leaders in their industries! MoveDocs streamlines the coordination of medical, financial, and professional services for personal injury cases—improving efficiency for attorneys, care providers, and their clients. Oasis Financial is the largest and most recognized plaintiff funding brand in the nation, having helped 400,000\+ plaintiffs access more than $2 billion in funding while their personal injury cases progress. And through Probate Advance, we enable heirs to access their inheritance without waiting through the lengthy probate process. Together, under the Libra Solutions banner, we support a nationwide network of more than 45,000 attorneys and 10,000 healthcare providers – creating a powerful platform to deliver faster, more seamless outcomes for our customers. Libra Solutions is seeking an Azure DevOps Engineer to build, automate, and operate the delivery pipelines and cloud platform behind our products. You will own our Azure DevOps (ADO) pipelines end to end, from build and test through security scanning, approval gates, and multi\-environment promotion, and you will manage our infrastructure as code so that every environment is reproducible, reviewable, and deployed the same way every time. You will also operate the application and integration tier those pipelines deliver to, including App Service, API Management, Data Factory, and Application Insights, and design the multi\-region resilience that keeps it running. Familiarity with SQL Server and Azure SQL is a plus, particularly for automating database deployments and environment refreshes. We operate in a regulated environment that handles sensitive medical and financial data, and we maintain a SOC 2 Type 2 program. The right candidate understands that a pipeline, a failover plan, or an environment deployment is also a control that must work every day and produce evidence that it did. You will work closely with software engineering, data, IT operations, and security, and with our AI\-native engineering pods as they adopt agentic development and delivery tooling. This position reports to the Director, TechOps and Security and can be based in any of our office locations in Denver, CO, Charlotte, NC, Rosemont, IL, or Las Vegas, NV. We welcome strong remote candidates, with occasional travel as needed. **Requirements** Desired Skills and Experience: * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience * 4\+ years of hands\-on DevOps, platform, or cloud engineering experience operating production workloads in Microsoft Azure * 3\+ years building and operating Azure DevOps Pipelines (YAML), including multi\-stage deployments, pipeline templates, environment approvals, and secure service connections * Hands\-on infrastructure\-as\-code experience with Bicep, ARM templates, or Terraform, deployed through CI/CD * Experience integrating security and quality tooling into CI/CD (code, dependency, and secrets scanning) and implementing release strategies such as deployment slots, blue/green deployments, and rollback * Strong Git skills, including branching strategies, pull request workflows, and branch policies * Hands\-on experience operating Azure App Service and Azure API Management in production * Working knowledge of Application Insights, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and KQL for building alerts, dashboards, and diagnostic queries * Experience developing and supporting Azure Data Factory pipelines * Experience designing and testing multi\-region architecture, geo\-replication, and disaster recovery in Azure * Proficiency in scripting and automation with PowerShell and/or Python, and comfort with the Azure CLI * Understanding of security fundamentals for cloud infrastructure, including RBAC in Entra ID, managed identities, Key Vault, encryption, and secure\-by\-default configuration * Experience working within a compliance framework such as SOC 2, HIPAA, PCI DSS, or ISO 27001, and an understanding of how infrastructure controls are evidenced to auditors * Self\-motivated and collaborative, with strong written communication; able to explain technical tradeoffs clearly to engineers, security staff, and non\-technical stakeholders * Strong troubleshooting skills and comfort supporting an existing production platform while building new automation * Must be authorized to work in the U.S. Preferred Technical Familiarity: * Microsoft certifications such as AZ\-400, AZ\-104, or AZ\-305 * SQL Server or Azure SQL experience, including T\-SQL, database deployment through pipelines (e.g., SSDT/DACPAC), backup and restore, and basic query performance tuning (DP\-300 a plus) * Experience with GitHub Actions or GitHub Advanced Security alongside Azure DevOps * Experience with containers, including Docker, Azure Container Registry, and Azure Container Apps or AKS * Experience using AI\-assisted engineering tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) and agentic CI/CD patterns in day\-to\-day work * Experience with Azure OpenAI or other Azure AI services * Familiarity with Azure networking: hub\-and\-spoke VNets, private endpoints, private DNS zones, NSGs, and Application Gateway/WAF * Experience with Azure Policy, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, and compliance automation platforms (e.g., Vanta, Drata) * Experience with Azure Functions, Service Bus, and Azure Front Door **Benefits** **Benefits** We offer competitive compensation and benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life insurance plans, 401(k) with company match, and paid time off.

jobs.title: Principal DevOps / Data Engineer
jobs.description: *For over 30 years, Alder has been a trusted guide for more than 5,000 families across the Northeast, helping them navigate the aging journey with compassion, clarity, and expert care. Our life care managers are seasoned social workers and nurses, providing both strategic direction and hands\-on support, from coordinating medical care and assessing home safety to attending appointments and facilitating meaningful family conversations.* *Deeply rooted in the community, we leverage a broad professional network to connect families with trusted resources and foster collaboration across disciplines. Whether offering occasional consultations or urgent crisis support, we tailor our involvement to meet each individual’s unique needs. At the heart of our work is a simple goal: to help families approach the practical and emotional aspects of aging with confidence.* **The Role:** Alder is building an intelligence\-first operating system for eldercare, on AWS with a data lakehouse at its core. comfortable reading Java services. * Security and compliance mindset; experience operating systems that handle regulated or sensitive data. * Clear written and verbal communication; able to work in a hybrid, small\-team environment in Greater Boston. **Qualifications:*** HIPAA experience or work in healthcare, eldercare or another regulated industry. * Experience with PostgreSQL change data capture, event sourcing or Kafka\-style streaming. * Experience with Istio, Valkey/Redis, and AWS Cognito. * Familiarity with BI tooling (QuickSight, Metabase, Looker or similar) and analytics for CRM and telephony data. * Experience supporting ML or LLM workloads and data pipelines for AI features. * Prior startup or early\-stage team experience. **Why Work at Alder?** At Alder, we value our team as our greatest asset. jobs.title: AI Engineer, Medical Vision Language Models
jobs.description: Lumexa Imaging is one of the country's largest providers of outpatient medical imaging. With over 5,000 team members and more than 185 outpatient imaging centers across 13 states, our team conducts more than 4 million outpatient studies annually. We are the partner of choice for health systems and radiologists, delivering best\-in\-class clinical excellence, operations, and state\-of\-the\-art technology across our platform. Lumexa Imaging is hiring an early\-career AI Engineer to help build, adapt, and deploy vision language models (VLMs) and imaging foundation models for clinical radiology. You will work hands\-on using agentic coding tools (Claude Code, OpenAI Codex) to transition ideas from radiologists into validated, deployed models. This is a build\-focused role centered on model development and deployment. Initial priorities include building clinical LLM pipelines (prior report summarization, scanned document summarization, and relevant prior selection) on infrastructure shared with our VLM work. **Why this role is a rare opportunity:** You will have access to a large, growing repository of clinical imaging and reporting data. A central part of this job is leveraging this real\-world, domain\-specific data, consistent with applicable privacy, security, and governance requirements, to develop, adapt, and evaluate AI models beyond what is possible using public data alone. You will work closely with the Chief Clinical AI Officer, the Clinical Applications team, and Infrastructure and Information Security. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities:** * VLM Development and Adaptation: Fine\-tune and adapt open VLMs (e.g., Qwen\-VL, LLaVA\-Med, MedGemma, InternVL) and imaging foundation models for report drafting, impression generation, finding detection, and prior comparison. Apply parameter\-efficient methods (LoRA, QLoRA) and full fine\-tuning under senior guidance. * Vision Encoders and Representation Learning: Work with vision encoders, contrastive image\-text models (CLIP, SigLIP), and self\-supervised approaches (JEPA). Build and maintain embedding pipelines for retrieval, cohort discovery, case similarity search, and drift detection * Data Curation: Curate and version datasets from our internal PACS and reporting systems, including DICOM header, burned\-in pixel, and paired\-report de\-identification * Agentic Engineering: Use Claude Code and OpenAI Codex daily to build, test, and maintain code. Maintain project context (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md), and help build and run MCP servers for internal system access * Deployment and MLOps: Deploy models via containerized inference and GPU serving (vLLM, Triton), support CI/CD pipelines, and monitor production models for drift and performance * Evaluation: Build automated evaluation harnesses for clinical accuracy, negation, laterality, and hallucination scoring against radiologist ground truth * Workflow Automation: Build agentic and LLM driven tools for operational workflows, such as converting unstructured requests into RIS scheduling actions and supporting intelligent operations dashboards **Required Qualifications:** * Hands\-on experience fine\-tuning transformer models in PyTorch (vision, multimodal, or language) using Hugging Face, MONAI, or similar (via internships, research, open\-source work, or projects) * Working knowledge of embeddings and vector search * Experience with open VLMs such as Qwen\-VL or LLaVA * Daily use of agentic coding tools (Claude Code, OpenAI Codex) * Familiarity with Docker and GPU\-based model serving * Comfort working with real\-world data and a reproducible approach to experiments **Preferred Qualifications:** * Hands\-on experience with vision encoders and contrastive models (CLIP, SigLIP, JEPA) * Exposure to medical VLMs, imaging foundation models, or self\-supervised methods (DINOv2, MAE) * Experience building MCP servers in Python or TypeScript * Familiarity with medical imaging formats (DICOM, HL7, FHIR) and HIPAA/PHI handling * Awareness of MLOps tooling (MLflow, Weights \& Biases, model registries) * Awareness of FDA considerations for clinical AI (510(k), PCCP) **Education/Licensing/Certification:** Degree in Computer Science, Biomedical Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience) **Experience (years and type):** Experience 0 to 3 years (internships, research, or projects count) **Travel Required (% of time):** Minimal, up to 10% **Physical Requirements \& Work Environment:** Standard remote office work Lumexa Imaging provides a competitive compensation program to attract, retain, and motivate a high\-performance workforce. Lumexa Imaging is an equal opportunity employer.

With more than 40 offices worldwide, the group has over 2,300 employees across Europe, Asia and the Americas. Working closely with DataOps, AI Engineering, Analytics Engineering, the role combines strong hands\-on engineering with the judgement to translate governance, risk, and control requirements into scalable pipeline patterns, contributing to a culture of quality, automation, and operational excellence that supports delivery at the pace of the business. In addition, the role will collaborate closely with Data Modelers and Data Analysts in the Data Office to enable the delivery and implementation of enterprise data products in an iterative fashion. evolve the Data Platform, applying Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold) principles to ensure clean, reliable data progression * Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for data workloads within Adhere to the operational risk framework for your role ensuring that all regulatory or company determined parameters are complied with * Role model for demonstrating highest level standards of integ aking * Strong hands\-on expertise with Databricks, Spark, and modern cloud technologies, with AWS experience highly valued * Advanced programming and data engineering skills, including Python, SQL, and the development of high\-performance data pipelines * Experience building and optimizing both real\-time and batch data processing solutions * A passion for engineering excellence, with a focus on automation, CI/CD, reliability, observability, and data quality * Experience working with large, complex datasets and delivering innovative solutions in dynamic, fast\-paced environments * Ability to navigate regulated environments while balancing business needs, governance, and risk requirements * Collaborative mindset with experience working in Agile teams and partnering across technology, operations, and business stakeholders **Skills and Experience** * Experience in financial services, with exposure to ETD and OTC derivatives markets preferred * Experience working with cloud platforms, including AWS and Azure * Hands\-on experience with data orchestration and transformation tools such as Apache Airflow, dbt, and Databricks Lakeflow * Strong experience with Databricks, management (MLOps) * Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional certification preferred **Salary Range: $180,000 to $210,000 per year and eligible for discretionary bonus** **Company Values** Acting as a role model for the values of the Company: **Respect** \- Clients are at the heart of our business, with superior execution and superb client service the foundation of the firm. Participate in code reviews and follow Git branching and merge practices. * Create and maintain technical documentation, runbooks, and lineage records that support auditability, supportability, and responsible AI governance. * Troubleshoot and resolve issues in pipelines, retrieval quality, integrations, and agent behavior, escalating complex issues to senior engineers as needed. * Partner with engineers, data owners, and business stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver reliable components. jobs.title: Industrial Engineer
jobs.description: Mastronardi Produce pioneered the commercial greenhouse industry in North America, and we’re now the leading greenhouse vegetable company on the continent. Our award\-winning, flavorful produce is packed under the SUNSET® brand and is available at leading grocery retailers across North America. Family owned for over 70 years, we pride ourselves on having the most flavorful products and the best people in the industry. We are constantly pushing boundaries to be a leader in fresh produce innovation. We seek individuals that demonstrate our PRIDE values (Passion, Respect, Innovation, Drive, Excellence) to help us fulfill our mission to inspire healthy living through WOW flavor experiences. Our facility in Jonestown, PA is currently seeking an Industrial Engineer – DC Performance \& Reliability. This role drives distribution center performance across an assigned portfolio of sites, using WMS and MES (Manufacturing Execution System) data to diagnose root causes and close performance gaps. The role provides insights to the Site GM and leadership teams on corrective action to move DC performance toward network Best\-in\-Class targets and leads DC and production\-flow infrastructure design to increase productivity and overall DC KPIs, supporting the company's growth objectives. The role partners closely with the Director of Insights \& Business Metrics and the Supply Chain Engineering Project Manager to translate findings into sustained operational improvement. **Values:** To perform the job successfully, the incumbent’s behavior must be consistent with the PRIDE values expected of all Mastronardi Produce employees: be Passionate; have Respect; be Innovative; be Driven and strive for Excellence. **Primary Responsibilities:** * Lead recurring DC metrics compliance reviews with site leadership, evaluating performance against network KPI targets (labor productivity, throughput, order accuracy, on\-time performance, inventory accuracy, and similar site metrics). * Conduct root cause analysis (5\-Why, fishbone/Ishikawa, DMAIC) on performance gaps, process flow breakdowns, and end\-user process non\-compliance to identify the true driver of underperformance rather than symptoms. * Serve as the analytical and coaching partner to the Site General Manager on workforce performance — the Site GM retains full ownership and accountability for training and workforce performance; this role surfaces KPI\-based diagnosis and corrective action needed. * Own performance oversight across an assigned portfolio of distribution centers (typically one primary/larger DC paired with one smaller DC), with dedicated single\-DC assignment for the network's largest sites as network growth requires. * Maintain a hands\-on onsite presence at assigned DCs — reinforcing the Site GM's daily cadence of performance reviews and floor\-level monitoring, particularly where onsite leadership capability for User Performance Management is still developing. * Lead DC and production\-flow infrastructure design and redesign initiatives in partnership with Operations Leadership — facility layout, workflow, and capacity planning — to support the company's projected growth in sales over the next four years. * Lead or significantly contribute to new DC site analysis, selection, and start\-up as part of network expansion to support business growth. * Translate DC performance metrics and customer\-service impact analysis into briefings for cross\-functional corporate HQ leadership (Sales, Customer Service, Finance, and other executive stakeholders) to inform enterprise\-wide growth planning and decision\-making. * Translate KPI and root\-cause findings into specific coaching recommendations for the Site GM's Corrective Action Plans; track corrective action plan progress and re\-validate that gaps close and stay closed, with the Site GM directing execution. * Map and analyze DC process flows (value stream mapping, time and motion studies) to identify nonvalue\- added activity, bottlenecks, and points of process/system deviation. * Standardize local site workflows against network SOPs; author or revise SOPs and work instructions where process breakdowns or compliance gaps are identified. * Partner with the Director of Insights \& Business Metrics on KPI definitions, dashboard requirements, and site scorecards used to drive the metrics compliance review cadence. * Partner with the Supply Chain Engineering Project Manager and IT design and implementation team where corrective actions intersect with WMS/MES rollout sequencing or system\-adoption gaps. * Facilitate structured problem\-solving sessions with site operations, maintenance, and quality teams to resolve cross\-functional root causes. * Present root cause analysis findings, corrective action status, and site performance trends to DC and Supply Chain Engineering leadership. * Support new system rollout compliance (WMS/MES) as it relates to sustained process adherence post go\-live. * Travel to other network distr e selection, and cross\-portfolio metrics reviews. * Assist with DC site Capex project reviews and documentation in support of site projects. * Work closely with the DC Site Maintenance team on key productivity initiatives and maintenance projects. * All other duties as required to support Supply Chain Engineering functions. **Education/Background Requirements:** * Bachelor's Degree in Industrial Engineering, Operations Management, or a related field (required); * Master's Degree in Industrial Engineering, Operations Research, or a related field preferred given the network design and facility planning scope of this role. * 8–12 years of progressive experience in distribution center or manufacturing operations, including demonstrated experience in DC/production facility design, network planning, or site selection — not solely steady\-state DC operations experience. * Demonstrated ability to influence senior site leadership (up to and including General Managers) and cross\-functional corporate leadership through data\-driven analysis, without holding direct line authority. * Demonstrated experience applying structured root cause analysis and corrective action methodologies * (5\-Why, fishbone/Ishikawa, DMAIC, A3, or equivalent). * Working knowledge of WMS/MES systems and process documentation. * Strong Excel proficiency and working familiarity with a BI/reporting tool (Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent) for metrics analysis. * Strong coaching, facilitation, and communication skills; comfortable advising site leadership — including the Site General Manager — on workforce performance corrective direction without holding direct line authority over the DC workforce. * Ability to work onsite at assigned DC portfolio sites, with periodic travel to other network locations for network design and site\-selection work. * Bilingual (English and Spanish) desired. **Specific Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Required:** * DC or plant start\-up experience strongly preferred — site analysis and selection, facility layout/design, and initial operations stand\-up. * Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or higher. * Experience with value stream mapping, time and motion studies, and line/labor balancing. * Experience in food, produce, CPG, or another perishable/high\-velocity distribution environment. * Exposure to Industry 4\.0 / analytics\-driven performance tools (real\-time dashboards, IoT\-enabled tracking). * Root Cause Problem\-Solving — moves past symptoms to the underlying "Why" using structured methodology. * Analytical Thinking — interprets DC metrics and translates them into targeted, actionable corrective actions. * Organizational Influence — engages effectively with Site GMs and cross\-functional corporate HQ leadership without formal authority; comfortable "leading leaders" through data and analysis. * Coaching \& Influence — advises Site GMs on corrective direction through analysis and relationship rather than positional authority. * Accountability \& Follow\-Through — tracks corrective actions to closure and re\-validates sustained compliance. * Communication \& Facilitation — clear across all levels, from DC floor associates to senior leadership. * Data\-Driven Decision Making — grounds recommendations in metrics rather than anecdote. * Adaptability — operates effectively across a multi\-site network with varying local conditions. **Please note:** Mastronardi Produce has accommodation processes and policies in place and provides accommodation for employees with disabilities. If you require a specific accommodation because of a disability or documented medical need, please contact the Human Resource office so that arrangements can be made for the appropriate accommodation to be put in place. jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Who We Are** Healthcare quality is complex. Medisolv helps make it manageable — and actionable. We partner with hospitals, health systems, ACOs, and payers to bring clarity to quality data, connecting clinical and claims information into a single, reliable view. More than 1,800 organizations and 130M\+ patient records rely on Medisolv to measure, report, and improve performance across 500\+ measures tied to CMS, The Joint Commission, and other programs. With support from Bessemer Venture Partners Forge, we're continuing to grow our platform and expand our impact — investing in advanced analytics, AI, and new capabilities that help healthcare organizations stay ahead of change and improve outcomes with confidence. Reporting to Director of AI \& Data Engineering, we are looking for an experienced Senior Data Engineer to join our team. **About the Role** The Senior Data Engineer will provide hands\-on technical leadership for Medisolv's healthcare data platform and customer implementations. You will design, build, and operate reliable data products that transform payer and quality data into trusted measure calculations, forecasts, and decision\-ready insights. This is a senior individual\-contributor role with broad ownership across Snowflake, dbt, orchestration, cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, data quality, and production operations. You will partner closely with product, domain experts, application engineers, security, and client\-facing teams while helping the engineering team establish scalable patterns and sound technical decisions. **What You'll Do** * Own the design and evolution of scalable Snowflake and dbt data models supporting healthcare quality measurement, forecasting, reporting, and customer\-specific workflows. * Lead complex ingestion and connector implementations for claims, enrollment, eligibility, pharmacy, survey, plan, and reference data delivered through SFTP, object storage, data shares, and APIs. * Set engineering patterns for orchestration, incremental processing, dependency management, reruns, reconciliation, and production support across Airflow and related workflows. * Drive cloud modernization work across AWS and Azure, including Terraform\-based infrastructure, secure connectivity, secrets management, environment promotion, and operational readiness. * Strengthen CI/CD and release practices using GitHub Actions and related tooling, with automated tests, security checks, observability, and controlled production deployment. * Translate healthcare quality requirements into maintainable technical designs, partnering with domain experts on CMS Star Ratings, HEDIS, CAHPS, HOS, PQA, measure calculations, and scenario modeling. * Investigate complex data and platform issues, lead root\-cause analysis, and implement durable improvements to reliability, performance, cost, and data trust. * Provide technical mentorship through architecture reviews, pull\-request feedback, documentation, and reusable patterns without direct people\-management responsibility. * Collaborate with product, client delivery, security, and engineering leaders to scope work, surface dependencies, communicate tradeoffs, and deliver against customer commitments. **What You'll Accomplish — Your Performance Objectives** **In your first 30 days, you will:** * Build working knowledge of the Lilac platform, healthcare\-quality domain, Snowflake/dbt model layers, orchestration, cloud environments, release processes, and active customer commitments. * Partner with engineering and domain leads to map critical data flows from ingestion through measure calculation, forecasting, reporting, and application consumption. * Review current architecture, operational risks, and the AWS\-to\-Azure migration plan; complete an initial production\-support shadowing cycle. **In your first 60 days, you will:** * Assume technical ownership of a meaningful data\-platform or customer\-integration workstream, including design, implementation plan, tests, observability, and rollout criteria. * Deliver or materially advance a production\-ready Snowflake/dbt, ingestion, or cloud\-infrastructure enhancement with measurable quality or reliability outcomes. * Establish clear design and review practices for the workstream and mentor teammates through code, model, and infrastructure reviews. **In your first 90 days, you will:** * Independently lead a cross\-functional delivery from requirements through production validation, including dependency management, data reconciliation, release coordination, and post\-release monitoring. * Recommend and begin implementing prioritized improvements to scalability, test coverage, operational resilience, security, or cloud portability. * Be a trusted technical owner for a core platform area and a reliable partner for healthcare\-domain, product, and customer\-delivery stakeholders. **Who We're Looking For — The Competencies That Matter** **Required** * Substantial professional experience building and operating production data platforms, with senior\-level ownership of architecture, delivery, and operational outcomes. * Advanced SQL and data\-modeling expertise, including hands\-on production experience with Snowflake and dbt or closely comparable modern cloud\-warehouse tooling. * Experience designing robust batch data pipelines and ingestion frameworks, including schema mapping, incremental processing, testing, reconciliation, and failure recovery. * Strong software engineering skills in Python or another production language, with disciplined version control, code review, automated testing, and documentation practices. * Hands\-on experience with infrastructure as code and CI/CD, including Terraform and GitHub Actions or comparable tools. * Experience operating across AWS and/or Azure, with practical knowledge of networking, identity, secrets, object storage, monitoring, and secure environment design. * Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical work across engineering, product, domain, security, and client\-facing stakeholders. * Commitment to secure handling of regulated healthcare data, least\-privilege access, auditability, and production reliability. **Strongly Preferred** * Healthcare payer data experience, especially Medicare Advantage, CMS Star Ratings, HEDIS, CAHPS, HOS, PQA, claims, enrollment, eligibility, pharmacy, or quality\-measure calculations. * Experience with Apache Airflow or comparable orchestration and with targeted reruns, backfills, data\-quality monitoring, and production incident response. * Experience migrating data platforms or containerized workloads from AWS to Azure, including Azure App Service, Key Vault, Blob Storage, Private Link, or Azure DevOps Pipelines. * Experience with forecasting, What\-If/scenario modeling, financial or reward calculations, semantic models, or customer\-specific analytics products. * Experience with Go/Golang, OIDC/SAML/RBAC, Cognito or enterprise identity integrations, Sigma, or Snowflake\-native analytics capabilities. **What You Bring — Professional Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, data science, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. * Professional certifications in Snowflake, dbt, AWS, Azure, or Terraform are helpful but not required. * Clear written and verbal communication, sound judgment under operational pressure, and the ability to make complex technical tradeoffs understandable. **How to Be a Medisolver — Our Values** * Customer Success Obsession * All\-Star Team Collaboration * Continuous Improvement through Curiosity \& Data\-Driven Learning * Courage with Kindness * Execution Focus — We Do Business, Not Just Talk Business *Medisolv is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We believe that diversity drives innovation, and we are dedicated to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued and respected.* *All candidates must successfully pass a pre\-employment background check and be legally authorized to work in the United States. Sponsorship is not available. This is a U.S.\-based/onshore role supporting work with regulated and PHI\-sensitive healthcare data.*

jobs.title: Data Quality Engineer
jobs.description: The Data Quality and Integration Developer supports the design, development, execution, monitoring, and improvement of enterprise data quality and data integration processes using Informatica Intelligent Data Management Cloud, including Cloud Data Governance and Catalog, Cloud Data Quality, Cloud Data Integration, Data Profiling, Metadata Command Center, and related governance capabilities. This role will operate within the Data Governance department partnering with data stewards, analysts within the line of business, application teams, database administrators, information security, and compliance stakeholders to identify data quality issues, create reusable rules, support data movement and transformation activities, interpret profiling results, publish quality scores, and support trusted data use across the organization. Primary responsibilities may include developing and maintaining rule specifications, dictionaries, scorecards, rule occurrences, profiling tasks, exception outputs, integration mappings, data pipelines, transformation logic, and monitoring processes; associating data quality rules to governed assets and glossary terms; reviewing profiling statistics such as null values, distinct values, patterns, inferred data types, value frequencies, and outliers; troubleshooting profiling, integration, mapping, and rule execution failures; documenting repeatable processes; supporting data quality dashboards; and translating technical findings into clear language for business users and governance stakeholders. **Requirements of Skills:** * Hands\-on experience with data quality, data profiling, data governance, metadata management, or data cataloging tools; Informatica IDMC, CDGC, CDQ, Data Profiling, and Metadata Command Center experience strongly preferred. * Ability to create, configure, test, and maintain data quality rules, rule specifications, dictionaries, scorecards, rule occurrences, and reusable data quality assets. * Strong SQL skills for researching source data, validating profiling results, identifying data anomalies, and supporting root cause analysis. * Experience supporting data integration activities, including data movement, transformation logic, pipeline execution, mapping validation, and integration troubleshooting across source and target systems. * Experience profiling structured data sources such as SQL Server, cloud data warehouses, flat files, or similar platforms to assess completeness, validity, consistency, accuracy, uniqueness, and timeliness. * Ability to interpret profiling statistics, including null counts, distinct and non\-distinct values, inferred data types, patterns, value frequency, lengths, minimum and maximum values, and outliers. * Understanding of how data quality rules connect to governed assets, business terms, technical data elements, classifications, and data quality scores within a governance catalog. * Ability to troubleshoot profiling, rule execution, connection, runtime, permissions, and source configuration issues in partnership with platform, infrastructure, DBA, and application support teams. * Strong documentation skills, including the ability to write repeatable procedures, support guides, requirements, issue summaries, and business\-friendly explanations of technical data quality findings. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and collaboration skills with the ability to work across technical and non\-technical teams. **Preferred Skills:** * Experience with Informatica Cloud Data Quality assets such as cleanse, parse, verifier, deduplicate, labeler, dictionaries, mapplets, mappings, or exception records. * Experience with data governance concepts such as business glossary, data lineage, data classification, critical data elements, policies, stakeholder roles, and governed workflows. * Experience with Microsoft SQL Server, Azure Synapse, Microsoft Fabric, ADLS Gen2, Power BI, Salesforce, Snowflake, Oracle, or similar enterprise data platforms. * Familiarity with Secure Agent, runtime environments, advanced cluster concepts, catalog source configuration, metadata extraction, and data profiling prerequisites. * Experience building dashboards, metrics, KPIs, or reports to monitor data quality trends, exceptions, remediation progress, or governance adoption. * Experience with Informatica Cloud Data Integration, Informatica PowerCenter, or similar ETL/ELT and data integration platforms is a plus. * Experience in a regulated industry such as banking, financial services, healthcare, insurance, or another environment with privacy, security, audit, and compliance obligations. **Requirements of Education and Experience:** * Bachelor’s degree in Data Management, Data Science, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Analytics, Management Information Systems, or a related field preferred. * Equivalent experience in data governance, data quality, data engineering, analytics, records and information management, information governance, or compliance may be considered in lieu of formal education. * Four or more years of experience in data quality, data governance, data profiling, data analysis, data integration, data engineering, reporting, or a related data management discipline preferred; level may be adjusted based on candidate experience. * Experience working with business stakeholders to understand data needs, define quality expectations, validate rules, review exceptions, and communicate results. * Professional development or certification interest in data management, data governance, data integration, information governance, privacy, risk, compliance, or Informatica IDMC/CDQ/CDGC/CDI is preferred.
