jobs.description: **POSITION SUMMARY:** The Electrical Engineering Manager leads the design and delivery of industrial control cabinets and robotic\-cell solutions for the Americas. This working manager translates customer requirements into safe, reliable, manufacturable, and commercially competitive solutions using Mitsubishi Electric automation technologies. The role sets technical direction, develops engineering talent, and drives standardization, cost reduction, quality, and on\-time execution. **The essential functions of the position include, but are not limited to the following:** * Lead the electrical engineering team, setting priorities, resource plans, design practices, and performance measures for industrial control cabinet and robotic\-cell projects. * Own the engineering lifecycle from requirements and concept development through design, verification, release, manufacturing support, commissioning, and continuous improvement. * Ensure designs meet customer requirements, company design controls, and applicable standards, including UL 508A, NFPA 79, NFPA 70 / NEC, IEC 60204\-1, IEC 61131\-3, IEC 61800, ISO 10218, ISO 13849\-1, and IEC 62061\. * Lead design and risk reviews addressing power distribution, SCCR, protection, grounding, thermal management, EMC, machine and robot safety, guarding, communications, maintainability, and lifecycle support. * Partner with Mechanical and Production Engineering to standardize component libraries, cabinet templates, drawing conventions, reusable software, version control, validation practices, layouts, guarding, cable routing, manufacturability, assembly, and serviceability. * Lead cabinet and panel solution costing and drive value engineering through design simplification, standardization, alternate component qualification, and supply continuity. * Manage technical relationships with panel builders, component suppliers, and engineering partners. * Prepare budgets, capacity plans, technical roadmaps, KPI and project reports, and leadership recommendations. * Perform other job\-related duties as assigned. Supervisory / Managerial Responsibilities * As a working manager, plan, assign, direct, and review the work of electrical engineers to meet project commitments. * Recruit, onboard, coach, develop, and retain the team while maintaining role clarity, development plans, succession coverage, and cross\-training. * Set performance expectations; provide feedback, recognition, coaching, and formal evaluations; and balance assignments and capacity based on commitments, risk, business value, and resource availability. Travel Requirements * Travel approximately 20% based on customer and supplier needs. **EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:** * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or Automation Engineering, or equivalent relevant experience with an OEM, system integrator, or panel builder. * At least 5 years of progressive experience designing and delivering industrial control cabinets, controls engineering, or systems integration, including technical or people leadership. * Experience with PLCs, HMIs, industrial robots, VFDs, servo and motion control, industrial networks, machine and robot safety, and electrical control\-panel technologies. * Working knowledge of electrical design practices and applicable control cabinet, machinery, and robotic\-cell safety standards. * Ability to create and review schematics, panel layouts, bills of material, functional specifications, I/O lists, network architectures, sequence\-of\-operation documents, and test procedures. * Experience with electrical CAD/CAE tools, including SolidWorks Electrical preferred, and with document control, revision control, and change management. jobs.title: Customer Success Engineer
jobs.description: Momentic is building the definitive verification layer for software: an AI\-native testing platform that helps engineering teams catch bugs before they ship. As AI accelerates software development, teams need a reliable way to verify that their products work. Engineering teams at Notion, Webflow, Xero and Whatnot use Momentic to ship with confidence. We’re hiring a Customer Success Engineer to own strategic relationships, customer success, and renewal readiness for our enterprise and selected medium\-touch customers. We’re looking for someone who combines technical depth with strong strategic account judgment: you can earn an engineer’s trust, lead a conversation with an executive sponsor, and turn an ambiguous customer problem into a plan that gets delivered. You’ll report to the CEO and work closely with customer engineering organizations, our Solutions Engineers, Sales, and Engineering to help customers realize measurable value from Momentic. From post\-implementation adoption through renewal, you’ll own the account plan, build relationships across the organization, and keep the right people aligned on what success looks like. You’ll keep a clear, current view of each account’s adoption, delivered value, and risks so customers and teammates can make informed decisions. **What you’ll do** ------------------ * Own our most strategic customer relationships. Build trust with executive sponsors, engineering leaders, technical champions, and day\-to\-day users. Understand their priorities and decision\-making process, and keep stakeholders aligned. * Turn adoption into measurable value. Create success plans with clear goals, milestones, and owners. Lead quarterly business reviews and annual planning sessions that connect testing coverage, suite health, and adoption to customer objectives. * Lead technical adoption and customer projects. Translate customer needs into requirements and execution plans. Get hands\-on to identify blockers and guide customers, coordinate with Solutions Engineering and Engineering to resolve issues, and bring actionable customer feedback into the product. * Own renewal readiness and customer risk. Identify changes in usage, engagement, sponsorship, or delivered value early. Lead plans to address risk, demonstrate customer value, and partner with Sales on the commercial renewal process. * Build the tools to run strategic accounts. Connect customer, contract, and product usage data into practical dashboards and workflows. Use AI to automate reporting, surface risks, and identify where to act, so you can spend more time driving customer outcomes. Build scalable workflows for smaller, low\-touch accounts rather than relying on manual account management. **You’re perfect for this role if…** ------------------------------------ * You’ve owned complex strategic accounts for a technical product, built trusted relationships from practitioners to executive sponsors, and delivered customer outcomes through difficult conversations. * You have an engineering background or, at minimum, a computer science degree, with demonstrated hands\-on coding and debugging ability. You can work credibly with engineers and engineering leaders, learn an unfamiliar product, and reason through testing, CI/CD, and adoption challenges. Experience working with developer\-tools customers is strongly preferred. * You’re strategic and numbers\-oriented. You can turn usage and technical results into a business case and account plan, and use that evidence to identify and manage renewal risk. * You’re organized, proactive, and comfortable with ambiguity. You can turn an unclear customer problem into a concrete outcome and lead cross\-functional work without formal authority. * You’ve built CS tooling, dashboards, templates, or operating processes at an early\-stage company. You use AI to build tools and automate workflows that improve account analysis, reporting, and customer management, and apply sound judgment to the outputs. * You’re based in San Francisco or willing to relocate, and can work from our office five days a week. **Nice to haves** ----------------- * Experience with automated testing, observability, or infrastructure. * Experience in forward deployed engineering, developer success engineering, or field engineering. * Consulting experience leading technical projects and managing senior client stakeholders. **About us** ------------ * Raised $18\.7M, including a $15M Series A, with backing from Standard Capital, Y Combinator, FCVC, Transpose Platform, and Dropbox Ventures. * A team of 17 and growing. * Based in San Francisco at 650 5th Street. **Benefits** ------------ * Medical, dental, and vision insurance. * 401(k). * Unlimited PTO and sick days, plus company\-observed US holidays. * Daily lunch and a fully stocked kitchen. * Commuter benefits. * Team offsites and events. Compensation Range: $185K \- $225K

jobs.title: Advanced Quality Engineer
jobs.description: **Position Title: Advanced Quality Engineer** **Reports to: Senior Advanced Quality Engineer** **Location: Spartanburg, SC** **People First. Safety is the Foundation.** At Motus, we launch complex automotive products into production environments where failure is not an option. We are preparing for the largest and most complex launch in our company’s history, where execution, precision, and quality will define success—and be highly visible across our organization and customer base. Every launch is a commitment: quality is built into the process through disciplined Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP), not inspected at the end. We are seeking an Advanced Quality Engineer (AQE) with deep experience in new product development (NPD), APQP, and PPAP who thrives in high\-velocity automotive manufacturing environments. This role sits at the center of execution—where engineering, manufacturing, supplier quality, and customer requirements (CSR) converge. This is not a support role. This is a launch ownership role. If you are energized by accountability, cross\-functional leadership, and solving problems before they impact the customer, this is where you will stand out. **What You’ll Own** As the Advanced Quality Engineer (APQP Lead), you will own end\-to\-end quality execution from concept through Start of Production (SOP)—ensuring compliance with IATF 16949, ISO 9001, and customer\-specific requirements (CSR). You are accountable for launch readiness, PPAP success, and zero\-surprise execution. You will: * Own APQP execution across all phases of new product development (NPD) * Serve as the primary quality interface with customers (OEMs) and suppliers (Tier 1 / Tier 2\) * Drive PPAP readiness, submission, and approval (Level 3 / Level 5\) * Lead development and validation of DFMEA, PFMEA, Process Flow Diagrams, and Control Plans * Ensure AIAG Core Tools are applied with rigor—not as a checkbox exercise **What Success Looks Like** * First\-pass PPAP approvals—no rework, no surprises * Flawless launch execution with no late\-stage quality escapes * All APQP deliverables complete and validated prior to SOP * Suppliers that are truly capable—not just document\-ready * Strong confidence from customers and internal leadership **How You’ll Make an Impact** In a high\-pressure, high\-visibility launch environment, you will: * Lead production buyoffs, Run at Rate, and PSO (Process Sign\-Off) with customers * Drive root cause analysis (RCA) using 8D, 5 Whys, and structured problem solving * Own corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) and eliminate repeat issues * Ensure MSA, Gage R\&R, and fixture validation are completed and capable * Apply SPC and capability analysis (Cp, Cpk, Pp, Ppk) to validate process performance * Partner with manufacturing and engineering to identify and eliminate risk before SOP * Drive supplier APQP and PPAP readiness, holding the supply base accountable * Act as escalation point for quality issues, customer concerns, and CSR requirements **What You Bring (Required Minimum Skills / Experience):** * Bachelor’s degree in engineering, manufacturing, or related field * 3\+ years of experience in automotive quality engineering / manufacturing quality * Proven ownership of: + APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) + PPAP (Production Part Approval Process) + AIAG Core Tools (FMEA, Control Plan, SPC, MSA) * Strong working knowledge of IATF 16949 and ISO 9001 QMS * Experience with: + SPC (Statistical Process Control) + MSA / Gage R\&R + Capability analysis (Cp, Cpk, Pp, Ppk) * Proficiency in GD\&T and blueprint interpretation * Demonstrated success leading 8D problem solving and root cause analysis (RCA) * Ability to manage multiple NPD / launch programs simultaneously * Strong communication skills with customers, suppliers, and cross\-functional teams * Willingness to travel up to 20% **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience in automotive Tier 1 / Tier 2 manufacturing environments * Familiarity with OEM requirements (BMW, Ford, GM, Stellantis, etc.) * Experience with customer portals, CSRs, and launch systems * Certification in IATF 16949 or Certified Quality Engineer (CQE) **Why This Role Matters** This is a launch\-critical Advanced Quality Engineering role, not a maintenance or audit position. Your work directly determines whether programs: * Launch on time * Meet customer expectations * Perform in the field You won’t be measured by activity; you’ll be measured by outcomes. When you own the launch, quality follows. And in this role**,** failure is not an option. **\#AdvancedQualityEngineer \#AutomotiveQuality \#Tier1Supplier \#APQP \#PPAP \#FMEA \#IATF16949 \#8D \#RootCauseAnalysis \#NewProductIntroduction \#ManufacturingQuality \#HiringNow \#MotusIntegrated** **Who We Are** Motus Integrated Technologies is a dynamic global leader in manufacturing high\-quality headliners, and interior trim solution products for the automotive industry. Headquartered in Holland, Michigan, Motus operates advanced manufacturing facilities across North America (U.S. and Mexico) and maintains a global presence with 5 locations. Motus is part of the Atlas Holdings portfolio, an industrial holding company based in Greenwich, Connecticut. Motus offers a vibrant working environment where innovation and forward\-thinking are at the forefront of what we do. If you are eager to contribute to our legacy and drive meaningful change, we would love to hear from you! Motus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. **Notice to Agency and Search Firm Representatives**: Please note that Motus is not accepting unsolicited resumes from agencies/search firms for this role. Resumes submitted to a Motus Team Member by a third\-party agency without a valid written \& signed search agreement between Motus and said third\-party agency, will become sole property of Motus. jobs.title: Senior ASIC Timing Engineer, DFT
jobs.description: NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Senior Software Engineer, Records Platform (T3\)** **About Neumo** Neumo builds the cloud software that powers government. More than 4,500 state, local and federal agencies across North America run on our platforms, processing over 900 million transactions and collecting $44 billion in revenue for the communities they serve. When a county records a deed, a family orders a birth certificate, or a business files a local tax return, that transaction often runs through our systems. That comes with a particular kind of engineering responsibility. Our platforms are systems of record for legally binding documents and public funds. Correctness is not negotiable, downtime has civic consequences, and the data we hold is expected to remain accurate and retrievable for decades. **Summary** The Senior Software Engineer designs, builds and maintains features for Neumo’s Records platform (Land Records, Vital Records and Search). County recorders and clerks use it to record deeds, index documents, issue certified birth, death and marriage certificates, and give the public secure access to records that go back generations. Every recorded document has legal weight, so correctness, security and reliability are essential. Records is a key area of investment for Neumo. We are evolving it from a tightly coupled, manually configured platform that depends on specific peripherals into a best\-in\-class product that meets customers where they are. Positioned between the Software Engineer and Staff Engineer roles, the Senior Software Engineer owns features from design through production and makes sound technical decisions within their area. They raise code quality on the team and help newer engineers grow. This role requires strong skills in .NET, SQL Server and cloud technologies, plus the judgment to work effectively in Neumo’s AI\-assisted, agentic delivery model. The Senior Software Engineer reports to a Software Engineering Manager on the Records platform. **Duties and Responsibilities** * Design, build, test and maintain features within the Records platform, such as eRecording and eSubmission, automated indexing, search, certified copy requests, property fraud alerts, and ID verification and payment integrations. * Contribute to platform modernization by decoupling tightly coupled components, replacing manual configuration with configurable, self\-service setup, and reducing dependencies on specific peripherals. * Take on meaningful parts of our modernization work, resolving compatibility issues and validating changes. * Build self\-service configurable features that support each jurisdiction’s statutes, workflows and level of digital maturity without custom code. * Develop and tune search features, including indexing, relevance and query performance, for large volumes of recorded documents. * Support customer migrations by building and testing data migration tooling, with a focus on data accuracy and record integrity. * Work from approved specifications in Neumo’s agentic delivery model. Use AI agents to draft code and tests, then review, correct and own what ships. * Conduct thorough code reviews, including reviews of AI\-generated code, and hold a high bar for correctness, maintainability and test coverage. * Troubleshoot and resolve complex production issues related to performance, reliability and data quality, and take part in on\-call rotations and post\-incident reviews. * Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, automated testing and monitoring to support reliable, repeatable releases. * Participate in sprint planning and backlog refinement. Give realistic estimates and raise risks early. * Document key design decisions and platform knowledge, and share expertise through pairing and walkthroughs so critical knowledge doesn’t live with one person. * Mentor Software Engineers and newer team members on coding practices, debugging, testing and how the Records platform works. * Partner with product managers, QA, architects, Staff and Principal Engineers, and implementation teams to clarify requirements and keep designs consistent with Neumo’s platform direction. * Build on Neumo’s shared enterprise services, such as identity and access, payments, notifications, reporting and search, instead of rebuilding them within Records. * Follow secure development practices, including vulnerability scanning, secrets management and access control, in line with the frameworks our government customers require. **Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience. * 5\+ years of experience in full\-stack development and cloud software, with a focus on Microsoft technologies. * Advanced coding skills in .NET, including both .NET Framework and modern .NET. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Staff Software Engineer, Records Platform** **About Neumo** Neumo builds the cloud software that powers government. More than 4,500 state, local and federal agencies across North America run on our platforms, processing over 900 million transactions and collecting $44 billion in revenue for the communities they serve. When a county records a deed, a family orders a birth certificate, or a business files a local tax return, that transaction often runs through our systems. That comes with a particular kind of engineering responsibility. Our platforms are systems of record for legally binding documents and public funds. Correctness is not negotiable, downtime has civic consequences, and the data we hold is expected to remain accurate and retrievable for decades. **Summary** The Staff Software Engineer is the technical lead for key projects on Neumo’s Records platform (Land Records, Vital Records and Search). County recorders and clerks use Records to record deeds, index documents, issue certified birth, death and marriage certificates, and give the public secure access to records that go back generations. Every recorded document has legal weight, so correctness, security and reliability are essential. Records is a key area of investment for Neumo. We are evolving it from a tightly coupled, manually configured platform that depends on specific peripherals into a best\-in\-class product that meets customers where they are. The Staff Engineer designs and builds scalable solutions, guides project\-level technical decisions, and sets the technical standards the team works to. This role requires deep expertise in cloud\-based micro service architecture and technology. It also requires leadership skills: influencing team decisions, championing quality and mentoring Senior Engineers, many of whom work alongside newer team members. The Staff Engineer reports to a Software Engineering Manager on the Records platform. The manager leads people and delivery, and the Staff Engineer leads on technical depth and direction. **Duties and Responsibilities** * Serve as technical lead on key Records projects. Work with cross\-functional teams to gather requirements, shape solutions and guide implementation from design through production. * Design, build and maintain advanced features within the Records platform, such as eRecording and eSubmission, automated indexing, search, certified copy requests, property fraud alerts, and ID verification and payment integrations. * Provide technical direction for the broader modernization. That includes decoupling tightly coupled components, replacing manual configuration with configurable, self\-service setup, and removing dependencies on specific peripherals. * Design for configurability across jurisdictions, so the platform fits each county’s statutes, workflows and level of digital maturity without custom code. * Own the technical direction for Records search, including indexing strategy, relevance, query performance and scaling for large volumes of recorded documents. * Design data migration approaches that move customers and their historical records onto the modern platform with full data accuracy and record integrity. * Partner with Senior Engineers, product, architects and leadership to create, refine and document technical standards, including standards for search and related infrastructure. * Write and maintain architecture decision records so the reasons behind key choices outlast any one person. * Set the code review and quality bar for the team, including review standards and test strategies for AI\-generated code under Neumo’s agentic delivery model. * Help the team work well from approved specifications. Write precise specs, show how to direct AI agents effectively, and make sure engineers own what ships. * Conduct thorough code reviews, troubleshoot complex issues, and resolve hard performance, reliability and data quality problems. * Lead the technical response to serious production incidents, and make sure post\-incident follow\-up actually improves the platform. * Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure\-as\-code, automated testing and observability to support reliable, repeatable releases. * Mentor Senior Engineers on design, code quality and development standards, and help them grow into technical leaders. * Reduce key\-person risk by documenting platform knowledge and spreading expertise through pairing, design reviews and walkthroughs. * Build on Neumo’s shared enterprise services, such as identity and access, payments, notifications, reporting and search, instead of rebuilding them within Records. Partner with Platform Engineering where Records needs something new. * Embed secure development practices, including vulnerability scanning, secrets management and access control, in line with the frameworks our government customers require. * Stay current with emerging technologies in search, cloud and AI\-assisted engineering. Run small, deliberate experiments and br ooks Like** *First 30 days.* You understand the Records monolith: its main domains, where they’re tightly coupled, and which customers and workflows depend on each. You’ve mapped how the platform talks to printers, scanners and other peripherals today, and where those dependencies are hard\-coded. You’ve walked through the current UI with staff and public users to see where the experience breaks down. You know where manual configuration slows down onboarding and support. You’ve built working relationships with your manager, product, architects and the engineers on the team, and you’ve seen the agentic delivery flow end to end. *By 60 days.* You’ve proposed a domain\-by\-domain modernization plan that ranks domains by customer value, risk and coupling, and names the first domain to pull out of the monolith. You’ve written architecture decision records for the key patterns: * **Service boundaries and APIs.** * **Data ownership.** When to use specific databases. * **A peripheral abstraction layer.** This lets the platform work with any standard printer or scanner rather than specific models. * **The modern React UI approach.** Including a shared component library and accessibility standards. You’ve also outlined the design for self\-service configuration, so customers and implementation teams can set up workflows, fees and document types without engineering help. Code review and testing standards, including for AI\-generated code, are documented and in use. *By 90 days.* The first domain is being extracted from the monolith and is close to production, with data migration and rollback plans in place. A working proof of concept shows the platform using standard printer and scanner protocols on at least two device types it couldn’t use before. The first modern UI screens are built on the shared component library and validated with real users. Senior Engineers are leading parts of this work with your guidance, and the full modernization has a clear technical path. *By the end of year one.* * **Domains.** Several domains run as independent services, with a published roadmap for the rest of the monolith. * **Peripherals.** The platform is peripheral\-agnostic in production. New customers can use their existing printers and scanners without custom work, and hardware\-related support tickets are going down. * **UI.** Key staff and public workflows run on the modern UI, with measurably better usability, accessibility and task completion times. * **Self\-service.** Customers can configure common settings themselves, which shortens onboarding and reduces requests to engineering. * **Upgrade and search.** The .NET upgrade is complete, and search performance and data migration quality have measurably improved. * **Team.** Senior Engineers are visibly stronger technical leaders, and modernization standards are being used as the model across Records. **Neumo Summary** With the backing of four decades of public sector expertise and corporate capability, Neumo has successfully supported government services. Neumo was honored and recognized for four (4\) consecutive years as a GovTech 100 Company representing the top 100 companies focused on making a difference in and selling to state and local government agencies across the United States. Neumo is committed to helping communities thrive and brings a wealth of experience combined with innovation. Today, Neumo offers more administrative and financial support to government officials than any other organization. And with a responsive, client\-focused approach, we foster partnerships that give our customers the certainty they need to accomplish more. Neumo offers a competitive benefits and compensation package and are looking for team members who will thrive in our dynamic environment. Neumo is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Selection for a position will be made without regard to race, religion, national origin, sex, political affiliation, marital status, non\-disqualifying physical handicap, and age.

jobs.description: **About Norm Ai** Norm Ai, the agentic law company, has a client base with a combined $30 trillion in assets under management. Norm Ai pioneered Legal Engineering, the process that empowers lawyers to build and supervise domain\-specific AI agents with Norm’s proprietary suite of no\-code software tools. Norm Ai technology is deployed inside many of the largest and most consequential institutions in the world. Norm Ai is also the technology behind Norm Law, LLP, a separate but affiliated AI\-native law firm built for the era of agentic AI. Norm Law’s attorneys advise leading institutions across private funds, private equity, venture capital, real estate, registered funds, and financial regulation, using the same legal intelligence platform that powers Norm Ai’s products. **AI Fluency:** Norm Ai prefers all team members to be fluent in AI. Successful candidates actively use AI in their day\-to\-day work to support thinking, creation, and problem\-solving. They use it to improve the quality and speed of their work and to continuously refine how work gets done end\-to\-end. Candidates should be prepared to demonstrate and discuss their AI usage throughout the interview process, including concrete examples of tools, workflows, and outcomes. We look for practical, hands\-on experience, not theoretical familiarity. **This Role:** -------------- We’re hiring AI Security Engineers to build automated, AI\-driven systems that find, prioritize, and fix security weaknesses faster than attackers can exploit them. You’ll work across the full lifecycle, from discovery and threat modeling through remediation and response, and go deep in either offensive research or defensive operations based on your strengths. You’ll report to the Chief Security Officer and work closely with Engineering. **What You’ll Do:** ------------------- ### **Across the Role** * **Build defensive automation:** Design, build, and improve AI\-driven security tooling, with the testing, safeguards, and human oversight you’d expect of production systems. * **Threat\-model:** Assess new and existing systems for risk, and use those models to decide where detection and remediation effort goes. * **Respond to incidents:** Join the response rotation for critical vulnerabilities and security events, from assessing exposure through remediation. * **Measure and communicate:** Track how well our security work is performing, and explain risks and tradeoffs clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences. ### **Research Focus** * **Find unknown weaknesses:** Proactively hunt for previously unknown weaknesses using both automated and manual techniques, in a safe and controlled way. * **Validate findings:** Confirm and reproduce findings, and feed what you learn back into the automation to make it better. ### **Operations Focus** * **Run vulnerability management at scale:** Triage, prioritize, and remediate vulnerabilities, automating as much of the process as you can. * **Turn threat information into priorities:** Bring threat intelligence and external advisories into decisions about what gets fixed first. **What We’re Looking For:** --------------------------- ### **Core Qualifications** * Strong software engineering skills, with production code in at least one modern language * Hands\-on experience building with LLMs or AI agents * Solid application security and cloud security fundamentals * Experience running threat models * Calm, structured judgment during incidents ### **Deep Expertise in at Least One Area** * **Research:** Vulnerability research, offensive security or red teaming, exploit development, CVE credits, or bug bounty work * **Operations:** Vulnerability management at scale, detection and response, security automation, or software supply\-chain security ### **Nice to Haves** * Threat intelligence experience * Experience in highly regulated industries * Experience securing multi\-tenant SaaS **Compensation and Benefits:** ------------------------------ **Base Salary**: $155,000 to $215,000 per year The range displayed in this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salary for this position. Within the range, individual pay is determined by various factors, including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. **Equity:** Included **Benefits:** 401(k) with employer match, health, dental, vision coverage, unlimited paid time off, free lunch in office daily, employee referral bonus program **Relocation:** Financial support to ease your move to New York City, designed to make the transition smooth and stress\-free. **Location / Office Requirement:** Washington, DC (preferred), New York City **Work model:** Hybrid **Travel expectation:** Travel to NYC headquarters at least once per quarter To learn more about Norm Ai, visit our **website**.

In addition, you will lead the suppliers and guide the design of the roof mechanisms components, achieving compliance to requirements (SDS, Design Rules, and Regulatory), managing attributes (package, design feasibility, NVH, water management, craftsmanship, crash safety) as well as the manufacturing assembly requirements at the assembly plant(s). An individual in this position will work on Roof Mechanism Systems, which includes Moonroofs, Convertibles, and some moveable Backlites. Relevant experience here would include automotive body exterior mechanisms development, glass/glazing, and manufacturing/quality controlsmethods. **Skills Required:** Product Development, Product Design, Microsoft PowerPoint, CAD, Mechanical Engineering 1\. Product Development \- Led a development of a part or mechanism where they had to work with an consider all aspects from manufacturing, metrology, quality, customer requirements, and costing. 2\. Product Design \- Has led creation of drawings and 3D data considering tolerance analyses and function driven GD\&T. 3\. Microsoft PowerPoint \- ability to create clear and concise slides with summariestake\-aways using both words and visual aids. 4\. CAD \- ability to open, cut sections, and measure 3D parts/assemblies. Even better if they can create CAD files from scratch. 5\. Mechanical Engineering \- ability to lead design based on attribute driven analysis such as calculations, requirements, CAE's, customer usage considerations; and applying engineering principlestools including DFMEA's, problem resolutionroot cause analyses (5/8D, 3x5why, red\-X, fishbone, GDMA, 6\-sigma), **Skills Preferred:** PFMEA , Statistics, PPAP, Statistical Process Controls 1\. PFMEA \- Created, reviewed and/or signed off any PFMEA's in prior roles. Experience with evaluating failure modes related to manufacturing processes 2\. Statistics \- Understands basic reliability and confidence modeling, has applied distribution models and calculations when analyzing data. 3\. PPAP \- Understand the elements of the PPAP process. 4\. Statistical Process Controls \- Understands and can interpret process capability sixpacks. **Experience Required:** Bachelor's degree or higher in mechanical engineering or a related field. 2\+ years of engineering experience in design, development, or launch of automotive mechanisms. Can include experience from internships and coursework. CAD Capable (such as CATIA, 3DX, Teamcenter)familiarity with CAE tools and software. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple issues effectively and efficiently. Demonstrated ability to show initiative and prioritize workload. Ability to travel domestical and international. Proficient in MS Office apps such as Excel, Word, and Power Point. **Experience Preferred:** Experience in design and release of roof system related mechanism applications. Software literacy and mechatronics experience. Strong understanding of statistical analysis. 8D and 5Why corrective action and problem\-solving skills. Experience with DFMEA's, PFMEA's, and SCCAF's Knowledgeable in the Phased PPAP process Detailed understanding of materials, manufacturing technologies, and GD\&T Ability to work in a fluid environment when overall vehicle targets, size, appearance, and manufacturing location are not always known. Ability to solve complex system issues and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists. Effective oral and written communication skills. Ability to adapt your role to a variety of applications and issues as required. **Education Required:** Bachelor's Degree **Additional Information:** \*\*\*FULLY ONSITE / 5 days per week\*\*\* On\-site position leading roof systems suppliers to meet program cost, weight, quality, performance, and timing targets. Apply GPDS knowledge to build on\-time delivery plans. Collaborate cross\-functionally to deliver a robust vehicle\-level system, validating all roof component interfaces. Prepare and present technical presentations for peer and management reviews. Perform and/or review technical analyses, including GD\&T stackups, CAE, and dynamic simulations, and sign off on results. Participate in Technical Design Reviews. Release and update parts in FEDEBOM and WERS through the product lifecycle. Review and sign off CAD in Teamcenter, documenting compliance with design rules and requirements. Develop DFMEAs, SCCAF, Boundary Diagrams, P\-Diagrams, and DVP\&Rs, leading design reviews based on Failure Mode Avoidance. Develop ESOWs and Engineering Concepts, and support Sourcing (SOBA, ED\&T, piece cost and tooling reviews). Identify validation, durability, and functional tests per SDS/ES (DVP/FEDE). Drive root cause analysis (8D, 3x5Why) and implement corrective actions, applying Six Sigma principles. Define and verify part\-level prototype requirements. Support parts sign\-off at assembly plants and resolve quality issues at all milestones. Assess PDL revision impacts and respond accordingly. Support STA via the Supplier Engagement Process, applying One OEM Behaviors. Travel to supplier and North America plant sites as required.

jobs.title: Network Support Technician
jobs.description: Job description POSITION DESCRIPTION Network Technician Department: Information Technology \| FLSA Classification: Non\-Exempt \| Employment Type: Full\-Time POSITION SUMMARY We are looking for experienced L1 OR L2 Network Technicians to provide Level 2 network support, troubleshoot connectivity issues, and maintain enterprise network infrastructure. The ideal candidate will have hands\-on experience with network hardware, LAN/WAN, routing and switching, and incident management. Key Responsibilities Provide Level 1 or 2 technical support for network\-related incidents and service requests. Troubleshoot LAN, WAN, Wi\-Fi, and network connectivity issues. Diagnose and resolve issues involving routers, switches, firewalls, access points, and network cabling. Perform network device configuration, installation, replacement, and basic maintenance. Troubleshoot TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLAN, routing, and switching issues. Monitor network performance and identify potential connectivity or hardware failures. Escalate complex issues to L3 engineers or specialized network teams when required. Work with vendors, service providers, and internal IT teams to resolve network incidents. Maintain accurate incident records, technical documentation, and network configuration details. Follow change management procedures, security policies, and established troubleshooting processes. Support network upgrades, equipment refreshes, and infrastructure deployment activities as assigned. Provide timely updates to stakeholders and ensure incidents are resolved within SLA requirements. Required Qualifications 2\+ years of experience in network support, network operations, or a similar technical role. Hands\-on experience with enterprise networking technologies. Strong knowledge of LAN/WAN, TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, and switching. Experience troubleshooting Cisco or other enterprise network equipment. Familiarity with network monitoring and diagnostic tools such as Wireshark, SolarWinds, ping, and traceroute. Experience using ticketing systems and following incident management processes. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and customer service skills. Ability to work independently and collaborate with cross\-functional technical teams. Preferred Qualifications CCNA, CompTIA Network\+, or an equivalent networking certification. Experience supporting large enterprise or manufacturing environments. Familiarity with firewalls, wireless networking, VPNs, and network security fundamentals. Experience with ITIL\-based incident and change management processes. Additional Requirements Must be authorized to work in the United States. Must be able to work at the client\-designated location and schedule. Willingness to participate in after\-hours support or maintenance activities, if required. PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS AND WORK ENVIRONMENT The demands below are representative of those required to perform this role's essential functions. Reasonable accommodations will be made for qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with the ADA and applicable state law. * Regularly required to sit, stand, walk, and use hands to operate a computer keyboard and standard office equipment. * Occasionally required to lift and/or move IT equipment weighing up to 50 pounds. * May require bending, kneeling, or crouching to install or service equipment. * Work is performed primarily in a standard office or data center environment with moderate noise levels. * May be required to travel to or work at multiple organizational sites or client locations. EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy and related conditions), gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state, or local law, including Title VII, the ADEA, the ADA, GINA, and USERRA. jobs.title: Optimization Planning Engineer
jobs.description: **Optimization Planning Engineer** **The Opportunity:*** Optimization Planning Engineer at a growth\-oriented downstream energy company. * Competitive salary with a strong comprehensive benefits package. * Opportunity to work in a positive, collaborative, and inclusive work environment. * Career growth and development opportunities within a unique and growing energy company. * Reporting to the Planning and Economics Manager, you will be primarily tasked with creating refinery\-wide operating plans that are safe, feasible, and economically optimized. **Key activities include:*** Serving as the primary interface between commercial group, logistics and refinery operations. Works closely with refinery operations, rail and marine schedulers, and product marketers to manage daily issues relating to tank movements, rail and marine movements, feedstock imports and product sales. * Develops and optimizes the 90 day run plan and forecast spreadsheet, updates daily by working with crude rail schedulers, and product marketers to incorporate crude and feedstock receipts, sales plans/targets and refinery operating constraints. * Shares weekly inventory projections with headquarters and risk group in Houston. * Communicates crude run plan/actual/forecast and anticipated constraints to refinery leadership and commercial team during weekly Refinery Production Planning meetings. * Performs daily refinery volumetric balance and generates production/consumption and refinery yield reports. * Responsible for generating all refinery gasoline blends and managing gasoline and gasoline blend stock inventories. Works with operations and laboratory to manage gasoline quality and economically optimize blends. * Runs Linear Program to evaluate near\-term refinery operations and help build an economically optimized plan. Communicates plan to refinery and corporate. Develops 3 month plan for Tacoma refinery and headquarters leadership. * Coordinates all refinery LP model changes and updates with the assistance of Haverly and/or outside consultant help as needed. Runs LP Model as needed to evaluate shifts in refinery economics. * Occasionally update crude assays in HCAMS and/or HCOMET (shared responsibility). * Responsible to run and maintain the LP results summary file (Excel using HCAMs / PIMS). This tool is used to generate the crude schedule and yields that form the basis for production, inventory and financial forecast for the Tacoma refinery. * Performs economic analysis on production opportunities and helps monitor unit optimization. * Periodically performs LP backcast analysis for refinery and reports results to leadership. * Engages technical skills to improve spreadsheet tools that are used for economic analysis and blending. Creates new spreadsheet tools as needed. * Job requires some “on call” support for gasoline blending issues, or other operational and logistical issues that may include nights/weekends/holidays. On call responsibilities are shared with Planning and Economics Manager. * Other job duties are required and directed. **Note**: This description is intended to give you a general overview of the position. Additional responsibilities and opportunities may be identified based on current business needs. **Qualifications:*** To meet the basic qualifications for this role, you will have legal authorization to work permanently in the United States for any employer without requiring a visa transfer or visa sponsorship. **Additional qualifications include:*** Bachelor’s degree in chemical or mechanical engineering preferred. * Minimum three years of oil refining/petrochemical experience in Process Engineering or Operations required. * Minimum five years of oil refining experience, especially in Planning and Economics, Operations, Lab, and Process Engineering preferred. * Experience running an LP (Haverly GRTMPS or PIMS) preferred. * Experience building and maintaining an LP (Haverly GRTMPS or PIMS) preferred. * Experience using Haverly HCAMS to process crude assays preferred. * Must also have computer skills including proficiency with Windows and Microsoft Office suite programs, especially Excel. * This position requires organization and communication skills with the ability to handle multiple tasks while meeting deadlines and production requirements. **About Us:** At Par Pacific, we own and operate market\-leading energy and infrastructure businesses in logistically complex markets. We have built a team of downstream industry veterans and subject matter experts to lead our organization with an entrepreneurial spirit and a collaborative, problem solving approach. We bring our diverse strengths and motivation to complex markets where we seek out diamonds in the rough. As a nimble, growing organization, we actively pursue new opportunities with corporate financing know\-how, respond to local market demands, and adapt to changing external environments. **More Good Reasons to Work for Par Pacific:****Unique Culture and RICH Val  nothing ordinary about Par Pacific \- a niche player in the energy space. And there's certainly nothing ordinary about Par Pacific employees. We are driven, hardworking, entrepreneurial\-minded professionals who love to win. Our RICH values describe how we approach our work: Respect for Others, Integrity, Collaborative Innovation, and Heart. If that describes you, you'll fit right in. **Location, Location, Location:** Because Par Pacific operates in some of the most beautiful places throughout the country, our employees get to make these places their home and enrich their lives. The refinery is in the Tideflats of Tacoma, Washington nestled against Commencement Bay and the South Puget Sound with sweeping views of Mt. Rainier. Located between two of America’s trendiest cities: Portland and Seattle, Tacoma offers plenty of indoor and outdoor activities. **Opportunistic Growth Strategy:** At Par Pacific, we look for operations with strong fundamentals and great employees who can move a business forward. Our management team has deep experience in the energy industry, as well as in leading mergers, acquisitions, and integrations of newly acquired companies. **Focused on the Future:** We are an energy company that has recognized the imperative and embraced the opportunity to begin the transition from fossil fuels. We are developing products that help reduce greenhouse gas emissions. **Excellent Compensation and Benefits:** In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a strong comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental and vision insurance, a robust allotment of paid time off, a 401(k) with company match, retirement savings plans, educational reimbursement, and more. Full\-time employees (and their families) are offered medical (with prescription coverage), dental, vision, voluntary critical illness, accident, life/AD\&D insurance, Flexible Spending Account and Employee Assistance Program. Employees can purchase company stock at discounted prices through the Employee Stock Purchase Program. **Hiring Range:** The hiring range for this position is $114,498 to $171,746, plus 15% discretionary bonus. The candidate selected will be placed according to his/her skills and qualifications. **Our Headquarters:** Par Pacific Holdings, Inc., based in Houston, Texas, owns, manages and maintains interests in energy and infrastructure businesses. We are a growing energy company focused on renewable and conventional fuels in the Western United States. Par Pacific also owns 46% of Laramie Energy, LLC, a natural gas production company with operations and assets concentrated in Western Colorado. Our common stock is publicly traded on the NYSE under the trading symbol "PARR". **Our Refineries and Logistics Operations:** We own and operate refineries in Hawaii, Montana, Washington, and Wyoming, with total operating throughput capacity of over 219 Mbpd. Par Pacific owns and operates one of the largest energy networks in Hawaii with 94,000 bpd of operating refining capacity, a logistics system supplying the major islands of the state and 90 retail locations. In the Pacific Northwest and the Rockies, Par Pacific owns and operates 125,000 bpd of combined refining capacity and related multimodal logistics systems. **Our Retail Operations:** We own and operate over 90 retail locations in Hawaii under the Hele and 76 brands and over 30 retail locations in Washington and Idaho under the nomnom brand. **Par Pacific Is an Equal Opportunity Employer:** Par Pacific prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type and affords equal employment opportunities to employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information or any other status protected by applicable law. Note: Par Pacific will not accept calls or unsolicited resumes from third\-party recruiters. All candidates are required to apply through this web posting.

jobs.title: Sr Software Engineer
jobs.description: **The Company** PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy. We operate a global, two\-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third\-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers. We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end\-to\-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross\-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross\-border trade. Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities. **Job Summary:** As a Sr Software Android Engineer on the Venmo Business Profiles team, you will help build the future of commerce on Venmo. You will design and deliver reliable, intuitive mobile experiences that help businesses create profiles, showcase products and services, connect with customers, and grow through Venmo. You will collaborate with product managers, designers, backend engineers, and other mobile engineers to solve complex problems across business onboarding, storefronts, search, social proof, payments, and account management. You will shape technical direction, improve Android architecture, strengthen engineering quality, and mentor other engineers while delivering experiences used by millions of people. This is an opportunity to work on a highly visible product at the intersection of commerce, payments, and social connection. You will help extend Venmo beyond peer to peer payments and make it easier for businesses to participate in the global economy. **Job Description:** **Essential Responsibilities:** * Delivers complete solutions spanning all phases of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) (design, implementation, testing, delivery and operations), based on definitions from more senior roles. * Advises immediate management on project\-level issues * Guides junior engineers * Operates with little day\-to\-day supervision, making technical decisions based on knowledge of internal conventions and industry best practices * Applies knowledge of technical best practices in making decisions **Minimum Qualifications:** * 3\+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience. **Additional Responsibilities \& Preferred Qualifications****:** At Venmo, we are creating a product that people love. We strive to create a delightful user experience while connecting the world and empowering people through payments. We are looking for intellectually curious people who want to be inspired and inspire others to change the world. Engineering is a craft, and at Venmo we want the internals of our software to be as elegant as the end user experience we are designing. We spend our days scaling our infrastructure and building new features to meet and exceed our user’s needs and wants. We teach and learn from one another and push each other to be at our creative and analytical best. As a member of Venmo Engineering, you will act as a subject matter expert. We are looking for technologists with the highest levels of technical talent, programming, and communication skills with a keen desire to deeply understand our product and how to make our systems stronger and more resilient. Come join our team! What you will do Lead engineering efforts and team level processes by defining it and Automation tests. Strong knowledge of common design patterns, algorithms, and object\-oriented programming with expertise in design patterns such as MVC and MVVM. Work Permit and Relocation Prerequisites: Must already possess valid authorization to work in the country where the position is advertised/located. Relocation support will not be provided for this role. **Subsidiary:** Venmo **Travel Percent:** 0 Visa Sponsorship through PayPal is not available for this position now or any time in the future. * The base pay for this role will depend on where you work and the relevant experience and expertise you bring. The expected range of pay for this role by location is: **Primary Location \| Pay Range:** Austin, Texas: ($130,500\.00 \- $193,600\.00 Annually) **Additional Location(s) \| Pay Range:** No other locations are assigned to this requisition currently. Additional compensation for this role may include an annual performance bonus, equity, or other incentive compensation, as applicable. PayPal does not charge candidates any fees for courses, applications, resume reviews, interviews, background checks, or onboarding. When making an application directly, we will never ask you to share passwords, one\-time passcodes (OTP), or verification codes. Any such request is a red flag and likely part of a scam. All communication regarding your application will come from official PayPal email domains. If you suspect fraudulent activity, please report it immediately. To learn more about how to identify and avoid recruitment fraud please visit https://careers.pypl.com/contact\-us. For the majority of employees, PayPal's balanced hybrid work model offers 3 days in the office for effective in\-person collaboration and 2 days at your choice of either the PayPal office or your home workspace, ensuring that you equally have the benefits and conveniences of both locations. **Our Benefits:** At PayPal, we’re committed to building an equitable and inclusive global economy. And we can’t do this without our most important asset\-you. That’s why we offer comprehensive, choice\-based programs, to support all aspects of personal wellbeing—physical, emotional, and financial—delivering meaningful value where it matters most. We strive to create a flexible, balanced work culture with a holistic approach to benefits, including generous paid time off, healthcare coverage for you and your family, and resources to create financial security and support your mental health. **Who We Are:** **Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion** PayPal provides equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. In addition, PayPal will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you are unable to submit an application because of incompatible assistive technology or a disability, please contact us at paypalglobaltalentacquisition@paypal.com. **Belonging at PayPal:** Our employees are central to advancing our mission, and we strive to create an environment where everyone can do their best work with a sense of purpose and belonging. Belonging at PayPal means creating a workplace with a sense of acceptance and security where all employees feel included and valued. We are proud to have a diverse workforce reflective of the merchants, consumers, and communities that we serve, and we continue to take tangible actions to cultivate inclusivity and belonging at PayPal. Any general requests for consideration of your skills, please Join our Talent Community. We know the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates. Please don’t hesitate to apply.

jobs.description: At **PEARCE**, **we've got a career for you!** Pearce is a leading technology\-enabled provider of asset management solutions for mission\-critical electromechanical infrastructure throughout North America. Pearce provides technical maintenance, repair, operations, and engineering services for uninterruptible power supply (UPS) systems, backup power generators, battery energy storage systems (BESS), critical cooling systems, and other electrical and mechanical infrastructure across end markets such as renewable energy, telecom, and data centers. Founded in 1998, Pearce has more than 4,000 employees and 28 locations across the U.S. Pearce is a wholly owned subsidiary of CBRE Group, Inc., the world's largest commercial real estate services and investment firm. To learn more about Pearce visit http://www.pearce\-services.com. **Your Impact** --------------- As an **OSP Engineer III supporting the Frontier program** at Pearce, you will lead complex outside plant (OSP) engineering projects supporting Frontier's fiber and copper telecommunications infrastructure. You will oversee engineering activities from initial design and field validation through permitting, construction readiness, and project closeout. This position requires experience with **Frontier engineering standards, systems, and workflows**, including **Varasset, FROGS, and Infinium**. You will maintain accurate engineering records, manage work orders, develop construction\-ready designs, and ensure compliance with Frontier requirements and industry standards. **Core Responsibilities** ------------------------- ### **OSP Engineering, Design \& Technical Leadership** * Lead engineering activities for Frontier OSP projects involving aerial, underground, buried, conduit, fiber, and copper infrastructure. * Develop engineering designs, construction work prints, splicing diagrams, bills of materials (BOMs), and supporting documentation. * Perform work order engineering for new construction, road moves, relocations, network modifications, and copper\-to\-fiber conversions. * Review existing network facilities and determine engineering requirements for expansions and upgrades. * Conduct route planning, constructability reviews, and design optimization. * Resolve engineering conflicts involving pole attachments, conduit capacity, cable placement, and existing infrastructure. * Provide technical guidance to junior engineers. ### **Frontier Systems \& Engineering Documentation** * Utilize **Varasset, FROGS, and Infinium** to support Frontier engineering workflows, work order management, and project documentation, as applicable. * Create, update, and maintain engineering records within Frontier\-required systems. * Track engineering activities and project milestones through applicable Frontier platforms. * Ensure engineering documentation and work orders are accurate and current. * Troubleshoot documentation discrepancies and coordinate corrections. * Follow Frontier engineering procedures and quality standards. ### **Field Validation, Standards \& Compliance** * Perform and coordinate field surveys for aerial and underground telecommunications facilities. * Evaluate pole conditions, cable routes, conduit availability, and construction feasibility. * Ensure designs comply with **NESC**, Frontier specifications, and applicable regulations. * Identify construction conflicts and recommend engineering solutions. * Review field findings, redlines, and as\-built documentation. * Support field inspections and resolve engineering issues during construction. ### **Permitting, Right\-of\-Way \& Joint Use** * Develop and review engineering documentation for municipal, county, state, and utility permits. * Coordinate right\-of\-way (ROW), easement, and access requirements. * Support pole attachment applications, pole loading analysis, make\-ready engineering, and joint\-use coordination. * Work with utilities, permitting agencies, and construction teams to resolve design conflicts. * Ensure permit documentation aligns with Frontier requirements. ### **Project Tracking, Quality Assurance \& Coordination** * Manage engineering work orders and ensure timely completion of deliverables. * Monitor schedules, project progress, and outstanding action items. * Perform QA/QC reviews of engineering designs, work prints, and system records. * Identify potential engineering delays and documentation issues. * Coordinate with project managers, construction teams, permitting specialists, and Frontier stakeholders. * Maintain accurate project status updates and support project closeout. **Core Experience** ------------------- ### **Required Qualifications** * **OSP Engineering Experience:** Experience engineering aerial, underground, buried, fiber, and copper telecommunications networks. * **Frontier Program Experience:** Experience supporting Frontier engineering projects, work orders, and documentation standards. * **Frontier Systems:** Experience using **Varasset, FROGS, and Infinium** to support engineering workflows and project records. * **Work Order Engineering:** Experience with road moves, relocations, network modifications, and construction work prints. * **Engineering Design:** Ability to develop and review engineering plans, splicing information, and bills of materials. * **Field Engineering:** Experience conducting field verification and reviewing existing telecommunications facilities. * **NESC Knowledge:** Working knowledge of NESC standards and OSP engineering practices. * **Permitting \& Joint Use:** Experience coordinating permits, pole attachments, and make\-ready activities. * **Quality Assurance:** Ability to review engineering documentation for accuracy and compliance. * **Technical Tools:** Proficiency with engineering record systems, Microsoft Office, CAD or comparable applications, and field measurement equipment. * **Project Coordination:** Ability to manage multiple assignments, meet deadlines, and communicate effectively. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience working directly with **Frontier Communications** or a contractor supporting Frontier programs. * Familiarity with Frontier fiber expansion, copper\-to\-fiber conversions, road moves, and network relocations. * Experience with OSP engineering tools such as AutoCAD, IQGeo, Katapult, O\-Calc, or comparable platforms. * Experience performing QA/QC reviews and mentoring junior OSP engineers. * Understanding of aerial and underground construction methods and utility coordination. * Ability to troubleshoot engineering issues and resolve discrepancies between field conditions and client systems. **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- * Deliver accurate, construction\-ready OSP engineering packages that meet Frontier requirements. * Maintain complete and current engineering records in Varasset, FROGS, Infinium, and other applicable systems. * Complete engineering work orders on schedule while meeting quality expectations. * Minimize design revisions, documentation discrepancies, and construction delays. * Build effective relationships with Frontier stakeholders, construction teams, and internal personnel. * Contribute to engineering quality and continuous improvement across the Frontier program. **What We Offer** Pearce offers a family\-friendly and innovative culture with opportunities for growth, competitive compensation, comprehensive health benefits including medical, dental and vision insurance, flexible spending accounts, HSA option. jobs.description: Pivotal is the leader in the emerging market of electric Vertical Takeoff and Landing (eVTOL) aircraft. We design, develop, and manufacture light eVTOL aircraft and are renowned for the BlackFly aircraft the world's first light eVTOL to fly manned missions and enter the consumer market. Efficient, compact, and simple, Pivotal aircraft are designed for a wide range of consumer, public service, and defense applications. Our distinctive tilt\-aircraft architecture and scalable platform have been flying for over 10 years. Last year we announced our next\-generation aircraft, the Helix, which is rapidly progressing toward general release and scalable production in 2026\. Mobility is one of the most highly\-valued areas of modern technology investments. This is the right company, in the right space, the right strategy, at the right time. If you are ready for adventure, we invite you to join our amazing team and grow with us. **About the Job** ----------------- The Battery Engineering team at Pivotal is seeking a hands\-on Battery Test Engineer to own the design and execution of battery performance characterization, thermal\-runaway, abuse, environmental, and durability testing. This engineer will translate system risks and requirements into safe, instrumented, repeatable tests at the cell and pack levels, then convert test results into defensible engineering evidence and actionable design improvements. ### **Responsibilities** * Own test planning and hands\-on execution for lithium\-ion cells and aircraft battery packs. * Plan and execute electrical and thermal performance characterization of cell candidates and prototype packs, including capacity, DCIR, power capability, mission\-profile cycling, and thermal response across temperature. * Operate high\-power battery cyclers, cell cyclers, and environmental chambers, and maintain test profiles, data pipelines, and test\-article configuration records. * Deliver correlation\-ready datasets to the simulation team and support model\-versus\-test comparison. * Design, build, and execute thermal\-runaway initiation, propagation, containment, venting, and mitigation tests, including fabrication of test articles, trigger methods, fixtures, and instrumentation appropriate to test objectives. * Develop environmental and durability tests covering temperature, thermal cycling, altitude or low\-pressure exposure, humidity, vibration, mechanical shock, and transportation conditions as applicable. * Define test objectives, hazards, instrumentation needs, data\-acquisition architecture, trigger logic, sampling rates, acceptance criteria, and stop conditions. * Prepare test articles, fixtures, chambers, power equipment, cooling systems, sensors, high\-speed video, thermal imaging, and data\-acquisition systems. * Lead test readiness reviews, job\-hazard analyses, emergency planning, exclusion\-zone definition, and coordination with EHS, facilities, fire\-safety, and external laboratories. * Execute testing safely, monitor tests in real time, respond to anomalies, and protect personnel, facilities, test assets, and data integrity. * Analyze temperature, voltage, current, pressure, gas, flame, ejecta, and propagation behavior, as applicable to the test objective and facility capability. * Author clear test plans, procedures, reports, nonconformance records, root\-cause assessments, and design recommendations. * Support model correlation and work with design engineers to improve containment, cooling, sensing, venting, and protection strategies. * Manage external test laboratories, including statement\-of\-work development, setup reviews, witnessing, data acceptance, and issue resolution. * Maintain calibrated instrumentation, safe lab practices, test configuration control, data traceability, and lessons learned. * Support transportation and environmental compliance test programs, including UN 38\.3 activities, when applicable to the product and program phase. environmental, abuse, reliability, or aerospace hardware testing experience. * Experience designing instrumented tests and selecting thermocouples, voltage and current measurement, pressure sensing, thermal imaging, and data\-acquisition hardware. * Working knowledge of lithium\-ion battery hazards, high\-voltage safety, stored\-energy hazards, fire risk, and safe test operations. * Experience developing test fixtures, procedures, hazard controls, and technical reports. * Ability to troubleshoot hardware, instrumentation, wiring, communications, and data\-quality issues in the laboratory. * overcharge, external heating, short\-circuit, crush, or penetration testing. * Experience with environmental chambers, vibration systems, thermal cycling, altitude chambers, shock testing, and high\-power battery pack cyclers (e.g., Chroma, etc.) or cell cyclers (e.g., Biologic, Arbin). * Experience with electric aircraft, EV, UAV, aerospace, defense, or other safety\-critical energy systems. * Familiarity with UN 38\.3 and relevant battery or aerospace environmental\-test standards, with the judgment to confirm applicability before defining a compliance plan. * Experience with jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: **Job title:** Site Reliability Engineer **Reports to:** Director, Site Reliability Engineering **Department:** Central Services **Location:** Alpharetta, GA or Remote **Grade:** 19 **About Priority:** Priority Commerce is a leading financial technology company on a mission to deliver a personalized, easy\-to\-adopt financial toolset that accelerates cash flow and optimizes working capital for businesses. Our vision is to eliminate the barriers to unlocking revenue \- empowering businesses to grow faster and operate smarter. We achieve this through the Priority Commerce Engine, an innovative platform that combines payables, acquiring, and banking and treasury solutions. This unified approach allows businesses to streamline financial operations, reduce unnecessary costs, and uncover new revenue opportunities. At Priority Commerce, we're driven by results. We expect our people to ***be known for results*** \- bringing expertise, momentum, and relentless focus to every challenge, helping our clients and each other thrive. **About the Role:** As a Site Reliability Engineer, you will keep Priority's payment, payables and banking platforms available, fast and recoverable. You will be the dedicated SRE for a product workstream: owning its monitoring, alerting and runbooks, taking on\-call, and helping lead incident response and postmortems alongside development teams and Senior SREs. This is a hands\-on role for an engineer with a few years of production experience who wants to grow into owning reliability for a domain end to end. **Responsibilities:*** Build and tune monitoring, dashboards and alerts; reduce alert noise and close detection gaps. * Help resolve production incidents, and lead triage of lower severity alerts. * Facilitate blameless postmortems and drive follow\-up actions to closure. * Define SLIs and SLOs for critical user flows. * Write runbooks and playbooks for AI\-assisted alert triage. * Automate toil through scripting, infrastructure as code and CI/CD improvements. * Support safer releases through readiness reviews, load testing and canary deployments. * Contribute to failover and disaster recovery testing. **What Success Looks Like:*** Delivery \& Execution: You participate in incident response, and manage post incident workflows, ensuring effective postmortems occur within SLA. * Product Quality \& Reliability: Your services have SLOs, actionable alerts and current runbooks. Alert noise trends down, and detection and recovery times improve. * Collaboration \& Knowledge Sharing: Engineers and monitoring teams use your dashboards and runbooks day to day, and postmortems lead to fixes rather than blame. * Business \& Product Impact: Fewer incidents reach customers or affect business operations, and new features ship without losing stability. * Professional Growth: You lead at least one reliability project from design to rollout and are on a clear path toward Senior SRE. **Candidate Requirements:** **Required:*** 3\-5 years of software, systems or DevOps engineering experience, including 2\+ years in SRE or production operations. * Production on\-call experience, including incident response and postmortems. * Hands\-on experience with AWS and Kubernetes. * Experience building monitoring and alerting with modern observability tools. * Proficiency in a scripting or programming language (e.g., Python, Go, TypeScript). * Experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform preferred) and CI/CD pipelines. * Working knowledge of Linux, networking fundamentals and relational databases. * Clear written communication. **Preferred:*** Experience in payments, fintech or banking, especially PCI DSS environments. * Familiarity with Kafka or other event\-driven architectures. * Experience designing SLOs and error budgets. * Experience using AI tools in operations. * Cloud or Kubernetes certifications (e.g., AWS Associate, CKA). **Work Environment \& Culture:** We believe that performance and experience go hand in hand \- *an exceptional employee experience is earned through contribution*. We are a results\-driven team, grounded in our core values: ownership, authenticity, service, trust, innovation, and camaraderie. Our culture is built for those who want to make an impact. We challenge each other to grow, celebrate progress, and support one another through shared goals and real connection. Whether you're building technology, serving clients, or supporting internal teams, you’ll be part of a company that empowers you to perform at your best and be known for results. **Compensation and Benefits:** **Compensation range: \[$111k\-$143k]** We invest in the whole employee \- personally and professionally. Our benefits package is designed to support your well\-being, growth, and success \- both inside and outside of work. **Financial Wellness** * Bonus programs * 401(k) match * Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP) * HSA and FSA options * Financial wellness resources and employee discount programs **Health \& Well\-being** * Medical, dental, and vision coverage * Mental health support for employees and dependents through Lyra Health * Family planning and women’s health benefits through Carrot * Gym membership reimbursement and virtual wellness programs (including yoga) **Time Off** * 3 weeks PTO to start, with unlimited PTO after year one **Growth \& Development** * Education expense reimbursement * Leadership development programs * Certified Payments Professional (CPP) certification support We believe great performance starts with feeling supported \- and we’ve built our benefits with that in mind. **Traditional Physical Requirements:*** Requires prolonged sitting, standing, bending, stooping and stretching. * Requires the ability to lift 10 pounds. * Requires eye\-hand coordination, manual dexterity and a normal range of hearing and vision (with or without correction). Join our team at Priority Technology Holdings, Inc. and be part of a dynamic and innovative company that is transforming the financial technology landscape. Together, we can shape the future of payments and banking solutions while providing unmatched value to our clients.
