jobs.title: Sr. Performance Engineer
jobs.description: **Location: Plano, TX (5 days on\-site)** **Final Inperson interview is required in cleint location: Plano, TX.** **Senior Performance Engineer** **About the Role** The client is seeking an experienced Senior Performance Engineer to join its enterprise applications team. The successful candidate will lead performance engineering for a business\-critical enterprise application suite in preparation for its go\-live at a Client property. The role is responsible for establishing performance baselines, validating that the application scales to production traffic volumes, and confirming that it operates within its sized capacity on production hardware. The application is hosted on Red Hat OpenShift running on on\-premises servers, across both non\-production and production environments. As this infrastructure has fixed capacity, and additional hardware requires significant procurement lead time, accurate measurement and forecasting are central to the position. The Senior Performance Engineer will work independently, conducting their own research and analysis, and will collaborate closely with development, database, platform engineering and vendor teams. **Key Responsibilities** · Establish, measure and maintain performance baselines for each release across API, service and user\-interface scenarios, weighted in proportion to actual usage. · Develop workload models, including transaction volumes, concurrent users, transactions per second and test durations, derived from production traffic data and agreed with business stakeholders and vendors. · Design, develop and maintain performance test scripts using JMeter, Artillery and Playwright, reusing existing test assets where appropriate. · Execute load and endurance tests throughout each release cycle in a dedicated performance environment. · Validate application scalability at and beyond production traffic volumes, assess utilization of CPU, memory, database and storage capacity, and report remaining headroom and capacity limits in time to inform hardware planning. · Analyze test results against baselines, identify regressions promptly, and determine root causes using platform, database and application metrics. · Partner with developers, database administrators and platform engineers to resolve performance issues, including query optimization, resource configuration, runtime tuning and scaling. · Prepare performance reports and present findings and recommendations to support formal release approval. · Work with platform engineering to ensure the performance environment remains representative of production and is managed through GitOps practices. · Identify and coordinate dependencies required for testing, including interface inventories, test accounts, test data and integration stubs. · Prepare and maintain production\-scale, anonymized test data sets. **Qualifications and Experience** · Minimum of seven years of experience in performance engineering or performance testing of enterprise web applications, including leading performance testing for major releases or system go\-lives and presenting capacity findings to senior leadership. · Demonstrated ability to work independently, including researching unfamiliar systems, forming and testing hypotheses, and drawing sound conclusions with minimal direction. · Experience in capacity planning for fixed, on\-premises infrastructure, including sizing workloads to available hardware, extrapolating results from non\-production to production environments, and forecasting future capacity jobs.title: Senior Inference Optimization ML Engineer
jobs.description: At Rhoda AI, we’re building the next generation of generalist intelligent robots. We own the full robotics stack from high\-performance hardware and robot systems to the infrastructure and state\-of\-the\-art foundation world models that control our robots. Our robots are designed to be generalists capable of operating in complex, real\-world environments and handling long\-tail edge cases, made possible by our cutting edge research and end\-to\-end system design. We've raised over $450M and are investing aggressively in model research, infrastructure, hardware development, and manufacturing scale\-up to make generalist robotics a reality. Running large multimodal foundation models for a growing fleet of robots is expensive. We can't rely on one hardware vendor or the most expensive accelerators. We're looking for an Inference Optimization engineer to make Rhoda's models run fast, correctly, and cheaply on a wide range of hardware: AMD Instinct GPUs, Google TPUs, wafer\-scale and dataflow accelerators, consumer GPUs like the RTX 5090, and the Jetson/Thor\-class compute on our robots. You'll decide which chip runs which workload, and then make sure it runs well there. You'll work closely with the research, robotics, and infrastructure teams. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * **Own cost\-efficient inference end\-to\-end.** Make Rhoda's foundation models (vision, video, language, proprioception, action) faster and cheaper to run, measured in latency, throughput, and cost per inference. * **Port and optimize models for non\-NVIDIA and lower\-cost hardware.** This includes AMD (ROCm, HIP, MIOpen/hipBLASLt, Composable Kernel), TPU (XLA, JAX, Pallas, PyTorch/XLA), wafer\-scale and dataflow accelerators (their SDKs and compilers), and consumer Blackwell GPUs such as the RTX 5090 (FP8/FP4, small memory, multi\-GPU setups over PCIe). * **Own on\-robot inference.** Deploy and optimize models on Jetson/Thor\-class embedded compute under tight latency, power, thermal, and memory limits, and decide how work is split between the robot and the cloud to meet real\-time control requirements. * **Evaluate hardware rigorously.** Build cost/performance models (perf/$, perf/W, memory capacity and bandwidth, interconnect) for each chip and model family. Write clear recommendations on which hardware to buy or rent for serving, offline evaluation, and on\-robot use. * **Build hardware\-portable optimizations.** Write and tune kernels that work across vendors where possible (Triton, Pallas, MLIR\-based compilers) and vendor\-specific ones where the speedup justifies it. Handle attention, KV cache, memory layout, and fused operators on every backend. * **Apply model compression for constrained hardware.** Use quantization (INT8, FP8, FP4/MX formats, AWQ/GPTQ), pruning, distillation, and model or tensor parallelism so models fit and perform well on chips with less memory or limited data\-type support. * **Keep results correct and consistent across backends.** Build tests that check numerical parity, policy quality, and robot\-relevant behaviour, so a model gives the same results whichever chip it runs on. * **Build benchmarking and regression infrastructure across hardware.** Track latency baselines, throughput curves, and cost per inference for every model version on every target, with automated detection of regressions. * **Work with research engineers** to design models that stay efficient and portable from the start, for example by avoiding operators that only exist on one vendor's hardware. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * 2\+ years of experience in inference optimization, ML systems, ML compilers, or a closely related field. * Deep hands\-on experience with PyTorch. * Strong understanding of compute, memory bandwidth, memory capacity, and interconnect bottlenecks, and how they change from one hardware architecture to another. * Experience with model optimization techniques: quantization (INT8/FP8/FP4, AWQ), distillation, pruning, and compilation (torch.compile, XLA, TensorRT, IREE/MLIR, TVM, or vendor compilers). * Familiarity with inference serving frameworks and their support for different hardware (e.g. vLLM on ROCm/TPU, SGLang, JetStream, Triton Inference Server). * Excellent debugging and measurement skills. You can take "this is slow on chip X" or "this costs too much" and turn it into clear bottlenecks, experiments, and validated improvements. * A high\-ownership, pragmatic mindset. You care about the total cost of a solution, not just peak benchmark numbers. **Nice to Have (But Not Required)** ----------------------------------- * Experience optimizing inference for diffusion models. * Production or deep project experience with **at least one accelerator stack other than NVIDIA datacenter GPUs**: AMD ROCm, Google TPU, wafer\-scale and dataflow accelerators, Groq, Tenstorrent, AWS Trainium/Inferentia, Intel Gaudi, or similar, or serious work deploying on consumer GPUs. * Kernel authoring on more than one backend: HIP or Composable Kernel on AMD, Pallas on TPU, Triton on both NVIDIA and AMD, CUTLASS/CuTe. * Contributions to open\-source ML compilers or hardware backends (PyTorch, OpenXLA, Triton, vLLM, IREE, TVM). * Experience running inference on wafer\-scale systems, TPU pods, or fleets of consumer GPUs. * Hands\-on experience with Jetson/Thor\-class platforms (TensorRT on Jetson, JetPack, DLA, power and thermal profiling). * Experience with multimodal or video model inference (variable\-length sequences, packing/bucketing). * Speculative decoding, continuous batching, disaggregated prefill/decode, or other LLM serving optimizations. * Experience with streaming or low\-latency systems for real\-time robot control. * Experience working with hardware vendors on driver or compiler bugs and early\-access silicon. **Why This Role** ----------------- * **Direct impact on cost and scale.** Every gain in perf/$ you deliver lowers the cost of serving models and evaluating new ones, and of putting capable models on many more robots. * **Strategic influence over hardware.** Your benchmarks and recommendations will directly shape which accelerators Rhoda buys and builds on, in the cloud and on the robot. * **High ownership on a small, elite team.** You'll own the optimization layer that decides how fast and how cheaply our foundation models run in the real world, on every target we use.

Compatible with any camera\-based device, HarmonEyes provides a one\-stop shop to analyze eye\-tracking data, develop models, and deploy solutions to applications at scale with the Theia™ SDK. Backed by 60\+ years of eye\-tracking experience and born from the largest validated eye\-tracking database (14 million unique records), HarmonEyes is used by the world's leading organizations in technology, aviation/automotive, healthcare, and elite performance in military and sports. **Job Description** **Job Description** As a Platform Engineer, you'll build and own the software that takes our ML models from research to production: the Theia SDK that runs real\-time inference at the edge, the APIs and services our customers and partners integrate with, and the cloud infrastructure behind our data and model pipelines. Clean, transform, validate, and analyze large tabular datasets, and build the tooling that lets our ML team explore and work with data efficiently. * **ML Productionization:** Partner with ML engineers to deploy, optimize, and monitor models in production and at the edge, including model conversion, latency and memory optimization, and inference pipelines. **Qualifications** **Qualifications** *Required* * 2–4 years of professional software engineering experience building production systems * Strong Python skills, including packaging and distributing libraries * Working familiarity with C\+\+ (reading, modifying, and building C\+\+ code in a cross\-platform codebase) * Experience designing and building APIs (REST, gRPC, or similar) and backend services * Hands\-on experience with AWS, containers, and CI/CD * Experience working with large tabular datasets in pandas (data cleaning, transformation, aggregation, and performance at scale) * Working familiarity with machine learning: you understand the model lifecycle and have helped deploy or integrate ML models in a product * Strong communication skills and comfort working across engineering and research teams *Nice to Have* * Experience building and shipping SDKs or libraries used by external developers * SQL and database engineering (schema design, query optimization, PostgreSQL or similar) * Kubernetes and infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform or similar) * Frontend experience (React or similar) * Edge or on\-device inference (ONNX Runtime, TensorRT, TFLite, Core ML, or similar) * Python compilation or distribution tooling (Nuitka, Cython, pybind11, or similar) * Exposure to time\-series, sensor, or signal\-processing data * Interest in VR/AR, eye tracking, or human\-computer interaction * 1 year experience in a research setting (developing or working with ML research domains) **Additional Information** **Why Join Us** * Remote role with room to grow into automation, tooling, and AI\-engineering work—not a pure manual\-QA seat * Direct exposure to a novel technical stack: real\-time eye\-tracking, ML pipelines, SDKs, and VR/AR integrations * Tight feedback loop with senior engineering and leadership—the work you ship is felt across the company How to Apply This position reports into the engineering team. jobs.title: Sr Software Engineer I-Observability Platform
jobs.description: Senior Software Engineer I \- Observability Platform Work Model: Onsite, Framingham, Massachusetts Staples is business to business. You’re what binds us together. Our eCommerce team delivers customer\-centric site experiences to position Staples as a digital selling platform of choice. Our team ensures that our mobile, desktop, and app platforms deliver the digital experience that our customers expect. We do this through customer insights, analytics, and testing to build a strong innovation pipeline for the future and to bring products and solutions to market seamlessly. We utilize online merchandising and campaigns executed by both humans and automated tools to convert new and returning website visitors into customers. We work end\-to\-end with our sales, merchandising, finance, logistics and technology teams to provide a world\-class, holistic digital experience, growing profitable results in a fun and rewarding work environment. We are inclusive, customer\-obsessed, and are looking for well\-rounded professionals with strong eCommerce business acumen to join our team Team Summary: The Observability Platform team within Staples Digital Solutions builds and operates the enterprise monitoring and telemetry capabilities that help keep customer\-facing platforms, supply chain systems, and critical business applications reliable, available, and performant. The team partners across engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, infrastructure, security, product, procurement, and technology vendors to improve operational visibility, accelerate issue resolution, and strengthen resilience across distributed and cloud environments. Role Summary: As a Senior Software Engineer I \- Observability Platform, you will serve as a senior technical contributor and subject matter expert for enterprise observability technologies. You will administer, engineer, integrate, and continuously improve infrastructure monitoring, application performance monitoring, digital experience monitoring, and telemetry management solutions. Using advanced technical knowledge and independent judgment, you will solve complex operational challenges, automate platform activities, improve signal quality, manage platform capacity and usage, and help strengthen service reliability and performance across the enterprise. What you’ll be doing: * Administer, configure, maintain, and enhance enterprise infrastructure monitoring, application performance monitoring, digital experience monitoring, and telemetry management platforms. * Lead the technical onboarding of applications, services, infrastructure components, and cloud resources into the enterprise observability ecosystem. * Design monitoring policies, alerting rules, dashboards, telemetry collection, health reporting, and diagnostic capabilities for distributed applications and infrastructure environments. * Develop scripts, automation, infrastructure\-as\-code, and reusable platform capabilities that improve deployment consistency, operational efficiency, and observability coverage. * Integrate observability platforms with IT service management, configuration management databases, incident management systems, CI/CD pipelines, and other enterprise technology tools. * Diagnose and resolve complex platform, performance, availability, telemetry, and integration issues affecting multiple applications, services, or technology teams. * Analyze alerts, telemetry volume, platform usage, licensing consumption, and capacity requirements; recommend improvements to signal quality, scalability, and cost efficiency. * Establish observability standards, implementation patterns, platform documentation, and operational procedures based on technical and industry best practices. * Evaluate emerging technologies and vendor solutions, and lead or guide complex platform upgrades, migrations, integrations, and operational improvement initiatives. * Partner with observability vendors and procurement teams on technical enablement, licensing, contracts, support cases, and renewal requirements. * Mentor less experienced engineers and provide technical direction, design reviews, and solution guidance without direct people\-management responsibility. * What you bring to the table: * Advanced analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to isolate complex performance, availability, platform, and integration issues. * Strong systems thinking and an understanding of dependencies across applications, infrastructure, cloud services, telemetry pipelines, and operational processes. * Initiative and intellectual curiosity to evaluate emerging technologies, challenge inefficient practices, and introduce practical improvements. * Sound judgment when balancing service reliability, operational risk, monitoring coverage, telemetry volume, platform capacity, licensing usage, and cost. * Strong collaboration, communication, and influencing skills, including the ability to explain complex technical concepts to technical and nontechnical audiences. * The ability to manage complex assignments, balance competing priorities, and deliver short\- and mid\-term outcomes with limited oversight. What’s needed\- Basic Qualifications: * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a directly related field. * 7\+ years of progressively complex experience in software engineering, systems engineering, platform engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, infrastructure engineering, or a related technology discipline. * 3\+ years of hands\-on experience administering or engineering an enterprise observability, infrastructure\-monitoring, or application performance monitoring platform, such as Zabbix, New Relic, Dynatrace, Datadog, SolarWinds, or AppDynamics. * 3\+ years of experience configuring monitoring, alerting, dashboards, telemetry collection, health reporting, or diagnostic capabilities for distributed applications or infrastructure environments. * 2\+ years of experience with a scripting, automation, configuration\-management, or infrastructure\-as\-code technology, such as Python, PowerShell, Bash, Terraform, Ansible, or Jenkins. * Experience integrating an observability platform with an ITSM, CMDB, incident\-management, or CI/CD toolchain. * Experience supporting production applications or infrastructure in Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform, Amazon Web Services, or another public\-cloud environment. * Working knowledge of observability platform licensing, cost management, vendor relationships, and contracts. What’s needed\- Preferred Qualifications: * Current certification in New Relic, Zabbix, Dynatrace, Datadog, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, AWS, or a related observability or cloud technology. * 2\+ years of hands\-on experience with OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, synthetic monitoring, digital experience monitoring, or real user monitoring. * 2\+ years of experience integrating or operating ServiceNow, PagerDuty, Jira, Confluence, or comparable enterprise operational tools. * Experience providing technical leadership for an enterprise observability implementation, platform upgrade, migration, or complex integration. * Experience supporting an Agile or SAFe delivery environment for at least one year or through two or more program increments or major releases. * Experience supporting observability capabilities for eCommerce, supply chain, retail, or another large\-scale customer\-facing technology environment. * Experience leveraging artificial intelligence to enhance observability solutions. We Offer: * Inclusive culture with associate\-led Business Resource Groups * 22 days of PTO and Holiday Schedule (7 observed paid holidays \+ 1 floating holiday) * Online and Retail Discounts, Company Match 401(k), Physical and Mental Health Wellness programs, and more! jobs.title: Escalation Technician
jobs.description: **Escalation Technician** **Compensation:** * **$25\.96–$33\.65 an hour**, based on experience and certifications, plus overtime. **Our Hiring Process:** * You will receive an email from us if your application is selected to move forward in our hiring process \- check your SPAM/JUNK! Please no walk\-ins or phone calls. **WE PREVENT TECH RAGE®!** Do you enjoy solving technical problems and helping others with their computer issues? Are you looking to take your IT support career to the next level? We are looking for an **Escalation Technician** to join our growing team. Since 2015, Tech Rage IT has been the managed IT partner for Central Florida businesses in manufacturing, engineering, construction and professional services. We handle managed IT, cybersecurity, Microsoft 365, cloud, backup and VoIP for companies of roughly 25–100 users. Our promise is simple: **We Prevent Tech Rage.** Clients reach a real person, get a fast answer, and know the work is documented and done right. You'll be the technical escalation point on our service desk and the person the technicians turn to when an issue needs deeper technical knowledge or troubleshooting. You'll own complex and recurring issues from start to finish, look for the root cause instead of just fixing the symptom, and help the team get better by sharing what you learn. You'll work closely with the Team Lead to identify technical knowledge gaps and training opportunities, while working with the Service Manager when recurring technical or service issues need broader attention. The role also includes opportunities to take on technical project work as your skills and experience grow. When you own a ticket, you own client communication too. We expect the same level of responsiveness, clear communication and documentation from you that we expect from every technician on the team. This is an in\-office role at our Longwood office. We want you in the room with the team. Now and then, a client issue may need you on\-site in the Central Florida area. You may also take on technical tasks from our project engineers as part of your continued technical growth, but this is not a project ownership role. **As an Escalation Technician, you will be expected to:** * Serve as a technical escalation resource for the Service Desk, helping troubleshoot difficult or time\-consuming issues and showing technicians how to approach similar problems in the future. Set the example for Service Desk standards through accurate, real\-time daily time entries, clear ticket notes, correct ticket status and complete documentation. * Own the escalation queue and resolve validated escalation tickets, including Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, networking, backup and security issues the service desk can't close. * Administer Microsoft 365, Entra ID and Intune across multiple client tenants. * Troubleshoot and maintain client networks: gateways, switches, Wi\-Fi, VLANs, VPN and firewall rules. * Respond to alerts from RMM, backup and disaster recovery, endpoint security and SaaS security monitoring tools. * Proactively verify backups and perform restores when needed. * Support Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS/DHCP, file and print, and Entra Connect sync. * Troubleshoot VoIP phone and end\-user requests. * Coordinate with vendors when issues require vendor support or escalation. * Learn and support client line\-of\-business applications. * Keep clients informed throughout the issue, including progress updates, planned changes and third\-party outage notifications. * Take part in an after\-hours on\-call schedule for client emergencies. * Follow established troubleshooting, escalation and change policies. Make technical changes within those guidelines and seek approval when a change falls outside the established process or carries additional risk. * Find root causes and look for ways to prevent recurring issues rather than repeatedly treating the same symptoms. Turn repeat fixes and useful troubleshooting knowledge into clear documentation so the team can resolve similar issues faster. * Work with the Team Lead to identify individual coaching opportunities and team\-wide training needs based on escalated issues. * Work with the Service Manager when recurring technical issues, service issues or patterns require broader attention or action. * Explain technical issues and solutions clearly and professionally, using language clients and technicians can understand. * Provides coverage for the team lead during periods of absence. * May provide coverage for other technical team members as needed. * Consistently maintain role specific KPI’s/metrics and best practice standards. **REQUIREMENTS:** * 3\+ years in IT support, including at least 2 years at Level 2 or above at an MSP or supporting multiple businesses, with a proficient working knowledge and understanding of: * Microsoft 365 administration: Exchange Online, Entra ID, MFA and Conditional Access, SharePoint/OneDrive/Teams, licensing. * Hands\-on Intune/endpoint management and Windows troubleshooting. * Networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, VPN, firewall rules, wireless. * Active Directory and Windows Server administration. * Core MSP tools: a PSA/ticketing system and an RMM platform. jobs.title: Oracle Data Migration Architect, Oracle Fusion Cloud and PeopleSoft
jobs.description: **Oracle Data Migration Architect, Oracle Fusion Cloud and PeopleSoft** *Working alongside Tessera Labs' Mosaic AI Agents* **Location:** US East Coast **Remote:** Yes **Engagement type:** Full\-time employee or fixed\-term contract (initial 3 to 6 months), full\-time capacity, with possibility of extension **Start date:** Immediate (November) **Engagement model:** Senior on\-site role. Leads the Oracle data conversion for a large US financial services client moving from PeopleSoft and other legacy finance systems to Oracle Fusion Cloud. Works with Tessera Labs' Forward Deployed Engineers, offshore Oracle data conversion consultants and Mosaic AI agents, and is the primary Oracle voice with the client's finance team and its systems integrator. **About Tessera Labs** ====================== Tessera Labs is redefining how enterprises adopt and operationalize Artificial Intelligence. Backed by Foundation Capital and led by a world\-class founding team, we combine deep enterprise ERP expertise with autonomous AI agents to deliver transformation outcomes at a fraction of the traditional time and cost. Our mission is to bring real AI automation to the enterprise, delivering speed, precision, and measurable impact. We operate with extreme ownership, move fast, and hold ourselves to the same rigor as the best traditional system integrators while working at AI\-native speed. **Role Summary** ================ We are seeking a hands\-on Oracle Data Migration Architect to own the architecture and end\-to\-end execution of a multi\-release finance data conversion from PeopleSoft and other legacy systems into Oracle Fusion Cloud. This person is the functional and data authority for the conversion: they speak the language of Oracle Fusion Financials, Procurement and Projects, and they understand PeopleSoft source data well enough to explain what every legacy value becomes in Fusion. This is not a configuration role. Oracle configuration is owned by the client's systems integrator. This role owns the data: mapping, business rules, FBDI load files, mock conversion cycles and reconciliation, with Tessera's platform and AI agents doing the extraction, transformation and loading at scale. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== **1\. Conversion Architecture and Mapping (30%)** ------------------------------------------------- * Own the conversion blueprint across releases: objects in scope, dependencies, load sequence and mock cycle plan, aligned to the client's entry and exit criteria. * Lead source\-to\-target mapping from PeopleSoft and other sources (for example Coda, Advantage, Basware, Clarity, Workday) to Oracle Fusion, including chart of accounts crosswalks and EDMCS hierarchies. * Define business rules, value mappings and data quality rules, and review the mappings and rules drafted by Mosaic AI agents before they are used. * Decide cutover treatment for open items and in\-flight transactions, and the approach for interim\-state and reverse mapping where needed. **2\. FBDI Loads and Reconciliation (30%)** ------------------------------------------- * Own FBDI and HDL template usage per object, and work with the systems integrator on load sequencing, environments and load error resolution. * Run mock conversion cycles end to end and diagnose load failures in Oracle Fusion terms. * Set reconciliation controls (counts, balances, aging, subledger to GL) and drive reconciliation to the client's exit criteria, including 100% reconciliation for Fixed Assets and Projects. * Secure business validation and sign\-off for each release. **3\. Client and Partner Leadership (25%)** ------------------------------------------- * Act as the senior Oracle point of contact on site with the client's finance SMEs, data conversion lead and systems integrator. * Lead mapping reviews, exception decisions and sign\-off sessions, and explain differences in accounting language. * Flag scope, risk and readiness issues early, including source system access, environment readiness and SME availability. **4\. Team and AI Agent Oversight (15%)** ----------------------------------------- * Guide offshore Oracle data conversion consultants and Forward Deployed Engineers on functional data questions. * Act as the final quality gate for AI\-generated mappings, transformations and load files before they reach the client. **Required Qualifications** =========================== * 10\+ years in Oracle ERP, with at least 3 end\-to\-end Oracle Fusion Cloud data conversions or migrations. * Strong functional understanding of Oracle Fusion Financials (GL, AP, AR, Fixed Assets) and working knowledge of Procurement and Projects (PPM). * Hands\-on experience with PeopleSoft Financials data structures as a conversion source. * Deep experience with FBDI (and HDL where relevant), load error resolution and mock conversion cycles. * Proven financial reconciliation experience, including subledger to GL and balance reconciliation with finance users. * Experience working alongside a systems integrator on a large Oracle Cloud program. * Strong SQL for data analysis and validation. * Excellent communication with finance stakeholders and executives. * Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline or equivalent experience. **Preferred Qualifications** ============================ * Experience with Oracle Revenue Management and Billing (ORMB) or EDMCS. * Financial services or asset management industry experience. * Experience with Oracle Fusion Time and Labor or contingent worker data. * Experience working with AI, RPA or automated data conversion tooling. * Oracle Cloud certification in Financials or Implementation. *No third party may recruit, solicit candidates, publish job opportunities, use Tessera Labs' name or branding, or represent that they are acting on behalf of Tessera Labs without prior written authorization. jobs.title: Oracle Financials Solution Architect-Finance to Manage (EBS and Fusion)
jobs.description: **Oracle Financials Solution Architect — Finance to Manage (EBS and Fusion)** ============================================================================= **Center of Excellence \| Working alongside Tessera AI Agents** **Location:** US\-based or near\-shore (Latin America). Both are open, and we will evaluate strong candidates from either. **Remote:** Yes, with travel to customer sites for workshops, pre\-sales meetings and go\-lives as needed. **Experience:** 15\+ years **Employment type:** Full\-time, permanent for US\-based candidates; long\-term contract for near\-shore candidates. **Positions:** 1 **Start date:** Immediate. **Engagement model:** Multi\-engagement solution architect role with a strong pre\-sales component. Approximately 60% delivery across several concurrent Oracle Financials engagements (discovery, design, hands\-on configuration and testing), 25% pre\-sales and client leadership, 15% platform enablement and product input. Works US business hours alongside customers, Oracle module consultants, Forward Deployed Engineers and the Principal Architects. **About Tessera Labs** ---------------------- Tessera is an AI\-native platform for enterprise transformation. The multi\-agent platform delivers governed execution across ERP, CRM, HCM, and finance systems, cutting timelines from years to weeks and costs by more than half. Built on deep expertise across Oracle, SAP, Salesforce, Workday, and other systems of record, Tessera address the scope a system integrator would have traditionally taken up with the speed of execution and efficiency of an AI\-native platform. For decades, enterprises have struggled with fragmented business systems, where migrations have consumed hundreds of millions of dollars, data stayed inconsistent and unreliable, and business processes slowed under manual review. Tessera was founded to change that, for Oracle and every other system enterprises depend on. The name itself — a tessera, a single tile in a mosaic — reflects our mission: unifying the disparate pieces of the enterprise into a coherent whole. Tessera is an AI\-powered, multi\-agent platform that harmonizes systems and lets teams work in plain English. **Role Summary** ---------------- We are looking for an Oracle Financials Solution Architect to own Finance to Manage — General Ledger, Payables, Receivables, Fixed Assets, Cash Management and the close — across several customer engagements at the same time, in both Oracle E\-Business Suite and Oracle Fusion Cloud. You run the discovery, lead the conversations with finance leadership, architect the design, configure it with your own hands and prove it works in testing. This is not a role where the design is handed to someone else to build. Many of our customers are not upgrading from one Oracle version to another. They come from a completely different ERP — PeopleSoft, JD Edwards, NetSuite, SAP ECC, Infor or a home\-grown finance system — and the chart of accounts, subledgers, intercompany and close process have to be redesigned, not migrated. You need to be able to read the legacy finance landscape, understand how the business really closes its books, and translate that into a clean Oracle design. You will also be one of the faces of our Oracle finance capability in front of prospects. You will run discovery calls and demos, shape solutions and estimates, contribute to proposals and statements of work, and stand in front of a CFO or controller to explain how we will get them there. Strong client communication is not a nice\-to\-have in this role; it is half of it. Exposure to Cost Accounting is a strong plus, because many of our customers are manufacturers and distributors where finance and costing cannot be designed apart. You will do this work with Tessera’s AI agents, not instead of them. The platform analyses the legacy configuration and data, drafts process models and fit\-gap, generates configuration and test scripts. What it cannot do is decide how many ledgers a customer really needs, or whether a legacy intercompany process is a requirement or a workaround. That judgment is the role, and every time you exercise it we expect it to go back into the platform. Two outcomes define the job. The first is a finance solution the customer’s controller signs off and closes the books on — reconciled, auditable and simpler than what it replaced. The second is that we win and deliver the next one faster, because what you learned is captured in the platform and in our pre\-sales material rather than in your head. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ ### **1\. Discovery and Solution Architecture (25%)** * Lead finance discovery with the controller, accounting, AP, AR and treasury teams: read the legacy configuration, reports and close checklists, and separate real requirements from habits and workarounds. * Translate the legacy finance model into Oracle — chart of accounts and segment redesign, ledgers (primary, secondary and reporting currencies), le ral Ledger, Payables, Receivables, Fixed Assets and Cash Management in both EBS and Fusion. You configure the system yourself rather than only writing the design. * Strong accounting and enterprise\-structure design: chart of accounts, ledgers and legal entities, Subledger Accounting / Accounting Hub, intercompany, multi\-currency and the period\-end close. * Proven pre\-sales experience on Oracle opportunities: discovery calls, solution demos, orals, estimates, and contributions to proposals, RFP responses and statements of work. * Excellent client communication: able to lead workshops with finance teams, present to a CFO or controller, and hold difficult conversations in a way that keeps the relationship. * Experience leading testing for finance — CRPs, SIT, UAT and mock closes with reconciliation — through to go\-live and the first closes after it. * Proven ability to work on several engagements at once without losing control of any of them. * Proven ability to learn a new AI platform quickly and become the person others ask. You will be expected to reach real fluency in the Tessera platform within your first months. * Excellent verbal and written business English, with strong presentation ability to both business and technical audiences. * Experience working with distributed (onshore, nearshore and offshore) delivery teams, with strong asynchronous communication discipline. * Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. **Who This Role Is Not For** ---------------------------- If your experience is configuring one module to a design someone else agreed, this is not the role — the work here starts with discovery and ends with a closed period. If you are an architect who no longer configures or tests yourself, you will find the hands\-on share of this role uncomfortable. If you have only ever moved customers from one Oracle release to another, you will under\-estimate how much of a different ERP’s finance model has to be understood before it can be replaced. And if you would rather not be in front of prospects, or see pre\-sales as somebody else’s job, this role will not suit you. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Cost Accounting experience in EBS Cost Management or Fusion Cost Management — standard and actual costing, cost elements, receipt accounting, landed cost and the cost\-to\-ledger flow — and exposure to Profitability and Cost Management. * Fusion Revenue Management (ASC 606 / IFRS 15\) and Advanced Collections. * Financial reporting and consolidation: FSG, Financial Reporting Center, Smart View, OTBI, and EPM or close tools such as Oracle FCCS or OneStream. * Migrations specifically from PeopleSoft, JD Edwards or SAP ECC to Oracle Fusion, including chart\-of\-accounts redesign and opening\-balance conversion. * Manufacturing, distribution, retail or financial services industry experience. * A CPA, CA, ACCA or equivalent accounting qualification, or an Oracle Financials certification for EBS or Fusion. * Prior experience partnering with AI, automation or RPA tooling inside an enterprise delivery context. * Spanish, Portuguese or German is a plus but not a must\-have. **First\-Year Measures of Success** ----------------------------------- * Month 1: Fluent in the Tessera platform. Leading finance on at least one engagement and supporting at least one live Oracle pursuit in pre\-sales. * Month 3: Finance design signed off and configuration underway on that engagement, a mock close completed or planned, finance pre\-sales material and estimating inputs in place, and reusable finance content live in the Tessera platform. *No third party may recruit, solicit candidates, publish job opportunities, use Tessera Labs’ name or branding, or represent that they are acting on behalf of Tessera Labs without prior written authorization. Any such activity conducted without explicit written consent is strictly prohibited.* Compensation Range: $200K \- $230K

This is a hands\-on software engineering role focused on applied AI. You'll build with existing models, connect them to our tools and knowledge, and make their outputs useful and trustworthy. We already have AI\-assisted workflows and a shared Claude skill and knowledge system. You'll build on that foundation, making successful workflows easier to reuse and bringing production engineering to the parts that need it. You won't be starting from a blank page, and you won't be limited to maintaining what's already there. **How You'll Make an Impact** ----------------------------- ### **Build agents that do useful work** * Design and ship agents that retrieve information, use tools, and complete multi\-step tasks across our business systems. * Connect workflows across tools such as Slack, Google Workspace, Asana, Shopify, and Klaviyo through APIs, webhooks, and MCP integrations. * Make long\-running workflows dependable with persistent state, retries, duplicate prevention, clear approvals, and recoverable failures. ### **Accelerate creative and growth workflows** * Partner with Creative and Growth to improve the path from customer research and performance insights to briefs, scripts, creative variants, and testable landing pages. * Build workflows that combine brand knowledge, approved product claims, asset libraries, and creative performance data while keeping human review where it matters. * Help teams learn from prior experiments so each new brief or test benefits from what we've already discovered. ### **Make company knowledge and data more useful** * Extend our shared skills, knowledge base, retrieval, and context\-management systems so AI tools can find and use the right source material. * Partner with our data team to connect AI workflows to governed analytics in Metabase and Hex, backed by Snowflake, rather than inventing competing definitions of business metrics. * Use SQL and data validation to investigate issues, verify outputs, and make analytical workflows easier for non\-technical teammates to use. ### **Turn prototypes into reliable products** * Build evaluations using real business tasks. Test accuracy, task completion, tool behavior, failure recovery, latency, and cost before scaling a workflow. * Add monitoring, useful logs, version control, automated tests, and clear documentation. Own failures after launch and fix their causes. * Protect customer and company data, separate brand and account contexts, and preserve human approval for consequential actions. * Choose the simplest approach that works, including ordinary code or deterministic automation when an LLM adds no value. ### **Help the company use AI well** * Work directly with teammates to understand their workflows, ship usable interfaces, and help them adopt what you build. * Create reusable skills and integrations rather than isolated prompts that only their author can operate. * Evaluate new models and tools through practical experiments, then explain what is worth adopting and why. * Measure outcomes such as time saved, adoption, output quality, and faster experiment cycles, not just the number of automations shipped. **We're Excited About Your** ---------------------------- * Experience shipping software that real users depend on, with ownership beyond the initial prototype. * Hands\-on LLM application development using Anthropic, OpenAI, or comparable APIs, including structured outputs, tool calling, retrieval, and multi\-step workflows. * Strong Python or TypeScript skills, sound software design, and comfort working with APIs, authentication, databases, and asynchronous jobs. * Practical understanding of RAG, context management, and MCP. You can explain the tradeoffs and show when a simpler approach is better. * Ability to build evaluations, diagnose unreliable behavior, and improve an AI system using evidence rather than prompt tweaking alone. * Working SQL proficiency and experience validating data against established reporting or warehouse models. * Product judgment and clear communication. You can turn an ambiguous request into a focused solution, explain technical tradeoffs, and work effectively with non\-technical partners. * Curiosity, initiative, and follow\-through. You experiment independently, learn quickly, and take responsibility for whether your work is useful. Experience with Claude Code, Codex, shared agent skills, or agent orchestration platforms such as OpenClaw is a plus. So is experience with ecommerce, consumer subscriptions, creative production, multimodal generation, or analytics tools such as PostHog and Metabase. We don't expect you to have used every tool in our stack. **How You'll Work** ------------------- You'll work on problems with visible business impact, from reducing manual reporting to making creative production and customer research more effective. You'll partner closely with the people doing the work, test with real inputs, and keep improving the system after it ships. We value people who can move quickly without confusing a convincing demo with a dependable product. Bring strong engineering fundamentals, good judgment about where AI helps, and a willingness to get into the details. **In Your Application** ----------------------- Tell us about an AI system you built that people actually use. What problem did it solve, what did you personally build, how did you evaluate it, and what failed along the way? Share a demo, repository, or architecture walkthrough where possible. Please don't include confidential information from another employer. **A Few of Our Perks and Benefits** ----------------------------------- * Competitive compensation and equity. * Health, dental, and vision plans. * HSA, FSA, and pre\-tax commuter benefits. * 401k to help you plan for the future. * Flexible PTO. * Unlimited Thesis nootropics. * A strong emphasis on personal development and promoting from within. * A dog\-friendly office in Flatiron, near Union Square and Madison Square Park. **Our Values** -------------- **Meet Your Potential:** Keep learning, seek honest feedback, and help others grow. **Own Outcomes:** Take responsibility for results, act with urgency, and follow through. **Lead with Science and Data:** Seek the truth through evidence and use it to make better decisions. **Create Exceptional Experiences:** Show up for teammates and customers with care, high standards, and a sense of belonging. **Pay Transparency** -------------------- Our salary ranges reflect competitive compensation for our size and industry and are one part of a total rewards package that includes benefits and equity. The base salary hiring range for this position is $160,000–$200,000\. Final compensation will be based on the candidate's location, skill level, and experience.

jobs.title: Product Quality Engineer
jobs.description: **Product Quality Engineer** Thompson Retractor has an opportunity for a **Product Quality Engineer.** The Quality Engineer is responsible for developing, implementing, and maintaining quality systems and processes that ensure medical devices meet applicable regulatory requirements and customer expectations. This role serves as a key technical resource for inspection planning, measurement system validation, customer complaint management, and regulatory document impact assessments. The Quality Engineer will work cross\-functionally with manufacturing, engineering, and regulatory affairs to uphold compliance with 21 CFR Part 820, ISO 13485:2016, and the EU Medical Device Regulation (EU MDR 2017/745\). Thompson is employee\-owned and vested employees automatically receive company shares. **What you’ll do:** * Develop, author, and maintain internal Quality Inspection Plans (QIPs) for machined components and assemblies, including critical\-to\-quality (CTQ) characteristic identification. * Lead end\-to\-end APQP phases for new program launches, tracking milestones to ensure compliance with customer specifications. Compile and submit complete PPAP packages\- including PFMEA, Control Plans, MSA, and dimensional results—securing on\-time customer sign\-offs. * Collaborate with manufacturing and process engineers to ensure inspection plans reflect current production processes, drawing revisions, and design intent. * Perform initial process studies (SPC) and capability analysis to verify manufacturing process stability prior to customer submission. * Review and interpret engineering drawings, GD\&T (ASME Y14\.5\), material specifications, and customer requirements to establish dimensional and functional acceptance criteria. * Collaborate with the CMM Programmer to capture, document, and maintain Coordinate Measuring Machine (CMM) set\-up plans, including part datum alignment, fixturing requirements, probe configurations, and reference feature sequences. * Translate CMM Programmer inputs into clear, controlled set\-up documentation (work instructions, setup sheets, and visual aids) that inspection personnel can consistently execute on the shop floor. * Serve as the primary Quality point of contact for the intake, processing, and closure of customer complaints in accordance with 21 CFR Part 820\.198 and ISO 13485 Section 8\.2\.2\. * Manage the end\-to\-end complaint lifecycle: receipt and acknowledgment, initial evaluation, complaint investigation, root cause analysis, corrective action, and formal closure. * Collaborate with the Risk Manager and Regulatory Affairs to evaluate each complaint for adverse event and MDR/Vigilance reportability; provide quality investigation findings, device history records, and risk data to support the reportability determination; ensure timely submission of Medical Device Reports (MDRs) to FDA and Vigilance Reports to Notified Bodies / Competent Authorities. * Lead and document formal impact assessments when external regulatory standards, guidance documents, or customer specifications are revised or newly issued. * Review regulatory updates for applicability to current products, processes, quality management system (QMS) procedures, and technical documentation; identify gaps and compliance risks. * Support the update or creation of quality system procedures, work instructions, forms, and technical file content to reflect regulatory changes; ensure document control compliance throughout. * Participate in internal and external audits (FDA inspections, ISO 13485 certification audits, Notified Body audits); prepare audit\-ready documentation and serve as Subject Matter Expert for inspection planning, complaint management, and QMS sections. **This Might Describe You:** * Bachelor’s or equivalence in Science, Engineering, or relative technical field, min. 5 \+ years previous quality / regulatory experience, and basic knowledge of ISO, FDA, and EU standards * Strong working knowledge of 21 CFR Part 820 Quality System Regulation (and awareness of FDA Quality Management System Regulation transition) * Practical experience with ISO 13485:2016 QMS requirements and implementation * Understanding of EU MDR 2017/745 requirements, including UDI, PMS, Vigilance, and Technical File obligations; familiarity with adverse event reportability criteria applied in collaboration with Risk Management and Regulatory Affairs * Familiarity with MDR/Vigilance reporting criteria; ability to support reportability determinations by providing quality data and investigation findings to Risk Manager and Regulatory Affairs * Ability to read and interpret CMM set\-up plans and measurement reports; experience collaborating with CMM Programmers to capture and document set\-up requirements * Experience with quality tools: FMEA, 8D, Control Plans, PPAP/FAI, SPC, MSA/GR\&R * Familiarity with machining processes (CNC milling, turning, grinding) and their quality characteristics To apply, please send your resume to human\_resources@thompsonsurgical.com EEO/AA Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Flexible spending account * Health insurance * Health savings account * Life insurance * Paid time off * Parental leave * Retirement plan * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Member of the Technical Staff, Product Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About Tolmo** --------------- Tolmo is cybersecurity for the age of AI. Coding agents now ship software faster than any human team can review or secure it; 100\+ pull requests per engineer per week is no longer an outlier, and attackers are using the same agents to find and exploit weaknesses in days, not months. The old playbook of quarterly pentests and endless alert queues breaks at this speed. We're building a new security playbook. Tolmo runs a fleet of AI security agents that reason over a live graph of your entire production system (code, CI, cloud, and telemetry) and continuously attack a faithful copy of it like a real adversary. Every finding arrives validated, with its blast radius and a remediation plan that lands in your workflow, ready for a coding agent to fix. Hours to integrate, days to your first validated finding. We've done this before: Tolmo's founders built Sqreen (acquired by Datadog) and led security products that thousands of organizations trusted. We're backed by Accel and Y Combinator and just getting started. **The role** ------------ Security tools have a reputation: dense, noisy, and built for specialists who tolerate them. We think that's a design failure, not a law of nature. As a Software Engineer on Product, you build the surfaces where people meet our agents, and you make them feel fast, clear, and trustworthy. You'll own **Mission Control**, where teams watch a fleet of agents work in real time, and the **findings workflows** that take a validated vulnerability from "what is this?" to "fixed" in as few steps as possible. The work is full\-stack: you'll shape the API and data model as much as the pixels, because a great interface usually starts with the right data underneath it. jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer – AI and Automation (Team Breeze)
jobs.description: **Who Are We?** Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That’s the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it. **Compensation Overview** The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance\-based cash incentive awards. **Salary Range** $142,900\.00 \- $235,800\.00**Target Openings** 1**What Is the Opportunity?** At Travelers, we're building the future of insurance — and Team Breeze is at the center of that work. This role puts you at the intersection of large language models (LLMs), cloud\-native infrastructure, and real business impact. If you've shipped AI agent systems to production and want to do it again at scale, we'd like to talk.**What Will You Do?** * Lead the design, configuration and development of complex, high\-visibility AI applications on Team Breeze with a focus on LLM agents, retrieval pipelines and production reliability. * Design and implement agent orchestration flows using AWS Bedrock AgentCore and/or frameworks such as LangGraph, including tool calling, routing and prompt strategies for Claude models on Bedrock. * Own the retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) pipeline end to end — from document ingestion (SharePoint/LivePublish to S3\), processing and embedding in Databricks, and serving from a vector store via Python retrieval APIs (FastAPI/Haystack) — including evaluation steps that measure retrieval and answer quality before each release. * Architect and build services on AWS using Lambda, API Gateway, S3, CloudFront/Lambda@Edge, Route 53, Secrets Manager/Vault and Bedrock application inference profiles to track and manage cost. * Develop and operate containerized retrieval and evaluation services on Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS), deployed with Helm and ArgoCD, including OpenTelemetry collector integration exporting traces to Dynatrace, S3 and Braintrust. * Implement and maintain infrastructure as code and CI/CD using Terraform (Terraform Enterprise), GitHub Actions and TEP pipelines to deliver reliable, repeatable deployments. * Build and maintain the application layer across Python and TypeScript/Node 24 (Lambda xAPIs) and React 19/Vite for front\-end UI experiences. * Lead investigation and resolution of critical, high\-impact production issues, including debugging across AWS services, Kubernetes workloads, data pipelines and observability tooling. * Provide technical guidance and mentorship to teammates, fostering strong engineering practices around design documentation, testing, evaluations, code reviews and operational readiness. * Continuously apply knowledge of current AI/LLM, cloud and observability trends to improve system design, developer productivity and business outcomes. * Perform other duties as assigned. **What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?** * **LLM and Agent Systems** + Demonstrated experience shipping LLM/agent systems to production — not just demos or prototypes. + Hands\-on knowledge of tool calling, prompt and routing design, RAG retrieval quality tuning, and defining evaluations to measure LLM and retrieval performance. + Experience with Strands, LangGraph or Bedrock AgentCore is a plus. * **Cloud, Infrastructure and Operations** + Strong AWS serverless and EKS experience; able to design and debug systems spanning Lambda, API Gateway and Kubernetes\-based containers in production. + Practical experience authoring and maintaining Terraform, Helm charts and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, TEP). + Observability fluency: tracing with OpenTelemetry or Dynatrace, structured logging with correlation IDs, cost tracking and incident handling. * **Full\-Stack and Data Pipeline Ownership** + Comfortable working across Python and TypeScript/Node 24 in the service layer and React 19/Vite on the front end. + Familiar with data and retrieval pipelines from ingestion through embedding to vector\-store\-backed APIs. + Consistent habit of writing tests, evaluations and data\-quality checks. * **Delivery** + Advanced delivery skills, including the ability to determine software design strategy and methodology, use automated tests and informed feedback loops to ensure quality and production readiness, and monitor the health of work efforts and adjacent systems. * **Domain Expertise** + Demonstrated track record of developing business partnerships and influencing priorities by identifying solutions aligned with current business objectives; closely follows industry trends relevant to the domain and shares knowledge with coworkers. * **Problem Solving** + Strong problem solver who uses data and proofs of concept to find creative solutions, reflects on outcomes, measures impact and uses that information to optimize — including decisions that involve a significant number of factors with broad implications. * **Communication** + Able to describe technology concepts in ways the business can understand, document initiatives clearly and concisely, collaborate effectively regardless of role, and give and receive constructive feedback; an attentive and empathetic listener. * **Leadership** + Takes action even when there is no clear owner; inspires and motivates others and is effective at influencing team members. **What is a Must Have?** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, related STEM field, or its equivalent in education and/or work experience. * 6 additional years of software engineering experience. **What Is in It for You?** * **Health Insurance**: Employees and their eligible family members – including spouses, domestic partners, and children – are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment. * **Retirement:** Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar\-for\-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers. * **Paid Time Off:** Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays. * **Wellness Program:** The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs. * **Volunteer Encouragement:** We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice. **Employment Practices** Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences. In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions. If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you. Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting. To learn more about our comprehensive benefit programs please visit http://careers.travelers.com/life\-at\-travelers/benefits/.

jobs.title: C++ Developer

and lifecycle initiatives in alignment with enterprise architecture, standards, and business objectives. * Serve as a technical escalation point for complex incidents, leading root\-cause analysis, service restoration, and corrective actions. * Provide technical leadership for operational and industrial communications solutions, including SCADA and AMI network connectivity. * Lead major network deployments, hardware replacements, upgrades, testing, and validation activities while defining engineering standards and best practices. * Partner with cybersecurity teams to strengthen network security, remediate vulnerabilities, and coordinate security event responses. * Proactively identify technical, operational, and capability gaps and lead improvements to network performance, standards, procedures, asset records, and other technical documentation. * Coach and mentor less\-experienced engineers through technical guidance, knowledge sharing, design reviews, and complex assignments. * Participate in the on\-call rotation and lead resolution of critical network incidents and emergency service issues. * Maintain compliance with all company policies and procedures and remain knowledgeable of applicable regulations, laws, standards, and best practices. * Because Tri\-State has an obligation to provide continuous, reliable electric service to its customers, the ability to work overtime at any time of the day or week is considered an essential function of the job. **OTHER DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES*** Perform other related duties as assigned. Education and Training:* Bachelor's or Master's Degrees in Computer Science, Information Technology, Telecom Engineering, or related Science or Technology fields. * Multiple Expert\-level certifications such as CCIE Enterprise Infrastructure, CCIE Data Center, Arista ACE Expert (Campus, WAN Routing, or Data Center), CWNE, Advanced Optical Networking certifications, or equivalent. Other:* Willingness to travel as required up to 15%. * Must possess a current valid driver's license. * Must be able to physically deploy routers, switches, wireless access points, firewalls, and other networking devices. Tri\-State is a wholesale power supply cooperative, operating on a not\-for\-profit basis, with electric distribution cooperatives and public power district members in four states: Colorado, Nebraska, New Mexico and Wyoming. Together with its members, Tri\-State delivers reliable, affordable and responsible power and energy services to nearly a million electricity consumers across roughly 200,000 square miles of the West. Founded in 1952 by its member systems to provide a reliable, cost\-based supply of electricity, Tri\-State is now headquartered in Westminster, Colo., employing approximately 1,000 people across five states. jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer, Finance
jobs.description: **About Tutor** We believe robots are the biggest lever we have to making the physical world a better, more affordable place. But robots are a rounding error in our society: nearly nine out of ten American factories and warehouses don’t even have a single robot, and robots have yet to make their way into our homes or places of business. Tutor Intelligence is changing that. Tutor is a robotics research and deployment company, building generally capable robot hardware and artificial intelligence to enable robots to go where no robots have gone before. Sonny is a semi\-humanoid robot with frontier dexterity approaching the human form. Cassie does back\-breaking work, moving boxes, pallets, and bulk goods for businesses from family\-owned manufacturers to some of the largest brands in the world. Tutor robots are manufactured at scale and operate as a network, combining the whole fleet’s learned experience to train ever more capable robot artificial intelligence. Founded at MIT and headquartered in Watertown, MA, our team is full stack: we design and manufacture robot hardware, train our own models, work directly with the smallest and largest end\-customers, and maintain our fleet across the United States. We’re a team of researchers, engineers, technicians, operators, and sellers who love building things and solving hard problems. Our mission is grand: robots everywhere, for the common good, raising the standard of living across North America, and then the world. **The Role** As our first Applied AI Engineer on Finance, you'll build the operating system for how Tutor runs its finances: planning and forecasting, billing, the close, and the numbers leadership and the board run the company on. You'll design the process flows and change the shape of the work, and you'll do it by writing a lot of software: building whole workflows, tools, and AI agents from scratch rather than living in spreadsheets. This is a technical role where you write and own software, and you'll embed as a true member of our finance team, owning outcomes for that team through technology. You'll have full visibility into what finance does across the business, and you'll treat finance as part of the wider Tutor system: our robots, deployments, customers, and data. Tutor sells robot labor with usage\-based pricing, so billing, revenue, and unit economics all depend on what the robots actually do. You'll join our forward\-deployed AI engineering team: a strategic team of engineers already embedded across deployment, manufacturing, maintenance, and hardware and software engineering, using AI to change how each of those functions works. You'll be its first engineer dedicated to finance. You'll start by taking over and extending finance tools we've already built. From there you'll steward the area as the business grows, using the tools alongside the team and improving them to handle more scale and complexity. ### **What you'll work on** * Architect and build the systems finance runs on, including FP\&A and forecasting tools integrated with our existing systems, with live dashboards and analytics in place of spreadsheets. * Automate the close with software and AI agents: reconciliations, AP/AR, spend review, and variance explanations. * Own the usage\-to\-invoice pipeline, so billing reconciles to what our robots actually did. * Build the financial data layer that joins accounting, spend, CRM, billing, and robot operations data. * Model the business in code: pricing and deal economics, fleet and financing scenarios, and the annual operating plan. * Take over and extend the tools we already have, and keep them working as the team and the business scale. * Build in the controls, checks, and audit trails that let the numbers hold up to auditors, lenders, and investors. ### **What we're looking for** * You've architected and shipped a real system end to end, whether product, internal tooling, data, or infrastructure, and can explain the design choices behind it. * You write working software (Python, SQL, APIs, data pipelines) and build with LLMs and AI coding tools every day. * A technical background with a spike somewhere else: finance, economics, operations, strategy, or founding something. Your path probably hasn't been linear. * Demonstrated passion for, interest in, or experience with finance, and a fundamental understanding of how a company's finances work. You don't need to have held a finance title. * Precision: you build checks, sweat edge cases, and hate a number you can't explain. * High slope: you learn fast, take on ambiguous problems with little direction, and want to make a mark. * You want to be embedded in a business function. This is not a product engineering or research role. ### **Nice to haves** * Usage\-based or subscription billing systems. * A modern accounting and spend stack, and BI tools. * Technical program management (especially FinOps or fintech), product management, or a past founder or first\-of\-function role. * Hardware unit economics, equipment financing, or other capital\-intensive businesses. **Why Tutor?** Whether you’re designing robots, closing deals, running deployments, or creating the processes that help us scale, your work doesn’t sit on a shelf. It shows up on real production floors, making physical work safer and more affordable. Our team of 160\+ is driven by curiosity and a genuine love of building. Everyone here takes real ownership, learns fast, and holds a high bar while having each other’s backs. If you love hard problems and creating things that didn’t exist before, you’ll fit right in. **Benefits** We take care of our team so they can do their best work. At Tutor, you’ll get:* Fully employer\-covered health insurance, so you’re protected without the premium. * A managed 401(k) to help you plan for the future. * Generous time off: unlimited PTO and all federal holidays off for full\-time salaried employees, and 16\+ days of accrued paid time off plus 1\.5x pay on federal holidays for hourly employees. * Regular in\-office meals and team social events throughout the year. As Tutor grows, so will our benefits. We’re continuing to invest in ways to support our team at work and beyond. Tutor Intelligence is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds.

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description: Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by diversity and inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health equity on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.** The Cyber Defense Tooling team is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to be a part of our development group. This individual will be tasked in helping maintain and advancing our in\-house developed product for our Security Operations Center. This product's main objective is to organize, streamline, and automate work for our operational teams that use the product. This role requires the ability to architect innovative solutions and coordinate development across multiple projects within Enterprise Information Security and reports to the Senior Manager of Cybersecurity Software Development for the Security Operations Center. Candidate expectation is self\-starter, highly organized, detail oriented, and seeks opportunities to improve the Security Operations Center. If you reside in **Eden Prairie, MN**, you will enjoy the flexibility of an office\-based role as you take on some tough challenges. **Primary Responsibilities:** * Is a team leader championing code quality, automation, security, architecture, and best practices * Mentors junior members of the team * Develops and implements solutions that exemplify modern software engineering practices * Enhances system design to simplify and improve resiliency in system interactions and dependencies * Maintains current perspective on technology trends and applies that to personal and team capability growth * Actively participates in code review and maintenance * Champions "automation first" mentality throughout engineering and operations practices * Drives code reuse and minimizes redundant development * Has strong familiarity with many technologies and shares that knowledge with others * Grow and mature automated response processes in the Security Operations Center * Support cross team collaboration in Enterprise Information Security to drive execution of initiatives * Distribute and provide technical material and updates to leadership * Drive increased productivity through operational excellence * Perform all other related duties as assigned * Leverage enterprise\-approved AI tools to streamline workflows, automate tasks, and drive continuous improvement You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear directions on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in. **Required Qualifications:** * High School Diploma * 6\+ years of experience with software development * 6\+ years of Golang experience or 6\+ years of experience in 2 backend languages (Python or Java or C\+\+ or C\#), at least one of which is compiled * 4\+ years of experience with JavaScript and at least one JavaScript framework (Vue, React) * 4\+ years of experience with Git * 3\+ years of experience with commercial cloud hosting environments including Amazon Web Services (AWS), Google Cloud Platform (GCP), or Microsoft Azure; specifically regarding tooling, best practices, and security **Preferred Qualifications:** * Familiarity with relational databases * Familiarity with graph databases such as AWS Neptune * 3\+ years of experience with containerization tools such as Docker * Knowledge of Agile, CI/CD, and DevOps practices * Demonstrated experience leading projects focused on innovations and development of information systems and/or security solutions * Familiarity with network design and implementation * Experience working in security operations, cyber defense, or application security * Undergraduate degree or equivalent experience * Software Certifications: AWS, GCP, Azure * All Telecommuters will be required to adhere to UnitedHealth Group's Telecommuter Policy. Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to local labor markets, education, work experience, certifications, etc. In addition to your salary, we offer benefits such as, a comprehensive benefits package, incentive and recognition programs, equity stock purchase and 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). No matter where or when you begin a career with us, you'll find a far\-reaching choice of benefits and incentives. The salary for this role will range from $91,700 to $163,700 annually based on full\-time employment.
