jobs.title: Assistant Professor in Transportation Engineering (Tenure Track)
jobs.description: **Assistant Professor in Transportation Engineering (Tenure Track)** ==================================================================== ### **Position Overview** **School / Campus / College:** College of Engineering **Organization:** Civil \& Environmental Engineering **Title:** Assistant Professor in Transportation Engineering (Tenure Track) ### **Position Details** #### **Position Description** The Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering (CEE) at the University of Washington invites applications for a faculty position at the rank of Assistant Professor (Tenure Track), with an anticipated start date of September, 2027\. The location of this position is on the University of Washington campus in Seattle, Washington. We seek applicants who demonstrate commitment to excellence in research, teaching, and service in a diverse and inclusive academic community. The successful candidate will join our faculty on a full\-time basis for a nine\-month academic appointment, 3\-year term, renewable, beginning September 16, 2027\. The base salary range for this position will be \[$11,500 \- $13,500] per month, commensurate with experience and qualifications, or as mandated by a U.S. Department of Labor prevailing wage determination. Positive factors for consideration include, but are not limited to, candidates with a promising record of research excellence in transportation; candidates working with emerging methods, tools, or technologies, such as artificial intelligence and machine learning, robotics and automation, new sensing and data sources, quantum applications, or directions we have not anticipated; and/or candidates who bring new areas of strength for the department. Applicants are encouraged to connect their work to one or more of the Grand Challenges identified in the Department's strategic plan. All University of Washington faculty are expected to engage in teaching, research, and service. Our department offers a highly collegial and collaborative culture, with broad interdisciplinary research ties and opportunities. The UW has an active community of transportation researchers within CEE, the College of Engineering (CoE), and across the university. The candidate is expected to collaborate with colleagues within CEE, CoE, throughout the university, and externally; and to develop an externally funded research program. In teaching, the candidate will support and expand transportation course offerings at the undergraduate and graduate levels. In all aspects of this position, the candidate will be expected to contribute to a welcoming and inclusive environment in research, teaching, mentoring, and service. #### **Qualifications** Applicants for this position must meet the following minimum qualifications: * A PhD or foreign equivalent degree, in civil engineering or a related discipline, by the date of appointment. #### **Instructions** To ensure full consideration of your application, please submit all materials no later than November 29, 2026\. Priority will be given to those applications received by November 29, 2026\. Applications will only be accepted via Interfolio. The position will remain open until filled. Applications should include the following materials, noting that any content exceeding page limits will not be reviewed: 1\. a cover letter of no more than 1 page detailing the candidate’s interest in the position, relevant qualifications and experiences, and a link to their Google Scholar profile; 2\. a curriculum vitae; 3\. a two\-page research statement that includes the candidate’s vision for their research for the next 5 years, alignment of their work with one or more of the Grand Challenges identified in the department’s Strategic Plan, and the potential for research collaboration and external funding; 4\. a one\-page description of the candidate’s vision for instruction and learning in civil and environmental engineering, identifying current undergraduate and graduate courses the candidate is interested in teaching and potential new course offerings; 5\. a one\-page description of the candidate’s record of and plans for service, including service to the profession, to the department and the University, and/or engagement with public agencies, industry, and the communities affected by transportation decisions; 6\. up to three publications that illustrate the candidate’s research contributions; 7\. contact information for at least 3 referees who are prepared to provide letters of recommendation upon request. References will only be contacted for short\-listed candidates, but if asked will be expected to submit recommendations within thirty days. Applicants should articulate how their past experiences and/or future plans in research, teaching, mentoring, and/or service promote a sense of belonging and foster a welcoming and inclusive environment. Any such information should be integrated into the statements on research, teaching, and service, not included as a separate statement. #### **Equal Employment Opportunity Statement** **Equal Opportunity** The University of Washington is committed to fostering an inclusive, respectful and welcoming community for all. As an equal opportunity employer, the University considers applicants for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, national origin, citizenship, sex, pregnancy, age, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, disability, or veteran status consistent with UW Executive Order No. 81\. **Benefits Information** The University is committed to providing excellent benefits to our faculty. For a summary of available benefits, please see UWHR benefits information. **Privacy Notice** Your application materials may be used for employment consideration and shared in accordance with UW’s Privacy Policy. **Disability Services** The University of Washington is committed to providing access and reasonable accommodation in its services, programs, activities, education, and employment for individuals with disabilities. To request disability accommodation in the application process, contact the Disability Services Office at 206\-543\-6450 or dso@uw.edu.

jobs.description: **Web Experience Developer** ---------------------------- ### **Center for Innovation in Teaching and Learning** The University of Illinois Urbana\-Champaign is accepting applications for the Web Experience Developer at the Center for Innovation in Teaching \& Learning (CITL). The Web Experience Developer is responsible for the design, development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of CITL's web presence. This position combines expertise in user\-centered web design with technical proficiency in Drupal and WordPress content management systems (CMS), HTML, CSS, and modern web standards to create engaging, accessible, inclusive, and responsive digital experiences that support the needs of the University community. Working collaboratively with CITL leadership, the AI strategist, and content owners, the Web Experience Developer translates organizational goals into effective web solutions that support faculty, staff, and students. This position is required to work on\-site. It is not a remote position. #### **Duties \& Responsibilities** * Website Design and Development + Design, develop, and maintain CITL website, including: - Front\-end code using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. - CMS themes and templates. - Troubleshoot and resolve layout, styling, and browser compatibility issues. - Optimize website performance, usability, and search engine optimization (SEO). - Maintain clean, well\-documented code following established web standards. + Create visually engaging, user\-centered web experiences that align with institutional branding while incorporating accessibility, inclusive design principles, and usability best practices. + Develop and modify page layouts, templates, navigation structures, and content components. + Implement responsive designs that provide consistent experiences across desktop and mobile devices. + Build and maintain reusable page components and content templates. * Content Management + Collaborate with content owners to understand operational goals, organize information, and publish web content. + Assist in planning site architecture, navigation, and information organization. + Maintain consistency across multiple websites and digital assets. + Support content migration and website redesign initiatives. + Serve as CITL web user support. * User Experience, Accessibility, and Inclusive Design + Apply user experience (UX) principles to improve website usability and engagement. + Ensure compliance with WCAG accessibility standards and University accessibility policies. + Conduct usability reviews and recommend improvements based on user feedback and analytics. + Collaborate with accessibility specialists to promote inclusive digital experiences. + Apply inclusive design principles that ensure websites are welcoming, intuitive, and usable for individuals with various backgrounds, abilities, identities, devices, and levels of digital experience. + Evaluate and recommend improvements that promote equitable access to information and services across the University's campus communities. * Collaboration and Project Support + Work closely with CITL’s AI strategist, communications staff, instructional designers, educational technologists, and subject matter experts. + Participate in website planning, redesign, and strategic digital initiatives. + Coordinate with CITL and campus IT as well as other stakeholders regarding web infrastructure and security. + Stay current with emerging web technologies, Drupal developments, accessibility requirements, and design trends. + Consult with campus partners to incorporate accessibility, inclusive design, and user\-centered best practices into web planning and development initiatives. + Perform other duties as assigned. #### **Minimum Qualifications** * High school diploma or equivalent. * Two (2\) years of work experience in IT‐related functions such as hardware/software support, programming, network design, network engineering, IT systems integration, or closely related field. For more information on Civil Service classifications, please visit the SUCSS web site at https://www.sucss.illinois.gov/pages/classspec/default.aspx. **This position is not eligible for any type of sponsorship for work authorization.** #### **Application Procedures \& Deadline Information** Applications must be received by 6:00 pm (Central Time) on November 5, 2026\. Apply for this position using the Apply Now button at the top or bottom of this posting. For full consideration, application materials should include a cover letter, current resume (including month/year employment dates), contact information for three professional references, and transcripts or proof of degree(s). Please ensure that your resume highlights your qualifications/experience for this position. This may include professional, academic, volunteer, or other applicable experience that aligns with the responsibilities of this role. In order to be considered as a transfer candidate, you must apply for this position. In order to be considered as a transfer candidate, you must apply for this position. Applications not submitted through https://jobs.illinois.edu will not be considered. If required by the position, transcripts or other documentation of credentials are to be provided no later than the first day of employment. For further information about this specific position, please contact kvogelba@illinois.edu. For questions regarding the application process, please contact 217\-333\-2137\. At the University of Illinois Urbana\-Champaign — the state’s flagship public university and one of the world’s leading research institutions — **every staff member helps shape what’s next**. Whether you’re empowering first\-generation students, fueling breakthrough innovation, or strengthening communities across Illinois and beyond, your work here has a far\-reaching and deeply meaningful impact. The university offers a highly competitive benefits package designed to support your well\-being, growth, and financial security. Join a top 10 public university that has launched over 330 startups and continues to redefine excellence — where the Illinois Value Proposition ensures that your contributions are recognized, your potential is nurtured, and your career can thrive. Ability to build/install software packages, work with multi\-platform hardware systems, and programming/scripting experience would be helpful. jobs.title: Linux Infrastructure Engineer (Bare Metal, Storage & AI Factory Infrastructure)
jobs.description: **Job Overview** We are seeking a highly experienced **Senior Linux Infrastructure Engineer** with deep expertise in Linux administration, bare metal infrastructure, enterprise storage, and next\-generation **AI Factory / GPU infrastructure platforms**. This role is focused on designing, deploying, operating, and troubleshooting large\-scale Linux\-based infrastructure that powers both traditional enterprise workloads and modern AI/ML environments. This is **not a DevOps\-focused role**. We already have a dedicated DevOps team and are looking for an engineer with extensive hands\-on experience in **Bare Metal as a Service (BMaaS), GPU infrastructure, high\-performance storage, data center operations, and enterprise Linux platforms**. The ideal candidate will have experience building and managing infrastructure from the hardware layer up, including servers, networking, storage, GPU clusters, and AI\-ready platforms. They should be comfortable working with high\-performance computing (HPC), AI Factory environments, and large\-scale Linux deployments where performance, reliability, and operational excellence are critical. **Key Responsibilities \& Required Skills** **Linux \& Bare Metal Infrastructure** * Expert\-level Linux administration (Ubuntu required; Red Hat and SUSE preferred) * Deep expertise in **bare metal server deployment, architecture, provisioning, and lifecycle management** * Experience operating **Bare Metal as a Service (BMaaS)** platforms and large\-scale infrastructure environments * Strong understanding of server hardware, including: + BIOS/UEFI + RAID controllers + Firmware management + iLO/iDRAC/IPMI + NICs and SmartNICs + HBA cards + Hardware diagnostics and troubleshooting * Experience designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise Linux infrastructure at scale **AI Factory \& GPU Infrastructure** * Experience deploying and managing **GPU\-accelerated infrastructure** for AI/ML workloads * Understanding of NVIDIA GPU technologies including: + A100, H100, H200, B200, or equivalent GPU platforms + NVIDIA DGX and OEM GPU servers + GPU provisioning and lifecycle management + GPU monitoring and performance optimization * Knowledge of AI Factory architecture and infrastructure requirements * Experience supporting GPU clusters, AI training environments, and high\-performance computing (HPC) workloads * Understanding of: + GPU resource allocation and scheduling + Multi\-GPU systems + GPU networking requirements + High\-bandwidth, low\-latency infrastructure design * Familiarity with NVIDIA ecosystem technologies such as: + CUDA + NCCL + GPUDirect Storage + NVIDIA Fabric Manager + NVIDIA Base Command (preferred) **Enterprise Storage \& Data Platforms** * Advanced Linux storage administration: + LVM + XFS, EXT4 + NFS + iSCSI + Fibre Channel SAN + Multipath I/O * Strong hands\-on experience with **Ceph**, including: + Cluster architecture + MON, OSD, MDS + RBD, CephFS, RGW + Capacity planning + Performance tuning + Failure recovery * Experience with high\-performance AI storage platforms such as: + WEKA + VAST Data + Dell PowerScale + Pure Storage FlashBlade + NetApp * Understanding of: + NVMe\-over\-Fabrics (NVMe\-oF) + RDMA + GPUDirect Storage + Parallel file systems + AI data pipelines **Networking \& Infrastructure** * Strong networking knowledge: + Bonding + VLANs + Routing + MTU optimization + DNS + DHCP * Experience with high\-performance data center networking: + 100G/200G/400G Ethernet + RoCE + RDMA + Spine\-Leaf architectures * Familiarity with NVIDIA Spectrum\-X, Mellanox/NVIDIA ConnectX adapters, or equivalent technologies * Strong understanding of Layer 2 and Layer 3 infrastructure design and troubleshooting **Operations \& Reliability** * Experience with high availability, clustering, and disaster recovery * Strong troubleshooting skills across: + Linux operating systems + Hardware platforms + GPU infrastructure + Networking + Enterprise storage * Experience supporting mission\-critical production environments * Bash and Python scripting for automation and operational efficiency * Experience creating operational documentation, runbooks, and infrastructure standards * Understanding of AI infrastructure design and reference architectures * AI cloud integration for workloads * SOP and runbook development and maintenance * Incident, problem, and capacity management * Business continuity and disaster recovery planning for AI workloads * Proactive risk identification and mitigation to avoid business impact **Nice to Have** * Kubernetes infrastructure (especially AI/ML and GPU integration) * KVM, VMware, OpenShift Virtualization, or similar virtualization platforms * Ansible automation * NVIDIA Base Command Manager * Slurm or HPC workload schedulers * Observability and monitoring platforms (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry) * Data Center Infrastructure Management (DCIM) tools * IPAM solutions * AWS, Azure, or hybrid cloud exposure **We Are Not Looking For** * Candidates whose experience is primarily CI/CD pipeline engineering * Engineers focused mainly on Terraform, GitOps, or application delivery pipelines * Cloud\-only administrators with limited bare metal, storage, or hardware experience * Professionals whose primary expertise is software development rather than infrastructure engineering **Ideal Candidate** Someone who has spent years designing, building, and operating enterprise Linux environments, large\-scale bare metal infrastructure, storage platforms, and modern AI Factory environments. The ideal candidate understands how to deploy and manage GPU\-enabled infrastructure, BMaaS platforms, enterprise storage, and high\-performance networking while solving complex operating system, hardware, storage, and AI infrastructure challenges. DevOps experience is a plus, but deep Linux, infrastructure, storage, BMaaS, and AI Factory expertise is the primary requirement.

Your impact: By improving network availability and performance, you help engineering and operations teams move data reliably and deliver dependable services. **Responsibilities** * Design and administer LAN and WAN infrastructure, Ethernet switching, IP networking, routing, and network protocols, including TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, and MPLS. * Configure and troubleshoot Cisco routers, Juniper equipment, firewalls, VPNs, IPsec, load balancing, QoS, and high\-availability systems. * Monitor network health and security using tools such as Splunk, SolarWinds, and PRTG; support vulnerability assessment, IDS, authentication, encryption, and remote access. * Support data center, SAN, VMware/vSphere, AWS, and Azure environments, plus DNS, DHCP, LDAP, Active Directory, and GPO services. * Automate configuration and operations with Ansible and scripting; document changes and follow Agile, DevOps, SDLC, and ITIL practices. **Experience** * Strong computer networking and network engineering experience, including network design, administration, installation, support, and equipment troubleshooting. * Working knowledge of Cisco ISE, Cisco ASA, Meraki, VPN management, PKI, SSO, SSL, HTTPS, SSH, SFTP, FTP, NFS, and VoIP. * Experience with Linux distributions such as Debian, CentOS, openSUSE, Ubuntu, and BSD; familiarity with Windows, macOS, Solaris, and UNIX is useful. * Scripting or development experience with Python, Bash, PowerShell, Java, SQL, or APIs; knowledge of virtualization and Citrix is a plus. * Background in IT, system administration, network security, telecommunication, or communications systems engineering; computer science education is relevant. Pay: $60\.00 \- $65\.00 per hour Expected hours: 8\.0 per week Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Sales Engineer
jobs.description: Valence is the AI company behind Nadia, a personalized coach for everyone, built to advance teamwork and talent strategy at enterprise scale. Nadia embeds personalized, proactive development directly into the flow of daily work to help individuals build new skills and behaviors. At the organization level, Nadia is a tool for HR leaders to improve the reach and impact of their talent programs, driving measurable improvements for learning, culture, and performance globally. Since being released in early 2023, Nadia has logged more than two million coaching conversations in 100\+ languages. Today, Nadia is deployed at scale across the Fortune 500, across the globe, including Nestlé, Coca\-Cola, IBM, Dell, The Home Depot, CVS Health, Delta Air Lines, Kaiser Permanente, Vanguard, and more. Valence is a Series B company backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and Insight Partners, with offices in New York, Toronto, London, and San Francisco. Learn more about our work with Microsoft: Valence Brings AI Coaching More Deeply Into the Flow of Work with Microsoft 365 At Valence, our team is focused on problems that actually decide whether AI changes how organizations operate: the ones with no playbook, no obvious answers, and no guarantee of success. If you want to be part of the small group that defines how AI transforms the future at a global scale, this is your chance. And this isn't for everyone. We're not looking for people who want predictability or incremental progress. We only want those who are restless at the edge of what's possible, who get bored when things feel "done," and who are driven to redefine what AI can mean for leaders, companies, and the world. Because at Valence, the work worth doing is the kind that redefines work itself. **The role** ------------ As a Sales Engineer at Valence, you will be the technical voice in our largest deals. You join calls from first meeting through signature, map how Nadia fits into a customer's systems, separate what we already do from what would be custom, and write the scope that delivery teams build from. You know how to tee up the right next technical discussions both externally with customers and internally with engineering. You know when to say "yes," when to say "yes, sequenced," when to push back, and when to find the simpler thing the customer actually needs. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Lead technical discovery with enterprise buyers, HR tech owners, IT and InfoSec. * Explain Nadia's architecture and how standard enterprise plumbing — SSO, SCIM, HRIS sync, Teams deployment, data residency, encryption keys — maps to the customer's environment. * Map the customer's architecture, sort requirements into standard connectors vs. configuration vs. custom work, and write the technical scope for the SOW. * Set realistic timelines with Engineering and route work to the right team: core engineering, forward\-deployed engineering, or solutions engineering. * Run security reviews and questionnaires, and handle CISO and IT conversations with clear, accurate answers. * Push back well. Be able to take an unconstrained view with clients, pushing a vision, while implicitly understanding the actual constraints that we have in terms of what we can deliver and on what timeline. Sometimes this takes the form of deflecting a client's "We must have X" requirement into something we can actually do. * Build the reusable assets — reference architectures, security answers, scoping templates — that make the next deal faster. * Use AI and AI First principles to build tailored demos and quick prototypes that show a customer how Nadia works with their frameworks, data and systems. * You own mapping client architectures, technical specs for customer integrations, flagging and defining implementation risk for systems we haven't integrated with before, hand\-offs to other engineering and FDE teams to deliver. **What you bring** ------------------ * 3\+ years in sales engineering, solutions architecture or a customer\-facing engineering role at a B2B SaaS company selling to large enterprises. * Hands\-on fluency with enterprise integration patterns: REST and SOAP APIs, SFTP and batch file feeds, webhooks, SSO (SAML/OIDC), SCIM provisioning. * Comfort with enterprise security and compliance conversations: SOC 2, data retention, encryption and BYOK, single\- vs. multi\-tenant, cloud networking such as private connectivity. * Experience scoping work that other engineers delivered, and owning whether the scope was right. * Clear writing. You can turn a 2\-hour discovery call into a one\-page architecture and a crisp list of open questions. * Judgment under pressure: you stay calm and honest when a customer is demanding and a deal is on the line. * AI fluency. You use AI tools every day, and you can explain how LLM products are prompted, grounded and evaluated, and where they fail. * A builder's instinct. You know how to use AI tools and coding agents to put together a tailored demo or lightweight prototype yourself, with scripting (Python or JavaScript), APIs or product configuration. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Experience with HRIS and talent systems, especially Workday, or with Microsoft Teams and the Microsoft 365 ecosystem. * Experience helping customers evaluate AI quality, such as building eval sets or success criteria. * Experience as an early or first SE at a growth\-stage company. **What You'll Get** ------------------- * **Team Leadership \& Scope:** Full people leadership of Valence's enterprise deployment organization for your region, direct influence over how Valence's biggest launches are run, and real influence over the best practices Enablement builds into the playbook. * **AI\-First Deployment Leadership:** Work directly with cutting\-edge AI models in production at enterprise scale, and build deep expertise in enterprise AI deployment across some of the world's largest organizations. * **Competitive Compensation \& Benefits:** + Competitive salary including base \+ performance bonus + Comprehensive health coverage (medical, dental, vision) from day one + Generous PTO, company\-wide R\&R shutdowns, and paid parental leave + Retirement plan support (401k / pensions) * **Meaningful Equity:** Ownership in a venture\-backed company at a growth inflection point, with top\-up grants tied to performance. * **Top\-Performing Culture:** A team built for top talent: high intensity to win, growth without limits, and a culture that solves hard problems and celebrates big wins together. **Location and Work Environment** --------------------------------- We have two seats open for this role: one based in New York, NY and one based in London, UK, each working a minimum of 3 days a week in office. We will consider remote candidates elsewhere in the relevant region for the right background. Candidates must be comfortable working with colleagues across different time zones and hold valid work authorization for their country of hire. Expect regular travel to customer sites for on\-site launches and executive business reviews.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Compute
jobs.description: * Engineering * San Francisco * Full Time **About Vercel:** ----------------- Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience. Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide. **About the role** ------------------ **Developers are building faster than ever. Humans and agents are deploying more than 6 million times a day on Vercel, spinning up over 2 million Sandboxes and serving a trillion requests per month.** Every single one is powered by our own compute infrastructure . The Persistence team sits within Vercel's Compute division. This team owns the deep infrastructure within Hive (our compute platform) focussing on storage and state for all our workloads (Builds, Sandboxes and Functions). This work is redefining compute with features like Fluid Compute, Persistent Sandboxes, and Custom Images. As a Software Engineer on the Persistence team, you'll work on the infrastructure that runs 100s of instances across every region where our customers deploy code, rethinking low\-level primitives and contributing to platform features that improve the experience for thousands of developers every day. This role is based in **London, UK**. If you're within commuting distance of our London office, the role includes in\-office anchor days. If you're located further afield within the UK, the role is fully remote. For location\-specific details, please connect with our recruiting team. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Manage and improve our fleet of clusters, running 100s of instances deployed in every region where our customers deploy and run their code. * Write Golang on a daily basis and use Terraform to provision infrastructure; you'll get to know Nomad as our scheduler for managing workloads. * Rethink the primitives of our infrastructure — working with virtual filesystems, Linux primitives, and low\-level virtualisation. * Own the reliability and performance of our compute platform, including on\-call coverage for a team where every improvement has outsized impact at scale. * Collaborate across teams to drive the convergence of all compute at Vercel. **What you need** ----------------- * 5\+ years of software engineering experience, with Golang strongly preferred. * Deep experience with virtual machines, file systems and Linux — you like knowing how things work under the hood (tcpdump, strace, and iptables are familiar tools). * Experience building and operating distributed systems at scale; you design for performance and reliability. * Experience with schedulers and orchestrators for managing containers and non\-containerised workloads (e.g. Nomad, Kubernetes). * Excellent problem\-solving and communication skills, with a genuine enthusiasm for digging into problems that don't have obvious solutions. **Bonus if you** ---------------- * Have worked on low\-level virtualisation or sandbox execution environments. * Have product engineering experience and care about the developer\-facing impact of infrastructure decisions. * Have experience with on\-call operations for large\-scale distributed systems. **Benefits:** ------------- * Competitive compensation package, including equity. * Inclusive Healthcare Package. * Learn and Grow \- we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills. * Flexible Time Off. * We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed. \#LI\-KR1 **Disclosures:** ---------------- * **Privacy:** Please review our Job Applicant Privacy Policy for more information on how we handle your data. * **Equal Opportunity:** Vercel is committed to fostering and empowering an inclusive community within our organization. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Vercel encourages everyone to apply for our available positions, even if they don't necessarily check every box on the job description.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: ### **When you join Verizon** You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere \& always. Want in? Join the \#VTeamLife. **What you’ll be doing:** As a part of the Strategic Analytics and Modeling team within the Transformation Command Center working on Network Capital Strategy, you will lead projects to develop and perform complex AI\-first and agentic modeling including statistical, analytical or advanced analytics on challenging long\-term network capacity questions, aiming to "right\-size" the future capacity planning needs for the multi\-billion dollar investments in our Verizon Network. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll have high autonomy to create, improve, design and execute using AI for capacity simulations and optimization, in partnership with the relevant business partners, while on the lookout for new modeling techniques, evolving technologies and emerging industry trends that can improve accuracy, speed or generally quality of simulations. Your work will help ensure that the needs of the network that serves our customer has accurate capacity plans so downstream finance teams may appropriately fund budgetary requests for next\-year expansion or operational network efforts. Responsibilities include: * Working with stakeholders to develop AI, agent\-based modeling, and algorithmic modeling for network elements and processes to support the 3\-year capital budget. * Planning and executing the design of the new capacity model, obtaining general agreement from NCS and the business team. * Operating the model across multiple checkpoints in a year, creating a hardened deployment, documentation, and plans for future automation of the process. * Planning future upgrades to the model with alternate types of algorithms, AI science or additional input features. * Actively leveraging and piloting AI tools — including agentic workflows, LLM\-assisted coding, and automated documentation/reporting — to accelerate model development, scenario testing, and stakeholder deliverables; Verizon expressly supports and encourages AI\-augmented approaches to this work. * Assertively adapt and navigate roadblocks in the software development process, self\-resolving issues and escalating roadblocks when appropriate. * Conducting occasional presentations to leaders and engineers to describe the nature of created systems. * Protecting invented Verizon Intellectual Property by pursuing patents when appropriate. **What we're looking for:** A passion for creativity, AI, innovation, process improvement, advanced algorithms, and best\-practices of independent software design. A motivated, independent individual who can properly discern next\-steps in the absence of requirements, and determine when to appropriately collaborate with the team and business partners. Proven ability to communicate technical information to technical or non\-technical audiences with an understanding that each project has the ability to change millions of dollars of spend to benefit the customer's network experience. You'll need to have: * Bachelor's degree or four or more years of work experience. * Four or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through one or a combination of work and/or military experience, or specialized training. * Intermediate proficiency in Python (or R), SQL with a moderate history or portfolio of accomplished projects. * Intermediate proficiency in Alteryx or Knime. * Experience building or integrating agentic AI workflows (e.g., LLM\-based agents, tool\-use/function\-calling pipelines, or automation frameworks like LangChain, AutoGen, or Claude/GPT\-based agents) to automate data ingestion, scenario generation, or report synthesis in support of capital planning and simulation workflows. Even better if you have one or more of the following: * Degree in business intelligence and analytics, data science, engineering, computer science, mathematics or similar. * Experience in time series analysis / forecasting. * Strong experience in engineering investigations, performance optimizations, or network capacity management. * Prior experience navigating engineering budget cycles, such as funding requests for cell\-site builds in a regional role. * Proven experience with gathering requirements and translating requirements to specific software practices. * Experience with data engineering. * Knowledge of cloud computing platforms e.g. Google Cloud Platform or Amazon Web Services. * Experience with high performance containerized GPU environments. * Solid foundation in mathematical optimization, prescriptive modeling, and network capacity management. * Designing, architecting, and deploying full\-stack web applications and APIs—leveraging frameworks like FastAPI, custom GUIs (e.g., Flet, Marimo), and high\-performance BI dashboards—to expose optimization models, streamline data ingestion, and accelerate scenario planning for non\-technical leadership. If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above. ### **Where you’ll be working** In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.### **Scheduled Weekly Hours** 40### **Equal Employment Opportunity** Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics. ### **Benefits and Compensation** Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD\&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home \& auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award\-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part\-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances. The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job\-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part\-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours. The annual salary range for the location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full\-time schedule is: $101,000\.00 \- $194,000\.00\.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About Virtru:** While the rest of the security industry obsesses over locking data down to prevent it from being lost or stolen, we're doing something fundamentally different at Virtru. We're setting data free so that you can intentionally share it with others, but without sacrificing security, privacy, or control. We've created both a suite of powerful data protection applications and an open platform that's sparking an ecosystem of innovation. Through the Trusted Data Format (TDF) open standard, we're not just protecting data; we're creating a new paradigm where security enables sharing rather than preventing it. Think of us as the Android of data protection: a robust platform with an open core that developers and partners can build upon, coupled with our own best\-in\-class applications that showcase what's possible when you reimagine security from the ground up. Backed by Iconiq Capital, Bessemer Venture Partners, Foundry Capital, and Tiger Global, we're helping Fortune 500 companies and government agencies discover that true data security means having the freedom to share, collaborate, and innovate — without compromise. **Compensation: $190,000 \- 250,000/year** **Team \& Position Details:** Virtru protects data wherever it travels, for customers ranging from commercial enterprises to the Department of Defense, the Intelligence Community, Law Enforcement, and Federal Civilian agencies. Many of these customers run Virtru inside their mission environments, and the most sensitive of those environments are cleared spaces where work happens on site, alongside the customer's own engineers. As a Senior Software Engineer in the Delivery Engineering organization, you'd be helping to build a founder team focused on making these deployments simple, easy, and fast. You will be the engineer who builds what a cleared customer needs and cannot get from the product alone: custom integrations and policy enforcement points (the components that enforce access policy inside a customer's application) delivered into the customer's environment. You will sit with customer engineers, understand how their systems really work, and ship working software that fits them. You will work directly with deployment engineers and forward deployed engineers on the customer side of each engagement, with QA to prove what you build before it ships, and with our product engineering and Platform Engineering counterparts to carry what you learn back into the product. The test of your work is simple: the second time we face the same customer need, we should be configuring something you built, not writing it again. The impact of this role is company and product wide, heavily enabling our goals to scale Virtru, partner, and customer led deployments non\-linearly without having to throw more humans at the problem. You'll be expected to come up with AI\-native design patterns that will increase our velocity without compromising our high bar for quality and security. The right candidate is excited about working on a small, nimble, highly autonomous and empowered team where everyone is expected to make high judgement, high velocity decisions independently and with urgency. If you want a role where the connection between what you build and what the customer achieves requires no explaining, this is one. **As a Senior Software Engineer in Delivery Engineering, your responsibilities will include:** * **Build custom integrations and policy enforcement points for cleared customers**, scoped against a statement of work, tested with QA, and delivered into environments Virtru does not operate. * **Work directly with customer engineers inside cleared environments** to understand their systems, agree what will be built, and explain your design to their security team. * **Turn what you build twice into a reusable asset.** When a second customer needs the same thing, the first build becomes a template, a library, or a tool that deployment engineers and forward deployed engineers can use without you. * Build on the SDKs and APIs that our product engineering teams maintain, and bring gaps and defects back to them with a clear reproduction and a documented outcome. * Write code that follows the engineering standard set by Delivery Engineering's Principal Software Engineer, and submit your work to the design review that standard calls for. * Package your work so it installs, upgrades, and runs in disconnected environments with no path to the internet. * Partner with deployment engineers and forward deployed engineers so the person who installs your work in the field has what they need: documentation, test evidence, and a clear way to report back. * Partner with our Platform Engineering counterparts on how your work is built, signed, and released. * Use AI coding agents as part of your daily workflow, and help the team learn which patterns raise quality and speed together. * Mentor and learn from peers across the organization, and help define what good looks like for  our software does, what it touches, and why it is safe to run, and you can answer the follow\-up questions. * **Nice to haves** + Windows and .NET depth: production .NET on Windows, including Windows Services, signed installers, and managed distribution. Many of our customers' end\-user environments are Windows\-heavy, and some of our policy enforcement points deploy on Windows client endpoints. + Go proficiency, which is what the Data Security Platform and OpenTDF are written in. + Kubernetes experience, including packaging and running software across more than one distribution. + Identity and authorization integration experience: OIDC, SAML, and attribute\-based access control (ABAC). + Familiarity with Zero Trust security architecture and concepts such as Policy Enforcement and Decision Points, cryptography, and identity. + Experience delivering software into air\-gapped or disconnected environments. + Experience building with AI coding agents. * **Where this role may not be a fit** + **Wanting a product\-only role with no customer contact.** Much of this job is working next to the customer, in their environment, on their problem. If you prefer to build away from customers, this role may not be for you. + **Inability to earn trust and credibility with partners and customers.** You may be the person who has to explain to a skeptical government security team why our software is safe, or to an internal VP of Engineering why we need to prioritize critical platform features. Those have to be conversations you are willing and excited to have. **Virtruvian qualities that will set you up for success:** * Thinking outside of the box to respectfully challenge your teammates and managers in the pursuit of excellence * Strong sense of urgency with an action\-oriented mindset * Able to collaborate and adapt to shifting priorities as business needs evolve * Comfortable with asynchronous communication including slack, email, zoom, etc. **Perks \& Benefits:** At Virtru, we believe people do their best work when their wellbeing is put first. This is why we make your wellbeing our priority with a thoughtful and holistic program that encompasses Occupational, Mental, Social, Physical, and Environmental Wellness by offering benefits such as… * A **Flexible PTO policy** — we strongly encourage you to take time off (in addition to 14 holidays) to ensure that you are getting the proper time needed to unplug and recharge. * A $1,500 annual **Learning \& Development Stipend** focused on providing you the resources to continually learn and professionally grow. * Frequent company\-sponsored **team celebrations** that provide ample opportunities to connect with teammates and be social! * Access to an **Employee Assistance Program** * Access to **Headspace**, a mental health app tailored to your specific needs. * A flat 3% contribution to your retirement account * **A high degree of flexibility** — Have an appointment, errand, or family emergency to take care of? jobs.title: Product Manager, Enterprise AI
jobs.description: **Company Description** Vuori is re\-defining what athletic apparel looks like: built to move and sweat in but designed with a casual aesthetic to transition into everyday life. We draw inspiration from an active coastal California lifestyle; an integration of fitness, creative expression and life. Our high energy fast paced retail environment is reflected in the clothes we make. We aim to inspire others to take on all aspects of their lives with clarity, enthusiasm and purpose…while having a lot of fun along the way. We are proud to be an outlet for opportunity and for personal growth and success. **Job Description** As AI Product Manager, you will be responsible for maintaining Vuori's AI product roadmap and seeing AI capabilities through successful delivery. Working closely with AI engineers, business stakeholders, and design, you will keep the team focused on the right problems, ensure requirements are clear and actionable, and track progress from concept to production. This role is well suited for a product practitioner who is energized by the day\-to\-day of shipping AI, someone who thrives on translating stakeholder needs into crisp requirements, removing blockers so teams can move fast, and staying close to outcomes to know when something is truly working for users and the business. **What you'll get to do:** *Maintain and manage the roadmap* * Keep the AI product roadmap current, well\-sequenced, and visible to stakeholders — reflecting business priorities, engineering capacity, and what is actually being built. * Work with business and technology leaders to surface AI opportunities, assess their value, and bring them into the roadmap through a structured prioritization process. * Facilitate trade\-off conversations between stakeholders and engineering teams, helping the group land on decisions that balance impact, feasibility, and timing. * Communicate roadmap changes, sequencing decisions, and delivery status clearly and on a regular cadence, so stakeholders are never surprised. * Flag risks and dependencies early, so teams have time to adapt before they become blockers. *Drive successful delivery* * Translate business needs and user requirements into clear, detailed product specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria that engineering and design can act on. * Work alongside AI engineers throughout delivery — answering questions, clarifying scope, reviewing work in progress, and making fast, informed decisions when scope needs to change. * Participate in agile ceremonies and rituals — sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives — that keep cross\-functional teams aligned and moving forward. * Manage launches end to end: rollout plans, stakeholder communication, go\-live readiness, and post\-launch monitoring. * Follow up after launch to confirm that what was built is working as intended, and surface issues quickly for resolution. *Partner and measure* * Build strong working relationships with business teams, operations, merchants, and marketing to understand their workflows, pain points, and where AI can genuinely help. * Work with engineering and data teams to track whether AI features are performing as expected — on both technical measures and user and business outcomes. * Collect and synthesize user feedback, usage data, and stakeholder input to inform a continuous improvement backlog. * Advocate for the end user throughout the development process, ensuring AI capabilities are intuitive, trustworthy, and fit for the people who use them. * Provide regular progress updates and impact summaries to senior leadership, grounded in data. **Qualifications** **Who you are:** * Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; or equivalent years of experience preferred. * 5\+ years of product management experience, including 2\+ years working on AI, machine learning, or data\-driven products shipped to real users in production environments. * Demonstrated track record of managing a product roadmap and delivering features end to end, with measurable business outcomes. * Strong ability to listen to stakeholders and users and translate their needs into clear, actionable product requirements. * Solid working knowledge of AI and ML concepts — enough to have substantive conversations with engineers and make grounded trade\-off decisions. * Experience tracking and reporting on the performance of AI products, including both technical and business success metrics. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adjust for engineering, design, business, and executive audiences. * Comfort with ambiguity and a consistent bias toward action, with strong organizational and follow\-through skills. *Preferred Qualifications* * Experience shipping LLM\-powered products, conversational AI, recommendation systems, or agentic workflows to production users. * Familiarity with AI evaluation approaches, responsible AI principles, and the unique considerations of deploying AI features to real users at scale. * Experience with enterprise AI or SaaS platforms such as Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI, or similar. * Comfort working with data — SQL, BI dashboards, or A/B testing frameworks — to independently assess product performance. * Experience in retail, e\-commerce, direct\-to\-consumer, or a similar consumer operating environment. * Demonstrated curiosity about emerging AI technologies and a history of bringing new capabilities to market. **Additional Information** **Our investment in you:** At Vuori, we’re proud to offer the following to our employees: * Health Insurance * Savings and Retirement Plan * Employee Assistance Program * Generous Vuori Discount \& Industry Perks * Paid Time Off * Wellness \& Fitness benefits The salary range for this role is $137,300 per year \- $176,610 per year. This role is bonus eligible. Vuori is proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer
jobs.description: We’re hiring a Senior Systems Engineer as WRA builds its new internal IT \& Cybersecurity functions. We are actively transitioning from an MSP model to a fully in\-house model, and this role will operate under the guidance of our Director of Information Technology \& Cybersecurity. This is also an excellent role for someone looking to refine their cybersecurity skillset. In this role, you will act as the primary engineer for our cloud and SaaS platforms, including Microsoft 365, Azure infrastructure, Entra ID, endpoint management, and a variety of general platforms used by each of our departments. Initially, most of your time will focus on standing up new tools and assisting in the migration of select tools used by our MSP. Afterwards, your general duties will shift to engineering Azure Virtual Desktop, Microsoft 365/Entra ID, endpoint management and building automations. You will be highly autonomous and will work closely with your Director to maintain and improve our current technology stack. Our 100\-person workforce is highly distributed, and your priority is engineering our tools to enable our staff to do their best work securely, efficiently and consistently. WRA has offices in the San Francisco Bay Area (San Rafael, Petaluma, and Emeryville) and in San Diego. This position may be performed fully remotely by candidates located in California, Colorado, Arizona, or Oregon but travel to our offices may be necessary 1 – 2 times per year on average. Candidates in the Denver metro area are especially encouraged to apply. ### **In this role, you will be responsible for:** Cloud Infrastructure * Own our Azure environment, including Azure Virtual Desktop and virtual servers, which enables our CAD, GIS and Accounting teams. This includes image management, patching, right\-sizing, scaling and scheduling, backups, performance optimization, and software versioning. * Deploy actionable virtual machine monitoring to measure performance (CPU, GPU, memory, disk and session latency), idle capacity and active use time, and implement alerts to monitor these metrics. * Perform root\-cause analysis of virtual infrastructure concerns and propose solutions. * Administer our Microsoft 365 environment, including Exchange, SharePoint \& OneDrive, Teams and data governance. * Engage with your Director and our specialized departments to ensure their tools are appropriately sized, configured and performant. * Co\-manage our SaaS and cloud infrastructure backup platforms, including for Microsoft 365, Azure virtual machines and other platforms. Identity \& Access Management (IAM) * Administer Entra ID and SSO, including conditional access, authentication, dynamic groups, and guest access governance. * Own employee identity lifecycle automations for onboarding, offboarding and role changes. * Maintain SCIM provisioning across our SaaS applications. Endpoint \& Mobile Device Management * Manage our Windows and limited Mac fleet by administering our endpoint management platform, including device enrollment, Autopilot, compliance \& configuration policies, app deployments and system patching. * Manage our mobile device configuration and application policies. AI \& Automations * Automate IT processes using PowerShell, Microsoft Graph and other platforms to reduce or eliminate manual administrative tasks and to ensure consistent quality. * Collaborate with your Director and other stakeholders to improve our implementation of Claude AI, including Connector configurations, Skills and Design. Cybersecurity * Partner with your Director to build new security operations capabilities from product selection and concept trials through implementation and administration. * Alongside your Director, administer our security stack, including our managed detection and response platform, email security, DNS and web filtering, and vulnerability management. * Participate in our incident response process, including investigations and root\-cause analyses, and apply technical containment measures as directed or delegated. * Assist in strengthening our infrastructure to be compliant with industry\-standard benchmarks such as CMMC and NIST SP 800\-171\. General IT Support * Work with our IT Operations Specialist as needed and serve as a final escalation point for complex IT Support requests. * Participate in an on\-call rotation for critical but rare IT outages and other emergent duties. Change Management \& Documentation * Maintain runbooks, architecture diagrams, and system configuration documentation. Documentation must be considered a deliverable – not a “nice to have.” * Follow industry\-standard Change Management practices for all system changes. ### **To be successful in this role, you will need:** Experience \& Location * At least 6 years of direct experience supporting a hybrid or remote workforce of at least 50 employees as an engineer. * Comfortable working fully remote with travel to our offices in California as described above. * Able to demonstrat lude lifting up to 50 lbs, climbing ladders indoors, crawling under furniture and reaching behind wall\-mounted equipment. Bonus Points for experience with or having: * Supporting CAD and GIS applications, such as AutoCAD, Civil 3D, ArcGIS and spatial datasets. * Supporting Egnyte, Deltek VantagePoint, Elevia or markup tools like Bluebeam and Adobe Acrobat. * Microsoft certifications, including (but not limited to) AZ\-104, AZ\-140, AZ\-305, AZ\-700, SC\-200, SC\-300, SC\-401, MS\-102 or MD\-102\. * Familiarity with industry\-standard frameworks, such as CMMC L1/L2, NIST SP 800\-171, CCPA, SOC 2, ITSM, or ITIL. * Executing platform migrations using third\-party tools and/or PowerShell. * Integrating IAM automations into ITSM platforms such as Jira, Freshservice, Zendesk or SolarWinds. * Supporting the implementation of data retention policies. * Administering UniFi Network and Protect. WRA has an established internal leveling system for our staff that maps to salary bands that have been informed by market data. Our leveling system is dependent on years of relevant industry experience, education, and the level of responsibility and autonomy at which you’re expected to operate. We have posted a salary range that corresponds to the appropriate level for this position. In your first conversation with our recruiter, we will discuss leveling and compensation with you to make sure that our expectations are aligned. * The salary range for this position is $130,000 – $145,000 **Who are we?** WRA’s an employee\-owned environmental consultancy. We are a tenacious team of planners, engineers, and scientists, and we aim to leave the lands we love better than we found them. Our clients and partners hire us because we’re skilled at navigating through challenging projects involving wildlands, parks, community spaces, and infrastructure. We bring over four decades of expertise, long\-standing relationships, and connections to our local communities to make sure that projects are pursued in responsible ways where both people and the environment thrive. As an organization, we believe that independence and interdependence are not mutually exclusive. We invest in systems, processes, and employee programs to support our staff’s collective engagement and success. At the same time, we encourage our employees to operate with an ownership mindset, taking responsibility for outcomes and being true to our commitments. WRA’s company vision is to cultivate a sustainable future where people and the environment thrive, and that effort starts first with our staff. We are committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive work environment, and we have developed flexible policies, internal practices, and are investing in programs that prioritize learning and sustainability. We aim to create conditions that allow employees to prioritize their families, lead healthy and balanced lives, and to bring their authentic selves to work every day. We believe that by creating an exceptional workplace, our employees will be able to do their best work and be able to meaningfully contribute to the sustainability of the environment and the communities in which we live. WRA is an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to creating a diverse environment. We recruit, employ, train, compensate and promote regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, disability, age, veteran status, and other protected status as required by applicable law. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: CTO / Senior Developer (part-time, remote)
jobs.description: Way Labs, St. Louis, Missouri. Part\-time, remote (US time zones). We are replacing a 20\-year\-old e\-commerce, warehouse and retail system with a new cloud platform, and we need one senior engineer to be its technical owner: the person who keeps it running, proves it is right, and answers the phone when something breaks. The business behind it is real and busy: several storefronts, two retail stores, a 60,000 square foot warehouse with an automated packing line, Amazon, Walmart and other marketplaces, a 3PL business and a subscription club. Millions of orders of history. How the work is done: most of the code is written by AI coding agents under the owner's direction, and the business rules have been documented module by module. You are not hired to type the code. You are hired to own it: review the architecture, run the data migration, keep the integrations and hosting healthy, and make sure the system is proven correct before each part goes live. You are comfortable working alongside AI agents, reading what they produce, and judging it by tests and evidence, not by eye. What you will do: 1\. Review the data model and architecture (a paid trial task to start). 2\. Lead the data migration: about 6\.7 million orders, 18\.5 million lines, customers, stock, gift cards and rewards, from the old Postgres database into the new one. Practice runs, reconciliation to the cent, and a rollback plan. 3\. Own the integrations: Amazon, Walmart, eBay, Shopify, Faire; FedEx, USPS and UPS; Square, Braintree and PayPal; TaxCloud; Signifyd. 4\. Own the proof: the test suite, the replay of real order history against the old system, and the nightly side\-by\-side run before cutover. Nothing switches on without passing evidence. 5\. Hosting, security and reliability on AWS: backups with tested restores, monitoring and alerts, the web application firewall, and a weekly security review. 6\. Technical lead on the switch weekend in January. 7\. After go\-live: the responsible engineer when the owner is not around, with on\-call for real problems. What you bring: 1\. 10\+ years building and running production systems, ideally e\-commerce, order management, warehouse or ERP. 2\. Strong Postgres: schema design, large data migrations, performance and row\-level security. 3\. TypeScript and Node, with React for admin screens. 4\. Real experience with carrier, payment and marketplace APIs. 5\. AWS (or similar) operations: deployments, backups, monitoring and incident response. 6\. Hands\-on use of AI coding tools such as Claude Code, and the judgment to verify what they produce. 7\. Calm, plain\-English communication with a non\-technical owner. You say what you checked and what you could not. Nice to have: ColdFusion (the old system), Supabase, Vercel, warehouse automation. Hours and pay: about 10 to 20 hours a week through the January cutover, then about 5 to 10 a week through April, then 2 to 4 a week plus a monthly on\-call retainer. $100 to $150 an hour depending on experience, as a contractor. Long\-term relationship. To apply: send a short note on the largest data migration you have led and how you proved it was right, plus your experience with AI coding tools. A link to your work or LinkedIn profile is enough; no cover letter needed. Pay: $100\.00 \- $150\.00 per hour Expected hours: 10\.0 – 20\.0 per week Benefits: * Flexible schedule Application Question(s): * Describe the largest data migration you have led: the size, where it moved from and to, and how you proved the result was correct. * Which of these have you integrated in production: Amazon SP\-API, Walmart, Shopify, FedEx, USPS, UPS, Square, Braintree, TaxCloud? Describe one hard problem you solved with one of them. * Which AI coding tools do you use today, and how do you check what they produce before it goes live? * At 9 PM on Black Friday, the tax service starts failing at checkout. What do you do in the first 30 minutes? * How many hours a week can you commit through January, and can you be on call after go\-live? Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Lead Data Engineer
jobs.description: **About this role:** Within COO Technology, Wells Fargo is seeking a Lead Data Engineer to help shape and scale our cloud‑native data ecosystem. In this role, you will focus on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services and frameworks, leading the design, build, and operation of reusable data capabilities that power analytics and AI at enterprise scale. The ideal candidate is passionate about standardized frameworks, self‑service data platforms, and governance‑by‑design, enabling secure, reliable, and compliant data solutions across Google Cloud services. The COO Technology group powers the firm’s most critical operations by modernizing and optimizing enterprise technology platforms that enable resiliency, regulatory excellence, data services, customer experience, and strategic execution across the Chief Operating Office. **In this role, you will:** * Design and implement scalable, secure data platforms on Google Cloud using managed services (BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage, Composer).) * Build reusable frameworks and tooling (ingestion, transformation, quality, orchestration) that can be adopted by multiple product and domain teams. * Enable self‑service data consumption and governance by standardizing patterns, templates, and platform capabilities rather than one‑off pipelines. * Design logical and physical data platform architectures leveraging BigQuery, Dataflow/Apache Beam, Dataproc/Spark, Pub/Sub, and Cloud Storage. * Define and implement standardized ingestion, transformation, and serving patterns (batch and streaming) as reusable blueprints. * Optimize cost, performance, and reliability of GCP data workloads (partitioning, clustering, storage classes, autoscaling strategies). * Build jobs.title: AI Transformation Engineer
jobs.description: Yext (NYSE: YEXT) is the enterprise agentic marketing platform. Built on the world's most comprehensive structured data platform for local businesses, Yext gives brands and their partners the visibility intelligence to win every moment of discovery – across AI and traditional search. Yext's API\-first architecture connects structured data to APIs, MCP servers, and generative interfaces, so partners and developers can build purpose\-built experiences on the same infrastructure powering Yext's own products. Thousands of brands and digital marketing partners in financial services, healthcare, retail, hospitality, and food rely on Yext to manage, measure, and optimize visibility at scale. For more information, visit yext.com. The AI Transformation Office partners with departments across Yext to improve business outcomes through 30 to 60 day transformation sprints. As an **AI Transformation Engineer**, you build the production systems that make that real: retrieval, answer drafting, routing and evaluation on live data, plus the APIs, automations and pipelines around them. Each sprint ends with a handoff to the team that owns the outcome. This is not a product\-roadmap engineering role. You embed with department teams, learn how work actually gets done, and build with whatever fits. That is usually a workflow platform such as n8n first, and code only where the platform runs out. You care as much about whether someone else can run your work as whether it runs in production. You build and you teach, as one motion. **What You'll Do** Production LLM systems (40%) * Build and run production LLM workflows in n8n and similar platforms: retrieval over ticket and documentation data, answer drafting and routing. * Build APIs, integrations and data pipelines that connect CRM, support and operational systems. * Build and calibrate confidence scoring so teams know when to trust an answer, and design the review steps and approval gates where a person decides. * Protect the data you work with: scope what each workflow can read, handle PII and sensitive fields, and keep access logs. * Ship every solution monitored, error\-handled and version\-controlled, not just functional. Evals and quality (15%) * Define evals before each build: test sets, groundedness and accuracy checks, and the thresholds that decide whether output ships or needs review. * Report quality results to partner teams in plain terms. * Track LLM spend and usage by team, manage API keys, and report run rate. Knowledge transfer and enablement (20%) * Pair\-build with embedded team members so they learn by doing, not by watching. * Write documentation that scales: runbooks, admin guides, architecture diagrams and decision logs. * Train department champions at the right altitude: enough to maintain and extend, not enough to overwhelm. * Build with handoff in mind from day one. jobs.title: Lead Platform Engineer (Full-Stack)
jobs.description: **Lead Platform Engineer (Full\-Stack) (Troy, MI \- Hybrid (Remote and In Person))** Our dynamic, mid\-sized IP law firm represents the world's leading computer software and hardware innovators—from early\-stage startups to unicorns and global Fortune 100 companies. Our work spans cutting\-edge technologies including artificial intelligence, autonomous vehicles, video encoding, quantum computing, and cloud computing. With approximately 50 attorneys and 30 staff across Michigan, California, and several other states, we are entering a phase of continued growth and organizational maturity. We are seeking a highly autonomous and experienced technical lead for our application platform on a **contract\-to\-hire** basis. You should be highly proficient in modern AI\-assisted development tools (Claude Code or similar) and able to leverage them effectively for design, coding, debugging, and productivity. As our senior technical lead, you will be the primary internal technical authority, responsible for everything from database schema design in MSSQL to the overall architecture, standards, governance, and delivery of the platform and the applications built on it. You may do much of the building yourself, with work supported by third\-party developers, or direct a small team as we grow. You should be ready for both. Key Point: We expect you to use AI coding tools like Claude Code as a daily part of your workflow, and to build AI\-powered features into our applications by calling model APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, or Azure OpenAI) and building or integrating MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers that connect AI tools to our data and systems. These should be built into the platform as reusable, governed services that attorneys and developers can build on safely. Type: Contract\-to\-hire (3–6 months), converting to full\-time. This is a new role. We are looking for someone who is eager to build something and earn the role of leading it. Salary: Salary range will be discussed with qualified candidates Excellent written and spoken English is required for this position. **Responsibilities** * End\-to\-End Ownership: Lead the full SDLC, including requirement gathering, system architecture, coding, testing, deployment, and documentation. * Platform Architecture: Design and build a platform that others can build on, including shared services, templates, and a governed path for attorneys and developers to take an application from prototype or spec to production, with sandboxes, review, and controlled promotion. Set technical direction across our Azure environment, including the core platform and the applications and workflows built on it. * Infrastructure \& DevOps: Manage and improve our Azure environments, CI/CD pipelines, and version control. * Database Ownership: Own the MSSQL / Azure SQL data layer, including schema design, backups, migrations, and performance tuning. * Security \& Compliance: Ensure all applications are secure by design, implementing authentication and authorization (Entra ID, managed identities, least privilege) and protecting against common vulnerabilities. Work with our IT on identity, network isolation, access policy, and security testing. * Technical Leadership: Scope, assign, and review work from contract or third\-party developers, set the standards they work to, and mentor attorney technologists. * Technical Roadmap: Advise leadership on technology choices, build\-versus\-buy decisions, technical debt, and future scalability requirements. **Required Skills** Backend: Expert in modern backend ecosystems, including knowledge of .NET and C\#. Must be comfortable building clean, maintainable logic independently and setting the standard others build to. * Database: Mastery of MSSQL. You must be able to design schemas and write efficient T\-SQL independently. * Frontend: Working proficiency in JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3, with the ability to oversee or integrate front\-end work performed by third\-party developers. Deep front\-end specialization is not required. * AI: Hands\-on experience shipping production software with AI\-assisted development tools, reviewing and governing AI\-generated code, and building features on model APIs. * Architectural: Proven ability to design platforms, templates, and patterns that other people build on, with governance and self\-service deployment, and that keep the codebase manageable as it grows. **Important Qualities** * Ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines without daily supervision or a project manager. * Ability to debug issues anywhere in the stack, from a CSS alignment bug to a database deadlock or a server configuration error. * Ability to balance “perfect code” with the need to deliver functional business value in a timely manner. * Disciplined approach to documenting the codebase and system architecture so that the system remains maintainable by whoever comes next, including AI agents. * A builder who can lead: you have built systems from the ground up and led others in building them, and you are as effective working alone as directing a team. * Motivated to create something: you want to shape a new role and platform, and are results oriented. * Ability to work with technically minded attorneys as collaborators, not just users. **Qualifications** * Experience: 5\+ years of professional experience, including time as technical lead, architect, or the senior engineer responsible for production systems, ideally with at least one previous role in a startup or small\-team environment where you had high levels of independence. * Leadership: Experience directing developers or contractors, including remote or offshore teams: scoping the work, reviewing it, and holding to a standard. * Environment: Experience in a regulated or confidentiality\-sensitive field such as legal, healthcare, finance, or government. * Tools: Proficient with Git, Visual Studio, SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS), Azure DevOps, and Azure. * Communication: Strong ability to explain technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders, including partners and firm leadership.
